papers.title: Wat3R: Underwater 3D Geometry Learning without Annotations
papers.abstract_en: Estimating 3D geometry in underwater environments presents unique challenges due to light attenuation, scattering, and the absence of large-scale, high-quality 3D annotations. Pioneering methods rely on massive dense annotations that are impractical in underwater settings. In this paper, we propose Wat3R, a cross-domain semi-supervised learning framework designed to adapt feed-forward 3D reconstruction models from air to underwater scenes. Uniquely, our method eliminates the need for any annotated underwater data following a teacher-student architecture, that learns robust geometry representations merely on abundant unlabeled real underwater video footage. We also design a cross-view consistency loss that leverages geometric cues from other views to compensate for the information degradation in the current view caused by water attenuation and scattering. Furthermore, considering the lack of comprehensive evaluation benchmarks, we construct Water3D, a diverse dataset covering various water bodies and underwater scenarios, designed for geometric task evaluation. Experimental results demonstrate that Wat3R outperforms current state-of-the-art methods in underwater multi-view depth estimation and point cloud reconstruction. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/LSXI7/Wat3R .
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/LSXI7/Wat3R
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Wat3R，一个跨域半监督学习框架，用于将前馈3D重建模型从空气场景适配到水下场景，无需任何水下标注数据，仅使用无标注水下视频。通过师生架构和跨视角一致性损失，利用多视图几何线索补偿水体衰减和散射造成的信息退化。同时构建了Water3D数据集用于几何任务评估。实验表明Wat3R在水下多视图深度估计和点云重建上优于当前SOTA。
Motivation: 水下环境的光衰减和散射使得获取大规模高质量3D标注困难，现有方法依赖密集标注，不适用水下场景。
Method: 采用师生架构（teacher-student）的跨域半监督学习，在大量无标注水下视频上学习鲁棒几何表示；设计跨视角一致性损失，利用其他视图几何线索补偿当前视图的信息退化。
Result: 实验表明Wat3R在水下多视图深度估计和点云重建任务上优于当前最先进方法。
Conclusion: 消除了水下3D重建对标注数据的依赖，并提供了Water3D评估基准。代码和数据集已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ZipDepth: Bringing Lightweight Zero-Shot Monocular Depth Anywhere, on Any Device
papers.abstract_en: Monocular depth estimation has seen remarkable progress through foundation models achieving robust zero-shot generalization, yet their computational demands place them far beyond the reach of embedded and mobile platforms. Lightweight alternatives exist, but have been developed almost exclusively within single-domain, self-supervised paradigms, failing silently under domain shift. We present ZipDepth, a compact monocular depth network that bridges this gap by combining an efficient reparameterizable encoder-decoder with large-scale knowledge distillation from a foundation model over a large multi-domain training set. Comprising just 6.1M parameters, ZipDepth runs at real-time rates from server GPUs to power-constrained devices, achieving the best trade-off between zero-shot accuracy and deployment efficiency among lightweight models across five benchmarks, taking a significant step towards the accuracy of foundation models with 50x more parameters.
papers.comment: ECCV 2026. Code: https://github.com/fabiotosi92/ZipDepth - Project page: https://zipdepth.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ZipDepth 提出一种轻量级零样本单目深度估计网络，仅 6.1M 参数，通过可重参数化编码器-解码器与大规模多领域知识蒸馏实现实时运行，在五个基准上取得最佳准确率与效率权衡。
Motivation: 现有单目深度估计基础模型虽泛化性强但计算量大，无法部署在嵌入式或移动设备；轻量级模型虽效率高但多局限于单域自监督，域迁移时失效。
Method: 结合高效的可重参数化编码器-解码器架构与从基础模型进行的大规模多领域知识蒸馏，在保持紧凑的同时提升零样本泛化能力。
Result: 模型仅 6.1M 参数，可在从服务器 GPU 到低功耗设备上实时运行，在五个零样本基准上取得了轻量级模型中最佳的准确率与部署效率权衡。
Conclusion: ZipDepth 显著缩小了轻量级模型与参数多 50 倍的基础模型之间的精度差距，为资源受限设备上的零样本单目深度估计提供了可行方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LongE2V: Long-Horizon Event-based Video Reconstruction, Prediction, and Frame Interpolation with Video Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Recovering high-quality video from sparse event streams is a challenging task. Regression methods often blur textures, while existing generative models struggle with long-term stability. We propose LongE2V, a novel approach that leverages pre-trained video diffusion priors to jointly handle event-based video reconstruction, prediction, and frame interpolation. By fine-tuning a foundational video model, our approach achieves high data efficiency and superior perceptual quality. We introduce Autoregressive Unrolling and Adaptive Context Switching to mitigate temporal drift in extremely long sequences. We also propose Reencoding Alignment with Cross Residual Correction to ensure precise bidirectional consistency during frame interpolation. Furthermore, Event Voxel Density Augmentation ensures robustness across varying sensor resolutions. Extensive experiments on real-world benchmarks demonstrate that LongE2V outperforms state-of-the-art methods across all three tasks, exhibiting exceptional temporal coherence and zero-shot generalization. Project page: https://cdfan0627.github.io/LongE2V-page/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LongE2V，利用预训练视频扩散模型（video diffusion prior）联合处理事件相机（event camera）的视频重建、预测和帧插值任务。通过微调基础视频模型、引入自回归展开与自适应上下文切换（Autoregressive Unrolling and Adaptive Context Switching）减轻长序列漂移，以及重编码对齐与跨残差校正（Reencoding Alignment with Cross Residual Correction）实现帧插值双向一致性。实验表明，该方法在多个真实基准上超越现有方法，具有优异的时间一致性和零样本泛化能力。
Motivation: 从稀疏事件流恢复高质量视频具有挑战性，回归方法易模糊纹理，现有生成模型长期稳定性不足。
Method: 基于预训练视频扩散模型微调，提出自回归展开与自适应上下文切换减少时序漂移，重编码对齐与跨残差校正确保帧插值双向一致性，以及事件体素密度增强（Event Voxel Density Augmentation）提升对不同传感器分辨率的鲁棒性。
Result: 在真实基准上，该方法在事件视频重建、预测和帧插值三个任务中均超越最先进方法，并展现出优异的时间一致性和零样本泛化能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法利用视频扩散先验有效解决了事件视频的长时序生成问题，但未明确提及局限性或适用范围。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Geometry and Gradient-based Partitioning for Panoramic Outdoor Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Scaling 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) to large outdoor scenes is costly in both data acquisition and computation. Adopting panoramic images with equirectangular projection (ERP) can reduce capture effort via their full $360^{\circ}$ field of view, yet the resulting omnipresent visibility invalidates existing partitioning strategies that rely on local camera frustums, causing block-wise optimization to degenerate into global training. Thus, we propose PanoLOG, a two-stage coarse-to-fine framework equipped with a Geometry and Gradient-based Partitioning Strategy tailored for large-scale panoramic 3DGS reconstruction. In the global coarse stage, PanoLOG leverages sky-sphere modeling and panoramic monocular depth supervision for reliable geometry, while in the refinement stage, G$^2$PS builds adaptive bounding volumes via parallax-driven uncertainty and assigns cameras via gradient-based importance scoring. Furthermore, we construct Pano360, the first benchmark on large-scale panoramic dataset for outdoor scene reconstruction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that G$^2$PS achieves state-of-the-art rendering quality while maintaining scalable, block-parallel training. Our models, training code, and dataset are publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PanoLOG，一种面向大规模全景户外场景的三维高斯溅射（3DGS）重建框架，包含全局粗阶段和局部精化阶段。在粗阶段使用天空球建模和全景单目深度监督，在精化阶段提出基于几何和梯度的分区策略（G$^2$PS），通过视差驱动的不确定性和梯度重要性评分构建自适应边界体积和相机分配。同时构建了首个大规模全景户外场景重建基准Pano360。实验表明方法在渲染质量上达到最优，并支持可扩展的块并行训练。
Motivation: 将3DGS扩展到大型户外场景成本高昂，使用全景图像可减少采集成本，但全景图像的全局可见性使得现有依赖局部相机视锥的分区策略失效，导致块优化退化为全局训练。
Method: 两阶段粗到细框架：粗阶段通过天空球建模和全景单目深度监督获得可靠几何；精化阶段使用G$^2$PS，基于视差驱动的不确定性构建自适应边界体积，并通过梯度重要性评分分配相机。
Result: 在Pano360基准上达到最先进的渲染质量，并支持可扩展的块并行训练。
Conclusion: G$^2$PS能有效实现全景户外场景的可扩展3DGS重建，且模型、代码和数据集已公开。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: OPSD-V: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Post-Training Few-Step Autoregressive Video Generators
papers.abstract_en: We propose OPSD-V, an on-policy self-distillation paradigm for post-training few-step autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models. Existing few-step AR video generators can produce long videos with low latency, but still suffer from error accumulation and weakened motion dynamics during long autoregressive rollout. OPSD-V reduces long-horizon degradation while preserving the original few-step inference path. The key idea is to introduce real long-video data as temporal context during training and use it to provide dense trajectory-level supervision. Specifically, the student follows the exact inference-time rollout, generating each chunk conditioned on its own previously generated KV cache. In parallel, the teacher is evaluated at the same student-visited denoising states, but uses a cleaner AR-consistent temporal cache in which older history can be replaced by real-video context. This provides dense denoising-level corrective targets under on-policy AR cache dynamics, without changing the sampler, number of denoising steps, or inference-time cache mechanism. We apply OPSD-V to representative few-step AR video models, including Self-Forcing and LongLive. Experiments show consistent improvements in visual quality, motion dynamics, and VBenchLong scores. A user study with 10 participants comparing 20 video pairs shows that OPSD-V is preferred over the base models in 66.0% of overall-preference judgments (82.5% excluding ties).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OPSD-V，一种用于后训练少步自回归视频扩散模型的在策略自蒸馏方法。通过引入真实长视频作为时间上下文，在训练时提供密集轨迹级监督，减少长自回归生成中的误差累积和运动动态减弱，同时保持原始少步推理路径。在 Self-Forcing 和 LongLive 等模型上实验，一致提升视觉质量、运动动态和 VBenchLong 分数，用户偏好率 66%。
Motivation: 现有少步自回归视频生成器在长 roll-out 中误差累积严重，导致运动动态减弱和视觉质量下降。
Method: 学生在推理时自回归生成每个块，条件于自己先前生成的 KV 缓存；教师在同一去噪状态下使用更干净的缓存（用真实视频替换旧历史），提供密集的去噪级校正目标。不改变采样器、去噪步数或推理缓存机制。
Result: 在 Self-Forcing 和 LongLive 上，视觉质量、运动动态和 VBenchLong 分数均一致提升；10 人用户研究中 66.0% 偏好 OPSD-V（排除平局后为 82.5%）。
Conclusion: OPSD-V 在不改变推理流程的前提下，有效缓解长自回归视频生成中的退化，且适用于多种少步模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Enhancing In-context Panoramic Generation via Geometric-aware Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we present Canvas360, a two-stage framework for in-context panoramic generation that combines geometry-aware pretraining with downstream task-specific fine-tuning. To address the lack of large-scale, high-quality training data tailored to in-context panoramic tasks, we propose Canvas360Dataset, a collection of 1M high-quality paired panoramic samples for style transfer, inpainting, outpainting, and editing, enabling effective supervision across diverse in-context generation scenarios. On the modeling side, Canvas360 enhances text-to-panorama generation through parallel depth generation, velocity circular padding, and similarity loss regularization, enabling the model to learn geometry-aware representations, capture object distortion details, and improve geometric consistency and global coherence. Furthermore, empowered by strong panoramic priors, Canvas360 enables a unified in-context panoramic generation framework that supports diverse downstream tasks via token-level concatenation, surpassing prior methods in both task coverage and modeling flexibility. Extensive experiments show that Canvas360 improves panoramic image fidelity, achieving particularly strong performance on the panorama-specific FAED metric and competitive or leading results across the reported quantitative evaluations. More information can be found on our project page: https://zry000.github.io/Canvas360/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Canvas360，一个两阶段框架，通过几何感知预训练和下游微调实现上下文全景图像生成。同时贡献了包含100万对高质量全景样本的数据集 Canvas360Dataset，支持风格迁移、修复、扩展和编辑等多样任务。实验表明该方法在全景专用指标 FAED 上表现优异。
Motivation: 现有上下文全景生成任务缺乏大规模高质量训练数据，且模型难以处理全景图像的几何畸变和全局一致性。
Method: 提出两阶段框架：先进行几何感知预训练（含并行深度生成、速度循环填充和相似性损失正则化），再在下游任务中通过 token 级拼接实现统一上下文全景生成。
Result: 在全景专用 FAED 指标上取得显著提升，并在多项定量评价中达到有竞争力或领先的结果。
Conclusion: Canvas360 通过几何感知预训练和统一框架，提升了全景生成的质量和任务覆盖范围，但摘要未提及局限性。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在全景专用 FAED 指标上取得显著提升，并在多项定量评价中达到有竞争力或领先的结果。
summary_sections.conclusion: Canvas360 通过几何感知预训练和统一框架，提升了全景生成的质量和任务覆盖范围，但摘要未提及局限性。

papers.title: OpenCoF: Learning to Reason Through Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning has become a core capability for large models, especially when reliable decisions require understanding logical consequences. Recent video generation models offer a reasoning path distinct from previous Chain-of-Thought (CoT): reasoning can unfold through temporally connected frames, known as Chain-of-Frame (CoF) reasoning. However, existing video generators are primarily trained on general video corpora, still lacking diverse supervision and dedicated designs for CoF reasoning. To address this gap, we introduce OpenCoF, a framework comprising the OpenCoF-17K dataset, a reasoning video dataset spanning 11 task families, and Wan-CoF, a fine-tuned video model for studying whether diverse temporal supervision improves CoF behavior. Across four video reasoning benchmarks, Wan-CoF achieves considerable gains over the Wan2.2-I2V-A14B baseline. Building on this, we empirically explore more advanced designs for CoF capabilities, i.e., equipping the model with visual and textual reasoning tokens. This mechanism respectively captures low-level visual cues and high-level semantic priors for spatial and temporal reasoning. Through performance comparisons and attention analysis, we examine how these tokens contribute across model depth, denoising steps, space, and time. Our results suggest that stronger video reasoning requires both broad temporal supervision and explicit mechanisms for organizing intermediate reasoning state. We open-source the dataset, model, and code to facilitate future research on reasoning-oriented video generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OpenCoF 提出一个面向视频生成推理的框架，包含推理视频数据集 OpenCoF-17K（覆盖 11 个任务家族）和微调模型 Wan-CoF。在四个视频推理基准上，Wan-CoF 相较于基线 Wan2.2-I2V-A14B 获得显著提升。论文进一步引入视觉和文本推理令牌来显式组织中间推理状态，并通过注意力分析探究其贡献。
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型主要训练于通用视频数据，缺乏针对 Chain-of-Frame 推理的多样化监督和专门设计，限制了其在逻辑推理任务中的表现。
Method: 构建 OpenCoF-17K 推理视频数据集；基于 Wan2.2 微调得到 Wan-CoF 模型；引入视觉推理令牌和文本推理令牌分别捕捉低级视觉线索和高级语义先验，以支持空间和时间维度的推理。
Result: 在四个视频推理基准上，Wan-CoF 的性能显著超过 Wan2.2-I2V-A14B 基线。通过性能比较和注意力分析，揭示了推理令牌在不同模型深度、去噪步骤以及时空维度的贡献模式。
Conclusion: 更强的视频推理能力既需要广泛的时间监督数据，也需要显式的中间推理状态组织机制。论文已开源数据集、模型和代码以促进后续研究。

papers.title: Ideas Have Genomes: Benchmarking Scientific Lineage Reasoning and Lineage-Grounded Idea Generation
papers.abstract_en: Scientific ideas rarely start from a blank page. They inherit mechanisms, repair known limitations, and recombine pieces of earlier work, much like biological genomes. Current benchmarks still say little about whether AI systems can follow this inheritance structure. We present IdeaGene-Bench (IG-Bench), a benchmark for scientific lineage reasoning and lineage-grounded idea generation. IG-Bench is organized around the IdeaGene framework: each paper or proposal is represented as a set of minimal, typed, evidence-grounded Idea Genome objects, and a GenomeDiff aligns these objects to record inheritance, mutation, loss, external import, and novel insertion under six operational evolutionary dynamics. The benchmark contains 1,961 golden lineage traces, 1,085 curated Idea Genome objects, and 920 pairwise GenomeDiff records across 10 scientific domains. It supports two evaluations. IG-Exam (42 task types, 1,029 instances) tests closed-form lineage reasoning across Idea Genome abstraction, inheritance tracing, evolutionary reasoning, and lineage verification. IG-Arena evaluates generation with a lineage-conditioned Population-Evolution Score(PES), asking whether a proposal can be inserted as a coherent descendant of a given lineage population: it should inherit the right Idea Genome objects, vary meaningfully from nearby work, and offer selection value for future research. Experiments on 14 LLM-based scientists expose a compositional bottleneck. The strongest system reaches only 27.3% exact accuracy on lineage reasoning, and structured lineage context reshuffles system rankings rather than helping every participant uniformly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出IdeaGene-Bench基准，用于评估AI系统在科学谱系推理和基于谱系的创意生成方面的能力。基准包含1961个谱系轨迹、1085个Idea基因组对象和920个GenomeDiff记录，覆盖10个科学领域。评估包括IG-Exam和IG-Arena两种任务，实验表明最强系统仅达到27.3%的准确率，存在组合瓶颈。
Motivation: 当前基准很少评估AI系统是否能够理解科学思想的继承结构（如继承、变异、重组等），因此需要建立评估框架。
Method: 提出IdeaGene框架，将论文表示为Idea基因组对象，用GenomeDiff记录继承、变异、丢失、外部引入和新的插入等操作。基准包括IG-Exam（闭式谱系推理）和IG-Arena（基于谱系条件生成），后者使用种群-进化分数（PES）评估。
Result: 在14个LLM-based scientist上评估，最强系统在谱系推理上仅达到27.3%的精确准确率，结构化谱系上下文会重排系统排名而非均匀提升所有参与者。
Conclusion: 当前AI系统在科学谱系推理上存在组合瓶颈，需要进一步发展。

papers.title: Score Accuracy Along the Forward Diffusion Does Not Certify Numerical Stability in Diffusion Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Score matching controls average error under the forward marginals, but a discretized reverse-time sampler evaluates the learned score along its own trajectory. We show that small forward-marginal error does not guarantee numerical stability. We construct a single smooth score field with arbitrarily small forward-marginal $L^2$ error. The learned reverse-time process is nonexplosive, has moments of every order, and can be arbitrarily close to the exact reverse-time process in path-space total variation. Yet its Euler--Maruyama discretizations converge in probability while every positive moment diverges. Thus weak convergence can hold even though every Wasserstein distance $W_p$, $p\ge1$, diverges. The same failure can occur within one fixed finite neural architecture. We construct a family of bounded, globally Lipschitz denoisers for which both the forward-marginal error and the path-space total variation distance tend to zero, while their Euler--Maruyama endpoints diverge in every $W_p$. For compactly supported data, we also give a simple positive result. Projecting the learned denoiser onto a known bounded closed convex set containing the support preserves pointwise accuracy, gives grid-uniform moment bounds, and yields Wasserstein convergence under mild local regularity. Experiments with a small fixed DiT-style network show large growth along rare numerical trajectories and its suppression by denoiser projection, while overall trajectory errors remain small.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明，分数匹配（score matching）仅保证前向扩散边际下的平均误差，并不能确保反向时间采样的数值稳定性。作者构造了一个平滑的分数场，其前向边际L2误差任意小，但Euler-Maruyama离散化在Wasserstein距离上发散，即使路径空间全变差距离趋近于零。对于紧支撑数据，投影去噪器到已知有界闭凸集可恢复稳定性。实验用小型DiT风格网络验证了理论。
Motivation: 现有工作通常假设分数匹配误差小即可保证采样质量，但该假设忽略了离散化误差与轨迹分布的耦合。本文旨在揭示前向误差小与反向采样数值稳定性之间的根本性脱节。
Method: 构造一个显式的平滑分数场，其前向边际L2误差可控，但Euler-Maruyama离散化的端点矩发散。同时提出投影去噪器方法：将学习的去噪器投影到包含数据支撑集的已知有界闭凸集上，以恢复矩界和Wasserstein收敛。
Result: 数值稳定性失败发生在每个Wasserstein距离W_p（p≥1）发散，尽管弱收敛成立。投影去噪器在保持逐点精度的同时，提供均匀网格矩界并保证Wasserstein收敛。实验显示投影抑制了罕见轨迹上的大增长。
Conclusion: 论文强调前向边际误差不足以作为反向采样稳定性的判据，投影去噪器提供了一种修复手段，但需要已知数据支撑集。局限性在于投影集的选择依赖先验知识。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MulTTiPop: A Multitrack Transcription Dataset for Pop Music
papers.abstract_en: We present MulTTiPop, a dataset of pop music segments and their associated multitrack MIDI recordings for the evaluation of automatic music transcription models. MulTTiPop contains 572 segments of popular music totaling 3.5 hours of audio, and contains songs from diverse genres and decades from the 1930s to 2000s. To collect this dataset, we perform metadata-based matching on song segments from the Lakh MIDI and TheoryTab datasets, manually identify an anchor beat between the audio and MIDI, then use beat tracking on the audio and warp the MIDI to match its tempo and timing. We evaluate state-of-the-art automatic music transcription models on MulTTiPop and find substantial room for improvement, with the best model achieving 38% Onset F1. More details and sound examples of MulTTiPop are available at https://gclef-cmu.org/multtipop.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Associated web preview available at https://gclef-cmu.org/multtipop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了MulTTiPop，一个包含572段流行音乐片段（共3.5小时音频）及其多轨MIDI记录的数据集，用于评估自动音乐转录模型。数据来自Lakh MIDI和TheoryTab数据集，通过元数据匹配和拍点对齐构建。评估现有模型发现最佳模型仅达到38%的Onset F1，表明该任务仍有较大改进空间。
Motivation: 自动音乐转录（automatic music transcription）缺乏高质量的评估数据集，尤其是多轨流行音乐。
Method: 从Lakh MIDI和TheoryTab数据集选取片段，通过元数据匹配音频与MIDI，手动识别锚点拍（anchor beat），再对音频进行节拍跟踪（beat tracking）并弯曲MIDI以对齐节奏和时延。
Result: 最佳模型在MulTTiPop上Onset F1仅为38%，表明现有模型在该数据集上表现有限。
Conclusion: MulTTiPop公开可用，为自动音乐转录研究提供更具挑战性的评估基准。

papers.title: SLORR: Simple and Efficient In-Training Low-Rank Regularization
papers.abstract_en: Low-rank factorization is widely used to compress neural networks, but modern models are often not naturally amenable to aggressive factorization without significant accuracy loss. Existing training-time low-rank regularizers can improve compressibility, but they often require SVDs of large weight matrices, modify the model architecture (introducing additional trainable parameters), or rely on stateful cached quantities. To address these limitations, we introduce SLORR, a simple, stateless, and architecture-preserving framework for in-training low-rank regularization, instantiated with two main variants based on the Hoyer sparsity metric and the nuclear norm. SLORR directly regularizes the original weight matrices using GPU-friendly approximations for the forward and backward passes of the regularizers, for which we provide approximation guarantees. We first evaluate SLORR on ImageNet-1K across short-horizon continued training of ResNet-50, ViT-B/16, and ViT-L/16, and pretraining of ResNet-18, where SLORR induces compressibility while introducing less than 8% training overhead. We further evaluate SLORR-Hoyer in LLM pretraining at 135M and 560M scales: SLORR-trained compressed models preserve performance substantially better than unregularized models while adding less than 1% average training overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SLORR，一个简单、无状态且保持架构的框架，用于训练中的低秩正则化。基于 Hoyer 稀疏度量和核范数两种变体，使用 GPU 友好的近似计算正则化项。在 ImageNet-1K 上对 ResNet-50、ViT-B/16、ViT-L/16 进行短时继续训练及 ResNet-18 预训练，训练开销低于 8%；在 135M 和 560M 规模的 LLM 预训练中，SLORR 训练的压缩模型性能损失远小于未正则化模型，平均训练开销低于 1%。
Motivation: 现有训练时低秩正则化方法常需 SVD 分解大权重矩阵、修改模型架构引入额外参数或依赖有状态缓存变量，限制了效率和实用性。
Method: 提出 SLORR，直接正则化原始权重矩阵，使用 GPU 友好的近似实现前向和后向传播，并提供近似保证。包含基于 Hoyer 稀疏度量和核范数的两种变体。
Result: 在 ImageNet-1K 上，SLORR 在引入 <8% 训练开销的同时诱导压缩性；在 135M 和 560M LLM 预训练中，SLORR-Hoyer 训练的压缩模型性能损失显著小于未正则化模型，平均训练开销 <1%。
Conclusion: SLORR 是一种简单、高效、保持架构的正则化方法，可提升模型压缩性而不引入显著训练开销。

papers.title: Using AI-based Learning Assistants in Higher Education: A Large-Scale Descriptive Analysis
papers.abstract_en: In this study, we present a large-scale descriptive analysis of the use of an AI-based learning assistant (Syntea) in higher education. Based on objective log data from 77,543 students enrolled in distance studies, we examine usage patterns across gender, age group, study cluster, degree, and study mode. To date, existing research on educational chatbots has largely relied on comparatively small samples and self-reported survey data, while large-scale evidence on actual usage behavior remains limited. Our findings show that Syntea is already embedded in the study routines of many learners, but that usage differs across demographic and structural contexts. By identifying these patterns, our study provides an empirical basis for the further development of AI-based learning support and contributes a large-scale analysis of educational chatbot usage in higher education.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对高等教育中AI学习助手Syntea的使用进行了大规模描述性分析，基于77543名远程学习者的客观日志数据，考察了性别、年龄、学习领域、学位和学习方式等维度上的使用模式。现有研究多依赖小样本和自报数据，而本研究提供了大规模实际使用行为的证据。结果表明Syntea已融入许多学习者的学习习惯，但使用情况因人口统计和结构性背景而异。
Motivation: 现有关于教育聊天机器人的研究多基于小样本和自报调查数据，缺乏大规模实际使用行为的证据，因此本研究旨在通过客观日志数据填补这一空白。
Method: 基于77543名远程学习者的客观日志数据，对AI学习助手Syntea的使用进行大规模描述性分析，按性别、年龄组、学习领域、学位和学习方式分组。
Result: 发现Syntea已嵌入许多学习者的学习常规，但使用模式在不同人口统计和结构性背景下存在差异。
Conclusion: 本研究通过识别使用模式为AI学习支持的进一步发展提供了实证基础，并贡献了高等教育中教育聊天机器人使用的大规模分析。

papers.title: Dimensionality Reduction Meets Network Science: Sensemaking on UMAP's kNN Graph
papers.abstract_en: While UMAP is widely used for exploring high-dimensional data, typical workflows focus on its lower-dimensional embedding, largely overlooking the rich k-nearest-neighbor (kNN) graph that UMAP constructs internally. This graph encodes the data manifold in its original high-dimensional space, before the distortion that UMAP's 2D projection introduces. We demonstrate the untapped potential of this internal representation, showing how standard graph algorithms applied to this graph enhance data sensemaking: (1) PageRank identifies representative data points, (2) k-core decomposition reveals dense core regions versus sparse periphery, and (3) clustering coefficient detects tight-knit neighborhoods with highly-similar data points. Through quantitative and qualitative evaluation on MNIST and Fashion MNIST, we show that these graph-based analyses are not only practical but also competitive with or complementary to purpose-built methods (e.g., k-medoids for exemplar selection, HDBSCAN for density-based clustering).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文揭示UMAP内部构建的kNN图在数据理解中的潜力，通过PageRank、k-core分解和聚类系数等图算法增强对高维数据的分析，并在MNIST和Fashion MNIST上验证其有效性。
Motivation: UMAP的典型工作流只关注降维后的2D投影，忽略了内部kNN图所编码的高维数据流形信息，导致潜在的结构信息未被利用。
Method: 对UMAP内部kNN图应用标准图算法：PageRank、k-core分解和聚类系数，分别用于代表性点识别、密度结构分析和紧邻社区检测。
Result: 在MNIST和Fashion MNIST上，这些图分析方法在代表性选择（与k-medoids竞争）和密度聚类（与HDBSCAN互补）方面表现出色。
Conclusion: 作者认为kNN图是UMAP中被低估的资源，图分析可以高效且有效地增强高维数据理解。

papers.title: AUTOPILOT VQA: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models for Incident-Centric Dashcam Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Vision-Language Models, Large Language Models, and Multimodal Large Language Models have improved autonomous driving tasks such as scene understanding, decision making, trajectory prediction, and visual question answering. However, evaluating whether these models can reliably reason about safety-critical incidents remains challenging. To address this gap, we present AUTOPILOT-VQA, an incident-centric visual question answering benchmark for dashcam video understanding. The dataset evaluates different systems through structured questions designed around real-world driving incidents and near-incidents. The benchmark covers diverse safety-relevant categories, including weather and lighting conditions, traffic environment, road layout, road surface state, signage, involved entities, accident occurrence, impact location, and avoidability-related reasoning. By requiring models to answer grounded questions about both contextual scene properties and event-level incident details, AUTOPILOT-VQA moves beyond object recognition toward temporally grounded, safety-aware reasoning. The dataset is released as part of the AUTOPILOT CVPR 2026 competition and provides a standardized benchmark for assessing the reliability of autonomous driving systems in different scenarios. Our benchmark support developments for more interpretable, robust, and safety-conscious vision-language systems for real-world autonomous driving.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AUTOPILOT-VQA，一个面向行车记录仪视频的 incident-centric VQA 基准，用于评估视觉语言模型在驾驶安全关键场景中的推理能力。数据集包含围绕真实驾驶事故和近事故的结构化问题，覆盖天气、交通环境、道路布局、路面状态、标志、涉及实体、事故发生、撞击位置和可避免性推理等类别。该基准旨在推动可解释、鲁棒且安全意识的视觉语言系统发展。
Motivation: 现有模型在自动驾驶场景理解方面取得进展，但缺乏针对安全关键 incident 的可靠推理评估基准。
Method: 构建了一个 incident-centric VQA 数据集，包含基于真实驾驶事故和近事故的结构化问题，涵盖天气、光线、交通环境、道路布局、路面状态、标志、实体、事故、撞击位置和可避免性推理等多个安全相关类别。
Result: 论文未提供具体实验结果，但声称该基准为自动驾驶系统在不同场景下的可靠性提供了标准化评估。
Conclusion: AUTOPILOT-VQA 有助于推动更可解释、鲁棒且安全意识的视觉语言模型在真实自动驾驶中的应用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ARDY: Autoregressive Diffusion with Hybrid Representation for Interactive Human Motion Generation
papers.abstract_en: Generating realistic 3D human motions in real-time within interactive applications is key for animation, simulation, and humanoid robotics. While recent offline motion generation approaches offer precise control via text and kinematic constraints, they lack the inference speed required for interactive settings. Conversely, existing online methods enable real-time synthesis but often sacrifice controllability or struggle with complex text semantics and long-horizon goals due to limited context windows. In this work, we introduce ARDY, a streaming generation framework that bridges this gap by enabling high-fidelity motion generation controllable via online text prompts and flexible kinematic constraints. ARDY employs a hybrid representation that combines explicit root features with a latent body embedding, balancing precise trajectory control with efficient generative learning. We propose a two-stage autoregressive transformer denoiser that features variable history context and supports conditioning on flexible, long-horizon kinematic constraints. By training on a large-scale motion capture dataset and being directly conditioned on text labels and kinematic constraints sampled from ground truth poses, ARDY natively learns controllable generation that supports online prompting and flexible long-horizon goals. Extensive evaluations on the HumanML3D benchmark and the large-scale, high-fidelity Bones Rigplay dataset demonstrate ARDY's high motion quality and constraint adherence, validating the efficacy of our key architectural decisions. Finally, we demonstrate the method's practical versatility through an interactive demo featuring dynamic text control, diverse keyframe pose constraints, path following, and interactive locomotion control via mouse and keyboard. Supplementary video results, code, and model releases can be found at https://research.nvidia.com/labs/sil/projects/ardy/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ARDY，一个基于自回归扩散的流式生成框架，用于交互式人体运动生成。它结合混合表示（显式根特征与隐式身体嵌入）和两阶段自回归 Transformer 去噪器，支持在线文本提示和长时程运动学约束。在 HumanML3D 和 Bones Rigplay 数据集上验证了高质量和约束遵循性，并通过交互演示展示了动态文本控制、关键帧约束、路径跟随等功能。
Motivation: 现有离线运动生成方法推理速度慢，无法满足交互应用需求；在线方法虽实时但牺牲可控性，难以处理复杂文本语义和长时程目标。
Method: 设计混合表示（显式根特征 + 隐式身体嵌入），并提出两阶段自回归 Transformer 去噪器，支持可变历史上下文和灵活的长时程运动学约束，通过大规模动作捕捉数据训练。
Result: 在 HumanML3D 和 Bones Rigplay 数据集上的评估表明，ARDY 在运动质量和约束遵循方面表现优异，验证了关键架构设计的有效性。
Conclusion: ARDY 实现了交互式高保真人体运动生成，支持在线文本和运动学约束控制，代码和模型已开源。

papers.title: Workflow as Knowledge: Semantic Persistence for LLM-Mediated Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) applications increasingly use explicit workflows for tool use, retrieval, branching, checkpointing, and human approval. Existing workflow systems already address many execution concerns. This paper proposes a Lisp-inspired but language-independent conceptual model: symbolic forms, object identity, and live-image thinking are used as explanatory lenses, not implementation commitments. In this model, workflow definitions, workflow instances, inference records, context snapshots, and dependency relations are represented as persistent knowledge objects in a shared knowledge substrate. Its central semantic distinction is between derive and infer: derive is deterministic computation over available state; infer is mediated LLM judgment under declared context and executor-controlled capability policy. The result is a preliminary conceptual account of semantic persistence: workflows do not merely produce knowledge and leave traces, but can themselves be represented as inspectable, resumable, and reviewable knowledge objects, while formal transition semantics remain future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种受Lisp启发的概念模型，将LLM工作流定义、实例、推理记录、上下文快照和依赖关系表示为持久知识对象，强调derive（确定性计算）与infer（LLM判断）的语义区分。该模型旨在使工作流本身成为可检查、可恢复、可审查的知识对象，但正式转换语义仍是未来工作。
Motivation: 现有LLM应用的工作流系统关注执行层面，但缺乏将工作流本身作为持久化知识对象进行表示和管理的概念基础。
Method: 提出基于符号形式、对象身份和实时映像思想的概念模型，在工作流定义、实例、推理记录、上下文快照和依赖关系上建立语义持久性，核心区分derive（确定性计算）和infer（受控LLM推理）。
Conclusion: 初步概念分析表明工作流可作为知识对象持久化，但语义形式化及实现仍需进一步研究。

papers.title: The Illusion of Equivalency: Statistical Characterization of Quantization Effects in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Post-training quantization is widely used to deploy large language models in resource-constrained settings, yet its evaluation relies almost exclusively on accuracy and perplexity. We show that these metrics fail to capture behavioral changes induced by quantization. We introduce correctness agreement, a decision-level metric that measures overlap in correct predictions between a base model and its quantized variants, independent of absolute accuracy. Across multiple models and quantization schemes from 8-bit to 2-bit, we find that behavioral divergence emerges under moderate quantization even when task performance appears preserved. To explain this effect, we analyze quantization as a structural operator on attention weights and quantify layer-wise distortions using statistical and distributional measures. Our results reveal non-linear breakpoints at low bit-widths and show that query and key projections are consistently more sensitive than value and output projections. These findings expose an illusion of equivalence between base and quantized models and motivate behavioral evaluation beyond conventional performance metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示标准精度和困惑度指标无法捕捉LLM量化带来的行为变化。引入决策级指标“正确一致性”测量基模型与量化变体间正确预测的重叠，发现中等量化下即使任务性能看似保留，行为已出现分歧。通过统计和分布度量分析量化对注意力权重的结构性影响，发现低比特宽度下的非线性转折点，并表明query和key投影比value和output投影更敏感。
Motivation: 现有后训练量化评估仅依赖准确率和困惑度，这些指标无法反映量化引起的行为变化，存在等价假象。
Method: 提出正确一致性（correctness agreement）指标，独立于绝对准确率；利用统计和分布度量分析量化作为注意力权重上的结构算子，逐层量化失真。
Result: 多项模型和量化方案（8-bit到2-bit）实验显示，行为分歧在中等量化时即出现，即使任务性能未明显下降；低比特宽度存在非线性断裂点；query和key投影比value和output投影更敏感。
Conclusion: 这些发现暴露了基模型与量化模型之间的等价假象，促使超越传统性能指标的行为评估。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Super Weights in LLMs and the Failure of Selective Training
papers.abstract_en: Recent work identified Super Weights, individual parameters whose removal degrades model performance by orders of magnitude. We show that this degradation due to pruning Super Weights does not universally apply to all LLMs. Furthermore, if these parameters are so important, Super Weight-aware training should be effective. We show the opposite. Training Super Weights in isolation (100 to 8,192 parameters) drops accuracy to random-guessing levels on both OLMo-1B and OLMo-7B, and expanding to local neighborhoods of up to 36K parameters provides no improvement. The failure is specific to Super Weight coordinates: training an equal number of randomly chosen positions in the same down_proj layers instead improves over the baseline, so the collapse comes from targeting Super Weights, not from sparsity itself. Vanilla LoRA, updating every position in attention weight matrices through low-rank structure, succeeds with only 0.16% of parameters, and applying the same low-rank update to down_proj succeeds as well. A 10-seed ablation confirms that constraining LoRA updates at positions corresponding to Super Weight coordinates yields statistically indistinguishable results. These findings establish that parameter importance does not imply parameter trainability in isolation, and that effective fine-tuning relies on structured decompositions over entire layers rather than targeting individually important weights.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Conference on Language Modeling (COLM) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了大型语言模型中的超级权重（Super Weights）现象，发现移除这些参数导致的性能退化并非普遍适用，且单独训练超级权重会导致准确率降至随机猜测水平，而结构化低秩更新（如LoRA）却能有效微调。
Motivation: 先前研究认为LLM中存在极少数关键参数（超级权重），其移除会严重损害模型性能。本文质疑这一发现是否具有普适性，并探究针对这些参数进行训练是否能带来收益。
Method: 在OLMo-1B和OLMo-7B模型上，分别对超级权重进行孤立训练（100到8192个参数）以及扩展至局部邻域（最多36K参数），并与随机选择相同数量参数训练、LoRA更新等进行对比；通过10种随机种子进行消融实验验证结果。
Result: 孤立训练超级权重导致准确率降至随机猜测水平，扩展邻域无改善；而训练随机选择的参数反而能提升基线，LoRA仅用0.16%参数即成功微调；将LoRA更新约束在超级权重坐标位置时结果无统计差异。
Conclusion: 参数的重要性并不等价于其在孤立条件下的可训练性，有效的微调依赖于整个层上的结构化分解（如低秩更新），而非针对个别重要权重。

papers.title: Validity of LLMs as data annotators: AMALIA on authority
papers.abstract_en: A national language model offers a linguistic community its own instrument for measuring what its citizens say and value. Portugal's AMALIA, a publicly funded 9B-parameter model for European Portuguese, appears competitive on agreement alone: asked to code the moral foundation of authority, it agrees with trained human coders to within six F1 points of open models eight to thirteen times its size. Yet agreement is reliability, not validity. For theoretical constructs that must be inferred rather than read from surface features, the question is whether the model follows the construct's theory or reaches the right code by correlated shortcuts. We test this with the recovery gap: the loss in performance when a holistic prompt is decomposed into the codebook's atomic clauses and recombined by the theory's explicit rule. If calibration closes that gap, some portability should survive across models and languages; where it does not, the construct-model instrument is the likely locus of failure. We ask whether a calibrated English instrument transfers to AMALIA-9B and to European Portuguese. For one construct and one corpus, it does not. Decomposition recovers only about half of AMALIA's holistic performance, and error analysis suggests reliance on surface correlates, especially moral outrage near authority figures. An open multilingual LLM closes the gap on the same Portuguese corpus under the same instructions, pointing away from the corpus as the main explanation. AMALIA can still screen and pre-code at scale, but it cannot yet measure this construct well enough to stand alone. The study is a single counterexample, not a verdict on national models; it argues that sovereign-LLM benchmark batteries should test not only agreement with human coders, but the evidential route by which that agreement is warranted.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估葡萄牙语国家语言模型AMALIA-9B作为数据标注者的有效性，重点关注道德基础中的权威维度。尽管模型与人类编码者的一致性达到F1分数接近，但通过恢复差距（recovery gap）测试发现，将整体提示分解为原子条款后性能下降约一半，表明模型依赖表面相关特征（如对权威人物的道德愤怒）而非理论构造本身。该研究指出，主权LLM基准测试不仅应检验与人类的一致性，还应检验达成一致性的证据路径。
Motivation: 现有研究主要关注LLM与人类标注者的一致性（可靠性），但忽略了有效性：模型可能通过表面相关捷径而非理论构造的推理达成正确编码。需要检验模型是否真正遵循构造的理论。
Method: 通过恢复差距测试：比较整体提示与分解为代码簿原子条款并重组后的性能差异。如果校准缩小差距，则构造-模型仪器可迁移；否则失败。实验中将校准的英语仪器迁移到AMALIA-9B和欧洲葡萄牙语。
Result: 对于单一构造和语料库，迁移失败：分解仅恢复约一半的整体性能。误差分析表明模型依赖表面相关特征，尤其是权威人物附近的道德愤怒。作为对比，一个开放的多语言LLM在同一葡萄牙语语料库上缩小了差距，表明语料库不是主要原因。
Conclusion: AMALIA可用于大规模筛选和预编码，但尚不能独立测量该构造。本研究是单一反例，并非对国家模型的最终裁决；建议主权LLM基准测试应包含验证有效性的测试。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: WaspMOT: A Benchmark for Long-Term Multi-Object Tracking of Trichogramma Wasps
papers.abstract_en: Multi-object tracking (MOT) has achieved strong performance on benchmarks dominated by short video sequences. However, such datasets do not adequately evaluate long-term identity preservation, where objects must be tracked consistently over extended durations. We introduce WaspMOT, a benchmark designed to address this gap through long-duration tracking of Trichogramma wasps in controlled ecological experiments. The dataset contains 10 sequences of approximately 12,000 frames each (over 8 minutes at 25 FPS), with dense MOTChallenge annotations and oracle detections to isolate association performance. Unlike existing benchmarks, WaspMOT forms a closed-set tracking scenario where all individuals remain present throughout the sequence, requiring consistent identity assignment across thousands of frames despite abrupt jumps, occlusions, and highly similar appearance. We establish a benchmark by evaluating five tracking-by-detection methods, including ByteTrack, BoT-SORT, C-BIoU, OC-SORT, and McByte, under a unified protocol. Results show that all methods suffer from significant trajectory fragmentation, highlighting the difficulty of long-term identity preservation even with perfect detections. A simple spatial tracklet stitching baseline consistently improves performance, indicating that substantial gains remain possible. WaspMOT provides a new benchmark for studying long-term association and reveals limitations of current tracking approaches that are not observable on conventional datasets. The benchmark will be made publicly available at the project repository: https://github.com/tstanczyk95/WaspMOT/ .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WaspMOT是一个针对长时多目标跟踪的新基准，包含10个序列，每个约12,000帧，跟踪Trichogramma wasps。评估了五种跟踪-检测方法，发现所有方法在长时身份保持上表现不佳，轨迹碎片化严重，简单的空间轨迹拼接即可显著改进。该基准揭示了现有跟踪方法在长时间跨度下的局限性。
Motivation: 现有MOT基准主要基于短视频，无法充分评估长时身份保持能力，而生态实验需要长时间一致跟踪个体。
Method: 构建WaspMOT数据集，包含10个长序列（各约12,000帧），使用MOTChallenge密集标注和oracle检测，以隔离关联性能。评估了ByteTrack、BoT-SORT、C-BIoU、OC-SORT和McByte五种方法，并引入了简单的空间轨迹拼接基线。
Result: 所有方法在长时跟踪中均出现严重轨迹碎片化，即使使用完美检测。空间轨迹拼接持续提升性能，表明仍有显著改进空间。
Conclusion: WaspMOT为研究长时关联提供了新基准，并揭示了传统数据集上不可见的跟踪方法局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Pose-to-Biomechanics: Bridging 3D Human Pose Estimation and Biomechanical Attribute Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Recent progress in 3D human pose estimation has made markerless recovery of skeletal motion increasingly accurate and scalable. However, most pose estimators remain optimized for geometric keypoint accuracy, while many real-world applications in rehabilitation, sports science, ergonomics, and clinical movement analysis require biomechanical quantities that describe how the body moves, loads, and activates. In this work, we propose BioModule, a lightweight plug-in temporal transformer that attaches downstream of any 3D pose estimator and predicts biomechanical attributes from standard 17-joint 3D skeletons. BioModule is estimator-agnostic and requires no modification of the upstream pose model, enabling existing pose estimators to be extended toward physically interpretable motion analysis. To train and evaluate BioModule, we construct a large-scale aligned dataset pairing Human3.6M video and 3D keypoints with the biomechanical label space of Human3.6Mplus. We establish and verify anatomical correspondence between coordinate systems of the two datasets, enabling frame-accurate cross-modal supervision. Using this aligned supervision, BioModule predicts biomechanical quantities. We further benchmark BioModule across seven state-of-the-art 3D pose estimators, providing the first systematic analysis of how upstream pose estimation quality propagates to downstream biomechanical prediction fidelity. The results position BioModule as a compact, modular bridge between vision-based pose estimation and biomechanically meaningful human motion analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BioModule，一种轻量级插件式时间变换器（temporal transformer），可附加在任何3D人体姿态估计器之后，从标准17关节3D骨架预测生物力学属性（如关节力矩、肌肉激活等）。为训练和评估，构建了Human3.6M视频/3D关键点与Human3.6Mplus生物力学标签的大规模对齐数据集，并建立了坐标系的解剖对应关系。在七个SOTA姿态估计器上的基准测试首次系统分析了上游姿态估计质量如何传播到下游生物力学预测的保真度。
Motivation: 现实应用（康复、运动科学、工效学、临床运动分析）需要生物力学量（如身体如何移动、负载、激活），而现有3D姿态估计器仅优化几何关键点精度，缺乏向物理可解释运动分析的扩展。
Method: 提出BioModule，一个估计器无关的插件时间变换器，利用Human3.6M与Human3.6Mplus的对齐数据集进行帧级跨模态监督训练，无需修改上游姿态模型。
Result: 在七个SOTA 3D姿态估计器上系统评估了上游姿态估计误差对下游生物力学预测的影响，表明BioModule能有效将视觉姿态映射为有意义的生物力学量。
Conclusion: BioModule作为紧凑、模块化的桥梁，使现有姿态估计器能够扩展至生物力学上有意义的人体运动分析，且体积小、即插即用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Latent Memory Palace: Reasoning for Control as Autoregressive Variational Inference
papers.abstract_en: Human decision-making is highly flexible -- some actions are taken immediately; others require longer deliberation. Language models have exhibited a similar capacity for adaptive "reasoning." However, transferring this capability to continuous control policies has been challenging, as directly reasoning in language space may lack the granularity for spatial understanding and precise motions. In this work, we show that reasoning for control policies can emerge by organizing information in an autoregressive latent space reminiscent of a memory palace, where retrieval is iterative and adaptive. Our method, Latent Memory Palace (LMP), formulates reasoning as variational inference with an autoregressive latent distribution. We derive a latent-space reinforcement learning technique to tractably optimize its variational lower bound. The resulting policy, LMP-$π$, achieves strong empirical performance in simulation and real-world domains while exhibiting interpretable, adaptive allocation of test-time compute. We further show that the same framework yields a variable-length action tokenizer, LMP-$\texttt{tok}$, which significantly improves the performance of downstream autoregressive policies. Together, these results present a new perspective on latent reasoning for control through the lens of variational inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Latent Memory Palace (LMP)方法，将控制策略的推理建模为自回归潜变量空间中的变分推断，通过潜空间强化学习优化变分下界。在仿真和真实世界任务中，LMP具有可解释的自适应计算分配，并衍生出变长动作分词器LMP-tok，提升了自回归策略的性能。
Motivation: 将语言模型中的自适应推理能力迁移到连续控制策略中面临挑战，因为语言空间缺乏空间理解和精细运动所需的粒度。
Method: 提出LMP框架，将推理视为具有自回归潜变量分布的变分推断，并推导出潜空间强化学习技术以可追踪地优化变分下界。
Result: LMP策略在仿真和真实世界领域取得强性能，展示可解释的自适应测试时计算分配；LMP-tok分词器显著提升下游自回归策略性能。
Conclusion: 通过变分推断视角为控制中的潜推理提供了新方向，表明自回归潜空间可以产生自适应推理。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Deep Learning for Joint Narrowband Interference Cancellation and Soft Demodulation in OFDM Systems
papers.abstract_en: Narrowband interference (NBI) severely degrades orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) systems by corrupting subcarriers and rendering classical soft demodulation ineffective. Conventional compressed-sensing (CS) mitigation exhibits high sequential latency and leaves structured, non-Gaussian residuals that cause log-likelihood ratio (LLR) unreliability, decoder saturation, and severe error floors when employing classical Gaussian demappers. We resolve this pipeline mismatch using a unified deep learning framework for joint NBI cancellation and robust soft demodulation. First, NBI-CNet employs a physics-informed convolutional architecture to estimate NBI parameters and remove multi-tone interference in a single forward pass. Without requiring prior knowledge of the active interferer count, NBI-CNet reduces computational complexity by up to 60% ($N{=}2048, Q{=}64$) compared to the state-of-the-art EOMP-IDS algorithm. Second, LLR-CNet acts as a structural whitener by mapping non-Gaussian post-mitigation residuals onto well-calibrated soft metrics. Simulations demonstrate that this joint framework eliminates the error floors inherent to traditional baselines across dense grids. Under severe interference ($\text{SIR}{=}{-}10$ dB), the pipeline operates within a $0.2$ to $0.5$ dB SNR margin of the optimal iterative baseline at a target block error rate (BLER) of $10^{-4}$. Under mild interference ($\text{SIR}{=}10$ dB) with heavy spectral overlap ($Q{=}12$), where classical greedy algorithms erroneously subtract valid data components and corrupt the payload, NBI-CNet avoids signal-peak confusion to deliver a coding gain exceeding $3$ dB. Finally, the architecture circumvents the $2{\times}10^{-4}$ error floor triggered by interferer-estimation errors, while its scale-invariant design enables robust generalization across arbitrary FFT sizes without retraining.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 11 figures, 6 tables. Preprint under review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一的深度学习框架，用于OFDM系统中的联合窄带干扰消除和鲁棒软解调。框架包含NBI-CNet和LLR-CNet两个模块，分别基于物理信息卷积网络估计和消除多音干扰，以及将非高斯残差映射为校准的软度量。仿真表明该方法在严重干扰下优于传统基线，消除错误平层，并降低计算复杂度。
Motivation: 窄带干扰会严重破坏OFDM子载波并使经典软解调失效，传统压缩感知方法存在高延迟和非高斯残差，导致LLR不可靠和误码平层。
Method: 提出NBI-CNet进行物理信息卷积网络单次前向传播估计和消除干扰，无需先验干扰数量；再通过LLR-CNet作为结构白化器，将非高斯残差映射为校准的软度量，实现联合消除和鲁棒解调。

papers.title: Remember When It Matters: Proactive Memory Agent for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.abstract_en: In long-horizon tasks, decision-relevant state is often scattered across an expanding trajectory, while the action agent must surface it and act. As trajectories grow, task requirements, environment facts, prior attempts, diagnoses, and open subgoals can be buried in the context window or pushed beyond it, failing to influence decisions when needed. We call this failure mode "behavioral state decay". We study memory as an active intervention mechanism rather than passive retrieval. A separate memory agent runs alongside an unmodified action agent, updating a structured memory bank from the recent trajectory and deciding whether to inject a memory-grounded reminder or remain silent. The module is plug-and-play with frontier action agents and existing agent harnesses. Across Terminal-Bench 2.0 and $τ^2$-Bench, it improves pass@1 for both weaker and stronger action agents, with gains of +8.3 pp on Terminal-Bench and +6.8 pp on $τ^2$-Bench. Ablations show that selective intervention outperforms passive bank exposure, always-on injection, advisor-only guidance, and general retrieval. As an early step toward open-weight memory policies, we train Qwen3.5-27B on SETA using SFT and GRPO, improving validation reward and achieving partial transfer to Terminal-Bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出主动记忆代理（Proactive Memory Agent），用于解决长时程任务中因轨迹增长导致的“行为状态衰减”问题。该记忆代理与未修改的动作代理并行运行，从近期轨迹更新结构化记忆库，并选择性地注入记忆提醒。在Terminal-Bench 2.0和τ^2-Bench上，该方法对弱、强动作代理均提升pass@1，分别提高+8.3和+6.8个百分点。消融实验表明选择性干预优于被动暴露、始终注入等基线。作为开放权重记忆策略的初步尝试，使用SFT和GRPO训练了Qwen3.5-27B，验证奖励提升并部分迁移至Terminal-Bench。
Motivation: 长时程任务中，决策相关的状态（如任务要求、环境事实、先前尝试等）散布于不断增长的轨迹中，可能被上下文窗口掩盖或超出范围，导致无法在需要时影响决策，作者将这种失效模式称为“行为状态衰减”。
Method: 提出一个独立的记忆代理，与未修改的动作代理并行运行。记忆代理从近期轨迹更新结构化记忆库，并决定是否向动作代理注入基于记忆的提醒（或保持沉默）。该模块即插即用，支持SFT和GRPO训练。
Result: 在Terminal-Bench 2.0和τ^2-Bench上，该方法对弱和强动作代理均提升pass@1，分别提高+8.3和+6.8个百分点。消融实验表明，选择性干预优于被动记忆库暴露、始终注入提醒、仅作为顾问指导以及通用检索等基线。
Conclusion: 作为开放权重记忆策略的早期步骤，训练了Qwen3.5-27B（使用SFT和GRPO），验证奖励提升并部分迁移到Terminal-Bench。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LTM: Large-scale Terrain Model for Wildfire-prone Landscapes
papers.abstract_en: Accurate 3D terrain maps are essential for emergency response when assessing wildfire hazards. However, wildfire-prone regions often span vast areas where conventional reconstruction methods underperform. Airborne LiDAR systems provide high-resolution terrain data, but they are expensive and infrequently updated. Image-based methods offer a lower-cost alternative, but struggle due to sparse visual features and limited image overlap. We propose a multi-modal reconstruction framework leveraging outdated Digital Elevation Models (DEMs) as geometric priors for image-based 3D reconstruction. Our key innovation is physics-based pixel-pixel alignment between images and DEM data, dramatically reducing computational complexity by eliminating expensive feature matching procedures. To validate our approach, we developed a large-terrain simulator based on a real wildfire-prone area, generating realistic images enabling a comprehensive evaluation. Given posed images and legacy DEMs, our method produces high-fidelity depth maps while maintaining real-time performance. We find significant improvements in reconstruction accuracy and computational efficiency over existing techniques, offering a scalable solution for wildfire response.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个多模态重建框架，利用老旧数字高程模型（DEM）作为几何先验进行图像三维重建，通过物理驱动的像素-像素对齐降低计算复杂度，在野火易发区域的大尺度地形上实现实时高保真深度图生成。
Motivation: 野火易发区域面积广阔，传统重建方法效果不佳；LiDAR 成本高且更新频率低；基于图像的方法因视觉特征稀疏和图像重叠有限而难以适用。
Method: 提出多模态重建框架，将过时的 DEM 作为几何先验，通过物理驱动的像素-像素对齐实现图像与 DEM 数据的配准，避免昂贵的特征匹配步骤，并基于真实野火区域构建大尺度地形模拟器用于评估。
Result: 在有姿态图像和遗留 DEM 输入下，该方法实现高保真深度图与实时性能，相比现有技术在重建精度和计算效率上均显著提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法为野火应急响应提供可扩展的地形重建解决方案，但未讨论对降水、气象预报等任务的适用性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: HumanForge: A Human-Centric Deepfake Video Benchmark with Multi-Agent Forgery Rationales
papers.abstract_en: Rapid advancements in video diffusion models and temporal editing tools have enabled the generation of highly realistic human-centric videos, posing unprecedented challenges to digital content forensics. Existing benchmarks primarily focus on either face-swapping or global text-to-video synthesis, overlooking the crucial dimensions of human-object or human-human interactions and multi-modal alignment. To address these limitations, we introduce HumanForge, a unified, large-scale, and multi-paradigm human-centric video forgery dataset. To construct and annotate this dataset without labor-intensive manual labeling or hallucinated monolithic prompts, we propose Gen2Anno, a modular active multi-agent pipeline built on LangGraph. Gen2Anno coordinates six specialized agents-ranging from source profiling to MoE-based reference analysis and closed-loop forensic verification-to generate over 18K high-fidelity video segments and produce structured, contrastive omni-annotations containing binary decisions, fine-grained artifact categories, and spatio-temporal localization. Extensive benchmarks using state-of-the-art traditional detectors and Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) demonstrate the significant challenges of zero-shot generalization and fine-grained reasoning on HumanForge. Code and dataset will be publicly released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HumanForge，一个大规模、多范式的人脸中心视频伪造基准数据集，并设计 Gen2Anno 流水线自动生成标注。数据集包含超过 1.8 万高清视频片段，提供二元判定、细粒度伪影类别和时空定位注释。现有检测器与大型多模态模型（LMM）在该数据集上零样本泛化与细粒度推理表现欠佳。
Motivation: 现有视频伪造基准局限于人脸替换或全局文本生成，缺乏对人人交互、人-物交互以及多模态对齐的覆盖，限制了数字取证研究的发展。
Method: 提出 Gen2Anno 模块化主动多智能体流水线，基于 LangGraph 协调六个专门智能体（从源分析到 MoE 参考分析和闭环取证验证），自动生成结构化对比注释。
Result: 使用传统检测器和 LMM 进行广泛基准测试，结果显示在 HumanForge 上零样本泛化和细粒度推理面临重大挑战。
Conclusion: HumanForge 与 Gen2Anno 为视频伪造检测研究提供了新的资源与评估范式，有助于推动更鲁棒的取证方法发展。

papers.title: MPFlow: Learning Budgeted Max-Flow Optimization on the Lightning Network with Deep Graph Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: We address liquidity placement in the Bitcoin Lightning Network (LN): given a fixed budget, which channels should a node open to maximize its routing capacity? We cast this as a budget-constrained combinatorial optimization problem on graphs, selecting $k$ edge additions that maximize $s$--$t$ max-flow, a theory-grounded measure of routing capacity, and solve it with graph reinforcement learning. Our lightweight agent combines a message-passing policy network with proximal policy optimization (PPO) and action masking, and is trained under a hub-exclusion curriculum: the network's top hubs are removed from training subgraphs, forcing the policy to learn capacity-aware placement rather than hub attachment. In extensive experiments on real Lightning Network snapshots, our method consistently outperforms strong heuristic baselines on the max-flow objective across multiple seeds and unseen graphs. The agent has been deployed in production for peer recommendations, executing 4640 channel-open decisions that cumulatively allocate 267.3 BTC over $16 million across 30 managed nodes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对比特币闪电网络（LN）中的流动性放置问题，即给定固定预算，节点应开放哪些通道以最大化路由容量。作者将其建模为图上预算受限的组合优化问题，选择k条边添加以最大化s-t最大流，并通过图强化学习求解。轻量级智能体结合消息传递策略网络、近端策略优化（PPO）和动作遮蔽，并在去除网络中心枢纽的训练课程下学习。在真实LN快照上，该方法在多轮种子和未见图上优于强启发式基线，并已部署到生产中执行4640次通道开放决策。
Motivation: 闪电网络节点需要有效分配有限流动性以最大化路由容量，但现有启发式方法（如连接中心节点）可能并非最优。
Method: 将流动性放置建模为预算约束下的边选择优化问题，最大化s-t最大流；使用图神经网络策略网络结合PPO和动作遮蔽进行强化学习，并通过中心枢纽排除课程训练促进容量感知决策。
Result: 在真实LN数据上，该方法在最大流目标上一致优于强启发式基线；部署后执行4640次通道开放，累计分配267.3 BTC（超过1600万美元）。
Conclusion: 基于图的强化学习可有效解决闪电网络中的预算约束最大流优化问题，且已证明在生产中的实用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ProjAgent: Procedural Similarity Retrieval for Repository-Level Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: Repository-level code generation requires implementing target functions while accounting for complex cross-file dependencies and project-specific conventions. Existing retrieval methods predominantly rely on lexical, structural, or semantic similarity, often overlooking repository functions that implement similar procedural logic despite differing in identifiers or application domains. We propose ProjAgent, a repository-level code generation system that introduces procedural similarity as an explicit retrieval signal. ProjAgent decomposes the target function into intermediate reasoning steps and employs an agentic workflow to retrieve repository functions that exhibit similar procedural behavior at each step. The retrieved procedural context is integrated with conventional semantic retrieval to construct a richer repository context for code generation. ProjAgent further incorporates a conservative static-analysis feedback loop that iteratively repairs generated code using compiler and static-analysis feedback. Evaluated on REPOCOD, ProjAgent achieves 41.14% Pass@1, outperforming existing retrieval-based baselines. These results demonstrate that procedural similarity is an effective and previously unexplored retrieval dimension for repository-level code generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ProjAgent，一种仓库级别代码生成系统，通过引入过程相似性作为检索信号。系统将目标函数分解为中间推理步骤，利用智能体工作流检索仓库中具有相似过程行为的函数，并与传统语义检索结合，再通过静态分析反馈循环迭代修复代码。在 REPOCOD 数据集上 Pass@1 达到 41.14%，优于现有基于检索的基线。
Motivation: 现有检索方法主要依赖词汇、结构或语义相似性，忽略了仓库函数间即使标识符或应用领域不同也可能具有相似过程逻辑的情况。
Method: ProjAgent 将目标函数分解为中间推理步骤，使用智能体工作流在每一步检索具有相似过程行为的仓库函数，并将检索到的过程上下文与常规语义检索集成，构建更丰富的仓库上下文。此外，该方法包含一个保守的静态分析反馈循环，利用编译器和静态分析反馈迭代修复生成的代码。
Result: 在 REPOCOD 基准上，ProjAgent 达到 41.14% 的 Pass@1，超越现有基于检索的基线方法。
Conclusion: 过程相似性是一个先前未被探索且有效的检索维度，能够提升仓库级别代码生成的性能。

summary_sections.method: ProjAgent 将目标函数分解为中间推理步骤，使用智能体工作流在每一步检索具有相似过程行为的仓库函数，并将检索到的过程上下文与常规语义检索集成，构建更丰富的仓库上下文。此外，该方法包含一个保守的静态分析反馈循环，利用编译器和静态分析反馈迭代修复生成的代码。
summary_sections.result: 在 REPOCOD 基准上，ProjAgent 达到 41.14% 的 Pass@1，超越现有基于检索的基线方法。
summary_sections.conclusion: 过程相似性是一个先前未被探索且有效的检索维度，能够提升仓库级别代码生成的性能。

papers.title: A Practical Investigation of Training-free Relaxed Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding accelerates sampling from an autoregressive LLM by using a faster auxiliary model to draft tokens which are then verified in parallel by the LLM. Standard speculative decoding is lossless: its rejection and resampling steps exactly preserve the LLM's sampling distribution. Recent work argues that relaxing this strict guarantee can yield further speed-ups, controlled capability-speed trade-offs, or even capability gains. We practically investigate training-free relaxed speculative decoding techniques, unify existing approaches within a shared framework, benchmark them on contemporary settings, and distil takeaways and empirical findings for practitioners. Important takeaways include: relaxation can require considerable capability evaluation unlike lossless speculative decoding, and many relaxed approaches rely on a drafter that is a good language model, making them unsuited for lightweight dedicated multi-token-prediction drafters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对无需训练的宽松推测解码（training-free relaxed speculative decoding）技术进行了实际研究，统一了现有方法框架，并在当代设置下进行基准测试。关键发现包括：宽松解码可能需要大量能力评估，且许多方法依赖具备良好语言模型的草稿模型，不适合轻量级专用多令牌预测草稿模型。
Motivation: 标准推测解码是无损的，但近期研究认为放松这一严格保证可以带来进一步加速或能力权衡。本文旨在实际调查无需训练的宽松推测解码技术，为从业者提供经验总结。
Method: 统一现有宽松推测解码方法在共享框架下，对当代大语言模型设置进行基准测试，并分析无训练条件下的性能与能力权衡。
Result: 宽松解码需要大量能力评估（与无损推测解码不同），且许多方法要求草稿模型本身是好的语言模型，因此不适合轻量级专用多令牌预测草稿模型。
Conclusion: 为从业者提炼了关于宽松推测解码的实用经验和发现，指出了其适用条件和局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SAM-MT: Real-Time Interactive Multi-Target Video Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Modern Video Object Segmentation (VOS) involves tracking and segmenting user-specified targets. While recent approaches have achieved remarkable performance in single-target scenarios, extending them to multi-target settings typically involves replicating the single-target processing for each individual object, resulting in reduced frame rates (FPS) with unbounded latency as target count increases. Built upon Segment Anything 2 (SAM2), we propose SAM-MT, which addresses this by transforming the model into an interactive framework for real-time Multi-Target video segmentation. SAM-MT uses explicit queries to represent different individual targets, in parallel with a shared representation for global context. It employs decoupled masked attention to keep individual identities distinct from cross-target interference, and sparse memory for stable temporal evolution, along with specialized strategies for occlusion handling and overlap prevention. SAM-MT successfully decouples latency from the number of targets, achieving real-time speed on par with single-target baselines (>36 FPS for 10 targets) while maintaining SAM2's robust video segmentation performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SAM-MT，基于SAM2的实时交互式多目标视频分割框架。通过显式查询表示个体目标、解耦掩码注意力、稀疏记忆以及遮挡和重叠处理策略，成功将延迟与目标数量解耦，在10个目标上达到>36 FPS，性能与单目标基线相当。
Motivation: 现有视频分割方法扩展到多目标时，延迟随目标数量线性增长，无法满足实时需求。
Method: 基于SAM2，引入显式查询表示不同目标，使用解耦掩码注意力避免交叉干扰，稀疏记忆保持时间一致性，并设计专用策略处理遮挡和重叠。
Result: 在10个目标上实现>36 FPS的实时速度，与单目标基线相当，同时保持SAM2的稳健分割性能。
Conclusion: SAM-MT成功将延迟与目标数量解耦，为实时多目标视频分割提供了高效方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SolarChain-Eval: A Physics-Constrained Benchmark for Trustworthy Economic Agents in Decentralized Energy Markets
papers.abstract_en: As agentic AI systems are increasingly applied to cyber-physical environments, their evaluation requires assessment of both task performance and trustworthiness. In decentralized energy markets, autonomous agents may improve market utility, but may also exploit invalid physical data, create artificial liquidity, and produce unstable governance decisions. Therefore, we propose SolarChain-Eval, a physics-constrained benchmark for evaluating trustworthy economic agents. It formulates market governance as a Gymnasium-compatible Markov Decision Process, where agents make hourly decisions. SolarChain-Eval evaluates each policy across multiple dimensions, including market utility, physical safety, slippage, action smoothness, spatial fairness, and auditability. To support agentic evaluation, SolarChain-Eval incorporates an LLM-based Planner/Auditor layer. The Planner defines episode-level action bounds and audit rules, while the Auditor reviews and revises high-risk actions. All interventions are recorded through structured logs, including trigger signals, proposed actions, revised actions, and audit rationales. Experiments with static, random, myopic, RL, and RL+LLM policies reveal a clear utility-safety trade-off. RL agents improve market utility but can still produce unsafe behavior. When the physics penalty is removed, reward-maximizing agents exploit invalid generation and increase artificial liquidity. The LLM Planner/Auditor improves auditability and mitigates selected risks, but it cannot fully compensate for a misspecified reward function. These results indicate that trustworthy agentic AI evaluation requires both physical constraints and transparent intervention traces. We release data and code as open access on GitHub for replicability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SolarChain-Eval，一个受物理约束的基准测试，用于评估去中心化能源市场中的可信经济智能体。它使用Gymnasium兼容的MDP，结合LLM规划/审计层，从市场效用、物理安全、滑点等多个维度评估策略。实验发现RL代理提高了市场效用但存在安全风险，LLM审计员可缓解部分风险但无法完全修正错误奖励函数。
Motivation: 去中心化能源市场中，自主智能体可能利用无效物理数据、制造流动性或产生不稳定治理决策，现有评估缺乏对可信度的综合考虑。
Method: 将市场治理建模为Gymnasium兼容的MDP，引入基于LLM的规划/审计层，其中规划者定义情节级行动边界和审计规则，审计者审查并修正高风险行动，所有干预通过结构化日志记录。
Result: 静态、随机、近视、RL和RL+LLM策略的实验揭示了效用-安全权衡：RL代理提高市场效用但仍可能产生不安全行为；移除物理惩罚后，最大化奖励的代理利用无效发电并增加人工流动性；LLM规划/审计提高了可审计性并缓解了选定风险，但无法完全补偿错误设定的奖励函数。
Conclusion: 值得信赖的智能体AI评估需要物理约束和透明的干预痕迹，并强调开放数据和代码的可复现性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multi-Resolution Feature Stem for Diabetic Retinopathy lesion segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Diabetic Retinopathy (DR) is a leading cause of preventable blindness worldwide, requiring automated lesion segmentation using deep learning models for early detection and monitoring. However, DR lesions vary dramatically in size from tiny microaneurysms to large hemorrhages and exudates. This variability creates conflicting demands on the model architecture and input resolution, posing a challenge for effective design. This work investigates the impact of input resolution on different lesion types. Through systematic experimentation with multiple architectures (U-Net, UNet++, Vision Transformers, DeepLabV3+) at $512 \times 512$ and $1024 \times 1024$ resolutions, we identify a critical, counter-intuitive phenomenon where increasing input resolution has opposing effects on different lesion types. We demonstrate that while higher resolution is essential for resolving fine-grained microaneurysms, it can unexpectedly degrade performance on larger hemorrhages. This finding challenges the common assumption that higher resolution is uniformly beneficial. To address this, we propose a novel Multi-Resolution Feature Stem, an input-level pyramid integrated with a UNet++ backbone. This architecture processes multiple scales in parallel, capturing fine-grained details without sacrificing contextual information. This work contributes crucial empirical evidence of this complex, resolution-dependent behavior and a practical, parameter-efficient architecture that successfully resolves this trade-off.
papers.comment: 2026 International Conference on Advances in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AAIML), 20-22 March 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究输入分辨率对糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）病变分割的影响，发现提高分辨率有利于微动脉瘤等小病灶，但意外地损害了出血等大病灶的性能。为此提出多分辨率特征茎（Multi-Resolution Feature Stem），在UNet++骨干网络上并行处理多尺度输入，平衡细粒度和上下文信息。在多个架构上的实验验证了这一现象及其解决方案。
Motivation: DR病变尺寸差异极大，高分辨率对小病灶有利，但可能对大病灶有负面影响，现有研究缺乏对这种矛盾的系统分析。
Method: 通过在U-Net、UNet++、Vision Transformers、DeepLabV3+等架构上对比512×512和1024×1024分辨率，揭示分辨率对不同病变类型的相反影响；并设计多分辨率特征茎，作为输入级金字塔与UNet++骨干结合，并行处理多尺度输入。
Result: 实验发现提高分辨率能提升微动脉瘤的分割性能，但会降低大出血的分割性能；提出的多分辨率特征茎有效解决了这一权衡，且参数高效。
Conclusion: 本文提供了分辨率依赖性行为的实证证据，并提出了实用的参数高效架构来解决DR分割中的分辨率权衡。

papers.title: Do Transformations Reveal the Truth? Generative Residual Learning for Generalized AI-Generated Image Detection
papers.abstract_en: The rapid advancement of generative AI has enabled the creation of highly realistic deepfake media, posing significant threats, including misinformation, digital identity theft, fraud, and manipulation of public opinion. AI-generated image (AIGI) detection is reliably challenging due to the diversity of generative methods and the subtle artifacts they leave behind. In this work, we propose GenRes, a novel framework for generative residual learning via a neural tensor network, which models fine-grained relational features between original and transformed samples to enhance generalization. To address scenarios involving multiple generative transformations, we introduce GenRes++, which employs a learnable attention mechanism to aggregate relational features across multiple transformed samples and enables the model to focus on the most informative cues. Both models leverage PE-Core as a feature extractor, providing generalized and semantically rich embeddings that improve cross-domain performance and enable the detection of AIGI generated by unseen methods. Comprehensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed GenRes++ approach outperforms existing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GenRes 和 GenRes++ 框架，利用神经张量网络和可学习注意力机制进行生成残差学习，以检测 AI 生成的图像。GenRes 建模原始与变换样本之间的细粒度关系特征，GenRes++ 通过注意力聚合多变换样本的关系特征，使用 PE-Core 作为特征提取器。实验表明该方法在多个基准数据集上优于现有方法。
Motivation: AI 生成图像检测因生成方法的多样性和伪影的微妙性而充满挑战，现有方法泛化能力不足，尤其是面对未知生成方法时。
Method: 提出生成残差学习框架 GenRes，基于神经张量网络建模原始与变换样本之间的细粒度关系特征；GenRes++ 引入可学习注意力机制聚合多变换样本的关系特征，并使用 PE-Core 提取器增强跨域性能。
Result: 在多个基准数据集上的综合实验表明，GenRes++ 优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 该框架通过关系特征学习和注意力聚合提高了 AI 生成图像检测的泛化能力，尤其对未见生成方法有效。

papers.title: Resample or Reroute? Budget-Aware Test-Time Model Selection for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Routing among large language models (LLMs) trades response quality against serving cost, motivated by the reported gap between deployed routers and a per-instance oracle. Recent analysis shows that test-time resampling can recover per-instance selection headroom that no single-commit router captures; however, that guarantee holds only under an idealized oracle equipped with correctness labels and an unconstrained budget, neither of which a deployed system has. To the best of our knowledge, no previous work treats resampling the committed model and rerouting to an alternative model as competing uses of a single per-query cost budget. Therefore, this work formulates budget-aware test-time model selection: given a per-query budget and an imperfect verifier, allocate each unit of budget between resampling and rerouting so that expected correctness is maximized. An online resample-or-reroute (RoR) allocation policy driven by estimated marginal correctness per unit cost is proposed, and its behavior is grounded in the recoverability asymmetry between selection and sampling. Replay experiments on newly regenerated multi-draw correctness tensors from an eleven-model open-weight pool over four benchmarks of differing difficulty show that the proposed RoR policy attains a favorable cost-quality Pareto front relative to single-route, one-commit-router, budget-aware best-of-K, cascade, and random-allocation baselines for the tested pools, with the largest gains on the most heterogeneous benchmark; an ablation further shows the gains are verifier-gated, shrinking as verifier quality degrades, and robustness replays under a provider price vector and a label-free agreement verifier delineate where the conclusions carry over.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 3 figures. Code: github.com/luka-krixvon/resample-or-reroute-experiment. Companion analysis: arXiv:2607.03436
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出预算感知的测试时模型选择问题，在给定每查询预算和 imperfect verifier 的情况下，在重采样（resample）已提交模型和重路由（reroute）到替代模型之间分配预算以最大化期望正确性。提出在线 resample-or-reroute (RoR) 分配策略，基于边际正确性每单位成本驱动，并在四个基准上的11个开源模型池上进行回放实验，表明 RoR 策略在成本-质量帕累托前沿上优于多种基线。
Motivation: 现有路由方法要么只做单次提交，要么不考虑预算约束，且未联合优化重采样和重路由。实际部署系统缺乏正确标签和无限制预算，因此需要一种预算感知的测试时模型选择方法。
Method: 形式化预算感知的测试时模型选择问题，提出 RoR 分配策略，每步根据估计的边际正确性每单位成本决定是重采样当前模型还是重路由到其他模型，并理论分析可恢复性不对称性。

Conclusion: 摘要强调验证器质量是关键门控因素，且标签无关的一致性验证器下结论依然成立。

papers.title: WebSwarm: Recursive Multi-Agent Orchestration for Deep-and-Wide Web Search
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM)-based web search agents are transforming information seeking from simple factoid question answering into complex, deep-and-wide search and research-oriented tasks. A single ReAct-style agent is constrained by one long trajectory and limited context, making it difficult to handle depth and coverage simultaneously. Existing multi-agent systems improve search coverage through parallel execution and aggregation, but still exhibit clear limitations in recursive depth, collaboration adaptability, and evidence-grounded expansion. We propose WebSwarm, a progressive recursive delegation framework that jointly constructs task decomposition, recursive expansion, and agent collaboration during inference. WebSwarm dynamically instantiates agentic search nodes, each coupling a local objective with a search mode that specifies how the node should organize search and collaboration. Each node can either solve its objective itself or further delegate child nodes; after solving, it returns evidence and results upward, enabling parent nodes to further expand, revise, or aggregate the search process. To guide this process, WebSwarm first probes how task-relevant information is organized on the web to ground subsequent node expansion, and reuses process-level experience across homogeneous sibling nodes. Experiments on BrowseComp-Plus, WideSearch, DeepWideSearch, and GISA show that WebSwarm consistently outperforms single-agent and multi-agent baselines on deep, wide, and interleaved deep-and-wide tasks. Further analyses of ablation, task difficulty, web tool efficiency, and model generalization explain WebSwarm's effectiveness and provide insights for multi-agent search systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出WebSwarm，一种渐进式递归委派框架，用于深度和广度网络搜索。通过动态实例化搜索节点，耦合局部目标与搜索模式，在推理过程中联合任务分解、递归扩展和智能体协作，实验表明优于单智能体和多智能体基线。
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的网络搜索智能体在深度和覆盖度上存在局限，单智能体受限于长轨迹和有限上下文，多智能体系统在递归深度、协作适应性和证据驱动扩展方面仍有不足。
Method: WebSwarm采用渐进式递归委派框架，动态实例化搜索节点，每个节点耦合局部目标与搜索模式，可自行解决或委派子节点，返回证据和结果供父节点扩展或聚合。先探测任务相关信息在Web上的组织方式以指导节点扩展，并在同质兄弟节点间重用过程经验。
Result: 在BrowseComp-Plus、WideSearch、DeepWideSearch和GISA基准上，WebSwarm在深度、宽度和交织的深度与广度任务上一致优于单智能体和多智能体基线。消融分析、任务难度、网络工具效率和模型泛化分析解释了其有效性。
Conclusion: 该工作为多智能体搜索系统提供了见解，表明递归委派框架能有效处理深度和广度搜索任务。

papers.title: EdgeRefine: Privacy-Utility Balance for Graphs via Jaccard Sampling under Edge Differential Privacy
papers.abstract_en: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have shown considerable success in learning from graph-structured data, but their use in privacy-sensitive areas remains difficult because graph structure can leak sensitive link information. To satisfy edge-level differential privacy, a common approach is to inject noise into all elements of the graph's adjacency matrix, thereby obfuscating the existence of any single edge. However, stronger privacy requires more noise, and excessive noise reduces utility, making the privacy-utility balance a major barrier to practical privacy-preserving graph learning. To address this issue, we propose EdgeRefine, a local differential privacy framework that improves this trade-off through adaptive edge refinement. EdgeRefine first estimates edge-existence probabilities using Jaccard similarity and ranks edges for noisy edge removal. To ensure the sparsity and reliability of the final graph, it uses the privacy budget $ε$ to determine the ratio of true to false edges, samples them separately based on this probability ranking, and controls the total number of edges with a separate sampling rate $k$. Extensive experiments show that EdgeRefine achieves accuracy comparable to the noise-free baseline and substantially outperforms other privacy-preserving methods across datasets and GNN architectures. Under privacy budget $ε= 2.5$, EdgeRefine improves node classification accuracy over state-of-the-art baselines by 17.8\% on ACM under GAT and 19.7\% on Cora under GCN. In graph classification, it achieves an average accuracy degradation of around 5\% compared to the noise-free baseline. Under graph reconstruction attacks, EdgeRefine maintains relative absolute error levels above 1 across all privacy budgets, averaging 1.962 on Cora and 1.472 on AMAP, indicating strong resilience against privacy leakage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EdgeRefine，一种通过Jaccard采样实现边差分隐私的图数据隐私-效用平衡框架。它利用Jaccard相似度估计边存在概率，按隐私预算ε决定真假边比例，并控制总边数。实验表明在ε=2.5时节点分类准确率提升，图分类精度损失约5%，且能抵御图重构攻击。
Motivation: 图神经网络在隐私敏感场景中面临边差分隐私带来的噪声过大、效用下降问题，隐私-效用平衡是主要障碍。
Method: 提出EdgeRefine框架，先通过Jaccard相似度估计边存在概率并排序，再根据隐私预算ε确定真假边比例，分别采样，并用单独采样率k控制总边数。
Result: 在ε=2.5下，节点分类准确率在ACM(GAT)提升17.8%，Cora(GCN)提升19.7%；图分类平均精度损失约5%；图重构攻击下相对绝对误差水平高于1。
Conclusion: EdgeRefine在边差分隐私下实现了隐私与效用的良好平衡，优于现有方法，对攻击具有强韧性。

papers.title: Formal Mechanisms for Market Stability in Self-Interested Agent Societies: A Marketplace Simulation Study
papers.abstract_en: Self-interested agents, left unconstrained, tend toward defection in repeated social dilemmas, causing cooperative gains from trade to collapse. This paper investigates what formal mechanisms, layered on top of unrestricted communication, are sufficient for a society of such agents to maintain market stability, and how resilient those mechanisms are to adversarial attack. We instantiate the research question as a multi-agent marketplace simulation where 18 LLM agents (DeepSeek-V3) with complementary production specialties must trade within a constrained social network to obtain utility. We conduct two experimental phases: (1) a mechanism comparison across eight conditions under progressive troll injection over 200 rounds, identifying Mediation as the top-performing mechanism; and (2) adversarial red-teaming of Mediation using iteratively prompt-optimised LLM-driven trolls, finding that the best attack (v6) reduces honest-agent utility by 13.3% but cannot collapse the market. Mediation enables recovery even under sustained adversarial pressure. We define adversarial robustness as a mechanism's ability to sustain positive honest-agent utility under optimised attack, and find that Mediation is robust: it can be bent but not broken.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究自利智能体（self-interested agents）社会中维持市场稳定的形式机制。通过多智能体市场模拟，18个LLM智能体（DeepSeek-V3）在受限社交网络中进行交易。实验比较了八种机制，发现调解（Mediation）表现最佳，并对其进行了对抗性红队测试，最优攻击使诚实智能体效用下降13.3%但无法崩溃市场。
Motivation: 自利智能体在重复社会困境中倾向于背叛，导致合作收益崩溃，需要研究何种形式机制能维持市场稳定并抵御攻击。
Method: 构建多智能体市场模拟，使用18个DeepSeek-V3 LLM智能体，具有互补生产专长，在约束社交网络中交易。实验分两阶段：八种机制比较（200轮逐步注入恶意智能体）和对抗性红队测试（使用迭代提示优化的LLM驱动恶意智能体攻击最佳机制）。
Result: 调解机制在八种机制中表现最优；最强化攻击（v6）使诚实智能体效用降低13.3%，但无法使市场崩溃，调解机制能在持续压力下恢复。
Conclusion: 论文定义了对抗鲁棒性为机制在优化攻击下维持正诚实智能体效用的能力，并发现调解机制鲁棒且可弯曲但不可摧毁。

papers.title: Secure Decentralized Federated Learning via Gossip and Virtual Voting
papers.abstract_en: Decentralized federated learning (DFL) removes the central server by letting nodes exchange model updates through peer-to-peer gossip, but existing gossip-based methods often lack provenance finality and resilience to Byzantine or lazy participants. Ledger-assisted federated learning (FL) improves auditability, yet blockchains, shards, or settlement committees can reintroduce global coordination costs that conflict with DFL locality. This paper proposes \emph{gspDAG-FL}, a secure DFL framework that derives consensus from the same gossip history used to disseminate models. Nodes exchange model payloads only with neighbors, while full nodes collect event certificates and receiver-endorsed accepted gossip proofs, reconstruct a compact Topology directed acyclic graph (DAG), and run Hashgraph-style virtual voting followed by compact full-node certificates. Finality is over unique model-origin tuples, not identical local parameter states. To improve resilience, gspDAG-FL combines payload validation, accepted-proof validation, and private semantic audit before aggregation. We formalize the adversarial setting, prove safety and conditional liveness of the control plane, and give a convergence guarantee for certified perturbed gossip under time-varying effective mixing. Experiments on MNIST classification and Penn Treebank language modeling, using fair held-out validation/audit data and networks up to \(N=100\), show that gspDAG-FL achieves learning quality close to validation-based ledger FL while reducing coordination bottlenecks, improving throughput, and maintaining high invalid-origin detection under mixed Byzantine and lazy participation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出gspDAG-FL，一个基于八卦协议和虚拟投票的安全去中心化联邦学习框架。通过让节点仅与邻居交换模型，全节点收集事件证书并构建拓扑有向无环图，运行Hashgraph风格虚拟投票，实现模型来源的唯一最终性。实验表明在MNIST和Penn Treebank任务上，gspDAG-FL接近验证式账本联邦学习的性能，同时降低协调开销并提高对拜占庭和懒惰参与者的检测能力。
Motivation: 现有去中心化联邦学习缺乏来源最终性和对拜占庭或懒惰参与者的鲁棒性，而账本辅助方案又引入全局协调成本，违背去中心化原则。
Method: 提出gspDAG-FL，利用八卦历史驱动共识：节点仅与邻居交换模型，全节点收集事件证书和接收端背书的八卦证明，构建拓扑DAG，运行Hashgraph虚拟投票生成全节点证书。结合载荷验证、接受证明验证和私人语义审计来增强鲁棒性。
Result: 在MNIST分类和Penn Treebank语言建模任务上，网络规模达N=100时，gspDAG-FL学习质量接近验证式账本联邦学习，同时通过减少协调瓶颈提升吞吐量，并在混合拜占庭和懒惰参与下保持高异常来源检测率。
Conclusion: 论文形式化证明了控制平面的安全性和条件活性，以及含认证扰动八卦在时变有效混合下的收敛保证，表明该框架在去中心化联邦学习中有效平衡安全与效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multi-Modal, Multi-Environment Machine Teaching for Robust Reward Learning
papers.abstract_en: As autonomous agents are increasingly deployed across diverse operational contexts, aligning their behavior with human intent demands reward functions that remain robust to such changes rather than overfitting to any single environment. Inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) provides a principled way to infer such objectives from human feedback. However, existing analyses of optimal teaching approaches for IRL focus on single-environment, demonstration-only settings, leaving underexplored how heterogeneous feedback modalities and environment dynamics jointly constrain reward functions that generalize across multiple environments. Because demonstrations in one MDP entangle reward information with that environments specific structure, the resulting rewards frequently fail to generalize when the agent is deployed in a new setting. We first analyze how different feedback modalities constrain rewards, showing that, in the unlimited-data regime, comparisons impose strictly stronger global constraints than other modalities. Beyond this theoretical analysis, we introduce a hierarchical machine teaching algorithm for reward learning that operates across multiple MDPs. The algorithm first greedily selects informative environments that expose complementary reward constraints, then strategically queries low-cost feedback within those environments. Empirically, our method achieves substantially lower regret and stronger generalization to held-out environments than uniform teaching baselines under identical feedback budgets, demonstrating the importance of multi-environment, multi-modal teaching for learning dynamics-robust reward functions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究跨多环境、多模态的机器教学（machine teaching）用于逆向强化学习（IRL），以学习鲁棒跨环境的奖励函数。作者分析了不同反馈模态的约束能力，并提出一种层级算法，先贪婪选择能提供互补约束的环境，再策略性查询低成本反馈。实验表明该方法在泛化到未见过环境时，比均匀教学基线取得更低regret。
Motivation: 现有逆向强化学习的教学分析仅针对单环境、只利用演示，导致学到的奖励函数过拟合特定环境动态，无法泛化到新环境。需要研究多环境、多模态反馈如何联合约束奖励函数。
Method: 提出层级机器教学算法，分为两步：先跨多个MDP贪婪选择能提供互补奖励约束的信息性环境；然后在所选环境中策略性查询低成本的反馈（如比较等模态）。算法基于理论分析，表明比较反馈在无限数据下提供严格更强的全局约束。
Result: 实验在相同反馈预算下，该方法相比均匀教学基线显著降低regret，并展现对未见过环境的更强泛化能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调多环境、多模态教学对于学习鲁棒于环境动态变化的奖励函数的重要性。
