papers.title: UltraX: Refining Pre-Training Data at Scale with Adaptive Programmatic Editing
papers.abstract_en: As available training data approaches its physical limit, gains from Scaling Laws have begun to diminish. Consequently, improving Large Language Models (LLMs) now depends less on data expansion and more on higher-quality data utilization. However, in the context of large-scale corpora, existing refinement methodologies face significant limitations in quality, efficiency, and reliability: Rule-based approaches are constrained by fixed heuristics and struggle with instance-level variations; LLM-based approaches improve quality but fail to meet the efficiency and reliability requirements of large-scale data processing. To address these challenges, we propose UltraX, a function-calling refinement framework for large-scale pre-training data that completes the editing function space by introducing insertion in addition to deletion and modification, enabling fine-grained instance-level editing. Specifically, UltraX builds a reliable program-supervision generation pipeline. In this pipeline, dataset-adaptive prompt optimization first guides an expert LLM to produce high-quality end-to-end refined texts, and Line Alignment Mapping and Dynamic Context Replacement then convert original-refined text pairs into structured program supervision. Meanwhile, UltraX improves supervision quality and stabilizes the training distribution with low-confidence example filtering and ratio-controlled sampling by operation combination. During inference and execution, it normalizes and validates model outputs through sliding-window prediction, global operation aggregation, and systematic post-processing, improving the stability and reliability of large-scale execution. Experiments show that UltraX achieves the highest average performance across all corpora and also matches or surpasses baselines with fewer training tokens, demonstrating stronger data efficiency and refinement reliability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出UltraX，一个基于函数调用的可编程编辑框架，用于大规模预训练数据的精细化清洗。UltraX扩展了编辑函数空间（新增插入操作），并通过数据集自适应提示优化、行对齐映射、动态上下文替换等技术构建可靠的程序监督生成流水线，同时采用低置信度过滤和操作组合比例控制来稳定训练分布。实验表明，UltraX在所有语料上取得平均最高性能，并以更少训练 token 达到或超过基线，展示了更强的数据效率和精炼可靠性。
Motivation: 现有数据精炼方法（基于规则或基于LLM）在大规模语料上存在质量、效率或可靠性的不足：规则方法受限于固定启发式，无法处理实例级变化；LLM方法虽提高质量但难以满足大规模处理的效率和可靠性要求。
Method: 提出UltraX框架，核心是函数调用式编辑：在删除和修改之外引入插入操作，实现细粒度实例级编辑。构建可靠程序监督生成流水线：先通过数据集自适应提示优化指导专家LLM生成高质量精炼文本，再通过行对齐映射和动态上下文转换将原始-精炼文本对转换为结构化程序监督。采用低置信度样本过滤和操作组合比例控制来提升监督质量并稳定训练分布。推理执行时使用滑动窗口预测、全局操作聚合和系统后处理来保证大规模执行的稳定性和可靠性。
Result: 实验表明UltraX在所有语料上取得平均最高性能，并且能以更少的训练 token 匹配或超过基线，展示了更强的数据效率和精炼可靠性。
Conclusion: UltraX通过引入插入操作和可编程编辑流水线，有效解决了大规模预训练数据精炼中的质量、效率和可靠性难题。

papers.title: BiSCo-LLM: Lookup-Free Binary Spherical Coding for Extreme Low-Bit Large Language Model Compression
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly constrained by memory capacity, weight bandwidth, and checkpoint storage during deployment. Existing low-bit compression methods mainly follow two directions. Scalar or group-wise quantization is simple and compatible with efficient low-precision kernels, but its representation capacity becomes limited when the target budget approaches 2 bits per weight. Vector-quantized weight compression provides a richer block-level representation, but usually introduces explicit codebooks, index lookup, and additional storage accounting. This paper presents BiSCo-LLM, a codebook-free binary spherical coding framework for extreme low-bit LLM weight compression. The core pipeline is built on three components. First, local weight chunks are mapped onto a unit hypersphere and binarized into compact spherical codes, so that the main payload is a bit-packed sign stream rather than explicit VQ centroids. Second, a residual BSQ stage encodes the reconstruction error left by the base spherical codec, providing an explicit rate-distortion path without stored codebooks. Third, category-wise recovery distillation is performed after replacing each Transformer module category, reducing the mismatch between local weight reconstruction and assembled model behavior. A small 8-bit protected-channel path is used as an auxiliary stabilization mechanism for sensitive channels and is counted separately from the BSQ payload. The reported storage budget includes binary codes, neural decoders, protected-channel payloads, LoRA adapters, and metadata.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BiSCo-LLM，一种无需码本的二进制球形编码框架，用于极端低位（如2比特每权重）的大语言模型权重压缩。该方法将局部权重块映射到单位超球面并二值化为球形码，配合残差阶段编码重建误差，并通过类别级恢复蒸馏减少局部重建与整体模型行为之间的不匹配。存储预算包括二进制码、神经解码器、保护通道载荷、LoRA适配器和元数据。
Motivation: 现有低位压缩方法中，标量/组量化在目标预算接近2比特每权重时表示能力受限，而向量量化引入显式码本和索引查找，增加存储和计算开销。
Method: 核心流程包括三个组件：1) 局部权重块映射到单位超球面并二值化为球形码，主载荷为符号位流；2) 残差二元球形量化阶段编码基球形编解码器的重建误差，无需存储码本；3) 逐类别恢复蒸馏，在替换每个Transformer模块类别后进行，减少局部重建与组装模型行为之间的不匹配。此外，使用8比特保护通道路径作为敏感通道的辅助稳定机制。
Result: 摘要未在数值上量化结果，但声称该方法在极端低位压缩下有效，存储预算包括二进制码、神经解码器、保护通道载荷、LoRA适配器和元数据。
Conclusion: BiSCo-LLM提供了一种无需码本的二进制球形编码方案，旨在实现大语言模型的极端低位权重压缩，并平衡率失真性能。

papers.title: Steering Neural Network Training through Interpretable Constraints Based on Partial Dependence
papers.abstract_en: Over the last few years, there has been an increased interest in making machine learning models more interpretable. Although a great deal of effort goes into developing techniques for interpreting the interactions learned by a given model, fewer studies focus on assessing the quality of such explanations. Even fewer focus on how to adjust the model to produce explanations faithful to prior knowledge, a process known as explanation-guided learning. Furthermore, most approaches in this area focus on classification problems and usually assume prior knowledge about which input features or regions are most important. In this work, we introduce a new approach to steering neural networks based on partial dependence, such that their average response to certain features aligns with specific functional domain knowledge about the problem. We empirically demonstrate on a range of regression problems, including dynamical systems forecasting, that models whose training has been controlled using our method perform better than unconstrained models and are more data-efficient. Moreover, we highlight that interpretations obtained from the former actually align with the user-provided knowledge, whereas those obtained from the latter do not.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于部分依赖（partial dependence）的约束方法，用于引导神经网络训练，使其对特定特征的平均响应与用户提供的功能领域知识一致。在动态系统预测等多个回归问题上，该方法训练的模型性能优于未受控模型，且数据效率更高，其解释也与先验知识对齐。
Motivation: 现有解释性研究多集中于解释模型学到的交互，但很少关注如何调整模型以产生符合先验知识的解释（解释引导学习），且大部分方法针对分类问题并假设已知重要特征或区域。
Method: 引入基于部分依赖的约束，通过调整训练过程使神经网络对特定特征的平均响应与给定的功能领域知识对齐。
Result: 在多个回归问题（包括动态系统预测）上，受控模型相比未受控模型表现更优、数据效率更高，且其解释与用户提供的知识一致。
Conclusion: 该方法有效融合领域知识于神经网络训练，提升性能与可解释性，但摘要未明确限制其在分类或复杂场景下的适用性。

papers.title: Native Video-Action Pretraining for Generalizable Robot Control
papers.abstract_en: The advent of video-action models offers a promising path for robot control. Nevertheless, we argue that repurposing video generative models designed for digital content creation is inherently inadequate for physical environments. To bridge this gap, we present LingBot-VA 2.0, a video-action foundation model built from the ground up for embodiment. Four core design principles showcase its evolution from LingBot-VA. (1) Departing from traditional reconstruction-focused VAEs, we introduce a semantic visual-action tokenizer, which aligns visual representations with both semantics and actions, improving instruction following and action precision in subsequent policy learning. (2) Given the strictly causal nature of temporal dynamics, we adopt a causal pretraining paradigm, training from scratch to circumvent the catastrophic forgetting that frequently occurs when adapting bidirectional architectures. (3) To meet the demands of high-frequency inference, our model employs a sparse MoE backbone, expanding model capacity without compromising efficiency. (4) Real-time closed-loop control is realized through an enhanced asynchronous inference scheme, which predicts future latents in parallel with action execution while re-grounding each rollout on the latest observation via learned forward dynamics. Real-world deployment validates LingBot-VA 2.0 as a robust foundation model, as evidenced by its few-shot generalization across complex manipulation tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LingBot-VA 2.0，一种从零构建的视频-动作基础模型，用于机器人控制。其四个核心设计包括：语义视觉-动作标记器（对齐视觉与语义和动作）、因果预训练范式（避免灾难性遗忘）、稀疏MoE骨干（扩大容量保持效率）、增强异步推理（并行预测未来隐状态并重锚定最新观测）。真实世界部署验证了其在复杂操作任务上的少样本泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型针对数字内容创作，不适用于物理环境，因此需要从物理环境出发构建视频-动作模型。
Method: 四个设计原则：1）语义视觉-动作标记器替代传统重建VAE，对齐视觉与语义和动作；2）采用因果预训练范式从零训练，避免双向架构适应时的灾难性遗忘；3）使用稀疏MoE骨干扩展模型容量；4）增强异步推理方案，并行预测未来隐状态并在每次滚动中通过学习的前向动力学重锚定最新观测，实现实时闭环控制。
Result: 真实世界部署验证LingBot-VA 2.0作为鲁棒基础模型，在复杂操作任务上展现少样本泛化能力。
Conclusion: 本文强调从头构建的、面向物理世界的视频-动作基础模型比借用数字内容生成模型更适用于机器人控制。

papers.title: The complexities of patient-centred conversational artificial intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Consumer-facing health chatbots powered by large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for symptom assessment. However, chatbot development and evaluation often rely on cooperative, articulate, simulated patients. We analysed 2,053 real patient-chatbot conversations and found that communication patterns and expression of emotions vary widely across users. We developed a patient simulator that separately models clinical content, emotional state, conversational strategy, and communication style. In a Turing-inspired evaluation of realism with 15 human graders, simulated conversations were nearly indistinguishable from real ones, with human graders achieving an accuracy of 55%. We used five distinct patient personae, across 1,164 clinician-graded cases, to evaluate the performance of four LLMs in urgency assessment. We found that communication style can significantly alter triage outcomes. Patient-centred conversational artificial intelligence must accommodate communication diversity: systems designed for idealised, rather than realistic, interactions risk underperforming and amplifying health disparities when deployed in the real world.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析2,053个真实患者-聊天机器人对话，发现用户沟通模式和情绪表达差异很大。作者开发了一个患者模拟器，分别建模临床内容、情绪状态、对话策略和沟通风格。在15名人工评分员的图灵测试式评估中，模拟对话几乎无法与真实对话区分（准确率55%）。使用五种不同患者角色，在1,164个临床医生评分案例中评估四个大语言模型在紧急程度评估上的表现，发现沟通风格显著改变分诊结果。结论是患者中心对话式AI必须容纳沟通多样性，针对理想化而非真实交互设计的系统在实际部署中可能表现不佳并加剧健康差异。

Method: 收集2,053个真实患者与聊天机器人的对话，分析用户沟通模式和情绪表达差异。开发一个患者模拟器，分别建模临床内容、情绪状态、对话策略和沟通风格。在模拟器生成的对话上，进行图灵测试式评估（15名人工评分员）。随后使用五种不同患者角色和1,164个临床医生评分案例，评估四个大语言模型在紧急程度评估上的表现。

papers.title: When Structured Sparse Autoencoders Learn Consistent Concepts Across Modalities
papers.abstract_en: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) have emerged as a promising technique for mechanistic interpretability by learning a set of sparse latent features in large models, each of which encodes a distinct concept. However, in vision-language models (VLMs), vanilla SAEs struggle to learn modality-consistent concepts, with concepts often exhibiting fragmented coverage (i.e., disjoint regions) in the visual modality. To address this challenge, we propose a Structured Sparse AutoEncoder ($S^2AE$) that enforces concept consistency from both semantic and spatial perspectives in the visual modality. Specifically, we group image patches based on Transformer attention similarity and spatial proximity, and introduce a structured sparsity regularization when training the vanilla SAE. The regularization consists of exclusive sparsity for inter-group concept disentanglement and group sparsity for intra-group concept consistency, which drives the latent neurons by SAEs to specialize in distinct, semantically grounded concepts. Evaluated on the \texttt{Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct} model, the method achieves 6.06% average improvement in semantic alignment (mIoU) and 60.81 in representational efficiency (lower l0 norm) while maintaining near-perfect reconstruction fidelity with an Explained Variance above 99%. Cross-modal analysis further demonstrates that $S^2AE$ enhances neuronal monosemanticity by this visual structural prior, achieving a 3.08% average gain in semantic consistency and a 2.37% average gain in monosemanticity scores for both modalities of multimodal features, thereby fostering more coherent and disentangled representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉语言模型（VLM）中稀疏自编码器（SAE）难以学习模态一致概念的问题，提出结构化稀疏自编码器（S^2AE）。该方法在视觉模态中从语义和空间两个角度强制概念一致性，通过基于注意力相似性和空间邻近性对图像块分组，并引入由组间互斥稀疏和组内群体稀疏组成的结构化稀疏正则化。在Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct模型上，该方法在语义对齐（mIoU）上平均提升6.06%，表示效率（更低的l0范数）提升60.81，同时重建保真度保持近乎完美（解释方差>99%）。跨模态分析表明，S^2AE通过视觉结构先验增强了神经元的单语义性，在多模态特征的语义一致性上平均提升3.08%，单语义性得分平均提升2.37%。
Motivation: 在视觉语言模型中，普通稀疏自编码器难以学习模态一致的概念，视觉模态中的概念经常出现碎片化覆盖（即不连续区域），这限制了可解释性。
Method: 提出结构化稀疏自编码器（S^2AE），基于Transformer注意力相似性和空间邻近性将图像块分组，并引入结构化稀疏正则化：组间互斥稀疏用于解耦不同组的概念，组内群体稀疏用于保持组内概念一致性，从而驱动SAE的潜在神经元专精于不同且语义有根基的概念。
Result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct模型上，语义对齐（mIoU）平均提升6.06%，表示效率（l0范数）降低60.81，重建解释方差>99%；跨模态语义一致性平均提升3.08%，单语义性得分平均提升2.37%。
Conclusion: 通过视觉结构先验可以有效增强多模态特征的神经元单语义性和概念一致性，得到更连贯、更解耦的表征。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Precision Therapy in Hepatocellular Carcinoma: A Clinical-Reasoning LLM for Risk Stratification and Treatment Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is a common malignancy and a leading cause of cancer-related mortality. Current guidelines and staging systems provide coarse categories, but often miss within-stage heterogeneity and the clinical context in electronic medical records (EMRs). We present HCC-STAR (Hepatocellular Carcinoma Staging, Treatment And pRognosis), a clinically aligned large language model that reads routine EMR narratives and jointly outputs risk score-based staging, ranked guideline-consistent treatments with evidence-based rationales, and individualized survival estimates. We curated about 30,000 HCC cases from SEER and expanded them into EMR-style narrative training data using a clinician-validated, prompt-based augmentation workflow. On this corpus, we developed a knowledge-aligned reasoning framework optimized with a step-verifiable composite reward, moving beyond text-level memorization of clinical guidelines. In a multi-center cohort of 6,668 patients from 12 hospitals in China, HCC-STAR achieved state-of-the-art performance in treatment recommendation and risk stratification compared with clinical guidelines and competitive models, including GPT-5 and Gemini-2.5 Pro. Hypothetical overall-survival analysis showed a median survival of 51 months under adherence to HCC-STAR recommendations, compared with 29 and 32 months under BCLC and CNLC. In clinician-centric evaluations, blinded hepatobiliary specialists rated HCC-STAR's reasoning and evidence-based justifications as trustworthy. The model surpassed resident and attending physicians in treatment accuracy and helped physicians make more accurate decisions faster when used as an assistant. These findings support HCC-STAR as a reliable and verifiable decision-support system for risk stratification and precision therapy in HCC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HCC-STAR，一个临床对齐的大语言模型，读取电子病历叙述，联合输出基于风险评分的分期、分级的循证治疗推荐和个体化生存估计。在12家医院6668名患者的多中心队列中，HCC-STAR在治疗推荐和风险分层上优于BCLC、CNLC指南及GPT-5、Gemini-2.5 Pro等模型。假设总生存分析显示，遵循HCC-STAR推荐的中位生存为51个月，而BCLC和CNLC分别为29和32个月。盲法评估中，肝胆专家认为其推理和循证理由可信，模型在治疗准确性上超过住院和主治医师，作为辅助工具可帮助医生更快做出更准确决策。
Motivation: 当前HCC指南和分期系统提供粗略分类，但常忽略电子病历中的阶段内异质性和临床背景，需要更精准的风险分层和治疗指导。
Method: 基于约3万例SEER HCC病例，通过临床验证的提示增强流程扩展为EMR风格叙述训练数据；开发知识对齐的推理框架，用步骤可验证的复合奖励优化，超越对临床指南的文本级记忆。
Result: 在12家医院6668名患者的多中心队列中，HCC-STAR在治疗推荐和风险分层上达到SOTA；假设总生存分析显示遵循推荐的中位生存51月，优于BCLC 29月和CNLC 32月。盲法评估中，专家认为其推理可信，模型在治疗准确性上超过住院和主治医师，作为辅助可帮助医生更快更准决策。
Conclusion: 摘要指出HCC-STAR可作为可靠且可验证的决策支持系统，用于HCC风险分层和精准治疗。

papers.title: Federated Deep Learning for Privacy-Preserving Cardiovascular Disease Risk Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Cardiovascular disease risk prediction models often rely on data from a single institution or centrally pooled datasets. Extending these models across institutions could be limited by privacy regulations and constraints on sharing patient-level data. Federated learning enables collaborative model development without transferring sensitive patient data, but its application in healthcare remains challenging because datasets often differ in size, population characteristics, and outcome definitions. In this study, we present a federated deep learning approach for privacy-preserving cardiovascular disease risk prediction that integrates two population-based cohorts with different characteristics: Lifelines, including 148,230 participants meeting the study inclusion criteria with self-reported outcomes, and the Rotterdam Study, including a smaller cohort of 10,155 participants with digitally linked clinical outcomes. Model performance was primarily evaluated on the Rotterdam Study because of its complete follow-up. Deep survival models trained using federated learning achieved higher predictive performance than models trained locally without federation. For the Rotterdam Study, the C-statistic increased from 0.728 (95% CI: 0.717-0.739) to 0.739 (95% CI: 0.728-0.749). For Lifelines, the C-statistic increased from 0.783 (95% CI: 0.775-0.791) to 0.787 (95% CI: 0.780-0.792). These findings suggest that federated deep learning across heterogeneous cohorts can improve cardiovascular disease risk prediction while preserving the privacy of individual-level patient data.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to Frontiers in Applied Mathematics and Statistics, Research Topic "Enhancing Healthcare through Federated Learning: Privacy, Security and Performance"

TL;DR: 本文提出一种联邦深度学习方法，用于在隐私保护条件下进行心血管疾病风险预测。方法整合了两个异质性队列（Lifelines和Rotterdam Study），联邦学习的深度生存模型在Rotterdam Study上C-statistic从0.728提升至0.739，在Lifelines上从0.783提升至0.787，表明联邦学习能在保护患者数据隐私的同时提升预测性能。
Motivation: 心血管疾病风险预测模型通常基于单中心或集中式数据，跨机构扩展受限于隐私法规和数据共享约束。联邦学习虽能解决这一问题，但医疗应用中不同队列在规模、人群特征和结局定义上的异质性仍是挑战。
Method: 采用联邦深度学习框架，训练深度生存模型（deep survival models），在两个异质性队列（Lifelines和Rotterdam Study）上协同训练，无需交换原始患者数据，通过模型参数聚合实现隐私保护。
Result: 在Rotterdam Study上，C-statistic从0.728（95%CI: 0.717-0.739）提升至0.739（95%CI: 0.728-0.749）；在Lifelines上，C-statistic从0.783（95%CI: 0.775-0.791）提升至0.787（95%CI: 0.780-0.792）。
Conclusion: 联邦深度学习在异质性医疗队列中能改善心血管疾病风险预测，同时保持患者级数据的隐私性。

papers.title: Robust Bayesian Decision Making under Adversarial Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: Scientific experiments are often designed to maximize information gain, yet in many applications the primary objective is to support reliable downstream decision-making. Existing decision-aware experimental design and active learning methods typically assume well-specified outcome models and implicitly rely on the stability of the optimal decision under real-world perturbations. In practice, however, experimental outcomes are frequently influenced by hidden or weakly modeled effects, which can substantially alter decision optimality and lead to misleading conclusions. We study sequential adversarially robust decision-aware experimental design, where data acquisition has to take into account information gain against plausible worst-case unexpected effects, modeled here as variation in adversarial variables. Building on Bayesian decision theory, we formalize an adversarially robust optimal decision under this setting and derive a principled Bayesian experimental design criterion. The criterion explicitly targets decision stability rather than nominal optimality. Experiments on synthetic and real-world scientific datasets show that conventional decision-aware design can converge rapidly to high confidence yet fragile decisions, while our robustness-aware approach yields decisions that are significantly more stable and reliable under adversarial variation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究对抗性不确定性下的鲁棒贝叶斯决策，提出对抗鲁棒决策感知实验设计方法，通过考虑最坏情况对抗变量变化来追求决策稳定性而非名义最优性。在合成和真实科学数据集上验证，传统方法可能快速收敛到高置信度但脆弱的决策，而该方法产生更稳定可靠的决策。
Motivation: 现有决策感知实验设计通常假设模型完美指定，忽视了实际中隐藏或弱建模效应导致的决策最优性变化，从而可能产生误导性结论。
Method: 在贝叶斯决策理论框架下，将未知的意外效应建模为对抗变量，形式化对抗鲁棒最优决策，并导出一个贝叶斯实验设计准则，该准则直接针对决策稳定性而非名义最优性。
Result: 在合成和真实科学数据集上，与传统决策感知设计相比，该方法显著提高了决策在对抗变化下的稳定性和可靠性。

papers.title: Spectral Stability of Pseudoinverse-Based Extreme Learning Machine
papers.abstract_en: Extreme Learning Machine (ELM) computes output weights analytically using the Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse. Although this leads to fast training, its numerical stability depends strongly on the conditioning of the hidden layer matrix. This paper studies pseudoinverse-based ELM from a spectral perspective. We show that the smallest singular value governs perturbation amplification in the output weights, while the condition number provides a quantitative measure of hidden-layer instability. We compare SVD-based pseudoinverse computation with iterative hyperpower methods and discuss width-dependent conditioning through a random feature interpretation. Experiments on synthetic matrices and ELM benchmarks show that SVD-based methods remain the most reliable under ill conditioning, while iterative methods are more sensitive to spectral properties. The results suggest that ELM stability is fundamentally governed by the singular value structure of the hidden layer matrix.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从谱角度研究基于伪逆的极限学习机（ELM）的稳定性，证明最小奇异值支配输出权重的扰动放大，条件数衡量隐藏层不稳定性。通过实验比较SVD与迭代超幂法，表明SVD在病态条件下最可靠。
Motivation: ELM使用Moore-Penrose伪逆计算输出权重，但其数值稳定性强烈依赖于隐藏层矩阵的条件数，需要从谱角度理解其稳定性机理。
Method: 理论分析最小奇异值与条件数对输出权重扰动的影响，并对比基于SVD的伪逆计算与迭代超幂法在不同条件下的性能。
Result: 实验表明SVD方法在病态条件下最可靠，迭代方法对谱性质更敏感。稳定性根本上由隐藏层矩阵的奇异值结构决定。
Conclusion: ELM的稳定性由其隐藏层矩阵的奇异值结构主导，选择伪逆计算方法时应考虑矩阵条件数。

papers.title: ImputeViz: A Visual Analytics Dashboard for Diagnosing Missing Data and Comparing Imputation Methods
papers.abstract_en: Missing data is a persistent obstacle in scientific, social science, and public health research, often biasing analyses and placing accountability on analysts for how they handle missing values. We introduce ImputeViz, an integrated visual analytics dashboard that supports diagnosing missingness, configuring imputation models, and evaluating results. The system brings together widely used methods, including MICE, Random Forest, XGBoost, and kNN, within an interactive environment that makes missingness patterns explicit. To support geospatial reasoning, we introduce gKNN, a geographically informed kNN variant that blends socioeconomic and spatial distances and exposes donor contributions, enabling provenance-based visual accountability by showing which regions drive each estimate. Our primary contribution is a method-agnostic visual analytics environment that makes cross-method comparison a first-class visual task and integrates gKNN alongside standard methods. Coordinated views reveal missingness structure through heatmaps, co-missingness summaries, and distributional diagnostics that help analysts reason about missingness patterns (MCAR/MAR) and cases where missingness may be non-random (MNAR). Users can compare and tune models and interrogate results via distributional overlays, a Method Comparison Summary reporting MAE, RMSE, Delta RMSE, and runtime for each algorithm on the current target and mask, along with variable-level discrepancy views. Cached per-method results and locked axis scales reduce cognitive overhead from shifting ranges during method switching. These comparisons highlight where methods disagree, which variables are sensitive, and how imputation choices affect downstream summaries. Case studies demonstrate how ImputeViz helps analysts select effective strategies, surface sensitive variables, and assess model robustness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ImputeViz 是一个集成可视化分析仪表盘，支持诊断缺失数据模式、配置插补模型并评估结果。系统集成了 MICE、Random Forest、XGBoost、kNN 等常用方法，并引入地理加权 kNN 变体 gKNN，通过协同视图（热图、共缺失摘要、分布诊断）和方法比较摘要（MAE、RMSE、Delta RMSE、运行时间）帮助分析师选择策略并评估模型鲁棒性。
Motivation: 缺失数据是科学研究中的常见障碍，现有工具缺乏对缺失模式的可视化诊断和跨方法比较的集成环境，导致分析师难以选择合适策略并评估插补影响。
Method: 提出 ImputeViz，一个方法无关的可视化分析仪表盘，集成了 MICE、Random Forest、XGBoost、kNN 等标准插补方法，并引入地理加权 kNN（gKNN）变体以结合社会经济和空间距离。系统提供热图、共缺失摘要、分布诊断等视图，并通过方法比较摘要和变量级别差异视图支持跨方法比较与参数调整。
Result: 案例研究表明，ImputeViz 能帮助分析师选择有效策略、识别敏感变量并评估模型鲁棒性。系统提供 MAE、RMSE、Delta RMSE、运行时间等指标，以及变量级别差异视图，突出方法分歧和插补对下游摘要的影响。
Conclusion: 主要贡献是提供了一个方法无关的可视化分析环境，使跨方法比较成为首要视觉任务，并整合了 gKNN，增强了插补结果的可解释性和责任性。

papers.title: SHAP-Weighted Cross-Modal Expert Fusion for Emotion and Sentiment Recognition: Evidence and Limits
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal emotion and sentiment recognition is commonly addressed by early fusion, which concatenates modalities before classification, or late fusion, which combines independently trained unimodal predictors. Early fusion can be accurate but monolithic, while late fusion is modular but may lose cross-modal interactions. This paper revisits XAI-guided adaptive fusion (\xgaf), a tree-based mixture of unimodal and cross-modal experts whose sample-level weights are derived from TreeSHAP attribution magnitudes. We focus on the effect of SHAP attribution reduction when experts have unequal feature dimensionalities. In this setting, mean-abs and median-abs reductions can suppress high-dimensional cross-modal experts, whereas sum-abs reduction preserves total attribution mass. On MELD 7-class emotion recognition, sum-abs \xgaf{} nearly matches early fusion across three face-sequence aggregators; the Transformer variant reaches 0.5983 \wf{}, compared with 0.6018 for early fusion and 0.4598 for probability-average late fusion. McNemar testing shows no significant difference between sum-abs \xgaf{} and early fusion on MELD ($p=1.000$), while \xgaf{} remains significantly better than late fusion ($p<0.0001$). On CMU-MOSEI 3-class sentiment recognition, sum-abs \xgaf{} reaches 0.6519 \wf{}, slightly exceeding early fusion (0.6485) and late fusion (0.5696). Ablation studies show that the main gain comes from adding cross-modal experts, especially the trimodal expert, rather than from complex per-sample routing. Diagnostics further show that mean-abs and median-abs weights are nearly uniform, while sum-abs weights concentrate on the trimodal expert. Thus, the main contribution is a transparent empirical analysis of how SHAP reduction, expert dimensionality, and cross-modal expert design affect modular multimodal fusion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视XAI引导的自适应融合（XGAF），一种基于TreeSHAP归因幅度的树状混合专家模型，用于多模态情感与情绪识别。研究发现当专家特征维度不等时，mean-abs和median-abs归约会抑制高维跨模态专家，而sum-abs归约保留总归因质量。在MELD和CMU-MOSEI数据集上，sum-abs XGAF接近或略超早期融合，显著优于概率平均晚期融合。消融表明主要增益来自跨模态专家（尤其三模态专家）而非复杂样本级路由。
Motivation: 早期融合精确但 monolithic，晚期融合模块化但可能丢失跨模态交互。现有自适应融合方法缺乏对SHAP归因减少及其与专家维度关系的系统分析。
Method: 提出XGAF框架，使用TreeSHAP归因幅度计算样本级权重，混合单模态和跨模态专家。对比三种SHAP归约方法（mean-abs、median-abs、sum-abs）在特征维度不等时的表现。
Result: 在MELD 7类情绪识别上，sum-abs XGAF的Transformer变体达0.5983 wF，早期融合0.6018，晚期融合0.4598；McNemar检验显示sum-abs XGAF与早期融合无显著差异（p=1.000），显著优于晚期融合（p<0.0001）。在CMU-MOSEI 3类情感识别上，sum-abs XGAF达0.6519 wF，略超早期融合0.6485和晚期融合0.5696。
Conclusion: 主要贡献是透明的实证分析，阐明SHAP归约方法、专家特征维度和跨模态专家设计如何影响模块化多模态融合。研究局限包括仅考虑TreeSHAP和特定数据集，未来可探索其他归因方法和应用场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Switch-Reasoner: Learn When to Think in Multitask Mixtures via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) often follow a fixed Think-then-Answer paradigm, which is inefficient in heterogeneous multitask settings because simple inputs may not require explicit reasoning while difficult ones can benefit substantially from it. Learning when to think is also unstable during post-training, where imbalanced rollouts can drive the model toward always-thinking or always-direct behavior. We propose Switch-Reasoner, a GRPO-based framework that learns to adaptively select reasoning modes for MLLMs. It treats thinking as a virtual tool invocation and allows the model to either answer directly or invoke explicit reasoning before answering. To stabilize this decision, we introduce a dual-level regulation mechanism that balances the overall use of Thinking Mode and Direct Mode while providing sample-level supervision based on the relative benefit of the two choices. Experiments on 11 multimodal tasks show that Switch-Reasoner reduces unnecessary reasoning while maintaining strong performance, achieving a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Switch-Reasoner，一种基于 GRPO 的框架，用于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）自适应选择推理模式（Thinking Mode 或 Direct Mode），以在异构多任务设置中平衡准确性与效率。实验在 11 个多模态任务上表明，该方法在不显著降低性能的情况下减少了不必要的推理计算。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 采用固定推理范式，对于简单输入可能过度计算，而复杂输入则需更多推理；同时后训练中学习何时推理易导致偏向始终推理或始终直接回答的不稳定行为。
Method: 采用 GRPO 框架，将思考视为虚拟工具调用，允许模型选择直接回答或先推理后回答；引入双层调节机制，在全局层面平衡两种模式的使用率，并在样本层面基于相对收益提供监督。
Result: 在 11 个多模态任务上，Switch-Reasoner 减少了不必要的推理计算，同时保持了强性能，实现了更好的准确率-效率权衡。
Conclusion: 摘要强调了自适应推理模式切换在多任务 MLLM 中的有效性，但未讨论泛化至其他模态或长序列场景的限制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SMetric: Rethink LLM Scheduling for Serving Agents with Balanced Session-centric Scheduling
papers.abstract_en: LLM scheduling is critical to serving, yet it remains unclear how well existing designs fit agentic serving--with LLM requests issued by agents instead of humans. This shifts the workload in two ways: (1) agents act only on complete responses, making the cluster's tokens per second (TPS) the primary goal and relaxing--not eliminating--per-token latency requirements; and (2) requests share much of their KV\$-reuse exceeds 80% of request tokens in a production trace from BAILIAN, versus 54-62% in chat. This paper first contributes a systematic study of request scheduling for agents on two real-world traces. We find that to increase KV\$ reuse, existing schedulers overly prioritize routing requests to instances caching their KV\$, overloading a few while leaving the rest idle, capping TPS. We thus present two key insights: (1) load balance need not sacrifice all KV\$ reuse, thanks to the global-tier KV\$ store and (2) by utilizing the workload's intra-session locality, balancing a small fraction of requests--the first request in each agent session--suffices to balance the cluster without sacrificing most KV\$ reuse on local instances. SMETRIC realizes these insights with balanced session-centric scheduling: it routes each session's first request purely for load balance and its follow-up requests in a cache-aware manner, preserving load balance and local reuse while keeping demand on the global tier low. Using the session turn information as the scheduling metric is deliberate: it is derived efficiently and accurately from the user inputs alone, so the scheduler stays clean and stateless. SMETRIC improves cluster TPS by 10-16% under prefill-decode colocation with a global store and prefill TPS by 2-34% under disaggregation over state-of-the-art schedulers, also with a better per-token latency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对智能体场景下LLM请求调度的负载不均衡问题，提出基于会话轮次信息的会话中心调度策略SMetric。研究发现现有调度器过度优先路由到缓存实例导致部分实例过载，而通过平衡每个会话的第一个请求即可实现负载均衡，同时保留大部分局部KV-cache重用。在预填-解码共置和分离架构下，SMetric分别提升集群TPS 10-16%和预填TPS 2-34%。
Motivation: 现有LLM调度器在智能体服务场景下不适用：智能体请求依赖完整响应，KV-cache重用率高达80%以上，但传统调度器为追求重用导致实例负载不均，限制整体吞吐。
Method: 提出SMetric调度器，利用会话轮次作为调度度量：每个会话的第一个请求完全基于负载均衡路由，后续请求采用缓存感知路由，从而在全局KV存储支持下实现负载均衡与局部重用兼顾。
Result: 在生产追踪BAILIAN上，SMetric在预填-解码共置架构下提升集群TPS 10-16%，在分离架构下提升预填TPS 2-34%，同时改善每token延迟。
Conclusion: 通过仅平衡会话的第一个请求即可有效均衡负载，无需牺牲大部分KV-cache重用，且调度器保持无状态和轻量。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有LLM调度器在智能体服务场景下不适用：智能体请求依赖完整响应，KV-cache重用率高达80%以上，但传统调度器为追求重用导致实例负载不均，限制整体吞吐。
summary_sections.method: 提出SMetric调度器，利用会话轮次作为调度度量：每个会话的第一个请求完全基于负载均衡路由，后续请求采用缓存感知路由，从而在全局KV存储支持下实现负载均衡与局部重用兼顾。
summary_sections.result: 在生产追踪BAILIAN上，SMetric在预填-解码共置架构下提升集群TPS 10-16%，在分离架构下提升预填TPS 2-34%，同时改善每token延迟。
summary_sections.conclusion: 通过仅平衡会话的第一个请求即可有效均衡负载，无需牺牲大部分KV-cache重用，且调度器保持无状态和轻量。

papers.title: Contravariance Theory: Strong Alignment for Minimal Solutions to Hard Tasks
papers.abstract_en: A series of results from the NeuroAI over the past fifteen years have raised core questions both about how to compare Deep Neural Network (DNN) models to the brain, and about how much convergent evolution to expect between artificial networks and real brain networks. Here, we show that for any two minimal DNN solutions to a sufficiently hard task: (i) "weak" alignment of network representations based on affine mappings guarantees "strong" alignment of privileged axes, and (ii) alignment "zippers" up the network hierarchy, causing the emergence of privileged axes from end-to-end task optimization. These results formalize the notion of contravariance from Cao and Yamins [2024], and illustrate important consequences for the theory of NeuroAI: with sufficiently strong tasks, choice of metric for inter-network comparison is not all that sensitive, and that convergent evolution is probably inevitable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明，对于任何两个解决足够困难任务的极小深度神经网络（DNN），基于仿射映射的网络表示“弱”对齐能保证特定轴的“强”对齐，且对齐会沿网络层级向上“拉链”，导致特权轴从端到端任务优化中涌现。这些结果形式化了 Cao 和 Yamins [2024] 提出的反变性（contravariance）概念，并表明在足够强的任务下，网络间比较的度量选择并不敏感，趋同进化（convergent evolution）极可能是必然的。
Motivation: 过去十五年的神经AI（NeuroAI）研究引发了核心问题：如何将深度神经网络（DNN）模型与大脑进行比较，以及人工网络与真实大脑网络之间应期待多少趋同进化。
Method: 通过理论证明，对任何两个极小DNN在足够难任务上的表示： (i) 基于仿射映射的“弱”对齐保证了特权轴的“强”对齐； (ii) 对齐沿网络层级向上“拉链”，使得特权轴从端到端任务优化中涌现。
Result: 这些结果形式化了反变性（contravariance）概念，并说明对于足够强的任务，网络间比较的度量选择并不敏感，趋同进化可能不可避免。
Conclusion: 本文的发现对神经AI理论有重要含义：任务足够强时，跨网络比较的度量不那么关键，且趋同进化很可能是必然的。

papers.title: CAAD: Causality-Aware Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection via Multi-Scale Alignment and Structural Causal Consistency
papers.abstract_en: The operational integrity of complex industrial systems relies on precise anomaly detection and diagnosis. The vast majority of existing methods narrowly focus on capturing temporal similarities of representations, often overlooking the disruption of internal causal relationships, which characterizes system failures and latent anomalies. In this paper, we propose a novel framework (CAAD) that reframes anomaly detection as the continuous verification of Granger causality consistency through exogenous variables. Specifically, the CAAD framework models exogenous time-series variables as residuals, identifying anomalies as significant deviations caused by external interventions. The proposed framework leverages multi-scale alignment to internalize system dynamics and utilizes a gradient-based matrix to monitor internal causal relationship breakdowns. By quantifying causal deviations of both dynamic evolution and relational topology, the CAAD is able to capture subtle causal shifts to achieve precise anomaly detection. Extensive experiments on real-world industrial datasets demonstrate that the CAAD achieves high-precision anomaly detection, outperforming most state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CAAD框架，将多变量时间序列异常检测重新定义为通过外生变量持续验证格兰杰因果一致性。该方法利用多尺度对齐学习系统动态，并通过基于梯度的矩阵监控内部因果关系的断裂，从而捕捉由外部干预引起的细微因果偏移。在真实工业数据集上的实验表明，CAAD实现了高精度异常检测，性能优于大多数现有基线。
Motivation: 现有异常检测方法大多仅关注表示的时间相似性，忽略了系统故障和潜在异常所表征的内部因果关系破坏，导致检测精度不足。
Method: CAAD框架将外生时间序列变量建模为残差，通过多尺度对齐内化系统动态，并利用基于梯度的矩阵监控内部因果关系的断裂，从而量化动态演化和关系拓扑中的因果偏差。
Result: 在真实工业数据集上，CAAD实现了高精度异常检测，性能优于大多数最先进的基线方法。
Conclusion: 通过量化因果偏移，CAAD能够捕获细微的因果变化以实现精确的异常检测，但论文未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: CommuniWave:A Machine Learning Model for Quantifying the Degree of Temporary Informal Behavior in Urban Communities
papers.abstract_en: For urban managers and designers, improving the functional attributes of urban communities to enhance territorial resilience in the face of complexity and uncertainty is crucial. Currently, community planning often follows a top-down approach and lacks effective metrics to quantify informal behaviors of residents, leading to frequent conflicts with original plans. This study introduces CommuniWave, a machine learning model designed to efficiently detect and quantify the Degree of Informal Behavior (DIB) in urban communities. The model integrates a Behavior Capture Net (BCN) based on mmaction2, a self-developed YOLOv10 model (YLX), and a Behavior Eval Model (BEM) using random forest. Ultimately, by generating DIB fluctuation charts from street videos, the model facilitates dynamic monitoring, supporting urban managers in making refined decisions to enhance the overall resilience of communities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CommuniWave机器学习模型，用于量化城市社区中居民非正式行为的程度（DIB）。模型整合基于mmaction2的行为捕捉网络（BCN）、自研YOLOv10模型（YLX）以及基于随机森林的行为评估模型（BEM），通过分析街景视频生成DIB波动图，支持城市管理者进行精细化决策以提升社区韧性。
Motivation: 当前社区规划常采用自上而下的方式，缺乏有效指标量化居民的临时非正式行为，导致规划与原计划频繁冲突，难以增强社区在面对复杂性和不确定性时的韧性。
Method: 提出CommuniWave模型，包含三个模块：基于mmaction2的行为捕捉网络（BCN）用于检测行为，自研YOLOv10模型（YLX）用于目标识别，以及基于随机森林的行为评估模型（BEM）用于计算非正式行为程度（DIB）。最终通过街景视频生成DIB波动图。
Result: 模型能够从街景视频中生成DIB波动图，实现动态监测，但摘要未报告具体的量化性能指标。
Conclusion: 该方法为城市管理者提供了量化非正式行为的工具，有助于做出精细化决策，从而提升社区的整体韧性。

papers.title: Structural Bottlenecks on Frequency Representation in End-to-End Audio Models
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end neural audio models achieve high-fidelity compression and generation. We might read that performance as evidence they directly represent interpretable features such as pitch and timbre, but a model can produce plausible outputs without doing so. A model may encode these features in any reachable basis, but regardless of which, the features are well described as compositions of time-frequency-localized primitives. Whether state-of-the-art encoders preserve access to these primitives, and thus to compositions of them, remains unclear. Through theoretical analysis and controlled experiments, we show that several state-of-the-art strided convolutional encoders impose two structural bottlenecks, both predictable from architecture and signal structure, on access to these primitives: (1) they collapse primitives into alias equivalence classes, establishing a bound on representational capacity, and (2) they limit the frequency resolution available to learned filters, restricting separability. For well structured data, we find collapse rates of 31-35% and filter bandwidths 10-35x above the theoretical resolution bound, confirming that both bottlenecks arise under realistic signal conditions. We then introduce Gabor Latent Refactorization (GLRF), a lightweight post-hoc intervention that re-expresses encoder latents in a frequency-localized basis, reducing filter bandwidths from 10-35x to 1.5-3x of the theoretical resolution bound while preserving reconstruction fidelity and improving control over attributes like pitch. These results show that the encoders in question predictably degrade access to frequency-localized primitives, entangling the features that depend on them, and that a lightweight, retraining-free intervention can recover much of that access, improving steerability and interpretability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过理论分析和受控实验，揭示端到端神经音频编码器在频率表示上存在两个结构性瓶颈：别名等价类（collapse into alias equivalence classes）和有限频率分辨率。提出轻量级事后干预方法Gabor潜在重构（GLRF），将编码器潜在表示重新表达为频率局部化基，使滤波器带宽从理论分辨率界限的10-35倍降至1.5-3倍，同时保持重构保真度并改善音高控制。
Motivation: 端到端音频模型虽能产生高保真输出，但其内部表示是否保留对可解释的声学特征（如音高、音色）所依赖的时频局部化基元访问尚不清楚，这限制了模型的可控性和可解释性。
Method: 从理论上证明步进卷积编码器引入两个结构性瓶颈：别名等价类限制表示容量，滤波器带宽限制频率分辨率。提出GLRF，一种无需重训练的轻量级事后干预，通过将潜在表示重新表达为Gabor基元（频率局部化基）来缓解上述瓶颈。
Result: 在结构化数据上，编码器对时频基元的别名率达31-35%，滤波器带宽为理论分辨率极限的10-35倍；GLRF将滤波器带宽降至1.5-3倍，保持重构保真度并改善对音高等属性的控制。
Conclusion: 现有编码器可预测地降低对频率局部化基元的访问，混淆依赖这些基元的特征，而轻量级无重训练干预GLRF能恢复大部分访问，提高模型的可控性和可解释性。

papers.title: VocaDet: Sample-Driven Open-Vocabulary Object Detection and Segmentation via Visual Tokenization and Vector Database Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary object detection and segmentation aim to recognize arbitrary objects beyond predefined categories. Although recent vision-language and reference-based approaches have significantly advanced this field, they often rely on text prompts, limited visual examples, or expensive feature matching procedures, making them difficult to scale to large and continuously expanding object repositories. In this work, we propose VocaDet, a sample-driven open-vocabulary object detection and segmentation framework that learns object concepts directly from user-provided positive and negative sample collections without model retraining. The key idea is to transform continuous visual representations into discrete visual vocabularies and perform efficient retrieval-based recognition through a scalable vector database. Specifically, we employ DINOv3 as the visual feature extractor and apply agglomerative clustering with adaptive clustering sensitivity to generate multi-granularity visual tokens. These visual tokens, together with position-debiased representations and spatial topology information, are stored as expandable object memories in a vector database. During inference, query images are converted into visual tokens and efficiently matched against the stored object memories for object localization and segmentation. Furthermore, a background filtering mechanism is introduced to remove frequently occurring background patterns and reduce redundant retrieval operations in practical fixed-camera scenarios. Experiments on the UA-DETRAC dataset demonstrate that VocaDet achieves effective open-vocabulary detection performance without conventional detector training, while supporting continuously expandable recognition capability as additional positive and negative samples are accumulated.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VocaDet，一种样本驱动的开放词汇目标检测与分割框架，无需模型重训练即可从用户提供的正负样本中学习对象概念。通过 DINOv3 提取视觉特征，利用凝聚聚类生成多粒度视觉标记，并存储在向量数据库中实现高效检索识别。在 UA-DETRAC 数据集上，VocaDet 无需传统检测器训练即取得有效检测性能，并支持随样本积累持续扩展。
Motivation: 现有开放词汇检测方法依赖文本提示、有限视觉样本或昂贵特征匹配，难以扩展到大型且不断增长的对象库。
Method: 采用 DINOv3 作为视觉特征提取器，通过自适应聚类灵敏度的凝聚聚类生成多粒度视觉标记，结合位置去偏表示和空间拓扑信息存储为向量数据库中的可扩展对象记忆；推理时，查询图像转换的视觉标记与对象记忆匹配，并引入背景过滤机制减少冗余检索。
Result: 在 UA-DETRAC 数据集上，VocaDet 无需传统检测器训练即实现有效的开放词汇检测性能，并支持随着正负样本积累而持续扩展的识别能力。
Conclusion: VocaDet 提供了一种无需重训练即可从样本集合中学习新对象概念的框架，适用于持续扩展的识别场景，但摘要未提及明确的性能数值或局限性。

papers.title: DocMaster: A Hierarchical Structure-Aware System for Document Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Leveraging large language models (LLMs) to analyze complex documents -- such as academic papers, technical manuals, and financial reports -- has emerged as a mainstream and critical task in both research and industry. In practice, users must first filter relevant documents from large collections and then conduct in-depth analysis (e.g. question answering) over the selected subset, yet existing systems flatten documents into plain-text chunks, discarding the rich hierarchical structures (sections, tables, figures, equations) and degrading downstream performance. We present DocMaster, a hierarchical structure-aware document analysis system. DocMaster parses documents into hierarchical document trees preserving original layouts and constructs a structure-aware semantic index that enables accurate document filtering and in-depth analysis. We demonstrate DocMaster through an interactive web interface that enables users to upload document collections, construct tree-based and multi-view semantic indices, filter relevant documents via natural-language conditions, and perform follow-up question answering over the filtered results. The source code, data, and demo are available at https://doc-master.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DocMaster 是一个层次结构感知的文档分析系统，能够将复杂文档解析为保留原始布局的文档树，并构建结构感知的语义索引，支持准确的文档筛选和深度问答。系统通过交互式 Web 界面演示，允许用户上传文档集合、构建树状和多视角语义索引、通过自然语言条件筛选相关文档，并对筛选结果进行后续问答。
Motivation: 现有文档分析系统将文档扁平化为纯文本块，丢弃了丰富的层次结构（如章节、表格、图形、公式），导致下游性能下降。
Method: DocMaster 将文档解析为层次文档树，保留原始布局，并构建结构感知的语义索引，支持文档筛选和深度分析。
Result: 摘要展示了系统的交互式 Web 界面和功能，但未提供具体的量化结果或基准测试。

papers.title: High-Dimensional Procrustes Matching via Tree Counts
papers.abstract_en: Suppose we observe two sets of $n$ Gaussian vectors in $\mathbb{R}^d$, with the promise that, after applying a permutation of $[n]$ and a rotation of $\mathbb{R}^d$, the two sets are $ρ$-correlated. The Procrustes matching problem asks us to recover the unknown permutation of $[n]$ that aligns the two sets. The problem is well-studied in the low-dimensional regime $d=O(\log n)$, but the high-dimensional regime $d\gg \log n$ has remained largely uncharted: prior matching guarantees require nearly perfect correlation $ρ=1-o(1)$, even for information-theoretic recovery. Our main result is a polynomial-time algorithm for exact recovery at constant correlation. The algorithm works by computing and comparing weighted counts of a specially chosen family of ``wide'' trees. So long as $d\ge \mathrm{polylog}(n)$, the algorithm succeeds with high probability for any $ρ^2>\sqrtα$, where $α\approx 0.338$ is Otter's tree-counting constant. We complement this algorithmic result with an improved information-theoretic guarantee, showing that exact recovery is possible when $ρ^2 \gtrsim \max\{\log n/d,\sqrt{\log n/n}\}$. We also carry out a low-degree advantage calculation, which suggests that the condition $ρ^2 > \sqrtα$ is necessary for any tree-counting algorithm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究高维Procrustes匹配问题，即观察到两组n个高斯向量，在未知排列和旋转后具有ρ相关性，目标是恢复排列。主要贡献是在高维d≫log n下，提出基于加权树计数的多项式时间算法，能在恒定相关性下精确恢复，条件为ρ^2 > √α（α≈0.338）。同时给出信息论下界和低度优势计算。
Motivation: 低维d=O(log n)已有研究，但高维d≫log n的排列恢复一直缺乏有效算法，已有结果仅适用于近完美相关ρ=1-o(1)。本文旨在实现恒定相关下的精确恢复。
Method: 算法通过计算和比较特定“宽”树的加权计数来工作，利用树计数的统计性质区分不同排列。理论分析结合Otter树计数常数α。
Result: 当d≥polylog(n)且ρ^2 > √α时，算法以高概率成功。信息论下界显示ρ^2 ≳ max{log n/d, √(log n/n)}时精确恢复可能。低度计算表明ρ^2 > √α对任何树计数算法是必要的。
Conclusion: 在高维Procrustes匹配问题上取得了突破，提供了首个在恒定相关下可行的多项式时间算法，并刻画了树计数方法的理论极限。

papers.title: Whareformer: Learning to Track What is Where in Long Egocentric Videos
papers.abstract_en: The recently established 'Out of Sight, Not out of Mind' (OSNOM) task for egocentric videos focuses on tracking objects that are moved by the camera wearer, online, maintaining knowledge of instance locations throughout the video even when they leave the field of view or become heavily occluded. In this paper, we propose the first learning-based solution to the OSNOM task: Whareformer, a transformer-based model with two components: an updatable memory of established tracks and a track assignment module that associates observations with existing tracks in a feed-forward manner. Whareformer jointly reasons over evolving object appearance (what) and updated 3D location (where), and employs a dedicated New Track token to reason about novel objects. Thanks to its design choices of using relative distances and evolving track representations, Whareformer is trained on a small set of 56 videos but achieves SOTA performance on 260 long test videos from three datasets: EPIC-KITCHENS-100 (unseen videos), IT3DEgo, and HD-EPIC, with significant absolute improvements over prior work.
papers.comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026. Project Webpage: https://jacobchalk.github.io/Whareformer/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对第一人称视频中物体的在线跟踪任务（OSNOM），提出首个基于学习的解决方案Whareformer。该模型采用Transformer架构，包含可更新记忆和轨道分配模块，通过联合推理物体外观和3D位置变化来跟踪物体，并引入特殊的新轨迹标记处理首次出现的物体。在EPIC-KITCHENS-100、IT3DEgo和HD-EPIC三个数据集上，Whareformer仅用56个训练视频即取得显著优于先前方法的性能。
Motivation: 现有OSNOM方法依赖手工规则或启发式，缺乏学习能力，难以处理物体离开视野或被严重遮挡的情况。需要一种能够在线维护物体实例位置知识的方法。
Method: Whareformer由两个组件构成：一个可更新的已跟踪轨迹记忆体，以及一个前馈式的轨迹分配模块，将观测与现有轨迹关联。模型联合建模物体外观（what）和更新后的3D位置（where），并使用专用新轨迹令牌来推理新物体。设计上采用相对距离和演化轨迹表示，使得模型只需少量训练视频即可泛化。
Result: 在EPIC-KITCHENS-100（未见过的视频）、IT3DEgo和HD-EPIC三个数据集的260个长测试视频上，Whareformer取得了当时最优性能，且较先前方法有显著绝对改进。
Conclusion: 本文展示了一种有效的基于Transformer的学习方案来解决第一人称视频中的物体跟踪问题，其轻量训练需求和跨数据集泛化能力表明该方法具有实用潜力。

papers.title: When the Judge Changes, So Does the Measurement: Auditing LLM-as-Judge Reliability
papers.abstract_en: An LLM-as-judge score can move even when the candidate responses stay fixed, simply because the evaluator has changed. We treat this evaluator-replacement ambiguity as a measurement-validity problem. Across four judgment datasets, we compare two upgrade paths available in practice: scaling Qwen3 dense judges from 1.7B to 32B parameters and moving across MiniMax M2-M2.7 released APIs. The main pattern is that judge upgrades are not interchangeable: only Qwen3 1.7B to 4B gives a robust adjacent gain, while MiniMax adjacent releases do not. Stronger judges reduce but do not remove position and verbosity bias. Repeated-sample juries add little when errors are correlated. Structured debate can move decisions substantially, but without parser and fallback logs those shifts cannot be attributed to deliberation. We argue that LLM-as-judge reports should include dataset slices, bias probes, error-dependence estimates, and protocol audit trails.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究LLM作为评判者（LLM-as-judge）的可靠性问题，指出更换评估模型会导致评分变化，即使候选回答固定不变。通过多个数据集比较不同升级路径（如Qwen3规模扩展和MiniMax API升级），发现升级并非无缝衔接，且强模型仍存在位置和冗长偏差。作者提出改进评估报告的建议。
Motivation: LLM作为评判者时，评估模型的更换会导致评分不一致，这构成测量有效性问题，影响评估结果的可靠性和可比性。
Method: 在四个判断数据集上，对比两种实际可行的升级路径：从Qwen3 1.7B到32B的密集模型扩展，以及MiniMax M2到M2.7的API版本升级。分析了位置偏差、冗长偏差、陪审团聚合和结构化辩论的影响。
Result: 只有Qwen3从1.7B到4B提供稳健的相邻增益；MiniMax相邻版本间并非互替。强模型减少但未消除位置和冗长偏差。当错误相关时，重复样本陪审团贡献甚微。结构化辩论可大幅改变决策，但需解析和回退日志才能归因于审议。
Conclusion: LLM-as-judge报告应包含数据集切片、偏差探测、误差依赖估计和协议审计轨迹，以提高可靠性。

papers.title: AI-guided stimuli discovery and generation to optimize facial emotion perception studies in autism
papers.abstract_en: Understanding perceptual differences between autistic and neurotypical adults requires behavioral assays that are sensitive, reliable, and mechanistically informative. Facial emotion perception is a useful test case because group differences have been reported, but findings vary across studies. Here we show that this variability may reflect image-level sparsity: autistic-neurotypical differences in emotion judgments were concentrated in a small subset of diagnostic facial expressions rather than spread uniformly across stimuli. We trained population-specific artificial neural network models to predict image-level judgments for autistic and neurotypical participants, then used these models to select novel faces predicted to maximize group separation. In an independent cohort, model-selected images produced larger behavioral differences than matched random images. We then used the same models with a generative adversarial network to transform diagnostic images toward greater predicted group agreement. In phenotype-matched validation, synthesized images reduced behavioral separation relative to their matched originals. These results establish a model-guided framework for discovering and transforming stimuli that reveal population-specific perceptual differences. More broadly, they show how behavioral phenotyping can move beyond averaging across fixed stimulus sets toward optimized assays that identify the conditions under which neurodivergent perception diverges or converges.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究自闭症与神经典型成人在面部情绪感知中的差异，发现差异集中在少数表情上。作者训练群体特定的人工神经网络模型来预测图像级别的判断，并用模型选择最大化组间差异的刺激。在独立队列中，模型选择的图像产生更大的行为差异。进一步使用生成对抗网络转换图像以减少组间差异。结果建立了模型引导的框架来发现和转换刺激，揭示群体特定的感知差异。
Motivation: 自闭症与神经典型成人面部情绪感知差异的研究结果因刺激选择而异，现有方法未能有效识别差异集中的刺激。
Method: 训练群体特定的人工神经网络模型预测图像级别判断，利用模型选择最大化组间差异的刺激，并使用生成对抗网络转换图像以减少组间差异。
Result: 模型选择的图像在独立队列中产生比随机匹配图像更大的行为差异；合成的图像减少了与原始图像的行为分离。
Conclusion: 模型引导的框架可用于发现和转换刺激，揭示群体特定的感知差异，推动行为表型分析超越固定刺激集的平均化。

papers.title: Stop Guessing When to Stop Testing: Efficient Model Evaluation with Just Enough Data
papers.abstract_en: The inherent rigidity of fixed-size benchmarks makes them an inefficient tool for model evaluation. Diverse evaluation objectives, including model ranking, model selection and testing throughout development, demand varying levels of statistical power. The mismatch between fixed sample sizes and these diverse needs results in either excessive computational cost or compromised reliability - a critical concern for model evaluation. To overcome these limitations, we call for adoption of sequential testing in our field. We provide an adaptive evaluation framework, that provides a principled way to navigate the trade-off between efficiency and reliability in model evaluation. Our framework combines the established statistical paradigm of sequential testing with stopping criteria tailored to common evaluation needs such as diminishing returns detection, and minimum detectable effect size. We demonstrate its ability to adaptively manage the efficiency-reliability trade-off on the Open VLM Leaderboard, including, for example, a 80% reduction in computational cost compared to fixed-size evaluation (with a 2.5-point CI width allowance) while maintaining statistical significance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文批评固定大小基准的低效，提出采用序贯测试（sequential testing）的自适应评估框架，根据评估需求（如递减回报检测、最小可检测效应量）动态停止测试。在Open VLM Leaderboard上，该方法在允许2.5点置信区间宽度的条件下，将计算成本降低80%并保持统计显著性。
Motivation: 固定样本大小的基准无法灵活匹配不同评估目标（如排名、选择、开发测试）所需的统计功效，导致计算浪费或可靠性下降。
Method: 提出一个结合序贯测试（sequential testing）与定制停止准则（如递减回报检测、最小可检测效应量）的自适应评估框架。
Result: 在Open VLM Leaderboard上，该方法在允许2.5点置信区间宽度的条件下，将计算成本降低80%并保持统计显著性。
Conclusion: 序贯测试原则可以有效管理模型评估中效率与可靠性的权衡，减少不必要的计算开销。

papers.title: Beyond wheelchairs and blindfolds: Investigating disability stereotypes in T2I models with INCLUDE-BENCH
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image (T2I) models have been shown to exhibit social biases. Prior work has mainly focused on gender, skin tone, and cultural representation within restricted occupational associations, and emerging benchmarks increasingly incorporate these dimensions. However, disability remains systematically underexplored. Current evaluation practices often fail to align with sociologically grounded definitions of stereotyping, limiting principled assessment of representational harms toward people with disabilities (PWD). To address this, we introduce INCLUDE-BENCH, the first large-scale benchmark for evaluating disability-related bias in T2I models. INCLUDE-BENCH comprises 119K generated images based on prompt design across multiple bias dimensions and both static and dynamic contexts. We evaluate 15 open-source and 2 closed-source models. Our key findings reveal that: (1) mobility-impaired and default disability prompts predominantly yield wheelchair depictions across all models; (2) disability-conditioned generations consistently exhibit less diversity; (3) stereotypical portrayals demonstrate stronger disability-text alignment; and (4) we introduce the Stereotype Content Model (SCM) Score, demonstrating that T2I models reflect real-world stereotypical associations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出INCLUDE-BENCH，首个大规模评估文本到图像（T2I）模型中残疾相关偏见的基准，包含119K张图像，覆盖多种偏见维度和静态/动态上下文。对15个开源和2个闭源模型进行评估，发现：行动障碍和默认残疾提示主要生成轮椅图像；残疾条件下的生成多样性较低；刻板印象描述与残疾文本对齐更强；引入 Stereotype Content Model (SCM) 分数，表明T2I模型反映了真实世界的刻板印象关联。
Motivation: 现有T2I模型偏见研究主要关注性别、肤色和职业关联，残疾维度系统性被忽略，且评估方法缺乏社会学定义的刻板印象理论支撑。
Method: 构建INCLUDE-BENCH基准，设计119K提示，覆盖多种偏见维度和静态/动态上下文，评估17个T2I模型，并引入SCM分数量化刻板印象。
Result: 所有模型中行动障碍提示主要生成轮椅图像；残疾条件生成多样性更低；刻板印象描述与文本对齐更强；SCM分数显示模型反映真实世界刻板印象。
Conclusion: T2I模型存在系统性残疾刻板印象，现有基准和评估方法不足以捕捉这些代表性危害，INCLUDE-BENCH为更全面的评估提供了工具。

papers.title: Do Egocentric Video-Language Models Capture Both Hand- and Object-Centric Cues?
papers.abstract_en: Hand-object interaction (HOI) recognition requires capturing both hand manipulations and object transformations. However, existing video-language models often fall into shortcuts by relying on spurious correlations among hands, objects, or environmental context, rather than reasoning from the appearance and dynamics of hands and objects themselves. To address this limitation, we propose a new learning paradigm that combines (i) hand-object masked training, which enables robust reasoning from partial hand or object observations, and (ii) an HOI-dynamics-aware decoder that explicitly learns hand- and object-centric embeddings through auxiliary predictions of their locations and semantics, enhancing sensitivity to both cues. To systematically evaluate such cue-specific reasoning, we introduce Cue-Isolated HOI (CI-HOI), a new evaluation that assesses models' ability to predict actions from hand- and object-related cues independently. To enable CI-HOI, we curate the DEHOI testbed, which separates hand- and object-related observations for disentangled HOI evaluation through inpainting. Using DEHOI, we demonstrate both quantitatively and qualitatively that our training strategy exploits hand- and object-centric information more effectively than existing models. Our approach improves over existing models on DEHOI, standard action recognition, object state recognition, and even robot manipulation action recognition, leading to more robust HOI understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现有视频语言模型在手-物体交互（HOI）识别中依赖虚假相关而忽略手和物体自身特征的问题，提出了手-物体掩码训练和HOI动态感知解码器，并构建了CI-HOI评估基准和DEHOI测试集。实验表明该方法在DEHOI、标准动作识别、物体状态识别及机器人操作识别上均优于现有模型。
Motivation: 现有视频语言模型识别HOI时往往利用手、物体或环境间的虚假关联，而非真正推理手和物体的外观与动态变化。
Method: 提出结合（1）手-物体掩码训练，从部分观测中鲁棒推理；（2）HOI动态感知解码器，通过辅助预测位置和语义显式学习手中心和物体中心嵌入。
Result: 方法在DEHOI、标准动作识别、物体状态识别及机器人操作动作识别上均有提升，实现更鲁棒的HOI理解。
Conclusion: 通过分离评估和针对性训练能有效提升模型对手和物体信息的利用。

papers.title: Systematic Evaluation of Learning Rate Scheduling Strategies Across Heterogeneous Architectures
papers.abstract_en: Choosing a learning rate scheduling strategy is critical to neural network training, but manual selection is costly and rarely exhaustive. While classical AutoML approaches often treat the scheduler as a secondary hyperparameter, we systematically investigate its impact on classification accuracy across a diverse pool of architectures. We evaluated 30 representative architectures from convolutional and transformer families within the LEMUR neural network dataset. Through automated source-code injection, we applied 25 scheduler configurations across nine PyTorch families, evaluating a total of 3,938 model variants on CIFAR-10. Our best configuration achieved a top-1 accuracy of 86.45%, with 237 variants exceeding 80%. The results show that the choice of scheduler depends heavily on the architecture: CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts and CyclicLR consistently outperform basic decay strategies. The resulting accuracy landscape, contributed to the LEMUR nn-dataset, provides a practical reference for principled scheduler selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了不同学习率调度策略在多种神经网络架构上的分类性能。在LEMUR神经网络数据集上，对30种代表性架构和25种调度器配置进行了测试，共3938个模型变体在CIFAR-10上评估。结果表明最佳配置达到86.45%的top-1准确率，且调度器的选择高度依赖于架构。
Motivation: 手动选择学习率调度策略成本高且难以穷尽，现有AutoML方法往往将调度器视为次要超参数，缺乏对其影响的系统研究。
Method: 通过自动源代码注入，在九个PyTorch系列中应用25种调度器配置，在LEMUR数据集上评估30种架构。
Result: 最佳配置在CIFAR-10上达到86.45% top-1准确率，237个变体超过80%；CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts和CyclicLR优于基本衰减策略。
Conclusion: 学习率调度器的选择高度依赖于网络架构，所生成的准确率景观可作为选择调度器原则性参考。

papers.title: CT-CLIP Representations for Multimodal Lung Cancer Survival Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Accurate prognosis prediction is important for treatment planning in lung cancer, but deep learning-driven survival modelling is often limited by the scarcity of curated imaging cohorts with reliable outcome data. This study evaluates whether representations from a domain-specific foundation model can be used for multimodal survival prediction in data-constrained clinical settings. We assess the foundation model CT-CLIP as a feature extractor for pretreatment computed tomography images and clinical variables from 242 diagnosed lung cancer patients. The evaluation includes adaptation strategies based on frozen encoders, full fine-tuning, and low-rank adaptation, together with modality ablations and comparisons with clinical and multimodal baselines. The results show that a frozen CT-CLIP model combined with a trainable lightweight survival head outperforms the clinical baseline and achieves comparable or improved performance relative to other multimodal approaches, and separates patients into clinically meaningful high- and low-risk groups.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对肺癌生存预测中深度学习模型受限于影像队列数据稀缺的问题，本文评估了领域特定基础模型CT-CLIP作为特征提取器的效果。在242名肺癌患者的预处理CT图像和临床变量上，对比了冻结编码器、全微调、低秩适应等策略。结果显示，冻结CT-CLIP结合可训练的轻量生存头优于临床基线，并达到或优于其他多模态方法，能将患者分为有临床意义的高/低风险组。
Motivation: 深度学习驱动的生存模型常因缺乏影像队列和可靠结果数据而受限，亟需在数据稀缺的临床环境下进行准确预后预测。
Method: 使用CT-CLIP基础模型作为特征提取器，评估冻结、全微调、低秩适应等策略，并结合临床变量进行多模态生存预测。
Result: 冻结CT-CLIP加轻量生存头优于临床基线，与其他多模态方法性能相当或更优，有效区分高风险和低风险患者。
Conclusion: CT-CLIP表示在数据受限的肺癌生存预测中表现有效，可分离出有临床意义的风险分组。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Cognitive-structured Multimodal Agent for Multimodal Understanding, Generation, and Editing
papers.abstract_en: Recent unified multimodal models show a single architecture can jointly perform vision/language understanding and image generation/editing. However, they repeatedly feed all historical visual and textual inputs into a shared context window, limiting long-horizon multimodal dialogue due to visual token explosion and unreliable cross-turn referencing. We propose a Cognitive-structured Multimodal Agent that externalizes visual information into an Episodic Visual Memory and selectively reactivates relevant episodes during reasoning. The agent consists of a Perceptual Abstraction Engine for structured visual abstraction, a Cognitive Retrieval Engine for cross-turn memory retrieval, and a Multimodal Executive Controller for autonomous task inference and action planning. To address the lack of turn-level retrieval supervision in existing datasets, we develop a Unified Scenario Engine that programmatically generates structured multi-turn conversations with fine-grained retrieval annotations, enabling reinforcement learning to optimize abstraction and retrieval policies. We also construct a long-horizon visual-dialogue benchmark stratified by difficulty to evaluate episodic visual recall. Our 8B agent achieves 91.4% retrieval accuracy over 20-turn sessions, surpassing 32B baselines by +8.2% while nearly halving per-turn inference time (23.1s -> 12.7s). We further present the Cognitive-structured Multimodal Agent Harness (CMA-Harness), a tool-augmented deployment of the same cognitive structure integrating persistent multimodal memory, web access, image generation/editing/composition tools, and OpenAI-compatible serving. Structured memory and modular decision-making offer a more scalable, efficient paradigm for long-horizon multimodal agents than monolithic parameter scaling. Code: https://github.com/caseclose/cma-harness ; Project page: https://caseclose.github.io/cma-harness/

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出认知结构化多模态智能体（Cognitive-structured Multimodal Agent），通过外部化视觉信息到情景视觉记忆（Episodic Visual Memory），解决长期多模态对话中视觉token爆炸和跨轮次引用不可靠的问题。模型包含感知抽象引擎、认知检索引擎和多模态执行控制器，并利用统一场景引擎生成带细粒度检索标注的多轮对话进行强化学习训练。在20轮对话中，8B参数模型达到91.4%的检索准确率，超过32B基线8.2%，并将每轮推理时间从23.1秒降至12.7秒。同时提供了工具增强的CMA-Harness部署框架。
Motivation: 现有统一多模态模型将所有历史视觉和文本输入重复放入共享上下文窗口，导致视觉token爆炸和跨轮次引用不可靠，限制了长期多模态对话。
Method: 提出认知结构化多模态智能体，包含三个核心组件：1) 感知抽象引擎（Perceptual Abstraction Engine）进行结构化视觉抽象；2) 认知检索引擎（Cognitive Retrieval Engine）进行跨轮次记忆检索；3) 多模态执行控制器（Multimodal Executive Controller）进行自主任务推理和动作规划。利用统一场景引擎（Unified Scenario Engine）程序化生成带细粒度检索注释的多轮对话，通过强化学习优化抽象和检索策略。同时构建了按难度分层的长期视觉对话基准。
Result: 在20轮对话会话中，8B参数模型实现91.4%的检索准确率，超过32B基线模型8.2%，并将每轮推理时间从23.1秒降低到12.7秒（减少近一半）。
Conclusion: 论文强调结构化记忆和模块化决策为长期多模态智能体提供了一种比单纯扩大参数更可扩展、高效的范式。同时提供了工具增强的部署框架CMA-Harness。

papers.title: The Context Access Divide: Interaction-Level Architecture as a Complementary Dimension of Agentic Inequality
papers.abstract_en: Sharp et al. (2025) introduce "agentic inequality" as a framework for analyzing disparities in access to AI agents across three dimensions: availability, quality, and quantity. These person- and organization-level dimensions characterize who can access agents and at what capability, but do not address a structurally important divide operating at a finer level: the individual interaction. Two users with nominally equivalent agent access may experience qualitatively different AI utility depending on whether the system can autonomously retrieve context from the user's knowledge corpus (Dynamic Context Retrieval) or requires the user to manually identify and attach relevant documents at each query (Manual Attachment). We term this the Context Access Divide (CAD). For knowledge-intensive workers whose intellectual capital spans tens of thousands of files, the CAD constitutes a qualitative threshold in AI usefulness: below it, the cognitive burden of context curation falls on the human, reproducing the inefficiencies AI is meant to eliminate. We propose contextuality -- the degree to which an AI system autonomously accesses a user's accumulated knowledge capital -- as a dimension of AI-mediated inequality that complements, but is not reducible to, the Sharp et al. framework. We formalize the CAD with a probabilistic model grounded in the fan effect literature in cognitive psychology, demonstrating that manual context attachment leads to a combinatorial collapse in task-success probability as corpus size and task conjunctivity grow, while dynamic retrieval architectures are structurally insulated from this collapse. We analyze the technical basis of this divide in the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures, and examine its implications for knowledge-work stratification and AI platform governance.

Result: 模型表明，当知识库规模大且任务需联合多个上下文时，手动附件的成功概率趋近于零，而动态检索保持稳定。
Conclusion: 上下文性（contextuality）应作为AI中介不平等的一个补充维度，现有框架无法还原其影响；该鸿沟对知识密集型工作者的生产力有质的区分。

papers.title: Ensemble Diversity Optimization for Subjective Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Subjective NLP tasks often exhibit systematic annotator disagreement, requiring models that represent uncertainty rather than collapse it. We introduce Ensemble Diversity Optimization (EDO), a prediction-space framework that jointly optimizes ensemble weights, effective cardinality, and calibration through a unified differentiable objective. EDO learns ensemble composition and size end-to-end via Gumbel-Softmax relaxation and incorporates a signed diversity regularizer, tuned on validation data, to steer optimization toward either preserving or suppressing disagreement. This regularization prevents ensemble collapse and enables controlled navigation of the utility-calibration trade-off. The framework integrates a soft F1 surrogate, class-weighted cross-entropy to address imbalance, and reliability-weighted diversity to regulate intra-ensemble variability. Experiments on four subjective text-classification benchmarks (ArMIS, ConvAbuse, HS-Brexit, MD-Agreement) show that EDO substantially improves probabilistic calibration, reducing cross-entropy (40-78% depending on baseline) and lowering Brier scores relative to Soft-CE, Soft-MD, Top-5 Voting, and WEL, while maintaining competitive F1 and better alignment with annotator distributions. These results demonstrate that jointly optimizing ensemble structure with a signed diversity regularizer provides an efficient, model-agnostic approach for modeling human subjectivity in supervised learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出集成多样性优化（EDO）框架，用于主观NLP任务中建模标注者分歧。EDO通过Gumbel-Softmax松弛联合优化集成权重、有效基数和校准，并引入符号多样性正则化器控制分歧保留或抑制。在四个主观文本分类基准上，EDO显著改善概率校准，降低交叉熵40-78%和Brier分数，同时保持竞争性F1。
Motivation: 主观NLP任务存在系统性标注者分歧，现有模型往往忽略或简单平均分歧，无法准确表示不确定性。
Method: 提出集成多样性优化（EDO），使用Gumbel-Softmax松弛端到端学习集成组成和大小，结合符号多样性正则化器（在验证集上调参）引导优化方向，并集成软F1替代、类别加权交叉熵和可靠性加权多样性。
Result: 在ArMIS、ConvAbuse、HS-Brexit和MD-Agreement四个基准上，EDO相比Soft-CE、Soft-MD、Top-5 Voting和WEL等基线，交叉熵降低40-78%，Brier分数下降，F1相当且与标注者分布更一致。
Conclusion: 通过符号多样性正则化联合优化集成结构，是一种高效、模型无关的方法，适用于监督学习中建模人类主观性。

papers.title: Drift-Aware Temporal Graph Rewiring (DATGR) for Adaptive Semantic Modeling in Biomedical Text
papers.abstract_en: Biomedical language evolves rapidly as new discoveries emerge, causing traditional text models to lose semantic fidelity over time. Static embeddings and co-occurrence graphs cannot capture such evolution, leading to performance degradation in retrieval and knowledge discovery tasks. This paper introduces a Drift-Aware Temporal Graph Rewiring (DATGR) framework that models concept evolution by dynamically updating co-occurrence edges based on estimated semantic drift. Instead of retraining embeddings for each time slice, DATGR performs lightweight, feedback-driven rewiring using a logistic update rule applied to edge weights. Evaluated on the Biomedical Multi-Relation Corpus (BIOMRC), the method achieved a mean Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic (AUROC) improvement of approximately 0.066 absolute difference (0.699 vs. 0.633) over a static baseline. Area Under the Precision-Recall Curve (AUPRC) remained comparable (0.738 vs. 0.744), showing that drift-aware adaptation enhances link-prediction recall without a loss in precision. These results demonstrate that edge-level adaptation effectively captures temporal semantic change in evolving biomedical text while remaining computationally efficient and interpretable.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Drift-Aware Temporal Graph Rewiring (DATGR)框架，通过轻量级的边权重逻辑更新规则动态调整共现图，以捕捉生物医学文本中概念的语义漂移。在Biomedical Multi-Relation Corpus (BIOMRC)上，该方法相比静态基线将AUROC提升约0.066（0.699 vs. 0.633），AUPRC保持可比，表明漂移感知的边级适应能有效提升链接预测召回率而不损失精度。
Motivation: 生物医学语言快速演变，传统静态嵌入和共现图无法捕捉语义变化，导致检索和知识发现任务性能下降。
Method: 提出DATGR框架，利用逻辑更新规则对每条边的权重进行反馈驱动的重连，无需为每个时间片重新训练嵌入，实现轻量级动态语义适应。
Result: 在BIOMRC数据集上，DATGR的AUROC为0.699（静态基线0.633），AUPRC为0.738（基线0.744），表明漂移感知适应显著提升召回率而不损害精度。
Conclusion: 边级适应机制能有效捕捉进化生物医学文本中的时间语义变化，同时保持计算效率和可解释性。

papers.title: VEGAS: Human-Aligned Video Caption Evaluation via Gaze
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models excel at video captioning, yet typically generate descriptions that fail to capture individual viewers' attention. We propose VEGAS (Video caption Evaluation via GAze Score), a training-free metric that leverages test-time gaze to sample personalized, attention-aligned text. It is a cross-modal, information-theoretic metric that quantifies how well a candidate caption matches a viewer's focus. To evaluate VEGAS, we curate a dataset of egocentric activities and instructional slides paired with synchronized gaze and reference annotations. We then select captions based on VEGAS via rejection sampling without model retraining. Experiments show that VEGAS-selected captions align significantly better with human focus and improve downstream caption-to-video retrieval, demonstrating the practical utility of incorporating viewer attention during inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VEGAS，一种无需训练的视频标题评估度量，利用测试时的眼动注视数据，通过跨模态信息论方法量化标题与观看者注意力的匹配度。该方法通过拒绝采样选择与注视更对齐的标题，在自建数据集上验证了其对下游标题-视频检索的提升。
Motivation: 现有视频标题模型生成的描述通常忽略个体观众的注意力差异，无法捕捉不同观众的关注重点。
Method: 提出训练无关的度量 VEGAS，基于测试时注视数据，利用互信息或类似信息论指标评估候选标题与观看者注意力的对齐程度，并通过拒绝采样（无需模型重训）选取更优标题。
Result: 在自建的带有同步注视标注的数据集上，VEGAS 选择的标题与人类注视对齐显著更好，并能提升下游字幕到视频的检索性能。
Conclusion: 将观看者注意力整合到推理阶段具有实际效用，证明了眼动数据可作为视频标题评估和筛选的有效信号。

papers.title: New features of the sea-surface slope distribution revealed by IASI observations: Directional properties, influence of the wave height, large wave tilts
papers.abstract_en: By analysis of the reflected solar contribution to mid-infrared radiance spectra collected by the IASI instrument, we investigate the influences of both the wind and significant wave height on the wave-slope probability distribution function (PDF). We show that, at equal wind speed, smaller wave heights enhance the directional (upwind-downwind and upwind-crosswind) asymmetries of the probabilities. We also point out that the sea-surface mean square slopes slightly decrease as the wave height increases (by about $5\%$ per meter for winds slower than 6 m/s), an original result for which we propose possible causes (short-scale damping by long waves and/or effect of compounding statistical processes). We also investigate the so far practically unstudied case of steep slopes and find large deviations from the quasi Gaussian behavior of the central part of the PDF, with a quite universal exponential decay of the probabilities with increasing tilt. We here observe larger probabilities in the downwind direction, but similar values in the up- and cross-wind ones. The physical mechanisms responsible for these trends are discussed. Finally, we propose refined parametrizations of the mean square slope versus wind-speed, which departs from the Cox and Munk linear relationships at moderate wind speed (5-8 m/s).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过分析IASI仪器收集的中红外辐射光谱中的太阳反射分量，研究了风况和有效波高对波浪坡度概率分布函数的影响。发现相同风速下，较小的波高增强了方向不对称性；均方坡度随波高增加而略微减小；陡坡区域概率呈指数衰减，偏离准高斯行为。提出了改进的均方坡度-风速参数化。
Motivation: 现有海面坡度分布研究多基于准高斯假设，且对陡坡区域和大波高影响了解有限。本文旨在揭示波高和风向对坡度分布的影响，特别是未充分研究的陡坡情况。
Method: 利用IASI仪器的中红外太阳反射数据，结合风速和有效波高信息，分析波浪坡度概率密度函数的方向特性和大倾斜行为。
Result: 发现相同风速下，小波高增强方向不对称性；均方坡度随波高增加每米减少约5%（风速<6 m/s）；陡坡概率呈指数衰减，下风方向概率更大，上风和侧风方向相似。
Conclusion: 波高对海面坡度分布有显著影响，陡坡区域呈现非高斯特性，所提参数化改进了Cox和Munk线性关系在中等风速（5-8 m/s）下的适用性。

papers.title: Frequency-Domain Multi-Modality Transportation Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Multi-modality transportation refers to urban systems composed of multiple transportation modes, such as traffic flow and public transit, whose dynamics are coupled by shared temporal patterns. Accurate multi-modality transportation forecasting remains challenging because (1) different modalities exhibit distinct spectral characteristics and (2) interact unevenly across frequencies, whereas most existing methods operate primarily in the time domain or rely on coarse feature fusion. To address these limitations, we propose a lightweight yet effective Frequency-Domain Multi-Modality modeling (FreMo) that explicitly exploits the frequency domain to enable adaptive and selective cross-modality synergy. FreMo disentangles modality-wise spectral refinement from cross-modality synergy and supports plug-and-play integration with general time series backbones. Specifically, FreMo introduces a Modality-Wise Frequency Filter (MFF) to adaptively refine spectral components within each modality, emphasizing informative frequencies while suppressing noise. FreMo further incorporates a Frequency-Guided Synergy Integrator (FSI) that selectively aggregates information across modalities based on their relative contribution at each frequency, facilitating effective cross-modality knowledge sharing while mitigating negative transfer. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets show that FreMo consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, with superior performance and generalization across diverse forecasting scenarios. The code is available at https://github.com/beginner-sketch/FreMo.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FreMo，一种轻量级频率域多模态交通预测模型，通过模态级频率滤波（MFF）和频率引导协同集成（FSI）实现自适应跨模态信息交互，在真实交通数据集上优于现有方法，并支持即插即用集成到通用时间序列骨干网络。
Motivation: 现有交通预测方法多基于时域或粗粒度特征融合，未能利用不同模态在频率域的差异性和跨模态频率依赖关系，导致预测精度受限。
Method: FreMo包含两个核心模块：MFF在模态内部自适应增强有效频率并抑制噪声，FSI按频率选择性聚合跨模态信息，实现选择性知识共享，避免负迁移。
Result: 在多个真实交通数据集上，FreMo一致超越现有基准，展现优越性能与泛化能力。
Conclusion: 频率域显式建模可有效捕捉多模态交通数据的频谱特性与跨模态相互作用，为交通预测提供轻量有效新范式。

papers.abstract_en: Fully characterizing a crystalline material requires integrating heterogeneous data sources -- atomic structures, diffraction patterns, electronic density of states, and natural language -- each of which captures a different facet of the same physical object. In practice, however, these modalities are stored and analyzed in isolation, making it difficult to relate or query materials across representational boundaries. We present MatBind, a contrastive learning framework that aligns four materials modalities -- crystal structure, powder X-ray diffraction (pXRD) simulated from structures, density of states (DOS), and text -- into a unified embedding space using crystal structure as the central physical anchor. The framework induces alignment between modalities never explicitly paired during training, enabling emergent zero-shot cross-modal retrieval as a direct consequence of the shared representation. The learned embedding space organizes materials according to physically meaningful properties without explicit supervision, and retrieval performance improves systematically when modalities are combined at query time. These results demonstrate that treating heterogeneous materials data as complementary projections of a single physical reality, rather than as isolated data sources, is not a practical choice but is consistent with the underlying physics.

papers.title: Applying JEPA-Style Predictive Learning to JA4-Derived Network Fingerprints
papers.abstract_en: I-JEPA and V-JEPA learn by matching latent predictions to target encoder outputs rather than regenerating the original input, and this has worked well for images and video. We explore whether the same objective works for compact network fingerprints. We built JA4-JEPA, a Transformer-based model trained on JA4, JA4H, JA4S, and JA4X subfields drawn from JA4DB and CIC-IDS- 2017. The training data combines roughly 397K samples from both sources, though no single sample contains all four view families. We evaluated the learned representations with a frozen kNN probe on protocol-family classification across TLS, DNS, and SSH. On 39,416 heldout samples the model achieved a cosine similarity of 0.9899 and a kNN accuracy of 0.9220. These results indicate that JEPA-style predictive learning can produce useful embeddings from JA4-derived fingerprints, even with incomplete view overlap across sources. Keywords: JA4, network fingerprinting, JEPA, predictive representation learning, self-supervised learning

papers.title: Two Axes of LLM Abstention: Answer Correctness and Question Answerability
papers.abstract_en: A model should refuse two different things: answers it would get wrong, and questions it should not answer at all, such as unanswerable ones or ones resting on a false premise. The usual recipe thresholds a single confidence score, which cannot tell these apart. Across five instruction-tuned models from three families (2B to 14B), we find they are separate axes. Ordinary answer-confidence tracks whether an answer is right but is nearly blind to whether the question is answerable; a linear probe on hidden states does the reverse. The blind spot does not shrink with scale. It is worst on naturally occurring false-premise questions (CREPE). There, answer-confidence, P(IK), P(True), and even asking the model outright whether a premise is false all stay near chance, while a hidden-state probe reaches 0.69 to 0.77 AUROC: the model represents a problem it will not report. This turns out to be fixable. Instructing a model to check premises backfires, because it then disputes sound and false premises alike (57% false challenges), unable to tell them apart; routing the same instruction with the probe roughly triples challenge precision. We turn the two axes into a calibrated policy that answers only when an answerability score and a correctness score each clear a separately certifies behave differently: the unanswerable-answer rate is controllable at every scale, while the wrong-answer rate is capped by model accuracy, so the guarantee tightens as threshold policy certifies both budgets at 0.75 coverage of correct answers, against 0.31 for a single threshold; at 14B it is the only policy that certifies at all.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型（LLM）的拒绝机制，发现模型需要区分两种不同类型的拒绝：一是拒绝可能答错的答案，二是拒绝不应回答的问题（如不可回答或基于错误前提的问题）。通过对五个指令微调模型（2B到14B）的分析，表明这两个维度是分离的：常规的答案置信度能较好预测答案正确性，但对问题可回答性几乎不敏感；而基于隐藏状态的线性探针则相反。该盲点不会随模型规模缩小，在自然发生的虚假前提问题（CREPE）上尤为严重。研究发现，直接指导模型检查前提会适得其反（57%的虚假挑战），而将相同的指令与探针结合可将挑战精确度提高约三倍。最后，作者将两个维度转化为校准策略，通过分别对可回答性和正确性设置阈值，实现对不可回答问题的可控拒绝率，同时在覆盖75%正确答案的情况下，其保证优于单一阈值策略。
Motivation: 现有LLM通常使用单一置信度阈值来决定是否回答问题，但这种方法无法区分模型可能答错的问题和模型根本不应回答的问题（如不可回答或基于错误前提的问题），导致拒绝策略不精确。本文旨在揭示这两个维度的分离性，并设计更有效的拒绝策略。
Method: 对五个指令微调模型（2B-14B）进行实验，使用多个指标（答案置信度、P(IK)、P(True)、隐藏状态线性探针）分别评估答案正确性和问题可回答性。分析了自然发生的虚假前提问题（CREPE数据集）上的表现，并比较了直接指导模型检查前提与将指导结合隐藏状态探针的效果。最后提出了一个校准策略，对可回答性分数和正确性分数分别设置阈值。
Result: 隐藏状态探针在检测问题可回答性上显著优于所有其他方法，在CREPE上达到0.69-0.77 AUROC，而答案置信度等方法接近随机。直接指导模型检查前提导致57%的虚假挑战（错误地挑战正确前提），而将同一指导与探针结合可将挑战精确度提高约三倍。校准策略在覆盖75%正确答案时，能同时保证不可回答-答案率和错误-答案率，优于单一阈值策略（后者仅达到0.31覆盖）。
Conclusion: LLM的答案正确性和问题可回答性是分离的轴，隐藏状态探针能捕捉模型内部对问题可回答性的表示，而这些表示在模型输出中未被利用。通过分别校准两个维度的阈值，可以更精确地控制模型的拒绝行为，获得更强的安全保障。
Relevance: 0
