papers.title: A scalable version of MADD for big-data classification
papers.abstract_en: Distance-based classifiers are very popular, and the Euclidean distance is one of the most commonly used metrics in distance-based classifiers. However, classifiers based on the Euclidean distance often suffer in high-dimensional setups due to issues such as distance concentration, violation of neighborhood structures, and the presence of hubs. In high-dimension, low-sample-size (HDLSS) situations, a data-driven semi-metric called the Mean Absolute Difference of Distances (MADD) is known to circumvent these issues. But one major problem with MADD is that its computational complexity increases quadratically with the training sample size. As a result, the application of MADD becomes computationally challenging for big datasets that have both a high dimension as well as a large number of observations. In this paper, we propose a scalable version of MADD that significantly reduces its computational complexity while retaining its advantages. This speed-up is achieved by selecting a representative set during the computation of MADD. Further speed-ups are achieved by using the idea of Random Fourier Features, particularly when the sample size is very large. We establish that our proposed methods achieve performances similar to MADD but only at a fraction of its computing time, both theoretically as well as numerically. Our approach broadens the scope of MADD, allowing its use to big-data with a very large number of observations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对高维大数据分类中MADD（平均绝对距离差）距离度量计算复杂度随训练样本量二次增长的问题，提出一种可扩展版本。通过选取代表性样本集和随机傅里叶特征（RFF）大幅降低计算时间，同时理论上和数值上证明其性能与原MADD相当。该方法使MADD能应用于大规模观测数据。
Motivation: MADD在HDLSS场景中优于欧氏距离，但其O(n²)计算复杂度限制了其在样本量大的大数据集上的应用。
Method: 提出两种加速策略：一是选取代表性样本集缩减计算规模；二是对极大样本量采用随机傅里叶特征（RFF）近似。
Result: 理论和数值实验表明，所提方法在保持MADD分类性能的同时，计算时间仅为其一小部分。
Conclusion: 该可扩展版本拓宽了MADD的适用范围，使其可用于观测数庞大的大数据分类任务。

papers.title: ArtMine: Discovering and Formalizing Artistic Processes
papers.abstract_en: Understanding how artworks are created requires reasoning about the iterative decisions, material operations, and contextual influences that shape artistic production. While recent generative AI systems can synthesize artworks with high fidelity, they primarily model distributions over finished artifacts rather than the creative processes underlying their creation. In practice, artistic workflows are only partially documented through fragmented sources such as archival records, preparatory studies, correspondence, etc., making process-level understanding difficult to formalize computationally. In this work, we introduce ArtMine, a framework for discovering and formalizing artistic processes from heterogeneous historical evidence. Our approach synthesizes heterogeneous artwork evidence into a structured repository, from which a Peircean abductive agent infers evidence-grounded production steps. These steps are converted into a compositional graph and rendering prompt, then optimized through self-reflection over deviations between the generated and reference artworks. We provide a preliminary proof-of-concept case study using open-domain historical sources across multiple artists and artistic movements, demonstrating that fragmented documentary evidence can support coherent, interpretable, and auditable representations of artistic workflows. By modeling creative processes rather than only final artifacts, our work moves toward process-centred human-AI co-creativity systems that can support artistic interpretation, creative education, reflective collaboration, and computational studies of cultural production.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ArtMine 框架，旨在从异构历史证据中发现并形式化艺术创作过程。该框架将碎片化的文献、草图、信件等证据整合为结构化仓库，利用皮尔士溯因推理代理推断创作步骤，进而生成组合图和渲染提示，并通过自反思优化。初步概念验证在多个艺术家和艺术运动的历史资料上展示了可解释、可审计的艺术工作流表示。
Motivation: 现有生成式 AI 主要建模成品分布，忽略了艺术创作背后的迭代决策和材料操作。艺术工作流仅通过不完整的历史片段记录，难以形式化计算，制约了过程层面的理解和人机协作。
Method: 将异构艺术作品证据（如档案、预备研究、通信）合成结构化仓库；基于皮尔士溯因（abduction）推理的代理从仓库中推断证据支持的创作步骤；这些步骤被转换为组合图（compositional graph）和渲染提示，并通过自反思循环优化生成与参考作品间的偏差。
Result: 在来自多个艺术家和艺术运动的开放域历史资料上进行概念验证，表明碎片化文献证据能够支持连贯、可解释、可审计的艺术工作流表示。
Conclusion: 通过建模创作过程而非仅最终成品，本文朝着以过程为中心的人机协同创造系统迈进，可服务于艺术解读、创意教育、反思协作及文化生产的计算研究。

papers.title: Texture Representations in Deep Vision Models: Comparing CNNs, Vision Transformers, and Human Perception
papers.abstract_en: In computational vision science, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have emerged as a popular model of biological vision because of the alignment they can exhibit with neural and behavioral data in humans and animals. However, it remains unclear to what extent this alignment persists for visual tasks that extend beyond the canonical object recognition paradigm based on well defined semantic content. In this study, we diverge from the common object-centric view by focusing on another aspect of vision: texture perception. We consider textures of different complexity generated with three different algorithms from the same source images. Using a rank-based statistic, we quantify the information encoded in the internal representations of a CNN and three Vision Transformers (ViTs), and we compare the similarity of these representations to those inferred from human psychophysics data. We find that the representation of textures is aligned in different ViTs, but not between the ViTs and the CNN; that ViTs form similar representations for textures of different complexity; that human performance in recognizing textures can be better predicted from ViTs representations rather than CNN representations. Taken together, these results suggest that ViTs may capture more faithfully than CNNs how texture patterns are visually processed by humans, and that the representations of texture stimuli in computational models may be driven by the network architecture.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究深度视觉模型中的纹理表示，比较CNN和Vision Transformers（ViTs）与人类感知的相似性。使用三种算法生成的纹理图像，通过秩基统计量化模型内部表示的信息，并与人类心理物理数据对比。发现ViTs之间纹理表示一致，但ViTs与CNN不一致；ViTs对不同复杂度的纹理形成相似表示；ViT表示比CNN更好地预测人类纹理识别性能。结果表明ViTs可能比CNN更忠实地捕捉人类的纹理视觉处理方式。
Motivation: 现有深度视觉模型与生物视觉的对齐研究主要基于对象识别，但纹理感知这一非语义视觉任务的对齐程度尚不清楚。
Method: 使用三种不同算法从相同源图像生成不同复杂度的纹理。采用秩基统计（rank-based statistic）量化CNN和三种Vision Transformer内部表示的信息，并与人类心理物理实验数据比较相似性。
Result: ViTs之间的纹理表示一致，但与CNN不一致；ViTs对不同复杂度的纹理形成相似表示；人类纹理识别性能可从ViTs表示更好预测，而非CNN表示。
Conclusion: ViTs可能比CNN更忠实地模拟人类对纹理的视觉处理，模型架构驱动纹理刺激表示。

papers.title: GitLake: Git-for-data for the agentic lakehouse
papers.abstract_en: We present GitLake, a Git-for-data design for an agent-first lakehouse. The system lifts single-table Iceberg snapshots into lakehouse-wide commits, branches, and merges, letting agents work on isolated branches while humans review and publish changes. Pipelines run on temporary branches and publish through a final merge, so all outputs become visible atomically or none do. Finally, we report production lessons as well as correctness insights from a preliminary Alloy model of our core abstractions.
papers.comment: Pre-print of the paper accepted at DASHSys, VLDB 2026, Boston, USA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GitLake 是一个为 agent-first lakehouse 设计的 Git-for-data 系统，将单表 Iceberg 快照提升为 lakehouse 级的提交、分支和合并，允许智能体在隔离分支上工作，人类审查和发布更改。管道在临时分支上运行，通过最终合并发布，所有输出原子化可见或不可见。
Motivation: 现有 lakehouse 系统缺乏类似 Git 的版本控制抽象，难以支持智能体独立开发、人类审查和原子发布。
Method: 扩展 Iceberg 快照为 lakehouse 级提交、分支和合并，智能体在隔离分支上操作，管道运行在临时分支，通过合并发布原子变更。
Result: 报告了生产环境中的经验教训以及核心抽象 Alloy 模型的正确性见解。
Conclusion: GitLake 的设计为 agent-first lakehouse 提供了有效的数据版本控制，支持安全协作和原子发布。

papers.title: Blind-Spots-Bench: Evaluating Blind Spots in Multimodal Models
papers.abstract_en: Modern AI models achieve strong performance on many established benchmarks, yet they still fail on tasks that humans find almost trivial, such as manipulating a string or drawing a dog with five legs. These examples suggest that existing benchmarks may under-measure persistent blind spots in current systems. We introduce $\texttt{blind-spots-bench}$, a benchmark designed to expose such blind spots through tasks that appear simple for humans but remain challenging for modern AI. We collect raw questions from students in an AI course, clean and annotate them with structured reference solutions, and propose a task taxonomy tailored to the resulting dataset of 235 samples. We further develop an automated grading pipeline to evaluate a wide range of models, including open-weight and closed-source language, vision-language, and image-generation models. Our analysis on $\texttt{blind-spots-bench}$ reveals that closed-source frontier models can substantially outperform open-weight models with even $\approx10\%$ gap, even when they attain comparable performance on existing benchmarks. A more fine-grained analysis shows that no single model dominates across all task types, and that some tasks remain challenging for all evaluated models. These results highlight the value of $\texttt{blind-spots-bench}$ as a diagnostic stress test for identifying concrete weaknesses in current modern models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Blind-Spots-Bench，一个用于暴露多模态模型盲点的基准测试，包含来自学生课程问题的 235 个样本，涵盖语言、视觉-语言和图像生成模型。实验发现封闭源前沿模型与开放权重模型之间存在约 10% 的性能差距，且没有单一模型在所有任务类型上占优。
Motivation: 现有基准测试可能无法充分衡量当前 AI 模型在人类认为简单的任务上的持续盲点，例如操作字符串或画五条腿的狗。
Method: 从 AI 课程学生中收集原始问题，清理并标注结构化参考解决方案，提出任务分类法，并开发自动化评分流程评估多种模型。
Result: 封闭源前沿模型相比开放权重模型有约 10% 的性能差距，即使在现有基准上性能相当；没有模型在所有任务类型上占优，部分任务对所有模型仍具挑战性。
Conclusion: Blind-Spots-Bench 可作为诊断压力测试，有效识别当前模型的薄弱环节。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: INTENT: An LSTM Framework for Vehicle Intention Prediction in Intersection Scenarios with Comprehensive Ablation Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Vehicle intention prediction is a pivotal aspect in the agility and safety of autonomous vehicles in all driving scenarios; if genuine enhancement of autonomous vehicles are required, we need to make them adopt human interpretation of driver's intention especially in cases that require a lot of human interaction as well as complex driving behaviors like the ones at intersections, roundabouts and emergency cases such as sudden stops where vehicle intention prediction helps in taking the correct evasive action within a real time period where every second of action makes an impact and can prevent a catastrophe from taking place. In the worst case, it helps minimize the damage and make safety a priority. Intention prediction can also be used to enhance trajectory prediction (intention conditioned trajectory prediction). In this study, The INTENT framework is proposed using LSTM model to predict the vehicle's intention at intersections 2 seconds ahead of the event occurrence to predict whether the cars in intersections are going straight, turning left, or turning right. Various model experiments and ablation study are thoroughly tested on InD dataset achieving 99.71% accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于LSTM的INTENT框架，用于预测十字路口车辆在事件发生前2秒的行驶意图（直行、左转、右转），并在InD数据集上达到99.71%的准确率，同时进行了全面的消融实验。
Motivation: 车辆意图预测对自动驾驶的安全性和敏捷性至关重要，尤其是在复杂路口等需要人类交互的场景中，准确预测意图有助于及时采取避让措施，减少事故风险。
Method: 采用LSTM模型构建INTENT框架，以预测十字路口车辆的未来意图（直行、左转或右转），并在InD数据集上进行多组实验和消融分析。
Result: 在InD数据集上，模型在2秒预测时间窗口内达到99.71%的准确率。
Conclusion: LSTM模型在车辆意图预测任务上表现出高准确性，消融分析验证了模型组件的有效性，但抽象未讨论跨场景泛化或实时部署限制。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Write-Protected Discrete Bottlenecks for Language-Grounded World Models: A Structural Limitation and Sufficient Fix
papers.abstract_en: How should language interface with a world model's discrete symbol system? The dominant paradigm -- end-to-end injection of LLM/VLM features into robot world models (RT-2, Octo, PaLM-E) -- implicitly assumes that language gradients can directly shape physical symbol representations. We ask whether this assumption is safe, find that it is not, and characterize the minimal architectural constraint that prevents the failure. Any language gradient entering a Gumbel-softmax-based discrete symbol bottleneck forces a structural trade-off: the vanilla estimator collapses to 2.2/64 symbols (4/5 seeds), while five anti-collapse strategies maintain diversity but fail to learn semantic labels (all <= 9.2% accuracy). No tested GumbelBottleneck variant achieves both objectives simultaneously. Within this family of discrete bottlenecks, the failure is structural rather than a matter of optimization. We characterize a sufficient set of three constraints that prevent the failure: (1) cut the gradient chain (z.detach()), preventing language signals from reaching the symbol bottleneck; (2) provide a gradient-free semantic channel -- a non-parametric Memory Table (Dict[symbol -> Counter[label]], zero parameters, zero gradients) where co-occurrence counting replaces gradient-based binding; (3) handle symbol collisions via DP-Means streaming clustering for automatic sub-cluster splitting. All three layers together achieve 97.2% grounding accuracy vs. 22.2% without Layer 3. Across two experiments spanning 74 independent runs, we demonstrate zero symbol collapse in all 32 seeds, with the blackboard achieving 79-100% semantic binding across three encoder architectures (CNN, V-JEPA 300M, CLIP ViT-L), two environments, and three texture conditions. The fix trains fewer than 2M parameters and requires no LLM fine-tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语言信号如何与基于离散符号的世界模型接口，发现Gumbel-softmax离散瓶颈在语言梯度注入时存在结构性失效：标准估计器导致符号崩溃（2.2/64有效符号），五种抗崩溃策略虽保持多样性却无法学习语义标签（准确率≤9.2%）。作者提出三个约束的充分修复：切断梯度链、引入无参数记忆表进行共现计数、用DP-Means流聚类处理符号碰撞，在74次独立运行中实现零符号崩溃，基础精度达97.2%。
Motivation: 当前主流范式（如RT-2、Octo、PaLM-E）假设语言梯度能直接塑造物理符号表征，但该假设的安全性未经检验。本文旨在揭示这一假设的潜在风险并寻找最小架构约束来避免失效。
Method: 提出三个充分约束的修复方案：(1) 切断梯度链（z.detach()），阻止语言信号到达符号瓶颈；(2) 提供无梯度语义通道——非参数记忆表（Dict[symbol→Counter[label]]），用共现计数替代梯度绑定；(3) 通过DP-Means流聚类自动处理符号碰撞。
Result: 在74次独立运行中，32个种子均未出现符号崩溃；黑板机制在三种编码器（CNN、V-JEPA 300M、CLIP ViT-L）、两个环境和三种纹理条件下实现79-100%的语义绑定；修复仅训练少于2M参数，无需LLM微调。
Conclusion: 作者强调，在GumbelSoftmax离散瓶颈家族中，语言梯度导致的失效是结构性的而非优化问题，所提三约束是充分修复方案，可实现高精度的语义绑定。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning $\mathsf{AC}^0$ under Locally Sampleable Graphical Models
papers.abstract_en: The problem of learning constant-depth circuits holds profound implications for computational learning theory. In a seminal result, by introducing the low-degree algorithm, Linial, Mansour, and Nisan (J. ACM 1993) presented a quasipolynomial-time learner for $\mathsf{AC}^0$ under the uniform distribution. However, obtaining comparable learning guarantees for broader classes of correlated distributions has remained a longstanding challenge. Recently, Chandrasekaran, Gaitonde, Moitra, and Vasilyan (arXiv 2026) extended these guarantees to Gibbs distributions on bounded-degree graphical models with both strong spatial mixing and polynomial growth. In this paper, we give a quasipolynomial-time learner for $\mathsf{AC}^0$ under graphical models that admit efficient local samplers, circumventing the polynomial-growth requirement in prior work. The key ingredient is a new low-degree approximation for Gibbs distributions, established by simulating and suitably truncating the classical Glauber dynamics. As applications, this framework yields learners for two-spin systems, including the hard-core model and Ising model, on arbitrary bounded-degree graphs, in regimes approaching their respective sampling thresholds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在局部可采样图模型（locally sampleable graphical models）下学习常数深度电路（AC⁰）的问题。作者提出一种拟多项式时间学习器，适用于具有高效局部采样器的图模型，无需先前工作中的多项式增长条件。关键技术创新在于通过模拟并截断经典格劳伯动力学（Glauber dynamics）建立吉布斯分布（Gibbs distribution）的新低度近似（low-degree approximation）。应用包括硬核模型（hard-core model）和伊辛模型（Ising model）在任意有限度图上接近各自采样阈值的学习。
Motivation: 尽管在均匀分布下AC⁰已有拟多项式时间学习算法，但在更广泛的相关分布（如图模型）下获得类似保证一直是长期挑战。先前工作需要在强空间混合和多项式增长条件下才能实现，这些条件在许多实际图模型中难以满足。
Method: 提出一种基于局部可采样图模型的学习算法，核心是建立吉布斯分布的低度近似：通过模拟并适当截断经典格劳伯动力学，得到有效的低度多项式近似，从而绕过多项式增长要求。
Result: 该学习器在具有高效局部采样器的图模型上实现拟多项式时间学习AC⁰，作为应用，在任意有限度图上逼近采样阈值时，为两自旋系统（如硬核模型和伊辛模型）提供了学习保证。
Conclusion: 本文通过新的低度近似技术，将AC⁰的学习保证扩展至更一般的图模型，无需多项式增长条件，为相关分布下的电路学习提供了新途径。

papers.title: Classifier Chain-based Pathological Test Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Accurate and timely diagnoses are essential for quality patient care. However, delayed recommendation of diagnostic tests and physicians' subjective interpretations can hinder effective care. This study introduces a pathological test recommendation system that speeds up the test selection process using patient symptoms before physician consultation. The recommendation task is framed as a multi-label classification problem utilising the Classifier Chain (CC) technique to consider dependencies between tests. We collected data from the SOUTHERN.IML pathology and then created a custom dataset with the help of the expertise. Multiple machine learning algorithms, including Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, and Random Forest, were applied to compare models and identify the best fit for our study context. The Logistic Regression with CC model had the highest overall accuracy at 98.83%, while the Majority Voting ensemble model provided the best balance with a precision of 0.93, recall of 0.85, and F1-score of 0.89. To ensure transparency of the models and clinical interpretability, we used Explainable AI (XAI) techniques utilising SHAP (SHapley Additive Explanations), which identifies how each symptom is contributing to a test recommendation. The diagnostic reasoning revealed by the model was consistent with established medical knowledge of symptoms for the recommended tests, which further adds confidence to the model's reliability for diagnostic purposes. The reasoning could help physicians make logical decisions in critical scenarios. Overall, our findings suggest that CC can improve the efficiency of the traditional algorithms in diagnostic process providing accurate test recommendations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于分类器链（Classifier Chain）的病理测试推荐系统，将测试推荐建模为多标签分类问题，利用患者症状预测所需诊断测试。在自定义数据集上，逻辑回归结合分类器链达到98.83%准确率，集成模型F1-score为0.89，并通过SHAP解释模型决策，与医学知识一致。
Motivation: 诊断测试的延迟推荐和医生主观解释可能影响有效治疗，需要自动化的测试推荐系统来加速流程。
Method: 将病理测试推荐视为多标签分类问题，采用分类器链（CC）技术捕捉测试之间的依赖关系，比较逻辑回归、决策树、随机森林等算法，并使用SHAP进行可解释性分析。
Result: 逻辑回归+CC准确率最高达98.83%；多数投票集成模型最佳平衡，精确率0.93、召回率0.85、F1-score 0.89。SHAP解释显示症状与推荐测试的关系符合医学知识。
Conclusion: 分类器链能提升传统算法在诊断过程中的效率，提供准确的测试推荐，且模型具有临床可解释性，有助于医生决策。

papers.title: ARGUS: Accelerated, Robust, General, and Unsupervised Cell Tracking Solutions
papers.abstract_en: Background and Objective: Quantitative analysis of cell dynamics is central to modern biological research, providing critical insights into immune cell interactions, disease progression, and drug mechanisms. Automated cell tracking in time-lapse microscopy remains challenging due to noise, morphological variations, overlapping cells, and dynamic events such as divisions and fusions. Methods: We present ARGUS, a framework for Accelerated, Robust, General, and Unsupervised Cell Tracking Solutions. ARGUS combines adaptive cell detection, dense Farneback optical-flow prediction, frame-to-frame linear assignment, and a sequence-level tracklet-refinement step that reconnects trajectory fragments across short temporal gaps. Results: On publicly available Cell Tracking Challenge datasets, ARGUS achieved detection accuracy of 0.905-0.971 and tracking accuracy of 0.897-0.964, with runtimes within 1 minute (5-6 seconds for 3 frames). Conclusions: ARGUS is a modular, interpretable framework that can be adapted to different imaging modalities and biological applications without training data or GPU infrastructure. The implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/Gitinc/argus
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 介绍 ARGUS，一种无监督细胞追踪框架，结合自适应检测、Farneback 光流预测、帧间线性分配和序列级轨迹优化，在 Cell Tracking Challenge 数据集上实现了高精度检测和追踪，且运行时间短。
Motivation: 自动细胞追踪在时间序列显微镜中面临噪声、形态变化、细胞重叠以及分裂融合等动态事件的挑战。
Method: 提出 ARGUS 框架，集成自适应细胞检测、密集 Farneback 光流预测、帧间线性分配以及序列级轨迹片段重连。
Result: 在公开数据集上检测精度达 0.905-0.971，追踪精度 0.897-0.964，单次运行时间低于 1 分钟（3 帧仅需 5-6 秒）。
Conclusion: ARGUS 是一个模块化且可解释的框架，无需训练数据或 GPU，可适应不同成像模态和生物学应用。

papers.title: From Legacy Documentation to OSCAL: An MCP-Based Agent Pipeline for Threat-Informed Continuous Compliance in Critical Infrastructure
papers.abstract_en: In critical infrastructure, operational technology environments often cannot be actively scanned, and yet active system feedback is needed for risk assessment and compliance. This paper presents a non-invasive, MCP-grounded multi-agent pipeline that converts natural-language system descriptions into source-verified knowledge graph and audit-ready artifacts in the NIST OSCAL format for continuous automated compliance management. The architecture decouples LLM-based reasoning from deterministic knowledge retrieval against authoritative threat-intelligence sources, reducing the risk of fabricated vulnerabilities and hallucinated attack paths. In an evidence-based synthetic scenario of a water utility, the pipeline achieves 0.90 CVE recall and perfect D3FEND recall. It generates a schema-valid OSCAL System Security Plan and an OSCAL Security Assessment Report. Nevertheless, the core insight is not that grounding via MCP eliminates errors (e.g., hallucinations) entirely from the pipeline, but that it shifts errors into the first phase of asset extraction from the natural language description. Here, a single incorrectly extracted entity can lead to genuine but irrelevant CVEs in subsequent stages of the pipeline, which consumes time and resources. However, it makes the remaining risk visible, verifiable, and suitable for a time-efficient manual review, since the infrastructure (e.g., version numbers, OS, etc.) is typically known.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Cyber Security and Resilience (IEEE CSR), Lisbon, Portugal, August 3-5, 2026. 8 pages, 1 figure
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对关键基础设施中无法主动扫描的运营技术环境，提出一种基于模型上下文协议（MCP）的多智能体流水线，将自然语言系统描述转换为NIST OSCAL格式的知识图谱和审计就绪工件，用于持续自动化合规管理。该架构将LLM推理与确定性知识检索解耦，降低虚构漏洞和幻觉攻击路径的风险。在合成的水务场景中，流水线实现了0.90的CVE召回率和完美的D3FEND召回率，并生成了符合模式的OSCAL系统安全计划和安全评估报告。但核心问题在于错误从资产提取阶段开始，单个错误实体可能导致后续阶段的真实但不相关的CVE。
Motivation: 关键基础设施中的操作技术环境通常无法进行主动扫描，但仍需主动系统反馈进行风险评估和合规管理，现有方法存在漏洞虚构和攻击路径幻觉的风险。
Method: 提出一个非侵入式的、基于MCP的多智能体流水线，将自然语言系统描述转换为源验证的知识图谱和NIST OSCAL格式的审计就绪工件，解耦LLM推理与确定性威胁情报源检索。
Result: 在合成的水务场景中，流水线达到0.90的CVE召回率和完美的D3FEND召回率，生成符合模式的OSCAL系统安全计划和安全评估报告。
Conclusion: 基于MCP的接地并不能完全消除错误，而是将错误转移到资产提取阶段；单个错误实体可能导致后续阶段的真实但不相关的CVE，但使剩余风险可见、可验证，并适合时效性手工审查。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Psychological Competence as a Missing Dimension in AI Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Current AI evaluation frameworks focus primarily on technical performance, including accuracy, robustness, reasoning ability, and policy compliance. These measures remain essential, but they are not sufficient for systems that interact directly with users through natural language. Human-facing AI systems are increasingly used as advisors, coaches, tutors, and companions. In these roles, their responses can shape how users reason, interpret emotions, form beliefs, calibrate trust, and make decisions. The relevant unit of evaluation is therefore not only the model, but the human-AI interaction. This paper introduces psychological competence as a missing dimension in AI evaluation. We define psychological competence as the capacity of a human-facing AI system to support user cognition, emotional interpretation, and behavioral decision-making in ways that are appropriate to the user, context, and purpose of the interaction. This includes interaction properties such as framing, tone, perceived authority, responsiveness, uncertainty handling, and conversational guidance. Existing evaluation approaches capture parts of this problem but rarely assess these psychological effects directly. Drawing on behavioral science and human-AI interaction research, we outline a conceptual framework for psychological competence and its core domains. Rather than proposing a specific benchmark, we define the construct, clarify its boundaries, and describe how it may be assessed through scenario-based probes, structured human evaluation, and model-assisted evaluation methods. We argue that psychological competence should become a core consideration for model providers, deploying organizations, researchers, and regulators concerned with the real-world effects of human-facing AI systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出心理能力（psychological competence）作为AI评估中缺失的维度，关注人机交互中AI系统对用户认知、情绪理解和行为决策的影响。作者从行为科学和人机交互研究出发，构建了心理能力的概念框架及其核心领域，并建议通过场景化探针、结构化人工评估和模型辅助评估方法进行衡量。
Motivation: 现有AI评估主要关注技术性能（如准确性、鲁棒性），但不足以评估直接与用户交互的AI系统（如顾问、教练、伴侣）的全面影响。这些系统可能塑造用户的推理、情绪解读和决策，因此需要评估人类-AI交互本身的效应。
Method: 不提出具体基准，而是定义心理能力这一概念，明确其边界，并概述如何通过场景化探针、结构化人工评估和模型辅助评估方法进行测量。
Conclusion: 心理能力应成为模型提供者、部署组织、研究者和监管者在考虑人机交互系统真实影响时的核心考量因素。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Understanding Axes of Difficulty For Long Context Tasks Via PredicateLongBench
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated rapidly improving long-context capabilities, prompting a wave of benchmarks designed to evaluate them. However, existing long-context evaluations - from Needle-in-a-Haystack (NIAH) tests to more recent multi-hop reasoning and summarization tasks - predominantly measure average-case performance, and many are either saturated or lack robustness. Notably absent is a systematic way to probe how models perform as we scale up the difficulty of tasks along various axes. We address this gap by proposing PredicateLongBench, a benchmark that stress-tests long-context reasoning by asking models to identify the longest contiguous subsequence of words in a long input that satisfies given predicates/constraints (e.g., lexicographic ordering), drawn from a broader predicate class. The central innovation of our benchmark is the identification and systematic exploration of multiple different axes of difficulty which test multiple aspects of long context understanding. We provide two complementary generation pipelines - a fully synthetic setup using random word-like strings, and a real-world setup that samples words from natural documents while preserving their distributional properties. We find that frontier models struggle to perform well as we scale up the difficulty of tasks along our axes, demonstrating the utility of our benchmark in understanding the limitations of current long-context capabilities. Furthermore, the tasks in PredicateLongBench, though challenging, are conceptually simple and do not require LLM-based generations or judges.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PredicateLongBench 是一个通过要求模型识别满足给定谓词的最长连续子序列来压力测试长上下文推理的基准。该基准提出了多个不同的困难轴，并提供了合成和真实世界两种生成管道。实验表明前沿模型在困难任务上表现不佳，证明了该基准的有效性。
Motivation: 现有长上下文评估主要测量平均性能，且许多已饱和或缺乏鲁棒性，缺乏系统地按困难轴缩放任务难度的方法。
Method: 提出 PredicateLongBench，包含合成和真实世界两种数据生成方式，通过定义多个困难轴（如谓词类型、序列长度等）来系统探索模型在不同难度下的表现。
Result: 前沿模型在 PredicateLongBench 上随着任务难度增加表现显著下降，表明当前长上下文能力存在局限性。
Conclusion: PredicateLongBench 提供了一个简单但具有挑战性的基准，有助于理解当前长上下文模型的弱点，且无需基于LLM的生成或评判。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出 PredicateLongBench，包含合成和真实世界两种数据生成方式，通过定义多个困难轴（如谓词类型、序列长度等）来系统探索模型在不同难度下的表现。
summary_sections.result: 前沿模型在 PredicateLongBench 上随着任务难度增加表现显著下降，表明当前长上下文能力存在局限性。
summary_sections.conclusion: PredicateLongBench 提供了一个简单但具有挑战性的基准，有助于理解当前长上下文模型的弱点，且无需基于LLM的生成或评判。

papers.title: Multi-Agent Firewall Architecture for Privacy Protection of Sensitive Data in Interactions with Language Models
papers.abstract_en: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have become essential productivity tools, their integration into workflows without adequate safeguards creates significant risks. This paper proposes an open-source, privacy-focused, user-facing firewall designed to secure both web-based and programmatic LLM interactions. The architecture combines a browser extension and a proxy for total traffic interception across both HTTP(S) and WebSocket communications. At its core, a flexible multi-agent pipeline delivers data leakage prevention through a hybrid approach combining deterministic detectors with LLM-driven semantic analysis, proprietary code leakage prevention, and extensible components designed for future security enhancements such as prompt injection evasion. The framework's layered architecture enables deployment across heterogeneous environments, allowing organizations to balance computational cost, detection depth and latency. Evaluation results demonstrate it achieves F1 scores of up to 94.93% on optimal configurations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个开源、面向隐私的用户端防火墙架构，用于保护与大型语言模型（LLM）交互时的敏感数据。该架构结合浏览器扩展和代理，拦截HTTP(S)和WebSocket通信，并通过多智能体管道实现数据泄露防护，混合使用确定性检测器和LLM驱动的语义分析。评估显示在最优配置下F1分数高达94.93%。
Motivation: LLM成为生产力工具，但缺乏充分保护导致敏感数据泄露风险；现有方案未能全面覆盖Web和程序化交互场景。
Method: 提出一个分层架构：前端浏览器扩展与后端代理组成全流量拦截；核心为多智能体管道，包含确定性规则、LLM语义分析、代码泄露检测等模块，支持扩展如提示注入防御。
Result: 在最优配置下，系统F1分数达94.93%，能有效平衡计算成本、检测深度和延迟。
Conclusion: 该开源防火墙适用于异构环境，可灵活部署以平衡隐私保护与性能需求。

papers.title: Enhancing the KidSat Model: Integrating Geographical Encoding and Data Quality Assessment for Childhood Poverty Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Accurate poverty mapping using satellite imagery is often hindered by (i) noisy and sparse survey-derived supervision, (ii) image quality issues such as cloud cover and image corruption, and (iii) lack of explicit spatial structure in image-only models. Building on the KidSat framework, we develop an enhanced pipeline that improves predictive accuracy via refined data preprocessing, systematic image quality assessment, and mathematically defined geographic encoding. First, we refine the fine-tuning target matrix by resolving high-cardinality sparsity and reducing one-hot dimensionality from 103 to 51 via DHS re-aggregation. Second, we introduce a simple two-stage quality-screening procedure to filter heavily clouded or corrupted observations. Third, we fuse DINOv2 visual embeddings with Spherical Harmonics (SH) location features. Across extensive experiments, these changes reduce MAE from 0.2167 to 0.1759, corresponding to an 18.83% relative reduction on the cluster-level severe-deprivation proportion scale. When extended from 16 to 33 African countries, the best-performing configuration achieves an overall MAE of 0.1658. We find that SH features consistently improve performance over the image-only backbone, whereas higher-capacity coordinate Multi Layer Perception augmentation (SH+SIREN) can underperform without carefully designed objectives. Finally, gradient-boosted tree heads (XGBoost/LightGBM) most effectively exploit nonlinear interactions in the fused visual-geographic representation. These findings provide a scalable and principled recipe for improving satellite-based socioeconomic predictions using only publicly accessible data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于KidSat框架，通过改进数据预处理、图像质量评估和地理编码（球谐函数SH）来提升卫星图像贫困预测的准确性。在16个非洲国家上，MAE从0.2167降至0.1759（相对降低18.83%），扩展到33个国家时最佳MAE为0.1658。研究发现梯度提升树头（XGBoost/LightGBM）能最有效地利用融合的视觉-地理表示。
Motivation: 现有卫星图像贫困映射常受限于噪声标签、图像质量（云覆盖、损坏）以及缺乏显式空间结构，导致预测精度受限。
Method: 提出三方面改进：1）通过DHS重新聚合将one-hot维度从103降至51以解决稀疏性；2）引入两阶段质量筛选过滤云覆盖或损坏图像；3）将DINOv2视觉嵌入与球谐函数（SH）位置特征融合，并使用梯度提升树作为预测头。
Result: 在16个非洲国家上MAE从0.2167降至0.1759（降低18.83%），33个国家扩展实验中最佳MAE为0.1658。SH特征一致优于纯图像基线，而SH+SIREN在高容量下可能效果不佳。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了一种可扩展、基于公开数据的卫星图像社会经济预测改进方案，强调了数据预处理和地理编码的重要性。

papers.title: Progression as Latent Drift: Generative Forecasting of Slow-Evolving Pathologies
papers.abstract_en: Forecasting the future anatomy of slow-evolving neurodegenerative diseases could enable earlier, more targeted intervention and improve clinical trial design, but it remains challenging because true progression signals are subtle in longitudinal MRI. In this low-signal regime, transferring modern generative sequence models directly is unreliable: training is dominated by stable baseline anatomy and confounded by dense, sample-specific nuisance variation. We first provide a theoretical analysis that explains these failures through two modes. Identity collapse occurs when optimization is driven toward reproducing the current anatomy, which prevents the model from learning faint temporal change. The continuous interpolation trap arises when standard smooth networks cannot separate localized biological drift from pervasive noise, which leads to spurious changes that diffuse across the volume. To address both issues, we propose Latent Drift, a progressive generative framework that learns change in a compressed semantic representation rather than synthesizing full-resolution anatomy. This design removes pixel-level identity from the prediction target and concentrates model capacity on progression-relevant dynamics. We further apply Finite Scalar Quantization to the learned change representation, which suppresses small, high-frequency nuisance fluctuations while preserving consistent structural drift. Experiments on longitudinal 3D brain MRI show that Latent Drift improves patient-specific neuro-forecasting over diffusion and autoregressive transformer baselines across generative fidelity and clinically relevant evaluation metrics. Project page: \href{https://cutepkq.github.io/latent-drift}{https://cutepkq.github.io/latent-drift}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对慢进化神经退行性疾病纵向MRI中进展信号微弱的问题，提出Latent Drift框架，通过理论分析揭示身份崩溃和连续插值陷阱两种失败模式，并在压缩语义表示中学习变化，使用有限标量量化抑制噪声。实验表明，在3D脑MRI上，该方法在生成逼真度和临床相关指标上优于扩散和自回归变压器基线。
Motivation: 纵向MRI中真实进展信号微弱，直接使用现代生成序列模型训练不稳定，被稳定基线解剖和密集样本特异性噪声主导。
Method: 提出Latent Drift渐进生成框架，在压缩语义表示中学习变化而非合成全分辨率解剖，并应用有限标量量化抑制小尺度高频噪声，保留一致的结构漂移。
Result: 在纵向3D脑MRI上，Latent Drift在生成逼真度和临床相关评估指标上优于扩散和自回归变压器基线。
Conclusion: 该框架通过将预测目标从像素级身份移除，集中于进展相关动态，改善了患者特异性神经预测。

papers.title: PolyUQuest: Verifiable Structure-Aware Web RAG over Heterogeneous Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Existing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems treat web pages as flat text, losing the structural and semantic signals encoded in HTML. We present PolyUQuest, a verifiable, structure-aware web RAG framework built on a heterogeneous graph that unifies hyperlink topology between pages, DOM hierarchy within pages, and entity-relation knowledge across pages. A two-tier router dispatches each query to one of three retrieval modes matched to its structural need, including direct block retrieval, cross-page graph traversal, and multi-hop entity reasoning. Every answer is fully verifiable, as each cited block carries its source page, heading path, and entity links so that users can trace any claim back to its structural evidence. We evaluate on the official websites of the Hong Kong Polytechnic University (PolyU), comprising 4,240 pages, 31,086 DOM blocks, 29,119 entities, and 37,680 relations, together with a multi-type evaluation benchmark. PolyUQuest outperforms existing RAG systems in answer correctness, coverage, and faithfulness, while consuming significantly fewer LLM tokens per query. The demonstration provides an interactive interface for inspecting cited answers, comparing retrieval traces across routing modes, and exploring evidence graph paths. PolyUQuest is being prepared for deployment as a student-facing QA service at PolyU.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PolyUQuest是一个可验证的结构感知Web RAG框架，构建异构图统一网页间超链接拓扑、网页内DOM层次和跨页实体关系。采用两层路由器将查询分派到三种检索模式（直接块检索、跨页图遍历、多跳实体推理），每个答案均附带结构证据（来源页、标题路径、实体链接）。在香港理工大学的4240页官方网站上评估，PolyUQuest在答案正确性、覆盖率和忠实性上优于现有RAG系统，并显著减少每查询的LLM token消耗。已准备部署为学生端QA服务。
Motivation: 现有RAG系统将网页视为纯文本，丧失了HTML中编码的结构和语义信号，导致答案不够准确且难以验证。
Method: 构建异构图统一超链接拓扑、DOM层次和跨页实体关系；设计两层路由器，根据查询的机构需求选择三种检索模式之一（直接块检索、跨页图遍历、多跳实体推理）；每个回答块携带来源页、标题路径和实体链接，实现完全可验证。
Result: 在PolyU官网（4240页、31086个DOM块、29119个实体、37680个关系）上评估，PolyUQuest在答案正确性、覆盖率和忠实性上均优于现有RAG系统，且每查询消耗的LLM token显著更少。
Conclusion: PolyUQuest提供了可交互的答案验证界面，并准备部署为香港理工大学的学生端QA服务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Different Teachers, Different Capabilities: Sub-1B On-Device Distillation for Structured Text Enrichment
papers.abstract_en: High-volume structured extraction pays a large model's latency on every item, so distilling the task into a small on-device model is attractive: comparable output at a fraction of the time and cost. We measure what that distillation actually delivers, per sub-task. Each news article is mapped to one JSON object with a short summary and five categorical labels. We distill an 8B reasoning teacher (deepseek-r1:8b) into a 0.6B student (Qwen3-0.6B; QLoRA, three seeds), and add two teacher controls: a same-size non-reasoning teacher and a larger managed pipeline. A blinded, reference-free, three-judge panel scores every arm against the full article, alongside two non-distillation baselines, few-shot prompting and constrained decoding. The student runs at about 0.8 s per article against the teacher's 39 s, and recovers 58% of the base-to-teacher gap on summary quality, beating its primary baseline (constrained decoding) by +16.8 points and few-shot prompting by a secondary +4.9. A same-size non-reasoning teacher trains a student no better than the untuned base, so the summary gain follows from the teacher's reasoning nature rather than its scale. Capabilities then split by teacher: the reasoning teacher transfers writing quality and the managed pipeline transfers label diversity, while a same-size instruction teacher's students stay more grounded on the 22 short, thin-source articles in the 93-item test set (74 versus 55 faithful), where the reasoning-lineage student fabricates. That grounding difference is a consistent ordering rather than a significant aggregate effect, and the subgroup is small, so we report it as a direction. Because no single engine wins every field, the deliverable is a per-field routing map for on-device enrichment.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 5 figures. has a same-size non-reasoning-teacher control, a three-judge LLM-as-a-judge panel with a negative control, full-source faithfulness grading, and a per-field routing analysis
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究将大型模型（8B推理教师）蒸馏到小型设备模型（0.6B学生）进行结构化文本提取，每个新闻文章映射为JSON对象。学生模型速度提升约50倍（0.8秒 vs 39秒），在摘要质量上恢复基座到教师差距的58%，超越约束解码和少样本提示基线。不同教师传递不同能力：推理教师提升写作质量，管理管道提升标签多样性，而同尺寸指令教师的学生在忠实性上更优（但差异不显著）。最终输出按字段路由图用于设备端富化。
Motivation: 高吞吐结构化提取中，大模型延迟高，蒸馏到小设备模型可降低成本，但需测量蒸馏实际传递的子任务能力。
Method: 蒸馏8B推理教师（deepseek-r1:8b）到0.6B学生（Qwen3-0.6B，QLoRA，三个种子），设置同尺寸非推理教师和更大管理管道作为对照。使用盲审、无参考、三人评审小组评分，对比少样本提示和约束解码基线。
Result: 学生运行0.8秒/篇 vs 教师39秒，恢复基座到教师差距的58%，超过约束解码（+16.8）和少样本提示（+4.9）。同尺寸非推理教师训练的学生不比未调优基座好。推理教师传递写作质量，管理管道传递标签多样性，同尺寸指令教师的学生更忠实（74 vs 55忠实）但差异不显著。
Conclusion: 不同教师传递不同能力，没有单一引擎在所有字段获胜，输出是按字段路由图用于设备端富化。

papers.title: UniRef-UAV: A Multimodal Benchmark for Universal Referring in UAV Imagery
papers.abstract_en: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) increasingly rely on visual grounding capabilities to localize task-relevant targets from diverse instructions in complex aerial scenes. Existing referring expression comprehension (REC) benchmarks and methods, however, are largely built around text-only queries and single-object outputs, which limits their applicability to practical UAV scenarios involving reference images, multimodal instructions, absent targets, and multiple valid target instances. To address this gap, we introduce \emph{Universal Referring}, a generalized UAV referring task that jointly expands the query modality and the output cardinality. We construct \emph{UniRef-UAV}, a multimodal benchmark that supports text-only, image-only, and text+image queries with modality-dependent target cardinality, where text-only and text+image queries admit no-target, single-target, and multi-target grounding while image-only queries focus on existence-aware single-instance grounding. It also provides in-domain and cross-domain evaluation protocols for visual-query generalization. We further present \emph{UAV-URNet}, a detection-style baseline that maps heterogeneous queries into a shared query space and predicts variable-size target sets through set prediction. Extensive experiments show that UAV-URNet provides a stable and reproducible baseline with more consistent no-target discrimination and a more lightweight, reproducible implementation than large general-purpose MLLMs. Additional domain analysis, query-representation analysis, and ablation studies demonstrate that multimodal queries help reduce visual-query ambiguity and promote a more unified query--target alignment space. The annotations, visual query crops/images, train/validation/test splits, evaluation scripts, and baseline code will be made publicly available to facilitate reproducible research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出通用引用（Universal Referring）任务，扩展了无人机图像中目标指代理解（REC）的查询模态和输出基数，并构建了UniRef-UAV多模态基准，支持文本、图像及文本+图像查询，涵盖无目标、单目标和多目标定位。同时提出UAV-URNet基线模型，通过集合预测实现异构查询的共享空间映射。实验表明该基线在无目标判别和轻量级实现上优于大型通用MLLM。
Motivation: 现有REC基准和方法多局限于纯文本查询和单目标输出，无法满足无人机场景中涉及参考图像、多模态指令、无目标和多目标实例的实际需求。
Method: 定义通用引用任务，构建UniRef-UAV基准（包含三种查询模态和相应输出基数）；提出UAV-URNet基线，将异构查询映射至共享查询空间，并通过集合预测输出可变大小的目标集。
Result: UAV-URNet提供稳定可复现的基线，在无目标判别上更一致，实现更轻量；多模态查询有助于减少视觉查询歧义并促进统一的查询-目标对齐空间。
Conclusion: 该工作为无人机视觉定位提供了更通用的基准和基线，但未涉及降水、预报等气象领域。

papers.title: MentalHospital: A Virtual Environment for Evaluating Psychiatric Clinical Encounters
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on isolated psychiatric tasks, including dialogue, diagnosis, and treatment planning, yet existing benchmarks rarely simulate complete psychiatric clinical encounters. We introduce $\textbf{MentalHospital}$, a virtual evaluation environment for LLM-based psychiatric clinical encounters. MentalHospital instantiates the Subjective Interviewing, Objective Examination, Diagnostic Assessment, and Treatment Planning (S.O.A.P.) workflow, using skill-augmented standardized patients constructed from 1,193 de-identified psychiatric electronic health record (EHR) cases spanning all major ICD-11 categories and 76 disorders. Each encounter is assessed through a dual-track protocol that combines objective comparison against EHR-derived references with subjective assessment of clinical process quality. To scale specialist judgment, we develop $\textbf{MentalEval}$, five domain-specific evaluators covering communication empathy, interviewing professionalism, clinical-note quality, diagnostic rigor, and treatment appropriateness, trained with rubric-grounded SFT and expert-guided DPO. Survey responses from 22 clinicians support MentalHospital's clinical fidelity (3.88/5), while MentalEval achieves strong expert alignment with an average QWK of 0.944. Benchmarking shows that even the strongest LLM trails clinicians by 37.28 percentage points in objective psychiatric competence, with mental status assessment as a key bottleneck.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MentalHospital，一个基于LLM的精神病临床遭遇评估虚拟环境，模拟S.O.A.P.工作流，使用来自1193个去识别化精神科电子健康记录案例的技能增强标准化患者，涵盖所有主要ICD-11类别和76种障碍。评估采用双轨协议，结合客观比较和主观过程质量评估，并开发了MentalEval，包含五个领域特定评估器。22名临床医生的调查支持其临床保真度（3.88/5），MentalEval与专家一致性平均QWK为0.944。基准测试显示最强LLM在客观精神病能力上落后临床医生37.28个百分点，精神状态评估是关键瓶颈。
Motivation: 现有LLM在孤立精神病任务上表现良好，但缺乏模拟完整临床遭遇的基准。
Method: 构建MentalHospital虚拟环境，基于1193个去识别化精神科EHR案例，使用S.O.A.P.工作流，并开发MentalEval评估器（通信共情、访谈专业、临床笔记质量、诊断严谨性、治疗适当性），通过基于规则的SFT和专家引导的DPO训练。
Result: 22名临床医生评价保真度3.88/5，MentalEval与专家一致性平均QWK 0.944。最强LLM在客观精神病能力上落后临床医生37.28个百分点。
Conclusion: 精神状态评估是LLM的主要瓶颈，该环境可用于评估和提升LLM的临床能力。

papers.title: Best-of-$N$ TTS Evaluation is Confounded by ASR Family Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Best-of-$N$ (BoN) inference improves content consistency in zero-shot text-to-speech by selecting from $N$ candidates with an automatic speech recognition (ASR) verifier. We identify an underexplored evaluation confound: a verifier's apparent quality depends strongly on which ASR family judges it. On LibriSpeech-PC test-clean~\citep{librispeechpc} with F5-TTS~\citep{f5tts}, verifier rankings reverse across Whisper, wav2vec~2.0, and HuBERT evaluators, and same-family verifier-evaluator pairs recover 2-3$\times$ more oracle headroom than cross-family pairs despite near-identical representations (linear CKA $0.978$) -- a pattern consistent with identity- or lineage-level coupling rather than representational overlap. We propose two \textbf{cross-family rank ensembles} (rank-averaging and conjunctive max-rank) that attain the lowest mean WER across three independent evaluators -- $1.61\%$ at $N{=}10$ ($-12\%$ relative to F5-TTS) -- with no measurable degradation under automatic SIM-o/UTMOS metrics; the best single verifier drives WER from $2.06\%$ to $1.72\%$ ($-16.5\%$) under the official F5-TTS evaluator. We recommend cross-evaluator triangulation as default reporting practice.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026 Workshop on Machine Learning for Audio
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现零样本文本转语音（TTS）中Best-of-N（BoN）评估存在一个混淆因素：验证器的表现强烈依赖于评估它的ASR家族。在LibriSpeech-PC上使用F5-TTS的实验表明，不同ASR评估器（Whisper, wav2vec 2.0, HuBERT）给出的验证器排名会反转，同家族验证器-评估器对恢复的oracle headroom比跨家族对高2-3倍。作者提出了两种跨家族排名集成方法（rank-averaging和conjunctive max-rank），在三个独立评估器上取得最低平均WER（1.61% at N=10），并建议将跨评估器三角测量作为默认报告实践。
Motivation: 现有BoN评估使用单一ASR验证器，但验证器的表观质量强烈依赖于评估它的ASR家族，导致评估结果不可靠。
Method: 提出两种跨家族排名集成方法：rank-averaging（排名平均）和conjunctive max-rank（合取最大排名），并推荐跨评估器三角测量。
Result: 在三个独立评估器上，该方法达到最低平均WER 1.61%（相对F5-TTS降低12%），最佳单一验证器在官方F5-TTS评估器下将WER从2.06%降至1.72%（-16.5%）。
Conclusion: 作者建议将跨评估器三角测量作为默认报告实践，以避免ASR家族对齐的混淆。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Compete Then Collaborate: Frontier AI Teachers Build a Verifiable Curriculum to Improve a Coding Student Beyond Imitation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models increasingly serve as teachers generating training data for smaller students. Prior multi-teacher knowledge distillation methods merge outputs without determining which frontier model teaches best, often relying on an LLM judge biased toward its own outputs. We introduce a compete-then-collaborate framework where four frontier AI teachers (Claude, Codex-GPT, Grok, Gemini) are ranked head-to-head by an execution-based judge (unit tests and stdin-stdout checks) with fairness controls, and then collaborate to build a verifiable curriculum for a student (Qwen2.5-Coder). We report three findings. (1) Under execution verification, all teachers solve standard problems near-perfectly after self-correction (99-100%) due to a saturation effect, but harder competition problems separate them (Gemini 77% > Claude 69% = Codex 69% > Grok 50%); however, the robust student-side results do not depend on teacher ranking. (2) Imitation (SFT) on verified solutions does not improve, and can degrade, an already-competent student at 7B and 32B (e.g., from 76.7% to 72.7% on MBPP-test, and 5.9% to 2.9% on competition problems). (3) Using the same collaborative curriculum as a reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) environment improves the student (from 5.9% to 8.8% peak on competition problems, a +49% relative gain), reversing SFT's direction. The value of AI-teacher collaboration lies not in pooling answers to imitate, but in jointly constructing a verifiable environment where the student learns by doing. We release a reproducible on-prem pipeline (NVIDIA GB10) with framework patches for running GRPO on a bleeding-edge stack.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种“竞争-合作”框架，让四个前沿AI教师（Claude、Codex-GPT、Grok、Gemini）通过基于执行（单元测试、标准输入输出检查）的评判进行头对头排名，然后合作构建可验证的课程，用于训练学生模型Qwen2.5-Coder。实验发现：(1) 在标准问题上所有教师自纠正后近乎完美，但更难的问题能区分出表现差异（Gemini 77% > Claude 69% = Codex 69% > Grok 50%），然而学生最终表现与教师排名无关；(2) 对已验证解决方案进行模仿学习（SFT）不仅没有提升，反而会降低原本有能力的7B/32B学生（例如MBPP-test从76.7%降至72.7%，竞赛题从5.9%降至2.9%）；(3) 将同一协作课程作为基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）环境能提升学生（竞赛题从5.9%升至8.8%，相对提升49%），扭转SFT的下降趋势。AI教师协作的价值不在于聚合答案供模仿，而在于共同构建一个可验证的环境让学生通过实践学习。
Motivation: 现有多个教师知识蒸馏方法直接合并输出，但未考虑哪个前沿模型教学效果最佳，且常依赖偏向自身输出的LLM评判。需要一种公平且可验证的机制来利用多个教师的能力。
Method: 提出“竞争-合作”两阶段框架。第一阶段：四个教师模型在头对头对决中由基于执行的评判（单元测试和stdin-stdout检查）进行排名，并加入公平性控制。第二阶段：排名后的教师协作构建一个可验证的课程（包含问题和测试用例），学生模型（Qwen2.5-Coder）在此环境中进行RLVR（基于可验证奖励的强化学习）训练。
Result: 在代码生成任务上，模仿学习（SFT）已验证解决方案会使学生性能下降（MBPP-test从76.7%降至72.7%，竞赛题从5.9%降至2.9%），而利用协作课程进行RLVR训练则可提升学生（竞赛题从5.9%升至8.8%，相对增益49%）。教师排名与最终学生表现无关。
Conclusion: 论文强调，多个AI教师协作的关键在于共同构建一个可验证的学习环境，让学生通过主动实践（而非被动模仿）来提升能力；该方法可复现，并提供基于NVIDIA GB10的流水线和GRPO框架补丁。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CASL-VAE: Learning Structured Latent Variables from Unpaired Data for Semi-supervised Clustering and Paired Sample Generation
papers.abstract_en: Quantifying variability in a target population relative to a reference population is central to many scientific and clinical problems (e.g., diseased vs. healthy). Yet, without paired data and in the presence of heterogeneous target variation, existing methods struggle to separate multiple modes of target-specific variation. We propose \textit{CASL-VAE}, a deep contrastive latent variable model that learns structured latent generative factors from unpaired data. CASL-VAE factorizes variation into continuous common latent factors shared across populations and hierarchical salient latent factors that model target-specific heterogeneity as discrete subtypes and continuous within-subtype variation. Using variational inference, we show how approximate joint likelihood optimization over reference and target domains can be performed using unpaired data, providing a principled basis for paired-sample generation and cross-domain analysis. We validate CASL-VAE on semi-synthetic neuroimaging data, demonstrating improved subtype recovery and paired-sample generation compared to baseline clustering and generative models. We also validate its ability to reveal biologically plausible heterogeneity in Alzheimer's disease.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出CASL-VAE，一种深度对比潜在变量模型，从非配对数据中学习结构化潜在生成因子，将变异分解为连续共同因子和分层显著因子（离散亚型+连续亚型内变异），通过变分推理优化近似联合似然，用于半监督聚类和配对样本生成。在半合成神经影像数据上验证了亚型恢复和配对样本生成能力的提升，并在阿尔茨海默病中揭示生物合理性异质性。
Motivation: 现有方法在处理非配对数据且目标变异具有异质性时，难以分离目标特定的多种变异模式，尤其是疾病与健康的对比场景中缺乏配对数据。
Method: 提出CASL-VAE，将变异分解为连续共同因子（共享）和分层显著因子（离散亚型+连续亚型内变异），利用变分推理通过非配对数据优化近似联合似然，实现配对样本生成和跨域分析。
Result: 在半合成神经影像数据上，相比基线聚类和生成模型，CASL-VAE改进了亚型恢复和配对样本生成；在阿尔茨海默病数据中能揭示生物合理性异质性。
Conclusion: CASL-VAE为非配对数据下的结构化潜在变量学习和配对样本生成提供了有原则的框架，在医学影像分析领域有潜力。

papers.title: AutoPersonas: A Multi-Timescale Loop Engine for Open-Ended Persona Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Long-term persona agents must remain identifiable while adapting to new events, relationships, evidence, and social conditions. We identify self-locking as a runtime failure mode in continuing persona-life loops: locally plausible events keep appearing while the generated life collapses toward familiar environments, weak relationships, suspended decisions, and stale life stages. We trace this failure to model-level convergence toward high-probability behavioral channels and system-level context gravity from State, memory, history, and environment summaries. We introduce AutoPersonas, a multi-timescale life-environment engine for bounded persona-level recursive self-evolution. It separates environment-side Occurrences, accumulated Observations, and persona State. Its OSO loop admits divergent future-facing material while requiring evidence-governed absorption before State or reachability changes. A three-year compressed simulation exposed environment watermark shells, occurrence-hardening gaps, slow-change accumulation failures, recursive indecision, and weak relationship persistence. An eight-model 40-day stress test generated 1,600 events and found mean rolling 5-day action-category repetition of 95.2%-97.6%, with all models crossing 90% by day 11. Semantic re-keeping found 79.0%-88.0% macro-theme repetition across all direct-loop runs. In a same-runtime 40-day A/B, context-slice masking plus per-sample divergence targeting reduced macro-theme repetition from 61.8% to 36.3% and roughly doubled cumulative theme count. A juvenile-goblin fictional-world run reproduced the anti-fixation regime without hard real-world intrusions. These results support a bounded claim: separating controlled divergence from evidence-governed absorption can reduce persona-environment self-locking while preserving identity continuity.
papers.comment: 52 pages, 13 figures/tables, ancillary public-safe evaluation artifacts included
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对长期角色代理在持续演化中出现的自我锁定失败模式（事件持续发生但角色生活趋于熟悉环境、弱关系、停滞），提出 AutoPersonas，一种多时间尺度生命-环境引擎。该引擎分离环境侧的发生、观察与角色状态，通过 OSO 循环要求未来导向材料在状态改变前经过证据驱动的吸收。实验表明，该方法在 8 模型 40 天压力测试中，所有模型动作类别重复率在 11 天后超过 90%；A/B 测试中通过上下文掩码和目标分歧将宏观主题重复从 61.8% 降至 36.3%，累计主题数翻倍，支持了“受控发散+证据吸收可减少自锁并保持身份连续性”的有限主张。
Motivation: 现有长期角色代理在持续演化中存在自我锁定失败模式：模型趋向高概率行为通道，系统级上下文引力导致事件重复、关系弱化、决策停滞，使角色缺乏适应性演化能力。
Method: 提出 AutoPersonas，一个多尺度生命-环境引擎，包含环境侧 Occurrences、积累的 Observations 和 persona State 的 OSO 循环。它允许引入前瞻性材料，但要求在 State 或可达性变化前进行证据驱动的吸收，从而分离受控发散与合理性保持。
Result: 摘要报告：3 年压缩模拟暴露环境水印壳、事件硬化缺口等失败模式；8 模型 40 天压力测试生成 1600 个事件，5 天滚动动作类别重复率 95.2%-97.6%，所有模型在 11 天后超过 90%；A/B 测试中上下文掩码+逐样本发散目标将宏观主题重复从 61.8% 降至 36.3%，累计主题数约翻倍。
Conclusion: 结论强调分离受控发散与证据驱动的吸收可以降低角色-环境自我锁定，同时保持身份连续性，但该主张为有限定范围。

papers.title: On the Design of Mixture-of-Experts for Dynamic Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic scene reconstruction remains challenging due to the heterogeneous and spatially varying nature of real-world motion. Although recent 3D Gaussian Splatting methods have introduced diverse deformation formulations for dynamic novel view synthesis, each method typically relies on a single deformation model within its representation, which limits robustness across diverse dynamic scenarios. In this work, we study a fundamental problem-multi-deformation modeling for dynamic 3D Gaussian representations-under two distinct integration constraints that differ in when and how multiple deformation experts interact during training. From a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) perspective, we view multi-deformation modeling as the problem of combining multiple specialized deformation models within a unified 3D representation. We first introduce Mixture of Deformation Experts (MoDE), which integrates multiple deformation experts directly into the deformable Gaussian Splatting pipeline through joint optimization. In MoDE, experts operate on a shared canonical Gaussian representation, enabling multi-deformation modeling without introducing additional training stages or modifying the original optimization schedule. In contrast, we further present Mixture of Experts for Dynamic Gaussian Splatting (MoE-GS) under a different integration constraint, where deformation experts are optimized independently and combined through a separate routing stage. As a result, expert interaction occurs over non-canonical Gaussian representations after individual optimization. Together, these two approaches provide alternative strategies for multi-deformation modeling, clarifying how integration constraints shape the design and behavior of deformation experts in dynamic 3D Gaussian representations. Our code is available at: https://github.com/cvsp-lab/MoE-GS-studio.
papers.comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究动态3D高斯表示中的多变形建模问题，从混合专家（MoE）视角出发，提出两种集成约束下的建模策略。MoDE将多个变形专家直接集成到可变形高斯泼溅管线中通过联合优化实现，而MoE-GS则独立优化各专家并通过单独路由阶段组合。两种方法为动态场景重建中的多变形建模提供了不同设计方案。
Motivation: 现有动态高斯泼溅方法通常依赖单一变形模型，难以应对真实世界运动的异质性和空间变化性，缺乏对不同动态场景的鲁棒性。
Method: 从MoE视角将多变形建模视为在统一3D表示中组合多个专门变形专家的问题。提出MoDE（联合优化共享规范高斯表示）和MoE-GS（独立优化后路由组合非规范表示）两种策略。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但表明两种策略为动态3D高斯表示中的多变形建模提供了替代方案，并揭示了集成约束对变形专家设计与行为的影响。
Conclusion: 本文通过两种集成约束下的MoE设计，阐明了动态3D高斯表示中多变形建模的两种策略，有助于理解不同设计选择对性能的影响。代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HSA: Hierarchical Slot Attention for Multi-granularity Scene-Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Slot attention is a powerful framework for object-centric learning, decomposing visual scenes into latent slots through iterative competitive attention. However, existing methods share two critical limitations: they decompose scenes into a flat set of slots at a single granularity, and this decomposition is based on appearance rather than semantics. Yet humans understand scenes through semantic hierarchies: separating foreground from background, recognizing object categories, and identifying individual instances. Crucially, such semantic hierarchies cannot emerge without supervision, because category names are human constructs, not visual patterns. We propose Hierarchical Slot Attention (HSA), which learns multi-granularity semantic scene decomposition from a single model. HSA decomposes scenes at three levels: holistic (foreground/background), semantic (object categories), and panoptic (individual instances). Using only 10\% labeled data, combined with hierarchical alignment loss, HSA learns all three levels jointly. We further introduce grouping purity and containment to measure whether the hierarchy is encoded in representation space, not just output masks. Experiments on COCO and PASCAL VOC demonstrate that HSA outperforms the strongest flat baseline by up to \textbf{$+$41.5} ARI at holistic, \textbf{$+$14.6} at semantic, and \textbf{$+$10.4} at panoptic level on COCO, with even larger gains on Pascal VOC, while requiring a single model instead of three. Code will be made available upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出分层插槽注意力（Hierarchical Slot Attention, HSA），从单个模型中学习多粒度语义场景分解，包括整体（前景/背景）、语义（物体类别）和全景（单个实例）三个层次。仅需10%标注数据，结合分层对齐损失，联合学习所有层次。在COCO和PASCAL VOC上，HSA在三个层次上均显著优于最强的平面基线，且仅需单个模型。
Motivation: 现有插槽注意力方法存在两个关键局限：将场景分解为单一粒度的平面插槽集，且分解基于外观而非语义。人类通过语义层次理解场景，但语义层次无法在没有监督的情况下自然出现。
Method: 提出HSA，学习三层次场景分解：整体（前景/背景）、语义（物体类别）和全景（个体实例）。使用10%标注数据，通过分层对齐损失联合训练所有层次。引入分组纯度和包含度指标来衡量层次编码在表示空间中的程度。
Result: 在COCO上，HSA在整体、语义和全景水平上分别比最强平面基线高出最多+41.5、+14.6和+10.4的ARI（调整兰德指数），在PASCAL VOC上提升更大。
Conclusion: HSA通过单模型实现多粒度语义场景分解，显著优于平面基线，验证了利用少量标注数据学习语义层次的有效性。

papers.title: SkelGen4D: Weakly-Supervised Skeleton-Based 4D Generation for Text-Driven Mesh Animation
papers.abstract_en: We study 4D generation to synthesize temporally coherent sequences of 3D geometry for animation and content creation. In contrast to existing SDS-based optimization methods and video-driven animation approaches, we adopt a skeleton-driven animation framework aligned with standard industrial pipelines, which enables explicit control and editing. To this end, we propose SkelGen4D, a weakly supervised feed-forward framework for text-driven mesh animation that generates explicit skeleton motions without requiring per-frame skeleton annotations. SkelGen4D first recovers temporally consistent pseudo-skeletons from animated meshes via differentiable fitting, and then generates text-conditioned skeleton motion sequences in a feed-forward manner, further refined with Motion-GRPO to ensure temporally coherent, physically plausible, and articulated animation. We evaluate our method on two large-scale benchmarks, Truebones Zoo and Diffusion4D. Our results show that our weakly supervised skeleton modeling matches or surpasses fully supervised baselines while scaling to diverse object categories for high-quality text-driven mesh animation. Further, our method supports flexible motion editing and is aligned with standard animation production pipelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SkelGen4D，一个弱监督的前馈框架，用于文本驱动的网格动画生成。该方法通过可微拟合恢复时间一致的伪骨架，并生成文本条件的骨架运动序列，再经 Motion-GRPO 优化，实现时间连贯、物理合理且关节清晰的动画。在 Truebones Zoo 和 Diffusion4D 基准上的评估表明，弱监督骨架建模与全监督基线相当或更优，且支持灵活的运动编辑，符合标准动画生产线。
Motivation: 现有 4D 生成方法（如 SDS 优化和视频驱动动画）缺乏显式控制且不兼容工业管线，而骨架驱动动画框架具有显式控制和可编辑性，但需要逐帧骨架标注，成本高昂。
Method: 提出 SkelGen4D，首先通过可微拟合从动画网格中恢复时间一致的伪骨架（弱监督），然后以前馈方式生成文本条件的骨架运动序列，最后使用 Motion-GRPO 进行精炼，确保时间一致、物理合理且关节清晰的动画。
Result: 在 Truebones Zoo 和 Diffusion4D 基准上，弱监督骨架建模与全监督基线匹配或超越，且能扩展至多样对象类别，实现高质量文本驱动网格动画。
Conclusion: 弱监督骨架驱动框架可有效替代全监督方法，显式运动控制与编辑能力使该方法与工业动画管线一致。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: An interpretable Good--Turing restart criterion for k-means++
papers.abstract_en: The k-means++ algorithm is commonly restarted multiple times to avoid poor local optima, yet the number of restarts is almost always chosen arbitrarily and applied uniformly regardless of data set difficulty. This undermines any comparison relying on such a choice and wastes computation on easy data sets while potentially under-serving hard ones. We introduce GTRC, a restart criterion combining a Good-Turing estimate, a proven unconditional bound, and a confidence-based bound on the probability that a further restart would improve on the current result, stopping once this probability falls below a user-specified tolerance $\varepsilon$. Across 36 data sets, GTRC reached clustering quality competitive with well-chosen fixed restart counts, while the number of restarts used varied considerably and appropriately with data set difficulty, governed by an interpretable, data-dependent signal rather than a fixed rule. GTRC offers a principled and reportable alternative to fixing the number of $k$-means++ restarts in advance. Software:https://github.com/RCdeAmorim/Good-Turing-Restart-Criterion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GTRC，一种基于 Good-Turing 估计的 k-means++ 重启准则，通过数据驱动的概率界自适应决定是否停止重启，避免人为固定重启次数。在 36 个数据集上，GTRC 达到与精心选择固定重启次数相当的聚类质量，且重启次数根据数据集难度合理变化。
Motivation: k-means++ 算法常用多次重启避免局部最优，但重启次数常随意设定且对所有数据集统一，对简单数据集浪费计算，对困难数据集可能不足，影响公平比较和效率。
Method: GTRC 结合 Good-Turing 估计、一个无条件界和一个基于置信度的界，估算进一步重启改善当前结果的概率，当该概率低于用户指定阈值 ε 时停止重启。
Result: 在 36 个数据集上，GTRC 的聚类质量与精心选择的固定重启次数相当，而重启次数根据数据集难度自适应变化，展现了数据驱动的适应性。
Conclusion: GTRC 提供了一种有原则且可报告的选择，替代了固定 k-means++ 重启次数，避免人工随意设定。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Closing the Null Space: Guidance-Aware Quantization for Classifier-Free Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Deploying classifier-free guidance (CFG) diffusion models under real-world compute budgets requires quantization, yet existing post-training quantization (PTQ) methods treat CFG models as single-branch networks, ignoring the paired conditional/unconditional structure that CFG inference fundamentally relies on. This structural blind spot has two consequences. At the system level, the two-pass CFG execution pattern imposes a latency overhead that parameter-count and bit-operation metrics conceal entirely, and commodity INT8 inference stacks fail to realize the theoretical efficiency gains that BOPs calculations promise. At the algorithmic level, calibrating against the guidance gap alone admits an exact null space: a quantized model can achieve perfect gap-fidelity diagnostics while the unconditional branch drifts arbitrarily, corrupting every guided prediction at inference time. This paper terms this the branch-drift trap, proves its existence analytically, and confirms it empirically through a false-positive result in which the best-calibrated model by standard diagnostics simultaneously produces the worst sample quality. To close the trap, Guidance-Aware Mixed Precision (GAMP) is proposed, which calibrates directly on the guided prediction, derives per-layer activation-bit sensitivity from guided-output degradation, and allocates bits via a greedy knapsack -- provably preventing unconditional branch drift by construction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究分类器无引导扩散模型的后训练量化问题，指出现有方法忽略了条件/无条件双分支结构，导致系统级延迟和算法级分支漂移陷阱。提出引导感知混合精度（GAMP）方法，直接校准引导预测，通过贪婪背包分配位宽，从构造上防止无条件分支漂移。
Motivation: 现有后训练量化方法将CFG扩散模型视为单分支网络，忽视了其条件/无条件双分支结构，导致系统延迟被低估且无条件分支可能漂移，降低生成质量。
Method: 提出引导感知混合精度（GAMP），直接基于引导预测进行校准，推导每层激活的位敏感性，并使用贪婪背包算法分配位宽，从构造上防止无条件分支漂移。
Result: 理论分析证明了分支漂移陷阱的存在，实验显示标准诊断下最优校准模型反而产生最差样本质量；GAMP方法避免了该问题并提升了量化效果。
Conclusion: 针对CFG扩散模型的量化必须考虑其双分支结构，GAMP通过直接校准引导预测和位分配有效防止无条件分支漂移。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Structure Learning on Clustered Data
papers.abstract_en: Recent algorithmic advances have made directed acyclic graph (DAG) structure learning scalable for causal discovery. Yet, the currently available techniques assume a completely homogeneous population, precluding their application to clustered data where cluster-specific variations (e.g., patient-specific effects) are common. We address this issue by introducing a new approach that estimates a global structure while accounting for local cluster-level effects. The key idea is to extend the fixed- and random-effects framework of classical mixed models to the structure learning setting. Towards this end, we present a differentiable graph coupling mechanism that guarantees the union of the fixed- and random-effects graphs remains acyclic. Computationally, we provide a provably convergent first-order method and leverage efficient batched updates across clusters. Statistically, we establish identifiability of the model and show that our approach recovers the true structure asymptotically. In experiments on real and synthetic data, our proposal detects dependencies missed by alternative estimators, underscoring its value for structure learning in clustered settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对聚类数据（如患者特异性效应）中的结构学习问题，提出一种融合固定和随机效应的DAG学习框架。通过可微图耦合机制保证全局图与局部图的联合无环性，并提供收敛的一阶优化方法和统计可识别性证明。实验表明该方法能检测到被现有方法遗漏的依赖关系。
Motivation: 现有DAG结构学习方法假设群体完全同质，无法处理存在集群特异性变异的聚类数据（如患者级别的异质性），限制了其在医学、生物学等领域的应用。
Method: 将经典混合模型中的固定-随机效应框架扩展到结构学习，提出可微图耦合机制强制固定效应图和随机效应图的并集保持有向无环。使用可证明收敛的一阶方法，并通过跨集群的批量更新实现高效计算。
Result: 在真实与合成数据上，该方法能检测到其他估计器遗漏的依赖关系，并渐近恢复真实结构。
Conclusion: 该方法为聚类数据提供了兼顾全局结构与局部异质性的因果发现工具，但需注意其计算复杂度可能随集群数量增加而上升。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: TVTA: Trajectory-Aware Viseme-Guided Temporal Aggregation for Event-Based Lip Reading
papers.abstract_en: Event-based lip reading has recently emerged as a promising direction for visual speech recognition, benefiting from the high temporal resolution and motion sensitivity of event cameras. However, existing methods typically perform spatial compression before sufficient temporal modeling, which may suppress sparse and localized motion trajectories that are crucial for distinguishing similar lip movements. Moreover, most current approaches optimize temporal representations mainly at the word-classification level, leaving the underlying articulatory structure weakly constrained. To address these limitations, we propose a temporally enhanced framework for event-based lip reading. First, we introduce Trajectory-Aware Differential Aggregation (TDA), which performs local temporal modeling at each spatial location before adaptive spatial aggregation. Second, we propose Viseme-Guided Aggregation (VGA), a unified temporal module composed of a CTC decoder and a viseme-guided gated aggregation branch, which injects viseme-aware sequence supervision and improves final temporal aggregation for word recognition. Third, we incorporate an EMA teacher--student training strategy to enhance robustness under strong event perturbations. Experiments on the DVS-Lip benchmark verify the effectiveness of the proposed design, and extensive ablation studies further validate the contributions of TDA, VGA, and teacher--student consistency. Qualitative decoding results also demonstrate that the proposed CTC-based temporal modeling learns meaningful viseme-aware structure from event streams.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对事件相机唇读问题，提出轨迹感知差分聚合（TDA）和视素引导聚合（VGA）的时序增强框架，并引入EMA教师-学生训练策略提升鲁棒性。在DVS-Lip基准上实验验证了方法的有效性，表明CTC时间建模能学习有意义的视素结构。
Motivation: 现有事件唇读方法通常在充分时序建模前进行空间压缩，可能抑制区分相似唇动的稀疏局部运动轨迹；且大多仅在词分类级别优化时序表示，缺乏对发音结构的约束。
Method: 提出轨迹感知差分聚合（TDA）在自适应空间聚合前进行局部时序建模；视素引导聚合（VGA）结合CTC解码器和视素引导门控聚合分支注入视素序列监督；引入EMA教师-学生训练增强事件扰动鲁棒性。
Result: 在DVS-Lip基准上验证了TDA、VGA和教师-学生一致性的有效性，定性解码结果显示CTC时序建模学习到有意义的视素感知结构。
Conclusion: 提出的时序增强框架能有效利用事件流的高时间分辨率特性，通过学习视素结构提升唇读性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RhyMix: A Lightweight Adaptive Multi-Rhythm Network for Long-Term Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Real-world time series exhibit complex dynamics characterized by multiple simultaneous temporal patterns: short-term fluctuations, periodic seasonal cycles, long-term trends, and irregular abrupt changes. However, many existing forecasting architectures rely on single-path temporal modeling--transformers capture long-range dependencies but smooth local variations, convolutions capture local patterns but have limited receptive fields, and linear models are efficient but cannot capture nonlinear dynamics. To address this, we introduce RhyMix (RHYthm MIXture), a hybrid neural architecture designed around a parallel dual-path modeling paradigm with adaptive gating mechanisms. RhyMix integrates two complementary encoding branches: (i) a Cyclic Path that incorporates explicit seasonal inductive bias through learnable cyclic embeddings, capturing predictable rhythmic patterns; and (ii) a lightweight Multi-Scale Temporal Convolutional Network with Channel Attention Path that employs multi-scale depthwise dilated convolutions to capture temporal dependencies across different receptive fields. A key innovation is the use of adaptive gating at multiple levels: a path gate dynamically combines four specialized forecasting heads (Direct, Trend-Seasonal Decomposition, Local Convolution, and Periodic Fusion) per sample and channel, while a hybrid gate adaptively balances the Cyclic and MSTCN-CA Paths based on input characteristics. This design ensures the model adapts to specific temporal patterns while maintaining linear complexity in sequence length, channels, and prediction horizon. Across extensive benchmarks on 12 real-world datasets for long-term forecasting, RhyMix achieves state-of-the-art performance on 10 of 12 datasets. The model remains lightweight (~40K params) with linear complexity and low-latency inference (<5ms),suitable for resource-constrained edge devices and real-time deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RhyMix，一种轻量级自适应多节奏混合神经架构，用于长期时间序列预测。该模型采用并行双路径编码（循环路径与多尺度时序卷积通道注意力路径），并通过多级自适应门控动态组合四个预测头和双路径输出。在12个真实世界长期预测基准上，RhyMix在10个数据集上取得最先进结果，模型仅约40K参数，推理延迟低于5ms，适合边缘设备部署。
Motivation: 现有时间序列预测方法（Transformer、卷积、线性模型）各自存在局限，难以同时捕捉短期波动、周期、趋势和突变等多重时间模式。
Method: 提出RhyMix架构，包含：(i) 循环路径，通过可学习循环嵌入引入显式季节偏置；(ii) 多尺度时序卷积通道注意力路径，使用深度可分离扩张卷积捕获不同感受野的依赖。关键创新在于多级自适应门控：路径门动态组合四个专用预测头（直接、趋势-季节分解、局部卷积、周期融合），混合门根据输入特征自适应平衡双路径输出。
Result: 在12个长期预测数据集上，RhyMix在10个上达到最优。模型参数量约40K，复杂度与序列长度、通道数、预测步长呈线性关系，推理延迟低于5ms。
Conclusion: 摘要强调RhyMix通过自适应门控和多路径设计，在保持轻量和线性复杂度的前提下适应不同时间模式，适用于资源受限的边缘设备和实时部署场景。
Relevance: 40

papers.title: Playing ZendoWorld: Challenging AI Agents on Active Visual Concept Induction
papers.abstract_en: A central challenge in building intelligent systems is enabling agents to jointly perceive complex inputs, form hypotheses about hidden patterns, and design informative experiments to test them. To study this problem, we propose ZendoWorld, a controlled interactive environment in which agents must infer a logical rule about visual game observations, acquire information by proposing new scenes, and refine their hypotheses based on feedback from the game environment. We evaluate several agents spanning pure VLM reasoning, Bayesian particle filtering, dynamic concept discovery, and neuro-symbolic methods. Our main findings are: (1) high accuracy in predicting labels for observed examples does not imply recovery of the underlying rule; (2) perception and induction are distinct bottlenecks for different agent classes; and (3) VLM-based agents propose near-uninformative experiments, failing to actively reduce hypothesis uncertainty. To compare these results, we collect human data on the task, which reveals a gap in inductive reasoning, particularly for more complex rules. Overall, ZENDOWORLD takes an important step toward evaluating intelligent agents and identifies concrete avenues for improvement, particularly in domains like scientific discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ZendoWorld交互环境，用于评估智能体在主动视觉概念归纳中的能力，包括感知、假设形成和实验设计。实验发现，高标签预测准确率不代表规则恢复，不同智能体在感知和归纳上存在不同瓶颈，且基于VLM的智能体无法提出信息量高的实验。
Motivation: 现有智能体在联合感知、假设推断和主动实验设计方面缺乏系统性评估，该研究旨在通过可控环境ZendoWorld来揭示这些能力的瓶颈。
Method: 构建ZendoWorld游戏环境，要求智能体从视觉观察中推断逻辑规则，并通过提出新场景获取反馈来迭代假设。评估了纯VLM推理、贝叶斯粒子滤波、动态概念发现和神经符号方法等多样代理。
Result: 主要发现：(1) 对已观察样例的标签预测高准确率并不等价于恢复底层规则；(2) 感知和归纳是不同智能体类别的不同瓶颈；(3) VLM代理提出的实验几乎无信息量，无法主动降低假设不确定性。
Conclusion: ZendoWorld为评估智能体提供了重要步骤，并指明了改进方向，尤其在像科学发现这样的领域。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 主要发现：(1) 对已观察样例的标签预测高准确率并不等价于恢复底层规则；(2) 感知和归纳是不同智能体类别的不同瓶颈；(3) VLM代理提出的实验几乎无信息量，无法主动降低假设不确定性。
summary_sections.conclusion: ZendoWorld为评估智能体提供了重要步骤，并指明了改进方向，尤其在像科学发现这样的领域。

papers.title: Selecting Interpretable Circular Coordinates from Data
papers.abstract_en: Circular coordinates obtained from persistent cohomology reveal loop structure in data, but they usually remain abstract: A detected circle does not tell us which measured angle, phase, torsion, or decoder explains it. We propose a method for selecting interpretable circle-valued coordinates from a user-supplied dictionary of scientifically meaningful candidates explaining the detected cohomology. In the continuous setting, each candidate is represented by the cohomology class of its pulled-back angular form, and selecting a minimum-energy set of candidates spanning the relevant $H^1$ subspace becomes a minimum-weight basis problem in a vector matroid. We then introduce CIRCOL, a method for discrete point clouds sampled from the manifold. We prove that the introduced cochain inner product is a consistent estimator of the $L^2$ inner product of fixed smooth 1-forms under non-uniform sampling. The resulting projection matrix both helps selecting a basis of low-energy dictionary coordinates and diagnoses topologically trivial candidates or unexplained persistent classes. Finally, we verify the effectiveness of our method on synthetic examples, on molecular simulations, and neural recordings of head-direction cells.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种从数据中选择可解释圆形坐标的方法，基于持久上同调检测环结构，并通过用户提供的字典选出最小能量的候选坐标。理论上，将问题转化为向量拟阵中的最小权重基问题；离散场景下提出CIRCOL方法，证明所引入的上链内积在非均匀采样下是光滑1-形式L^2内积的一致估计。通过合成数据、分子模拟和头部方向细胞神经记录验证有效性。
Motivation: 持久上同调获得的圆形坐标通常是抽象的，不能直接揭示哪个测量角度、相位或解码器解释了检测到的圆。需要从候选字典中选出可解释的圆形坐标。
Method: 连续场景下，每个候选由其拉回角形式的同调类表示，选择最小能量集覆盖相关H^1子空间转化为向量拟阵的最小权重基问题。离散场景下提出CIRCOL，使用上链内积的一致估计构建投影矩阵，辅助选择低能量字典坐标并诊断拓扑平凡候选或未解释的持久类。
Result: 在合成示例、分子模拟和头部方向细胞神经记录上验证了方法的有效性。
Conclusion: 方法能从字典中选出可解释的圆形坐标，并诊断拓扑平凡候选。

papers.title: Multimodal 3D LUT Generation via StatLUT with Statistical Features for Photorealistic Style Transfer
papers.abstract_en: Photorealistic Style Transfer (PST) aims to transfer the color and tonal style of a reference to a content image while strictly preserving its structural integrity. However, existing deep learning-based methods inherently suffer from semantic entanglement caused by pre-trained image encoders, leading to unnatural spatial distortions. Moreover, current pixel-level mapping paradigms often ignore color gamut topology, resulting in color banding, while also lacking the multimodal capability for intuitive text-driven control. To address these bottlenecks, we propose StatLUT, an innovative multimodal framework for 3D LUT generation. First, we bypass traditional encoders and introduce a Lab-Extractor to derive spatially-agnostic statistical features, fundamentally decoupling color distributions from structural semantics to ensure artifact-free rendering. Second, we formulate LUT generation as a Transformer-based Seq2Seq translation task, utilizing a Multi-dimensional Residual Mapper (MR-Mapper) to predict topologically smooth 3D LUTs. Finally, to break the single-modal barrier, we propose the H-Diffuser, a lightweight Diffusion Transformer that directly synthesizes statistical features from natural language prompts, enabling flexible text-driven color grading. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that StatLUT significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both visual quality and quantitative metrics, pioneering a highly robust and flexible paradigm for multimodal photorealistic style transfer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 StatLUT，一个用于真实感风格迁移 (PST) 的多模态 3D LUT 生成框架。通过 Lab-Extractor 提取颜色统计特征以解耦颜色与结构，利用 Transformer 序列到序列任务生成拓扑平滑的 3D LUT，并提出 H-Diffuser 实现文本驱动的色彩调节。实验表明该方法在视觉质量和量化指标上显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有 PST 方法存在语义纠缠导致空间失真、颜色映射忽略色域拓扑引起色带、缺乏多模态文本控制能力等问题。
Method: StatLUT 包含三个核心组件：Lab-Extractor 提取空间无关的统计特征；MR-Mapper 基于 Transformer 的 Seq2Seq 模型预测 3D LUT；H-Diffuser 轻量扩散 Transformer 从文本提示合成统计特征。
Result: 在标准基准上，StatLUT 在视觉质量和量化指标上均显著超越当前最优方法。
Conclusion: StatLUT 为多模态真实感风格迁移提供了鲁棒且灵活的范式。

papers.title: LUMI: Tokenizer-Agnostic LLM-Based Lossless Image Compression
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM)-based lossless image compression methods typically represent pixel data through the native text interface of a pretrained model, converting pixel values into token sequences that the LLM processes through its vocabulary head. This design shows that pretrained language models can provide probability estimates for image coding, but it also couples compression to tokenizer behavior, vocabulary-specific numeric tokens, and model-family-specific adaptation. In this paper, we present LUMI (LLM-based Unified Model-agnostic lossless Image compression), a tokenizer-agnostic framework for lossless RGB image compression with frozen LLM backbones. LUMI replaces pixel-as-text tokenization with a pixel embedding module that maps raw intensity and channel information into the continuous embedding space of the LLM. It further introduces intra-patch position encoding to retain two-dimensional spatial structure after flattening, and uses a 256-way prediction head to produce probabilities over the native pixel alphabet. Only the pixel embedding, position encoding, soft-prefix parameters, and prediction head are trained, while the LLM backbone remains fixed. Experiments on natural, medical, and remote-sensing image benchmarks with LLaMA, Qwen, and Gemma backbones show that LUMI provides a unified interface across tokenizer families, achieves competitive compression rates, and improves cross-domain robustness over tokenizer-based LLM compression baselines. These results formulate LLM-based lossless image compression as pixel-space adaptation of frozen foundation models rather than tokenizer-specific language-symbol modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LUMI，一种与分词器无关的基于冻结大语言模型的无损RGB图像压缩框架。LUMI用像素嵌入模块替代文本分词，将原始像素映射到LLM连续嵌入空间，并引入块内位置编码保持二维结构，使用256路预测头输出像素概率。实验在多个骨干网络（LLaMA, Qwen, Gemma）和多种图像域（自然、医学、遥感）上验证，实现了有竞争力的压缩率并提升跨域鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的无损图像压缩方法将像素通过文本分词器转换为token序列，耦合了压缩与分词器行为，限制了模型通用性和跨域适应能力。
Method: LUMI框架包含三个可训练组件：像素嵌入模块（将原始像素映射到LLM连续嵌入空间）、块内位置编码（保留二维空间结构）、256路预测头（输出像素概率）；LLM主干冻结。
Result: 在自然、医学和遥感图像基准上，使用LLaMA、Qwen、Gemma骨干网络，LUMI在不同分词器族上提供统一接口，压缩率与基于分词器的基线相当或更优，跨域鲁棒性提升。
Conclusion: 本文说明基于LLM的无损图像压缩可视为对冻结基础模型的像素空间适配，而非依赖特定分词器的语言符号建模。

papers.title: Benchmark Evaluation of Feredated Learning on Multi-organ Images
papers.abstract_en: The privacy requirements of medical data and its substantial variations across organs and modalities hinder the clinical implementation of medical AI. Federated learning (FL) is a feasible approach to overcome these challenges. Due to the continuous emergence of FL algorithms and the highly heterogeneous nature of medical data, objectively evaluating their performance in real-world clinical settings remains difficult. Therefore, a comprehensive federated medical imaging benchmark, serving as a unified evaluation standard, is crucial for advancing the technology toward reliable clinical application. Existing federated medical imaging benchmarks have not yet adequately incorporated state-of-the-art algorithms, are limited to data from single organs or modalities, and overly emphasize model accuracy, making it difficult to comprehensively assess the overall efficacy of FL in real-world medical environments. To address these challenges, we developed the MobenFL benchmark. This benchmark integrates 20 cutting-edge FL algorithms and 22 medical imaging datasets, covering 12 critical organs across the human body, surpassing existing benchmark in breadth. In terms of evaluation dimensions, MobenFL not only assesses performance but also systematically incorporates key metrics such as algorithmic efficiency and privacy protection capabilities. Additionally, it conducts specialized evaluations for complex real-world clinical scenarios involving different diseases, devices, and imaging modalities, thereby providing a comprehensive and in-depth evaluation framework for the clinical application of FL in the medical field.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了 MobenFL 基准，整合了 20 种前沿联邦学习算法和 22 个医学影像数据集，覆盖 12 个人体关键器官，并引入算法效率与隐私保护等多维评估指标，旨在为联邦学习在医学影像领域的临床应用提供统一评价标准。
Motivation: 现有联邦医学影像基准未充分纳入最新算法、局限于单器官或单模态数据，且过度强调模型精度，难以全面评估联邦学习在真实临床环境中的综合效果。
Method: 构建 MobenFL 基准，集成 20 种联邦学习算法和 22 个多器官、多模态数据集，在评估中同时考虑性能、算法效率和隐私保护能力，并对不同疾病、设备和成像模态场景进行专项评估。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果。
Conclusion: MobenFL 提供了比现有基准更全面、更深入的联邦学习临床评估框架，有助于推动可信医学人工智能应用。
