papers.title: Metrics or Mirage? An Audit of Evaluation Inconsistencies in Colonoscopy Polyp Segmentation Benchmarks
papers.abstract_en: Progress in colonoscopy polyp segmentation is routinely reported through leaderboard comparisons on a small set of public benchmarks. We argue that this apparent progress is difficult to verify: a systematic audit of \textbf{27 papers} published between 2015 and 2026 reveals three structural problems in how the community evaluates models. \textbf{First}, 25 of 27 papers \textit{omit the Hausdorff distance}. Hausdorff distance is a boundary-accuracy metric with direct clinical relevance for detecting flat or small polyps, and is a standard in radiotherapy segmentation. \textbf{Second}, at least five \textit{incompatible train/test split protocols} co-exist across papers reporting results on the same two datasets (Kvasir-SEG and CVC-ClinicDB), making published Dice scores non-comparable even when they appear in the same leaderboard column. \textbf{Third}, 26 of 27 papers make \textit{performance claims without any statistical significance test}. Strikingly, four papers published \emph{after} the Metrics Reloaded framework~\cite{metricsreloaded2024} (Maier-Hein et al., \textit{Nature Methods} 2024) perpetuate these same problems, suggesting that general-purpose metric guidance has not yet reached the colonoscopy sub-community. To show these problems are not merely cosmetic, we re-evaluate five representative models under three controlled protocols with a single uniform scorer, and find that the reported metric conceals large boundary and recall failures, that the ``best'' model changes with the metric, and that near-tied rankings reverse across random splits. We propose a five-point \textbf{Polyp Segmentation Reporting Checklist}~(PSRC) as a lightweight, domain-adapted corrective.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对2015-2026年间发表的27篇结肠镜息肉分割论文进行系统性审计，揭示三个评估结构性问题：25/27论文省略了临床相关的Hausdorff距离指标；至少五种不兼容的训练/测试划分协议使Dice分数不可比；26/27论文未进行统计显著性检验。通过在受控协议下重新评估五个模型，发现报告指标掩盖了边界和召回失败，最佳模型随指标变化，排名因随机划分翻转。提出五点评分报告清单（PSRC）作为轻量级修正。
Motivation: 结肠镜息肉分割的进展主要通过排行榜比较报告，但这种进展难以验证，因为社区评估存在系统性问题，如指标选择、数据划分和统计检验的不一致。
Method: 对27篇论文进行审计，并重新评估五个代表性模型在三种受控协议下使用统一评分器，以展示评估不一致的影响。
Result: 发现25/27论文省略Hausdorff距离；至少五种不兼容的协议；26/27论文无显著性测试；四个论文在Metrics Reloaded指南后仍犯同样问题。重新评估显示报告指标掩盖了较大边界和召回失败，最佳模型随指标变化，排名因随机划分翻转。
Conclusion: 提出五点评分报告清单（PSRC）作为轻量级、领域适应的修正，以改善结肠镜息肉分割评估的透明度和可重复性。

papers.title: PIT-SUN: A Deployable Empirical Marginal Transform Framework with Expectation-Consistent Recovery for Regression in Recommender Systems
papers.abstract_en: Estimating original-space conditional expectations is central to value-driven recommender systems, including dwell time, GMV, and LTV forecasting. Standard MSE is expectation-consistent in principle, but its gradients become unstable on heavy-tailed, zero-inflated, and multimodal targets, causing mean collapse and tail shrinkage. Target transformation alleviates this scale conflict, yet any useful nonlinear marginal transform loses expectation consistency under direct inversion. This is not an implementation oversight: a direct inverse-transform estimator is universally expectation-consistent only when the inverse transform is affine, which cannot simultaneously provide bounded tail compression. Existing conditionally linear recovery methods restore expectation consistency, but still leave open which coordinate, inverse lookup, recovery base, and deployment monitor should be selected for sparse complex marginals. We propose \textbf{P}robability-\textbf{I}ntegral-\textbf{TranS}formed \textbf{Un}biased recovery (\textbf{PIT-SUN}), a deployable empirical marginal recovery framework. PIT-SUN uses one empirical marginal table to define a bounded normal-score coordinate, its inverse-quantile lookup, a variance-controlled recovery base, and drift monitoring, then applies multiplicative SUN recovery to estimate the original-space expectation instead of directly inverting transformed predictions. Experiments on synthetic distributions, public benchmarks, large-scale industrial datasets, and online deployment show robust improvements in point accuracy, calibration, and ranking quality with lightweight deployment overhead.

papers.title: TMI: Text-to-Image Meets Image-to-Image for Complementary Data Synthesis to Boost Long-Tailed Instance Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Large-vocabulary instance segmentation is constrained by long-tailed category distributions and fine-grained inter-class ambiguity. While data synthesis offers a promising alternative, current paradigms have complementary limitations: text-to-image (T2I) methods inherit noisy pseudo-labels and struggle on rare classes, whereas copy-paste methods compromise contextual realism. To address these issues, we propose a hybrid pipeline coupling T2I generation with context-aware image-to-image (I2I) editing. The T2I branch provides broad category and scene diversity, while a teacher-student scheme ensures label reliability by selectively retaining only prompt-specified categories. To strengthen supervision for rare classes, we introduce VRAIN (Verified Rare-class Augmentation via INstructed editing), a novel I2I editor. VRAIN inserts high-confidence instances at semantically appropriate locations within in-the-wild scenes, yielding semantically coherent and visually natural edits that reduce domain gaps and enable targeted augmentation. On the LVIS benchmark, our method surpasses existing baselines, improving overall AP by up to +4.0 points and rare-class AP by up to +9.5 points, while scaling effectively with backbone capacity. Our project page is available at https://seokhunchoi.github.io/TMI
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. The first two authors contributed equally to this work
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出混合管道 TMI，结合文本到图像 (T2I) 生成与上下文感知的图像到图像 (I2I) 编辑，以解决大词汇量实例分割中的长尾类别和细粒度歧义问题。T2I分支提供类别和场景多样性，并通过教师-学生方案确保伪标签可靠性。新的 I2I 编辑器 VRAIN 在自然场景中语义恰当位置插入高置信度实例，产生语义连贯且视觉自然的编辑。在 LVIS 基准上，总体 AP 提升高达 +4.0，稀有类 AP 提升高达 +9.5。
Motivation: 大词汇量实例分割受限于长尾类别分布和细粒度类间模糊性。现有数据合成方法存在互补缺陷：T2I 继承噪声伪标签且对稀有类效果差，而复制粘贴方法损害上下文真实感。
Method: 提出混合管道 TMI，包含两个分支：首先是 T2I 生成提供广泛类别和场景多样性，并用教师-学生方案仅保留提示指定类别的可靠标签；其次提出 VRAIN 作为 I2I 编辑器，在高置信度实例的语义恰当位置插入，实现定向增强。
Result: 在 LVIS 基准上，总体 AP 提升 +4.0 点，稀有类 AP 提升 +9.5 点，并且随骨干容量有效扩展。
Conclusion: 该方法通过结合 T2I 和 I2I 的优势，互补了各自局限，实现了对长尾实例分割的有效数据合成增强。

papers.title: Unpaired Joint Distribution Modeling via Multi-Scale Image Representations
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies the problem of learning a joint distribution from marginal observations, which is inherently ill-posed due to the ambiguity of feasible couplings. We propose LUD-MSR, a latent-variable probabilistic framework that models the joint distribution via auxiliary representations and optimizes evidence lower bounds using only marginal data. Under mild assumptions, we establish an upper bound on the distribution approximation error. This analysis reveals a trade-off in representation learning between domain consistency and information preservation. To address this trade-off, we introduce a Multi-Scale image Representation (MSR) mapping that exploits structural similarity at coarse scales while suppressing domain-specific variations. We show that MSR achieves a more favorable balance of this trade-off compared to existing approaches. Experiments on real-world denoising benchmarks, including cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM), demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究从边缘观测学习联合分布的病态问题，提出LUD-MSR框架，通过辅助表示建模联合分布并优化证据下界。理论分析揭示了表示学习中域一致性与信息保持的权衡，引入多尺度图像表示（MSR）来利用粗尺度结构相似性并抑制域特定变化。在真实去噪基准（包括冷冻电镜）上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 从边缘观测学习联合分布是病态问题，存在可行耦合的歧义性，现有方法难以有效处理表示学习中的域一致性与信息保持权衡。
Method: 提出潜在变量概率框架LUD-MSR，通过多尺度图像表示（MSR）映射实现域一致性与信息保持的更好平衡，并优化证据下界。
Result: 在冷冻电镜等真实去噪基准上，LUD-MSR框架展示了有效性，优于现有方法。
Conclusion: MSR在域一致性与信息保持的权衡中实现了更有利的平衡，为联合分布学习提供了新思路，但当前仅针对去噪任务验证。

papers.title: MLQENABLER: Enabling Secure Machine Learning Queries over Encrypted Database in Cloud Computing
papers.abstract_en: In cloud computing, the public cloud service providers (CSPs) can provide cloud storage as the primary service while providing additional machine learning (ML)-based services by using the clients' data in storage. This business model extends the border of cloud computing services and brings in new business growth possibilities. Although it is promising, the model also brings in security concerns since the public commercial cloud cannot be fully trusted. For example, the public commercial clouds may sell clients' sensitive data to the government or other companies. To address the security concerns, an immediate solution is to require clients to encrypt their datasets before outsourcing to the cloud. However, if a database is formally encrypted, then the database contains only pseudorandom numbers, making it impossible to enable ML over it. In this project, we propose MLQENABLER (ML Queries Enabler) scheme to enable secure ML queries over encrypted database in cloud storage. MLQENABLER employs an index-aid approach to achieve security and ML capability simultaneously. Our initial experiments show that MLQENABLER achieves an acceptable security level while incurring only a slight ML performance degradation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MLQENABLER 方案，用于在云计算中对加密数据库执行安全的机器学习查询。该方案通过索引辅助方法同时实现安全性和机器学习能力，初步实验表明在可接受的安全水平下仅造成轻微的 ML 性能下降。
Motivation: 在云计算中，用户将数据加密后外包给不可信的云服务商，但加密后的数据库无法直接用于机器学习，需要一种既能保证数据安全又能支持 ML 查询的解决方案。
Method: 提出 MLQENABLER 方案，采用索引辅助（index-aid）方法，在加密数据库上实现安全 ML 查询，平衡安全性与机器学习性能。
Result: 初步实验显示，MLQENABLER 达到了可接受的安全水平，同时仅引起轻微的机器学习性能下降。
Conclusion: 该方案为在加密云数据库上执行安全机器学习查询提供了可行途径，但实验尚处初始阶段，需进一步评估。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A First-Principles Theory of Slow Thinking and Active Perception
papers.abstract_en: As part of a series on first-principles modeling of cognitive functions, this paper attempts to provide a mathematical formulation of thinking and perception. It formally derives slow thinking or more generally, active perception, and encompasses the design, training and inference of slow thinking large language models. Our starting point is the lifting and projection of probability distributions on the observable and latent spaces, with the objective of representing complex data distributions by simple function families such as neural networks. A theory called "active lifting" is proposed, based on the sampling of latent sequences and an intrinsic drive to reduce uncertainty with maximum rate. It derives a large design space, containing the slow thinking models in a subspace that we call the static theory. These models are positioned on the representation hierarchy and sampler hierarchy induced by the static theory, and can be upgraded by climbing the two hierarchies. Active lifting further derives an inference process with an internal time axis, and a training objective that resembles minimum-length coding as well as the invention of languages. Thus, it characterizes the agency of perception, including the emergence of the slow thinking formats. Technical by-products of this theory include a three-stage pathway for improving slow thinking models, a unified approach to constructing encoders and generative models for all data modalities, a priori formation of human-like visual representations, and a possible solution to policy collapse.
papers.comment: Published on 2026/05/11 in Journal of Machine Learning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文作为认知功能第一性原理建模系列的一部分，提出了慢思考和主动感知的数学形式化，并涵盖了慢思考大型语言模型的设计、训练与推理。理论核心是概率分布在可观测量与隐空间上的提升与投影，提出了基于潜在序列采样和内在不确定性减少驱动力的“主动提升”理论，从中推导出静态理论子空间中的慢思考模型、推理过程及类似最小长度编码的训练目标。
Motivation: 当前对慢思考（slow thinking）和主动感知缺乏严格的数学基础，而大型语言模型的推理能力需要更系统的理论指导。
Method: 提出主动提升理论，通过概率分布的提升与投影，从采样隐序列和最大速率降低不确定性出发，形式化推导出慢思考模型的设计空间、推理过程（含内部时间轴）和训练目标（类似最小长度编码和语言发明）。
Result: 从理论上统一了慢思考模型的表示层次和采样器层次，并给出三阶段改进路径、多模态编码器与生成模型的统一构建、类人视觉表征的先验形成以及策略崩溃的潜在解决方案。
Conclusion: 该理论为理解和改进慢思考大语言模型提供了第一性原理框架，但文中未涉及具体实验验证，其有效性有待后续实证研究。

papers.title: Dive Into the Implicit Biases of Low-rank Vision-language Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language alignment, the stage that bridges pretrained vision encoders and large language models, is widely treated as a form of pretraining requiring full-parameter updates. We challenge this view and investigate what happens when low-rank adaptation is applied to the LLM during this stage instead. We find that low-rank alignment not only reduces computational costs but also outperforms full-parameter alignment on most benchmarks. To understand this phenomenon, we systematically characterize the implicit biases introduced by low-rank adaptation during alignment. Empirically, we find that low-rank alignment shifts model behavior from hallucinatory to conservative and preserves per-token linear separability of visual features that full-parameter alignment disrupts, a phenomenon we term LS-curse. Geometrically, low rank aligned models exhibit more homogeneous and structurally stable visual representations, maintaining modality-specific knowledge rather than prematurely fusing entity-level semantics. Theoretically, we establish two theorems showing that low-rank alignment induces preferences for parameter subspaces with flat gradients and feature subspaces robust to perturbations, providing a principled explanation for the observed structure-preserving behavior. Extensive experiments cover ablation over 100 alignment configurations, three families of low-rank operators, and various rank, encoder, and other settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文挑战视觉语言对齐阶段必须使用全参数更新的观点，探索在LLM上应用低秩适配的效果。研究发现低秩对齐不仅降低计算成本，还在多数基准上优于全参数对齐。系统分析了低秩适配带来的隐式偏差：低秩对齐使模型行为从幻觉转向保守，并保持视觉特征的逐词线性可分性（LS-curse）。几何上，低秩对齐模型产生更均匀且结构稳定的视觉表示，保持模态特定知识而非过早融合实体级语义。理论上，证明低秩对齐倾向于选择梯度平坦的参数子空间和鲁棒的特征子空间。实验覆盖100种对齐配置、三类低秩算子及多种秩和编码器设置。
Motivation: 视觉语言对齐通常被视为需要全参数更新的预训练阶段，计算成本高。作者质疑这一观点，探索在LLM上使用低秩适配的效果，旨在此设置下理解低秩适配的隐式偏差及其对模型行为的影响。
Method: 在视觉语言对齐阶段对LLM应用低秩适配，系统分析隐式偏差：实证上观察模型行为变化、视觉特征线性可分性（LS-curse）及几何表示特性；理论上建立两个定理，证明低秩对齐偏好梯度平坦的参数子空间和特征子空间。
Result: 低秩对齐在多数基准上优于全参数对齐，降低计算成本，使模型行为从幻觉转向保守，保持视觉特征的逐词线性可分性，产生更均匀且结构稳定的视觉表示。
Conclusion: 低秩对齐不仅有效，而且通过引入结构保持的隐式偏差，优于全参数对齐。论文提供了理论和实验支撑，但域为视觉语言对齐，未涉及气象或降水预报。

papers.title: Open-ended Multi-agent Autocurricula via Visual Inspection of Policies with Multi-modal LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Open-ended curricula in Reinforcement Learning (RL) aim to train generally-capable agents by identifying tasks that facilitate learning increasingly complex skills. A major challenge when designing such curricula is assessing task difficulty relative to the agent's current learning progress. While previous work has explored using scalar task scores or textual summaries of the agent's behavior, here we study a different approach: directly inspecting policy behavior via recorded episode videos. We introduce a simple yet effective instantiation of this approach which leverages a Video Language Model (VLM) to both process these videos and provide curriculum recommendations, which we call Visual Inspection of Policies (VIP). Since videos can naturally contain any number of controllable agents, we empirically study VIP on the StarCraft Multi-Agent Challenge (SMAC). We show that even with a lightweight and openly accessible VLM (VideoLLaMa2-7B), VIP can use policy videos to generate more effective curricula than both its text-only ablation and methods that rely on scalar task scores.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于视频语言模型（VLM）的多智能体自动课程学习方法（VIP），通过直接检查策略行为的录播视频来推荐任务难度。在StarCraft多智能体挑战（SMAC）上，即使使用轻量级VLM（VideoLLaMa2-7B），VIP也比纯文本或标量任务分数的方法生成更有效的课程。
Motivation: 开放端课程学习中，评估任务难度相对于智能体当前学习进展是一个挑战。以往方法依赖标量分数或文本摘要，本文探索直接通过视频检查策略行为来推荐课程。
Method: 提出VIP方法，使用视频语言模型（VLM）处理智能体行为的录制视频，并基于视觉分析生成课程推荐。
Result: 在SMAC环境上，VIP比纯文本消融和依赖标量任务分数的方法产生更有效的课程，且轻量级VLM即可实现。
Conclusion: 视频直接检查策略行为是一种有效的课程学习方法，轻量级VLM便可取得良好效果。

papers.title: Dual-Correlation Hypergraph Network for Unaligned RGBT Video Object Detection and A Large-scale Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: RGB-Thermal (RGBT) Video Object Detection (VOD) has gained significant traction due to its ability to overcome the limitations of conventional RGB-based VOD under challenging conditions. However, spatial misalignment commonly exists between RGBT image pairs. To address this, we propose a Dual-Correlation Hypergraph Network (DHNet) that captures high-dimensional complementary information by explicitly modeling two types of correlations: temporal correlation across consecutive frames and spatial correlation from cross-modal features. Specifically, we first design a Patch-based Spatial Alignment Module (PSAM) to sequentially align the multimodal features at the local region level. Subsequently, we introduce a Dual Hypergraph Fusion Module (DHFM), which constructs separate temporal and multimodal hypergraphs to enhance object discriminability through dual-correlation learning. Furthermore, the field currently lacks a large-scale, scene-diverse benchmark dataset for comprehensive evaluation. To address this gap, we construct DVT-VOD1000, a large-scale RGBT VOD dataset containing 1,000 video sequences with 103,464 RGBT image pairs. The dataset covers diverse scenarios, including campuses, parks, transportation, rural areas, night scenes, rain, and snow. Comprehensive experiments on VT-VOD50 and our DVT-VOD1000 demonstrate that DHNet achieves state-of-the-art detection accuracy. The dataset and source code will be made publicly available on https://github.com/tzz-ahu/ to support academic research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出双相关超图网络（DHNet）用于未对齐的RGB-T视频目标检测，并构建了大规模基准数据集DVT-VOD1000（包含1000个视频序列、103464对RGB-T图像）。DHNet通过补丁空间对齐模块（PSAM）和双超图融合模块（DHFM）显式建模时间相关性和跨模态空间相关性，在VT-VOD50和DVT-VOD1000上达到了最先进检测精度。
Motivation: RGB-T视频目标检测中，图像对之间存在空间未对齐问题，且缺少大规模场景多样的基准数据集。
Method: 提出DHNet，包含补丁空间对齐模块（PSAM）用于局部区域对齐，以及双超图融合模块（DHFM）分别构建时间超图和跨模态超图以增强目标判别性。
Result: 在VT-VOD50和自建DVT-VOD1000数据集上达到最先进检测精度。
Conclusion: DHNet有效处理了RGB-T视频中的未对齐问题，且DVT-VOD1000为后续研究提供了大规模基准。作者将公开数据和代码。

papers.title: Leveraging Color Naming for Image Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: Enhancing images to make them visually appealing is a persistent challenge in computer vision. Many deep-learning methods train models on paired datasets to replicate expert editing styles. However, these approaches struggle with two key issues: (1) interpretability and (2) a parametrization suitable for user adjustments. To address these challenges, we present NamedCurves+, an approach inspired by the concept of Color Naming, a universal set of familiar colors widely used in software tools for intuitive editing. Our method integrates color names into a learning-based framework, enabling global adjustments for each named color through tone curves. To address local image variations, we incorporate a transformer block that captures spatial dependencies, enabling context-aware edits across the image. NamedCurves+ enhances the retouching process's interpretability and supports user interaction, allowing flexible modifications of individual tone curves to refine the retouched image according to personal preferences. Extensive experiments on tasks such as image retouching, tone mapping, and exposure correction demonstrate that NamedCurves+ outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Notably, our approach is both explainable, as the tone curves explicitly represent how each color name contributes to the enhancement, and interactive, allowing users to customize the retouching process and achieve results tailored to their liking.
papers.comment: Project page: https://namedcurves.github.io. arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2407.09892
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出NamedCurves+，一种基于颜色命名（Color Naming）概念的图像增强方法。该方法将颜色名称融入学习框架，通过色调曲线（tone curves）对每个命名颜色进行全局调整，并利用Transformer块捕获空间依赖性以实现局部上下文感知编辑。实验表明，该方法在图像润饰、色调映射和曝光校正任务上优于现有方法，同时具备可解释性和交互性。
Motivation: 现有深度学习方法在图像增强中存在两个关键问题：可解释性不足，以及参数化不适合用户调整。
Method: 提出NamedCurves+，将颜色命名概念集成到基于学习的框架中，每个命名颜色通过色调曲线调整，并引入Transformer块处理局部图像变化。
Result: 在图像润饰、色调映射和曝光校正任务上，NamedCurves+优于现有最先进方法，且色调曲线显式展示了每个颜色名称对增强的贡献。
Conclusion: 该方法具有可解释性和交互性，允许用户自定义色调曲线以实现个性化编辑。

papers.title: LEEVLA: Seeing What Matters in Latent Environment Evolution for Vision-Language-Action
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models aim to map multimodal inputs to robot actions. However, most existing approaches struggle to cover complex dynamic scenarios due to treating all visual tokens uniformly and reasoning with human-selected factors, which lack mechanisms to emphasize task-critical evidence and ignore underlying factors. To address this issue, we propose LEEVLA, a VLA architecture for seeing what matters in Latent Environment Evolution that explicitly guides the model toward informative regions while preserving the structured evolution of latent world representations. To identify salient and instruction-relevant regions, we introduce drift-guided dynamic prioritization (DGDP), which combines dynamic position prioritization (DPP) with semantic drift guidance (SDG) to guide the VLA agent where to attend during training. On top of this, we introduce structured feature flow generation (SFFG), which models how these prioritized features should evolve in latent space via prototype-to-periphery (P2P) prediction, and a mutual-neighborhood contrastive (MC) loss to maintain topological consistency among neighborhoods. Together, DGDP and SFFG form a task-aware "where-how" training framework. Extensive experiments on VLA benchmarks show that LEEVLA consistently outperforms prior methods, confirming that explicit task-evidence guidance and structured latent reasoning are both crucial for scalable VLA. Our code is available at https://github.com/LyuQi127/LEEVLA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LEEVLA，一种视觉-语言-动作（VLA）架构，通过显式引导模型关注任务关键区域并在潜在空间中保持结构化演化，解决现有方法无法处理复杂动态场景的问题。实验表明该方法在 VLA 基准上优于先前方法。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 模型统一处理所有视觉令牌并使用人工选择因素进行推理，缺乏突出任务关键证据的机制，难以覆盖复杂动态场景。
Method: 提出漂移引导动态优先化（DGDP）识别显著与指令相关区域，包括动态位置优先化（DPP）和语义漂移引导（SDG）；引入结构化特征流生成（SFFG），通过原型到外围预测建模特征在潜在空间的演化，并使用互邻域对比损失保持拓扑一致性。
Result: 在 VLA 基准上，LEEVLA 始终优于先前方法，证实了显式任务引导和结构化潜在推理对可扩展 VLA 的重要性。
Conclusion: 论文强调显式任务证据引导和结构化潜在推理对于可扩展 VLA 至关重要，但未提及在天气预测等领域的适用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Out of Sight: Compression-Aware Content Protection against Agentic Crawlers
papers.abstract_en: The rise of LLM-based agents with reasoning, summarization, and memory capabilities has created a new threat surface for online content that conventional defenses fail to address. Existing defenses like access controls can be circumvented by agents mimicking ordinary browsers, and injection-based defenses often degrade human readability. In this paper, we revisit the agent pipeline and identify context compression, which agents routinely invoke to fit context budgets, as a critical yet overlooked defense layer. We propose CAPE, a framework that protects high-value textual content by injecting invisible perturbations without changing its human-visible surface form, thereby inducing severe information loss during agent compression. CAPE extracts disruptive seed perturbations from an accessible surrogate compressor, then adapts them to query-only target compressors through prior-guided evolution and preference-calibrated candidate prioritization, achieving effective protection under a low query budget. Experiments on three content types and four compression settings show that CAPE improves information loss by up to 75.8% over the strongest baseline while keeping protected content visually indistinguishable from originals. CAPE also transfers to real-world settings, including the LangGraph agent workflow and GitHub Copilot, highlighting its generality and practical value. This paper aims to reveal context compression as a new defense layer, promoting content protection research in the agent era.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CAPE框架，针对基于LLM的智能代理（agent）通过注入不可见扰动，在代理进行上下文压缩时造成信息丢失，从而保护高价值文本内容。实验显示CAPE在多种压缩设置下比最强基线提升高达75.8%的信息损失，同时保持内容视觉不变，并能迁移到LangGraph和GitHub Copilot等实际场景。
Motivation: 现有防御手段（如访问控制、注入式防御）无法有效抵御模仿普通浏览器的智能代理，且常损害人类可读性。作者发现代理常规调用的上下文压缩过程是一个被忽视的防御层。
Method: CAPE框架从可访问的替代压缩器中提取破坏性种子扰动，通过先验引导的进化和偏好校准的候选排序将其适应到仅查询的目标压缩器，在低查询预算下实现有效保护。
Result: 在三种内容类型和四种压缩设置下，CAPE将信息损失相比最强基线提升高达75.8%，且保护内容与原始内容在视觉上无法区分。
Conclusion: 本文揭示上下文压缩可作为新的防御层，推动智能代理时代的在线内容保护研究。

papers.title: ASMR: Agentic Schema Generation for Ship Maintenance Report Writing
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we study the automatic schema generation problem: given a collection of historical ship maintenance and operational reports across multiple form categories, automatically discover compact and informative schemas that capture the essential information requirements of each report type. To address this challenge, we propose ASMR, a modular agentic framework consisting of two specialized agents. A Field Generation Agent extracts semantic concepts from historical narratives and generates candidate schema fields through adaptive multi-granularity clustering, while a Structural Optimizer Agent employs reinforcement learning to identify compact, informative, and non-redundant schema representations. The resulting schemas can guide report authors toward producing more complete, consistent, and actionable reports. Preliminary results demonstrate the promise of the proposed approach and highlight several open research challenges at the intersection of data management, agentic AI, and human-centered AI.
papers.comment: Accepted at the DASHSys 2026 workshop (Systems for Data-centric Agents with Human-in-the-loop), co-located with VLDB 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对船舶维护和操作报告的模式自动生成问题，提出ASMR框架，包含字段生成智能体和结构优化智能体。字段生成智能体通过自适应多粒度聚类从历史叙述中提取语义概念，结构优化智能体利用强化学习发现紧凑、信息丰富且无冗余的模式。初步实验展示了该方法的潜力。
Motivation: 船舶维护报告的格式不统一，导致报告质量参差不齐。自动发现各报告类型的关键信息模式，有助于指导作者生成更完整、一致和可操作的报告。

papers.title: Overthinking: Amplifying Reasoning Weights to Extract Learned Secrets
papers.abstract_en: Black box auditing of language models is an essential pre-deployment tool, but it may miss subtle forms of misalignment and hidden information. To better elicit hidden information during an auditing process, we introduce \emph{overthinking}: the process of using reasoning task vectors to amplify the propensity to think out loud of reasoning models. Given the parameters of a non-reasoning instruct model $M$ and reasoning-distilled model $R$, we define the \emph{overthinking model} as $\boldsymbolθ_{\mathcal{O}_α} = \boldsymbolθ_{\mathcal{M}} + α(\boldsymbolθ_{\mathcal{R}} - \boldsymbolθ_{\mathcal{M}})$, where $α> 1$ amplifies reasoning beyond the pure reasoning model $R$. Additionally, we introduce new layer-wise attenuation strategies that selectively amplify reasoning without losing quality and coherence of model outputs. We demonstrate that overthinking models are more likely to reveal hidden information across four experimental settings, across 2B-32B models. Our findings suggest that reasoning amplification may surface secrets or unintended behaviors acquired during training up to $10\times$ more frequently than the original reasoning model. How secrets surface depends on the secret type: some require perturbation along the reasoning direction, while others yield to any sufficiently large weight perturbation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出"过度思考"（overthinking）方法，通过放大推理权重（使用推理蒸馏模型的参数差异）来提取非推理指令模型中的隐藏信息。在2B-32B规模模型上的实验表明，该方法可使隐藏信息或无意行为的暴露频率比原始推理模型提高最多10倍，且不同秘密类型需要不同的扰动策略。
Motivation: 黑盒审计可能遗漏微妙的不对齐和隐藏信息，需要更有效的方法来诱发这些信息，从而增强模型部署前的安全性检查。
Method: 定义过度思考模型为参数线性插值并放大推理方向向量：θ_Oα = θ_M + α(θ_R - θ_M)，其中α>1；同时引入逐层衰减策略，选择性地放大推理而不损失输出质量和连贯性。
Result: 在四种实验设置下，过度思考模型比原始推理模型更频繁地揭示隐藏信息，频率提升最高达10倍；秘密的表面方式取决于秘密类型，有些需要沿推理方向的扰动，有些则对任何足够大的权重扰动敏感。
Conclusion: 推理放大可以表面训练中获得的不利行为或秘密，但不同秘密需要不同的扰动方式，表明该技术可作为审计工具补充。

papers.title: Attention-Based Segmentation of WMHs and Differentiation of Vascular vs. Demyelinating Lesions
papers.abstract_en: White Matter Hyperintensities (WMHs) are commonly observed in brain Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) scans. They are associated with various neurological conditions, including vascular and inflammatory demyelinating diseases. Despite differing in etiology, WMHs from these conditions often appear similar on Fluid Attenuated Inversion Recovery (FLAIR) images. This similarity makes differential diagnosis challenging. In this work, we highlight the potential of combining attention-based segmentation with feature-driven classification. This approach supports more accurate and efficient classification between vascular and demyelinating white matter pathologies. For segmentation, we evaluate the effectiveness of attention mechanisms, specifically the Bottleneck Attention Module (BAM) and the Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM). We also test different architectures, particularly Attention U-Net. In addition, we explore advanced training strategies, such as patch-based learning and a 2.5D approach, to enhance lesion detection. After segmentation, we extract morphological features from the lesion masks. We then use them to classify WMHs based on their underlying cause. Our experiments utilize five publicly available datasets with diverse imaging protocols to promote model generalizability, despite limited sample sizes. The results suggest that attention-based segmentation and feature-driven classification offer a promising direction for discriminating vascular and demyelinating white matter lesions. Further validation in larger clinical cohorts is still needed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对脑白质高信号(WMHs)在FLAIR图像上表现相似导致血管性与脱髓鞘病变鉴别困难的问题，提出结合注意力机制分割与形态特征驱动的分类方法。实验使用五个公开数据集，评估了BAM和CBAM等注意力模块以及Attention U-Net架构，并采用patch学习和2.5D策略。结果表明该方法有望区分两种病变，但需更大临床队列验证。
Motivation: WMHs在血管性和脱髓鞘疾病中表现相似，常规FLAIR影像难以区分病因，而精确分类对治疗决策至关重要。
Method: 先使用带注意力模块（BAM/CBAM）的U-Net进行WMHs分割，并采用patch学习和2.5D训练策略；分割后从病变掩膜中提取形态学特征，用于区分血管性与脱髓鞘病变的分类。
Result: 在五个不同成像协议的公开数据集上，注意力分割与特征分类方法展现出区分两种病变的潜力，但摘要未报告具体数值。
Conclusion: 注意力机制分割结合形态特征分类是区分血管性和脱髓鞘白质病变的有前景方向，仍需在大规模临床队列中进一步验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Understanding Layer Patching in Model Size Interpolation
papers.abstract_en: Zero-shot model size interpolation aims to create new models of intermediate target sizes by combining existing models without additional training. Recent work on boomerang distillation [Kangaslahti et al., 2026] shows that a student language model distilled from a larger teacher can be expanded by iteratively patching its layers, replacing student layers with contiguous blocks of teacher layers to obtain models whose size and performance interpolate between the student and the teacher. In this work, we provide the first systematic study of student-layer selection for model size interpolation. We cast finding the optimal layer subset for each model size as an optimization problem and prove it can be viewed as a shortest-path problem in a certain acyclic graph. In experiments, we show that patching strongly shapes interpolation behavior, with effects that vary substantially across model families. We find that simple sequential strategies--patching either from the first layer to the last or from the last to the first--often achieve surprisingly strong performance in practice. We further introduce KLPatch, a greedy patching algorithm based on KL divergence, which often improves over last-to-first patching and approximately solves the optimization problem. Together, our results provide a principled understanding of how layer patching affects model size interpolation and offer practical guidance for constructing near-optimal interpolated models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文首次系统研究了模型大小插值（zero-shot model size interpolation）中的学生层选择问题。将寻找每层最优子集视为最短路径问题，并证明贪心算法KLPatch基于KL散度可近似求解最优解。实验发现简单的顺序修补策略（从头到尾或从尾到头）在实践中效果出奇地好。
Motivation: 零样本模型大小插值旨在通过组合现有模型创建中间大小模型而无需额外训练，但学生层如何选择最优至今缺乏系统研究。
Method: 将学生层选择形式化为最优化问题，证明可转化为有向无环图上的最短路径问题；提出KLPatch贪心算法，基于KL散度选择修补层。
Result: 实验表明修补方式显著影响插值行为且效果因模型族而异；简单的顺序策略（首到尾或尾到首）性能强大；KLPatch通常优于从尾到首的策略，并近似最优解。
Conclusion: 提供了对层修补如何影响模型大小插值的原理性理解，并为构建近优插值模型提供了实践指导。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MuScriptor: An Open Model for Multi-Instrument Music Transcription
papers.abstract_en: Existing methods for automatic music transcription are often limited to single-instrument recordings or fail on complex, real music mixes. Although previous work utilizes synthetic training data, the resulting models generalize poorly, leading to largely unusable transcription output in realistic, multi-instrument settings. In this work, we analyze the effectiveness of synthetic data for pre-training while combining it with fine-tuning on real music audio and post-training using reinforcement learning. We further introduce conditioning on instrument presence to customize transcriptions. Finally, we release MuScriptor, an open-weight multi-instrument music transcription model that works on real-world music recordings from across a diverse range of musical genres.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MuScriptor，一个开放权重的多乐器音乐转录模型。通过合成数据预训练、真实音频微调和强化学习后训练，结合乐器存在条件化，解决了现有方法在复杂真实音乐混音中泛化差的问题。模型适用于多种音乐风格的真实世界录音。
Motivation: 现有自动音乐转录方法多局限于单乐器录音，在复杂真实音乐混音中表现不佳，合成数据训练的模型泛化能力差。
Method: 采用合成数据预训练，结合真实音乐音频微调和强化学习后训练，并引入基于乐器存在的条件化输入以定制转录。
Result: 发布了MuScriptor，一个开放权重的多乐器音乐转录模型，在多种音乐风格的真实世界录音上有效工作。
Conclusion: 通过结合合成数据预训练、真实数据微调和后训练，以及乐器条件化，可以构建在真实多乐器场景中可用的转录模型。

papers.title: Continual Test-Time Adaptation in Computer Vision: Methods, Benchmarks, and Future Directions
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural nets achieve remarkable performance when training and test data share the same distribution, but this assumption frequently breaks in real-world deployment, where data undergoes continual distributional shifts. Continual Test-Time Adaptation (CTTA) addresses this challenge by adapting pretrained models to non-stationary target distributions on-the-fly, without access to source data or labeled targets, while mitigating two critical failure modes: catastrophic forgetting of source knowledge and error accumulation from noisy pseudo-labels over extended time horizons. In this comprehensive survey, we formally define the CTTA problem, analyze the diverse continual domain shift patterns that characterize different evaluation protocols, and propose a hierarchical taxonomy that categorizes existing methods into three families: optimization-based strategies (entropy minimization, pseudo-labeling, parameter restoration), parameter-efficient methods (normalization layer adaptation, adaptive parameter selection), and architecture-based approaches (teacher-student frameworks, adapters, visual prompting, masked modeling). We systematically review representative methods within each category and present comparative benchmarks and experimental results across standard evaluation settings. Finally, we discuss limitations of current approaches and highlight emerging research directions, including adaptation of foundation models and black-box systems, providing a roadmap for future research in robust continual test-time adaptation. We encourage visiting our repository at [https://github.com/sarthaxxxxx/Awesome-Continual-Test-Time-Adaptation](https://github.com/sarthaxxxxx/Awesome-Continual-Test-Time-Adaptation)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统综述了计算机视觉中的持续测试时适应（CTTA）问题。CTTA旨在使预训练模型在无源数据和无标签目标的情况下，在线适应非平稳的目标分布，同时避免灾难性遗忘和误差累积。文章正式定义了CTTA问题，分析了多样化领域偏移模式，提出了一个层次化分类法，将现有方法分为三类：基于优化（熵最小化、伪标签、参数恢复）、参数高效（归一化层调整、自适应参数选择）和基于架构（师生框架、适配器、视觉提示、掩码建模）。此外，文章提供了标准评估设置下的对比基准和实验结果，并讨论了当前局限和未来方向，包括基础模型和黑盒系统的适应。
Motivation: 深度神经网络在训练和测试数据同分布时表现优异，但实际部署中常遭遇连续分布偏移。CTTA旨在解决这一挑战，避免灾难性遗忘和伪标签误差累积。
Method: 提出一个层次化分类法，将CTTA方法分为三类：优化-based（熵最小化、伪标签、参数恢复）、参数高效（归一化层调整、自适应参数选择）和架构-based（师生框架、适配器、视觉提示、掩码建模），并系统综述了每类中的代表性方法。
Result: 在标准评估设置下提供了多种方法的对比基准和实验结果，但摘要未报告具体数值。
Conclusion: 当前方法仍有限制，未来方向包括基础模型和黑盒系统的适应，为后续研究提供了路线图。

papers.title: ProsMAE: Multi-Source MAE Pretraining for ISUP Grade Classification
papers.abstract_en: Whole slide images (WSIs) provide rich diagnostic information for computational pathology, but their gigapixel scale, stain variation, scanner differences, tissue artifacts, and limited expert annotation make robust model training challenging. This paper presents a multi-source Masked Autoencoder (MAE) framework, named ProsMAE, for histopathology representation learning. Tiles from Prostate cANcer graDe Assessment (PANDA), CAncer MEtastases in LYmph nOdes challeNge 2017 (CAMELYON17), and BReAst Carcinoma Subtyping (BRACS) are used for ProsMAE pretraining to expose the encoder to diverse tissue morphology and acquisition conditions. The learned encoder is transferred for International Society of Urological Pathology (ISUP) grade classification through ProsCLS, using a frozen encoder and a linear classification head. ProsMAE achieved a higher mean validation quadratic weighted kappa (QWK) than the vanilla MAE frozen linear-probe baseline under the evaluated disjoint PANDA split. Repeated-split evaluation remains necessary to further establish robustness across split compositions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ProsMAE，一种多源掩码自编码器（MAE）预训练框架，用于组织病理学表示学习。使用来自PANDA、CAMELYON17和BRACS数据集的图像块进行预训练，使编码器暴露于多样的组织形态和采集条件。然后将学习到的编码器迁移到ISUP分级任务（ProsCLS），使用冻结编码器和线性分类头。在PANDA数据集的特定划分上，ProsMAE的平均验证二次加权的Kappa（QWK）高于原始MAE的冻结线性探针基线。
Motivation: 全切片图像（WSI）的千兆像素尺度、染色变异、扫描仪差异、组织伪影和有限专家标注使得训练鲁棒模型具有挑战性。现有方法常受限于单一数据源，缺乏对多样组织形态和采集条件的泛化能力。
Method: 提出多源MAE预训练框架，从多个公开数据集（PANDA、CAMELYON17、BRACS）中提取图像块进行联合预训练。预训练后，冻结编码器并附加线性分类头，用于ISUP分级任务（称为ProsCLS）。
Result: 在PANDA数据集的特定划分上，ProsMAE的平均验证二次加权kappa（QWK）高于原始MAE的冻结线性探针基线。
Conclusion: 多源MAE预训练有助于提升下游分级任务的性能，但仍需重复划分评估以进一步确认鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SQuaD-SQL: Efficient Text-to-SQL with Small Language Models via LLM-Guided Knowledge Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-SQL is a fundamental task in natural language processing that enables users to interact with structured databases using natural language. While large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance on this task, their substantial computational requirements hinder deployment in resource-constrained settings. In this paper, we introduce SQuaD-SQL (Small-Qualified and Distilled for SQL), a novel approach that empowers small language models (SLMs) to approach the performance of LLMs on the Text-to-SQL task while significantly improving efficiency through knowledge distillation and synthetic data generation. Our method comprises three key components: (1) LLM-based synthetic data generation, where structured knowledge is extracted from LLMs via carefully designed prompting strategies; (2) parameter-efficient fine-tuning, enabling full model training on a single consumer-grade GPU; and (3) domain-adaptive fine-tuning, where domain-specific synthetic data further enhances performance in targeted domains. Experiments on the WikiSQL dataset demonstrate that SQuaD-SQL achieves an execution accuracy of 86.9% on the test set, approaching the performance of LLMs while offering faster inference and lower memory usage. These results suggest that, with proper training strategies, SLMs can serve as practical and efficient alternatives for Text-to-SQL applications in resource-limited environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SQuaD-SQL方法，通过知识蒸馏和合成数据生成，使小语言模型（SLM）在Text-to-SQL任务上接近大语言模型（LLM）的性能。在WikiSQL数据集上达到86.9%的执行准确率，同时推理更快、内存占用更低。
Motivation: LLM在Text-to-SQL任务上表现优异但计算开销大，难以部署在资源受限环境。需要一种高效且性能接近的方法。
Method: 包含三个组件：基于LLM的合成数据生成（通过精心设计的提示策略提取结构化知识）、参数高效微调（可在单张消费级GPU上训练）、领域自适应微调（用领域特定合成数据提升性能）。
Result: 在WikiSQL测试集上达到86.9%的执行准确率，接近LLM性能，且推理更快、内存占用更低。
Conclusion: 合适的训练策略可使SLM成为资源受限环境下Text-to-SQL应用的实用高效替代方案。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Unified Face Attack Detection via Fine-Grained Semantic Guidance
papers.abstract_en: The growing applications of facial recognition systems are accompanied by increasingly diverse security threats. Existing datasets lack detailed textual descriptions of forgery cues, leading most prior methods to treat face attack detection primarily as a visual recognition task. In this paper, building upon the large-scale MS-UFAD dataset which contains over 8 million attack images, we enrich each image with a fine-grained textual description of forgery cues. Furthermore, we propose a Dual Alignment Forgery Network(DAF-Net) to better leverage these textual information. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach extracts more generalizable and semantically meaningful forgery representations from attack images, outperforming both vision-only methods and approaches based on coarse-grained descriptions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对人脸攻击检测任务，在大型数据集MS-UFAD（包含超过800万攻击图像）上为每张图像补充细粒度的伪造线索文本描述，并提出双对齐伪造网络（DAF-Net）来融合视觉与文本信息。实验表明，该方法能够提取更泛化且语义更强的伪造表示，在性能上优于纯视觉方法及使用粗粒度描述的方法。
Motivation: 现有数据集缺少伪造线索的详细文本描述，导致大多数检测方法仅将其视为视觉识别任务，模型泛化性不足。
Method: 基于MS-UFAD数据集，为每张攻击图像标注细粒度文本描述；提出DAF-Net，通过双对齐机制融合视觉特征与文本特征来检测攻击。
Result: 在攻击检测任务上，该方法优于纯视觉方法和基于粗粒度描述的方法，能够提取更泛化且语义更强的伪造表示。
Conclusion: 细粒度语义引导可提升人脸攻击检测的泛化能力和语义表示质量，为多模态融合提供新思路。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LEXIC: Lightweight Eye-tracking eXtension via Injected Complexity
papers.abstract_en: On the recent EyeBench benchmark, predicting reading comprehension from eye movements exposes a stark gap: text-aware models using pretrained language models reach 56--63% AUROC, while gaze-only models operate at chance. We ask how far a gaze-only model can be pushed by lightweight, language-model-free conditioning. Building on the EyeBench AhnCNN baseline, LEXIC-Base, we propose two mechanisms to inject three precomputed word-level difficulty signals, GPT-2 surprisal, word frequency, and word length, into the per-fixation input: direct concatenation, LEXIC-Concat, and a residual mechanism, LEXIC-Res, where a small head predicts typical-reader gaze response and the encoder is conditioned on the deviation. On the OneStop reading comprehension task, with K=5 seed-ensemble training across ten folds, both mechanisms produce statistically consistent AUROC gains on Unseen Text, +1.8 to +2.2 percentage points, Wilcoxon p <= 0.065. LEXIC-Concat additionally lifts Unseen Reader by +2.9 percentage points, p = 0.010. We trace an architectural boundary in LEXIC-Res on Unseen Reader, +1.8 percentage points, p = 0.19, to the prediction head being calibrated to training readers, transferring imperfectly to out-of-distribution readers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何仅通过眼动数据（gaze-only）在无需预训练语言模型的情况下提升阅读理解预测性能。基于EyeBench的AhnCNN基线（LEXIC-Base），作者提出两种轻量机制：直接拼接（LEXIC-Concat）和残差机制（LEXIC-Res），将GPT-2 surprisal、词频、词长三个预计算的单词级难度信号注入到每次注视的输入中。在OneStop阅读理解任务上，两种机制在未见文本（Unseen Text）上均获得统计显著的AUROC提升（+1.8到+2.2个百分点），LEXIC-Concat还在未见读者（Unseen Reader）上提升+2.9个百分点。
Motivation: 现有眼动阅读理解预测中，文本感知模型（使用预训练语言模型）表现远优于纯眼动模型，但纯眼动模型仍处于随机水平。作者希望探索在不依赖语言模型的情况下，通过轻量级条件机制最大程度提升纯眼动模型的性能。
Method: 基于EyeBench AhnCNN基线（LEXIC-Base），提出两种注入机制：1) LEXIC-Concat：直接将三个难度信号（GPT-2 surprisal、词频、词长）拼接至每次注视的输入特征；2) LEXIC-Res：使用一个小型头网络预测典型读者的眼动响应，然后对编码器施加基于预测偏差的条件机制。使用K=5种子集成训练，十折交叉验证。
Result: 在OneStop阅读理解任务上，两种机制在Unseen Text上均取得统计一致的AUROC提升（+1.8到+2.2个百分点，Wilcoxon p≤0.065）。LEXIC-Concat在Unseen Reader上提升+2.9个百分点（p=0.010），而LEXIC-Res在Unseen Reader上提升+1.8个百分点但未达统计显著（p=0.19），归因于预测头对训练读者过拟合，迁移至分布外读者效果有限。
Conclusion: 论文表明，通过注入预计算的单词级难度信号，轻量级无语言模型方法可以显著提升纯眼动模型的阅读理解预测性能，但残差机制在未见读者上的泛化存在局限。该方法为眼动追踪的轻量化应用提供了新思路。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DeepPySR -- A Symbolic Regression Framework with Dynamic Pruning, Pareto Selection, and Hierarchical Composition for Real-World Scientific Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Symbolic regression (SR) discovers analytical equations from data, yielding glass-box models with directly interpretable formulas, unlike black-box methods that rely on unstable post-hoc tools such as SHAP or LIME. This transparency is crucial in clinical medicine and social science, but SR faces three challenges: high-dimensional inputs, principled selection of Pareto-front formulae, and data irregularities such as multicollinearity and class imbalance. We introduce DeepPySR, which addresses these issues with a dynamic variable-pruning schedule to remove irrelevant features during search, an exponential Pareto selection criterion that eliminates trade-offs between accuracy and complexity, and a multi-layer architecture for hierarchical symbolic composition. On four Feynman physics benchmarks and seven biomedical and social-science datasets, DeepPySR outperforms PySR and baselines on body fat (R$^2$: 0.794 vs.\ 0.702), heart disease (F1: 0.898 vs.\ 0.787), student performance (R$^2$: 0.964 vs.\ 0.948), and Raine BMI (R$^2$: 0.525 vs.\ 0.370), producing interpretable formulas aligned with domain risk factors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DeepPySR，一个符号回归框架，通过动态变量剪枝、指数Pareto选择和层次组合来解决高维输入、Pareto前沿选择和多重共线性等问题。在四个费曼物理基准和七个生物医学/社会科学数据集上，DeepPySR在多个指标上超过了基线，产生了可解释的公式。
Motivation: 现有符号回归方法在高维输入、Pareto前沿选择以及数据不规则性（如多重共线性和类别不平衡）方面面临挑战，限制了其在需要可解释模型的临床医学和社会科学中的应用。
Method: 提出了动态变量剪枝调度（在搜索过程中移除无关特征）、指数Pareto选择准则（消除精度与复杂度之间的权衡）以及用于层次符号组合的多层架构。
Result: 在体脂（R²: 0.794 vs. 0.702）、心脏病（F1: 0.898 vs. 0.787）、学生成绩（R²: 0.964 vs. 0.948）和Raine BMI（R²: 0.525 vs. 0.370）上，DeepPySR优于PySR等基线，并生成与领域风险因素一致的可解释公式。
Conclusion: 摘要强调DeepPySR通过动态剪枝、指数Pareto选择和层次组合，在多个现实世界数据集上实现了更好的可解释性和性能，适用于需要透明模型的领域。

papers.title: Prismata: Confining Cross-Site Prompt Injection in Web Agents
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous web agents promise to automate everyday browsing tasks, but inherit one of the web's oldest attack surfaces. Cross-Site Scripting proved that mixing trusted and untrusted content is dangerous, even on benign pages. Agents resurface this risk by interpreting natural language as instructions, allowing third-party and user-generated content to hijack the agent via prompt injection. The core challenge is that deriving a task-specific security policy requires reasoning over page structure that is entangled with the attacker's content. We present Prismata, a defense enforcing contextual least privilege for web agents, constraining both what the agent sees and what it can do. Prismata's dynamic trust derivation produces permission labels for page content, with structural confinement guarantees, inspired by classical integrity models, that bound any labeling errors so that labels can only decrease in privilege and mislabelings are bounded. Prismata's mechanical confinement enforces these labels by redacting content and restricting agent capabilities. Importantly, these mechanisms require no developer annotations, so Prismata supports the long tail of websites. Across recent published web agent attacks, including adaptive variants, Prismata substantially reduces attack success while preserving benign task utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Prismata，一种针对自主 Web 代理的跨站提示注入防御机制。它通过动态信任推导和机械约束，限制代理能看到的页面内容和可执行的操作，无需开发者标注即可适用于大量网站。实验表明，Prismata 能显著降低攻击成功率同时保持良性任务效用。
Motivation: 自主 Web 代理继承跨站脚本攻击的风险，第三方和用户生成内容可通过提示注入劫持代理。现有防御难以在页面结构与攻击者内容纠缠的情况下推导任务特定的安全策略。
Method: Prismata 采用动态信任推导为页面内容生成权限标签，并结合结构约束保证（受经典完整性模型启发）使得标签错误仅会降低权限且误标有界。机械约束通过内容删减和限制代理能力来执行这些标签。
Result: 在近期发表的 Web 代理攻击（包括自适应变体）上，Prismata 大幅降低攻击成功率，同时保持良性任务效用。
Conclusion: Prismata 提供了一种无需开发者标注的、基于上下文最小特权原则的防御方法，适用于长尾网站，在安全性和实用性之间取得平衡。

summary_sections.motivation: 自主 Web 代理继承跨站脚本攻击的风险，第三方和用户生成内容可通过提示注入劫持代理。现有防御难以在页面结构与攻击者内容纠缠的情况下推导任务特定的安全策略。
summary_sections.method: Prismata 采用动态信任推导为页面内容生成权限标签，并结合结构约束保证（受经典完整性模型启发）使得标签错误仅会降低权限且误标有界。机械约束通过内容删减和限制代理能力来执行这些标签。
summary_sections.result: 在近期发表的 Web 代理攻击（包括自适应变体）上，Prismata 大幅降低攻击成功率，同时保持良性任务效用。
summary_sections.conclusion: Prismata 提供了一种无需开发者标注的、基于上下文最小特权原则的防御方法，适用于长尾网站，在安全性和实用性之间取得平衡。

papers.title: Generalization Theory for Through-the-Wall Radar Human Activity Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Through-the-wall radar (TWR) human activity recognition (HAR) is important for non-line-of-sight indoor sensing, security monitoring, and emergency rescue. However, structured distribution shifts caused by person variation, observation-view variation, and wall-condition variation severely degrade recognition generalization, while the origin of the target-domain error still lacks a rigorous theoretical explanation. To address this issue, a generalization-analysis framework for TWR HAR is proposed in this paper. First, models for indoor human kinematics, TWR echo generation, radar image formation, feature representation, and bounded-weight neural networks are established within a unified source-to-target learning formulation. Then, the source risk, target risk, empirical risk, and admissible physical domain descriptor are defined, and a unified target-domain generalization bound is derived. Next, the structured shift term is decomposed into cross-person, cross-view, and cross-wall components, and the bound-tightening effects of physical low-dimensional representations, multi-source training, and parameter-space coverage are analyzed. Simulated and measured experiments jointly support the resulting theoretical analysis and illustrate its application value.

TL;DR: 本文针对穿墙雷达人体活动识别中结构化分布偏移（人员、观测视角、墙体条件变化）导致泛化性能下降的问题，建立了统一的源到目标学习框架，推导了目标域泛化界，并分析了物理低维表示、多源训练和参数空间覆盖对界的收紧效果。
Motivation: 穿墙雷达人体活动识别在非视距室内感知、安防监控和应急救援中至关重要，但人员、视角和墙体条件变化引起的结构化分布偏移严重降低识别泛化性，且目标域误差的成因缺乏严格理论解释。
Method: 建立了从人体运动学、雷达回波生成、图像形成、特征表示到有界权重神经网络的统一建模，定义了源风险、目标风险、经验风险和相关物理域描述符，推导了统一的目标域泛化界，并将结构化偏移项分解为跨人员、跨视角和跨墙体分量，分析了物理低维表示、多源训练和参数空间覆盖对界的收紧效果。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但称仿真与实测实验共同支持了理论分析并展示了应用价值。
Conclusion: 本文提出的泛化分析框架为穿墙雷达人体活动识别提供了理论依据，结构化的分布偏移分解和界收紧分析有助于指导实际系统设计。

papers.title: ICDAR 2026 HIPE-OCRepair Competition on LLM-Assisted OCR Post-Correction for Historical Documents
papers.abstract_en: We present the results of HIPE-OCRepair-2026, an ICDAR competition on LLM-assisted OCR post-correction of historical documents. OCR post-correction remains a long-standing challenge in digital heritage: large-scale collections of digitized documents are affected by legacy OCR errors, while re-digitization at scale remains impractical. Large language models (LLMs) offers a major opportunity to revisit this challenge, yet their effectiveness across languages, document types, and noise conditions - and their tendency to hallucinate - remains insufficiently understood. HIPE-OCRepair-2026 pursues two objectives: (i) to evaluate the capabilities of modern OCR post-correction systems, and (ii) to provide a reproducible evaluation framework anchored in the HIPE-OCRepair-2026 dataset, a harmonized multilingual resource consolidating existing and newly curated historical datasets. Participants were tasked with correcting noisy OCR transcripts from historical newspapers and printed works in English, French, and German (17th-20th century), working at the level of coherent transcription units (paragraphs or articles) without access to source images. The evaluation adopts a retrieval-oriented rather than diplomatic scoring approach, reflecting the practical use case of search and access over digitized collections. Four teams submitted systems ranging from zero-shot prompting to continued pre-training and fine-tuning, offering insights into the merits of different adaptation strategies. Results show that modern LLM-assisted systems can significantly improve OCR quality, but performance varies across datasets, languages, and noise levels. Over-correction on low-noise inputs emerges as a recurring challenge, highlighting the importance of evaluation beyond character error reduction. The dataset, scorer, and evaluation pipeline are publicly released to support future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了ICDAR 2026 HIPE-OCRepair竞赛的结果，该竞赛旨在评估LLM辅助的历史文档OCR后校正方法。竞赛使用多语言（英语、法语、德语）历史报纸和印刷品数据集，参赛系统包括零样本提示、继续预训练和微调等方法。结果表明，LLM辅助系统能显著提升OCR质量，但性能因数据集、语言和噪声水平而异，且对低噪声输入存在过度校正问题。数据集、评分器和评估流程已公开。
Motivation: 历史文档的OCR后校正仍是数字遗产领域的长期挑战：大规模数字化文档受遗留OCR错误影响，而重新数字化不切实际。大语言模型（LLM）提供了解决此问题的机会，但其在不同语言、文档类型和噪声条件下的效果及幻觉倾向尚不明确。
Method: HIPE-OCRepair-2026竞赛组织了一个多语言历史文档OCR后校正任务，参与者需在无源图像的情况下纠正噪声OCR转录（段落或文章级别）。评估采用检索导向而非外交式评分，反映数字化收藏中搜索和访问的实际用例。
Result: 四支参赛队伍提交了从零样本提示到继续预训练和微调的系统。结果表明，现代LLM辅助系统能显著提升OCR质量，但性能因数据集、语言和噪声水平而异。低噪声输入上的过度校正成为重复性挑战。
Conclusion: 竞赛强调了评估超出字符错误减少的重要性，并公开了数据集、评分器和评估流程以支持未来研究。

papers.title: Securing Autonomous Vehicle Systems via Twin-Aware Federated Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Federated reinforcement learning (FRL) is crucial for enabling collaborative learning across multiple agents without sharing raw data, thereby enhancing privacy and scalability in the decision-making process within dynamic vehicular environments. However, poisoning attacks pose a significant threat to the security and reliability of FRL-based systems, particularly in safety-critical autonomous driving, where this vulnerability remains largely unexplored. These attacks can compromise the global control model by subtly injecting malicious system parameters, leading to potential hazards. To counter these challenges, we present \alg (\underline{Sec}ure \underline{A}ggregation with \underline{p}oisoning-\underline{p}revention and historical reinforcement) as a defensive framework aimed at enhancing the robustness of FRL systems designed for safety-critical driving scenarios. \alg strategically integrates digital twins for rehearsal-based learning and leverages historical aggregated model parameters along with a selected central gradient to ensure that only benign data is aggregated, effectively mitigating the influence of malicious agents. Theoretical guarantees are provided for the convergence performance of \alg in the presence of poisoning attacks. We also validate the effectiveness of \alg using developed digital twins that model realistic highway environments to evaluate the control of autonomous vehicles under adversarial conditions.
papers.comment: Submitted to IEEE for potential publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对联邦强化学习（FRL）在自动驾驶中面临投毒攻击的威胁，提出防御框架SecAgg。该框架集成数字孪生进行排练学习，结合历史聚合参数和选定的中心梯度，确保仅聚合良性数据，从而抑制恶意代理影响。提供了理论收敛保证，并在模拟高速公路环境的数字孪生中验证了有效性。
Motivation: 联邦强化学习在自动驾驶中易受投毒攻击，攻击者通过注入恶意系统参数破坏全局模型，现有研究尚未充分探索该安全漏洞。
Method: 提出SecAgg防御框架，利用数字孪生进行排练学习，结合历史聚合模型参数和选定的中心梯度，设计聚合机制以过滤恶意更新。
Result: 提供了在投毒攻击下SecAgg的收敛性理论保证，并在模拟真实高速公路环境的数字孪生中验证了该框架的有效性。
Conclusion: 该框架增强了安全关键自动驾驶中FRL系统的鲁棒性，能够有效抵御投毒攻击。

papers.title: Answer Set Programming Energised! End-to-End Neurosymbolic Reasoning and Learning with ASP and Energy Based Models
papers.abstract_en: We present a general neurosymbolic reasoning and learning methodology based on a modular integration of answer set programming with an energy based model substrate. Key contributions are: (1) supporting joint optimisation in the continuous latent space through explicit ASP-based declarative semantics fully incorporating background knowledge, constraints, non-monotonic inference; and (2) advancing recent works at the interface of answer sets, probabilistic logic, and answer set modulo theories by providing a generalised model and practical platform for ASP-centric robust, end-to-end training for applications in dynamic domains (e.g., involving perception and interaction). We provide a practical implementation, and demonstrate basic use and application (with MNIST), and evaluate with the visual question-answering benchmark Clevr and the multi-object tracking benchmark MOT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于应答集编程(ASP)与能量模型(EBM)模块化集成的神经符号推理与学习方法，支持在连续潜空间中进行联合优化，并整合背景知识、约束和非单调推理。该框架提供了一个通用模型和实际平台，用于动态领域（如感知与交互）的鲁棒端到端训练，并在MNIST、Clevr视觉问答和MOT多目标跟踪基准上进行了演示与评估。
Motivation: 现有神经符号方法在动态领域中缺乏对背景知识、约束和非单调推理的显式声明语义支持，且难以实现端到端的联合优化。
Method: 将应答集编程(ASP)与能量模型(EBM)模块化集成，通过ASP的声明语义编码背景知识和约束，并利用能量模型的连续潜空间实现联合优化，支持非单调推理。
Result: 在MNIST上展示了基本应用，并在Clevr视觉问答和MOT多目标跟踪基准上进行了评估。
Conclusion: 该工作为ASP为中心的神经符号推理提供了一个通用模型和实际平台，适用于需要感知和交互的动态领域。

papers.title: Understanding and Mitigating the Video-Action Generalization Gap via Temporal Ratio
papers.abstract_en: Generative video foundation models exhibit strong compositional priors, yet world-action models (WAMs) and video-action models (VAMs) often lose these priors after finetuning on robotic action data. We refer to this discrepancy as the video-action generalization gap. In this paper, we systematically investigate this gap by evaluating a comprehensive design space of VAMs, demonstrating that standard design choices yield no emergent explanation pattern. To explain this behavior, we introduce the Temporal Ratio (TR), an attention-based measure of how strongly the action head relies on future latent rollouts relative to the anchored current frame. TR has two key properties: first, a model's structural reliance on future-predictive latents, measured via TR, acts as a predictor of its compositional generalization capacity; second, it natively fluctuates based on task phase, shifting attention to future frames during planning and reverting to the present frame for precise manipulation. Finally, based on these findings, we propose an inference-time adaptive guidance method, which exploits this intrinsic feature attention pattern to dynamically amplify compositional video conditioning signals precisely when the policy relies on future rollouts. Evaluated on the LIBERO benchmark and real-world tasks, our approach mitigates the OOD-ID compositional generalization gap. More details: https://umishra.me/temporal-ratio/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了视频-动作泛化差距（video-action generalization gap），即生成式视频基础模型在微调于机器人动作数据后丢失组合先验的问题。作者提出时间比率（Temporal Ratio, TR）作为注意力指标，衡量动作头对未来潜在展开的依赖程度，并发现TR可预测模型的组合泛化能力，且根据任务阶段动态变化。基于此，提出一种推理时自适应引导方法，在LIBERO基准和真实世界任务上缩小了分布内与分布外组合泛化差距。
Motivation: 生成式视频模型在微调于机器人动作数据后，其强大的组合先验会丢失，导致视频-动作泛化差距，现有标准设计无法解释这一现象。
Method: 引入时间比率（TR）作为注意力指标，量化动作头对未来潜在展开的依赖；提出推理时自适应引导方法，利用TR动态增强组合视频条件信号。
Result: 在LIBERO基准和真实世界任务上，所提方法缩小了分布内与分布外的组合泛化差距。
Conclusion: TR可预测模型的组合泛化能力，且基于TR的引导方法能有效缓解视频-动作泛化差距。

papers.title: TTHE: Test-Time Harness Evolution
papers.abstract_en: The behavior of an LLM agent is determined not only by the underlying model, but also by its harness: the executable program that constructs context, invokes tools, verifies intermediate results, and recovers from failures. Existing approaches optimize such harnesses before deployment, searching training or development data for a fixed agent workflow that is then frozen at test time. This limits adaptation when the test distribution, failure modes, or tool interactions differ from those seen during development. We ask whether the harness can instead be optimized during evaluation itself, using only the unlabeled execution traces the agent produces on the test inputs. We introduce Test-Time Harness Evolution (TTHE), which treats the executable harness as the state of test-time adaptation. During evaluation, TTHE maintains a population of candidate harnesses and refines them through an agentic proposer that reasons over their execution traces, without gold labels or task-specific supervision; a judge then commits an improved harness from execution-derived proxy signals, and the selected program persists to govern subsequent inputs. Crucially, TTHE does not update model weights, require gold labels, or train a separate adaptation model: solver, proposers, and judge are different roles and harnesses around the same frozen LLM, so all adaptation occurs through changes to the surrounding program. Across text-to-SQL, competitive programming, software engineering, data-science coding, and agentic tool-use tasks, TTHE improves fixed ReAct-style baseline harnesses, yielding persistent, inspectable improvements rather than a pre-searched workflow or per-query retries. These results recast test-time adaptation for LLM agents as evolution over executable control programs and identify execution-derived proxy reliability as a central challenge for robust unsupervised agent improvement.

papers.title: Joint estimation of high-dimensional spiked covariance matrices via a partially shared subspace
papers.abstract_en: Statistical analysis of high-dimensional data is often hampered by limited sample sizes, yet auxiliary datasets from related sources are often readily available. When two such datasets share part of their covariance structure, but not all of it, exploiting the shared part can substantially improve estimation. We propose a spiked covariance model that explicitly captures this partial sharing: two datasets share a subspace of unknown rank and arbitrary position in the spectrum, while each retains its own distinct spiked directions. The model treats the two datasets symmetrically and strictly generalizes existing models for shared covariance structure. We develop a complete estimation procedure that includes joint estimation of the shared subspace and its rank, a closed-form pooling weight for combining the two datasets, and asymptotic guarantees derived from random matrix theory in the proportional-growth regime. The framework also resolves a gap in contrastive dimension reduction by providing a principled estimator for high-dimensional settings. We illustrate the methodology on portfolio construction during the early COVID-19 pandemic and on contrastive analysis of brain tumor gene expression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种部分共享子空间的高维尖峰协方差模型，用于联合估计两个相关数据集的协方差结构。模型对称处理两个数据集，允许它们共享一个秩未知的任意位置子空间，同时保留各自独特的尖峰方向。基于随机矩阵理论在比例增长机制下给出了渐近保证，并推广了现有共享协方差模型。该方法在COVID-19早期投资组合构建和脑肿瘤基因表达对比分析中展示了应用。
Motivation: 高维数据分析常受限于样本量小，但辅助数据集易得。当两个数据集协方差结构部分共享时，利用共享部分可显著改进估计。现有模型未充分处理此类部分共享情形。
Method: 提出一个部分共享子空间的尖峰协方差模型，包括共享子空间及其秩的联合估计、两数据集合并的闭式池化权重，以及基于随机矩阵理论的渐近保证。
Result: 理论结果包括在比例增长机制下的渐近一致性。应用案例展示了早期COVID-19投资组合构建和脑肿瘤基因表达对比分析的实用性。
Conclusion: 该框架填补了高维对比降维中原理性估计器的空白，并对称处理两数据集，严格推广了现有共享协方差结构模型。

papers.title: Workload-Preserving Differentially Private Synthetic Data for Causal Inference via Maximum-Entropy Calibration
papers.abstract_en: Workload-based differentially private (DP) synthetic data methods privately measure aggregate queries and post-process the noisy answers into synthetic records. Generic workloads can achieve strong distributional fidelity, but causal estimands such as the average treatment effect (ATE) depend on treatment-arm balance and outcome moments that generic marginals need not preserve. We propose causal workloads: DP query sets designed around the orthogonal moments used by doubly robust causal estimators. The released workload can be used directly by stable moment-map estimators or reconstructed by maximum-entropy calibration into reusable synthetic data; our theory decomposes ATE error into sampling, privacy, workload-approximation, Monte Carlo, and calibration terms. We also introduce Causal-AIM, an adaptive workload selector, and a noise-aware multiple-imputation (NA+MI) procedure for confidence intervals from DP synthetic data. Because the workload is released once, the same DP synthetic table can support ATE, ATT, and subgroup analyses without additional privacy spending. Empirically, causal workloads are most useful at strict privacy budgets and for calibrated uncertainty, while generic workloads often retain an advantage for point RMSE as privacy relaxes. The broader lesson is a tradeoff: distributional fidelity can help point accuracy, but valid causal inference requires preserving causal moments and propagating DP noise rather than treating synthetic rows as real.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出一种工作负载保持的差分隐私合成数据方法，专门用于因果推断。该方法通过设计因果工作负载（针对双重稳健因果估计器所需的正交矩的DP查询集）和最大熵校准来生成合成数据，并引入自适应工作负载选择器Causal-AIM以及噪声感知多重插补（NA+MI）用于置信区间估计。实验表明，因果工作负载在严格隐私预算下对校准不确定性有用，但通用工作负载在隐私放宽时在点RMSE上仍有优势。
Motivation: 现有差分隐私合成数据方法注重分布忠实性，但可能丢失因果估计所需的关键矩（如处理组平衡和结果矩），导致因果推断偏差。
Method: 提出因果工作负载（causal workloads），即围绕双重稳健因果估计器使用的正交矩设计的DP查询集；结合自适应工作负载选择器Causal-AIM和噪声感知多重插补（NA+MI）进行置信区间估计。
Result: 因果工作负载在严格隐私预算和校准不确定性上最有用，而通用工作负载在隐私放宽时在点RMSE上仍有优势。
Conclusion: 分布忠实性有助于点精度，但有效的因果推断需要保留因果矩并传播DP噪声，而非将合成行视为真实数据。

papers.title: VSRo-200: A Romanian Visual Speech Recognition Dataset for Studying Supervision and Multimodal Robustness
papers.abstract_en: We introduce VSRo-200, the first large-scale dataset for visual speech recognition (lip reading) in Romanian, comprising 200 hours of real-world podcast videos. All samples are annotated with pseudo-labels generated by a fine-tuned Romanian ASR model, while a subset of 100 hours is additionally transcribed by humans, enabling controlled analysis of supervision quality under a unified framework. Building on this dataset, we establish a benchmark for visual speech recognition in low-resource settings. We systematically study the impact of supervision quality, showing that while human annotations provide better performance at fixed data scales, pseudo-labels enable continued improvements through scalability. We further evaluate robustness under domain shift using curated out-of-distribution (OOD) test sets, and analyze audio-visual speech recognition (AVSR) under noisy conditions, where multimodal fusion significantly improves robustness compared to audio-only models. Finally, we demonstrate that representations learned on VSRo-200 transfer effectively to the LRRo benchmark for isolated word recognition, substantially outperforming previously reported results. Overall, VSRo-200 provides a new testbed for studying supervision, domain generalization, and multimodal fusion in low-resource visual speech recognition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 VSRo-200，首个大规模罗马尼亚语视觉语音识别（唇读）数据集，包含 200 小时真实播客视频。数据使用伪标签和人工标注，支持监督质量、域迁移和音视频融合鲁棒性的系统研究。实验表明，伪标签通过可扩展性持续提升性能，多模态融合显著提升噪声鲁棒性，且 VSRo-200 预训练表示在 LRRo 基准上大幅超越此前结果。
Motivation: 视觉语音识别领域缺乏低资源语言的规模化数据集，且对监督质量、域迁移和多模态鲁棒性的系统性研究不足。
Method: 构建 200 小时罗马尼亚语播客视频数据集，100 小时有人工标注，100 小时使用微调 ASR 模型生成伪标签。在此基础上建立基准，并设计 OOD 测试集和噪声条件研究。
Result: 人工标注在固定数据量下性能更优，但伪标签通过扩展规模持续提升效果；多模态融合在噪声下相比纯音频模型显著提升鲁棒性；VSRo-200 预训练特征在 LRRo 孤立词识别任务上大幅超越此前方法。
Conclusion: VSRo-200 为低资源视觉语音识别中监督、域泛化和多模态融合研究提供了新平台。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PS4: Proxy-Supervised Joint Training for Real Target Speaker Extraction
papers.abstract_en: Training target speaker extraction (TSE) models for real conversational mixtures remains challenging because large-scale training corpora and clean target speech for supervision are unavailable. We present PS4, a proxy-supervised training framework for TSE in real conversational mixtures, with two main contributions. First, we construct a large-scale corpus of 71,771 training samples derived from four public datasets, covering both Chinese and English scenarios. Each sample contains an overlapping speech mixture, per-speaker enrollment audio, a ground-truth transcript, and frame-level voice activity labels. Second, we propose a proxy-supervised joint training strategy that fine-tunes a BSRNN-based TSE model using four complementary differentiable objectives: ASR cross-entropy, speaker similarity, frame-level voice activity detection, and perceptual audio quality. Starting from a publicly available pre-trained checkpoint, only the BSRNN separator is updated during fine-tuning. On the REAL-T challenge leaderboard, PS4 ranks 2nd overall, achieving the best speaker similarity and timing F1 among all submitted systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对真实对话混合中目标说话人提取（TSE）训练数据匮乏的问题，提出PS4代理监督训练框架。构建了包含71,771个样本的大规模语料库（覆盖中英文），并提出联合训练策略，使用ASR交叉熵、说话人相似度、帧级VAD和感知音频质量四个可微分目标微调BSRNN-based TSE模型。在REAL-T挑战中排名第二，并获得最佳说话人相似度和时序F1。
Motivation: 训练真实对话混合的目标说话人提取模型缺乏大规模训练语料和干净的监督目标语音，现有方法难以泛化到真实场景。
Method: 构建71,771个训练样本的语料库；提出代理监督联合训练策略，利用ASR交叉熵、说话人相似度、帧级VAD和感知音频质量四个可微分目标微调BSRNN分离器（仅更新BSRNN参数，从公开预训练检查点开始）。
Result: 在REAL-T挑战排行榜上总体排名第二，并获得最佳说话人相似度和时序F1。
Conclusion: PS4代理监督框架能有效利用多种弱监督信号训练真实场景下的目标说话人提取模型。

papers.title: Contrastive Order Learning: A General Framework for Ordinal Regression
papers.abstract_en: We propose contrastive order learning (ConOrd), a contrastive learning framework for ordinal regression that integrates the strengths of contrastive learning and order learning. While contrastive learning effectively leverages all samples in a batch, it typically ignores the inherent ordering among rank labels. Conversely, order learning explicitly models label ordinality but often relies on local, margin-based comparisons, limiting its ability to capture global ordinal structure. ConOrd addresses these limitations by introducing a contrastive order loss with soft affinity and disparity weights based on rank differences, enabling fine-grained modeling of ordinal relationships across all sample pairs within a batch. Extensive experiments on a range of ordinal regression tasks, including facial age estimation, blind image quality assessment, and blind video quality assessment, demonstrate that ConOrd consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance and generalizes well across diverse ordinal regression scenarios. The source code is available at https://github.com/cwlee00/ConOrd.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出对比顺序学习（ConOrd），一种结合对比学习和顺序学习的有序回归框架。通过引入基于秩差异的软亲和度与差异权重，ConOrd 能够捕获批次内所有样本对之间的顺序关系。在人脸年龄估计、盲图像质量评估和盲视频质量评估等任务上取得了最优性能。
Motivation: 对比学习通常忽略标签的顺序性，而顺序学习依赖局部边际比较，难以建模全局顺序结构。ConOrd 旨在同时利用对比学习的全样本优势和顺序学习的有序性。
Method: 提出对比顺序损失（contrastive order loss），根据秩差异定义软亲和度与差异权重，对所有样本对进行细粒度的顺序关系建模，集成到对比学习框架中。
Result: 在人脸年龄估计、盲图像质量评估和盲视频质量评估等有序回归任务上，ConOrd 一致达到最优性能，具有良好的泛化性。
Conclusion: ConOrd 是一种通用的有序回归框架，有效融合对比学习和顺序学习的优势，适用于多种有序回归场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BACH: A Bayesian Admixture of Contrastive Heads for Multi-Interest Two-Tower Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Two-tower retrievers compress each user into a single embedding, limiting their ability to serve diverse interests. Multi-interest models give each user several heads scored by a maximum inner product, but their hard-routing training under-utilizes heads (routing collapse) and gives no per-user estimate of how much each interest matters for serving. We present \textbf{BACH} (\emph{Bayesian Admixture of Contrastive Heads}), which casts multi-interest two-tower retrieval as a per-user mixture over the heads, fit by variational inference. The soft mixture trains every head (mitigating collapse), produces a per-user weighting of the interests that is reused at serving, and admits a shared global-codebook variant with precomputable retrieval. On three large-scale benchmarks, MovieLens-20M, Taobao, and Netflix, BACH improves top-of-ranking retrieval over hard-routing multi-interest and single-vector baselines at every head count; we further find that scoring every candidate by its best head, consistent with serving, outperforms the usual target-routed training, and that BACH improves further still.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出BACH（贝叶斯对比头混合模型），将多兴趣双塔检索建模为用户兴趣的软混合，通过变分推断训练。该方法避免硬路由引起的头利用率崩溃（routing collapse），并为每个用户生成可复用的兴趣权重。在MovieLens-20M、Taobao和Netflix三个大规模基准上，BACH在不同头数下均优于硬路由多兴趣和单嵌入基线，且使用最优头评分（与推理一致）进一步改进。
Motivation: 传统双塔检索将用户压缩为单一嵌入，无法覆盖多兴趣。现有多兴趣模型使用硬路由训练导致部分兴趣头闲置（routing collapse），且无法为每个用户提供各兴趣的重要性估计，限制了检索效果。
Method: BACH将多兴趣检索建模为每个用户对兴趣头的贝叶斯混合（Bayesian admixture），通过变分推断（variational inference）拟合软混合权重。软混合训练使每个头均被优化，缓解头崩溃；权重在推理时可直接复用。此外，支持共享全局码本变体，可预计算检索。
Result: 在MovieLens-20M、Taobao和Netflix三个基准上，BACH在所有头数下均提升top-of-ranking检索效果。进一步发现，对每个候选使用其最优头评分（与推理一致）优于常规目标路由训练，且BACH在此设置下表现更佳。
Conclusion: BACH通过软混合训练有效缓解了多兴趣模型中的路由崩溃问题，并为每个用户提供可解释的兴趣权重，可直接用于服务阶段。该方法在多个大规模推荐基准上取得一致提升。

papers.title: Vanilla SGD with Momentum Survives Heavy-Tailed Noise: Convergence Analysis without Gradient Clipping or Normalization
papers.abstract_en: Stochastic gradient descent (SGD) is a cornerstone of modern optimization. While its performance under heavy-tailed noise is often addressed through specialized modifications such as gradient clipping or normalization, we investigate a more fundamental question: how does vanilla SGD, particularly with momentum, perform in the presence of heavy-tailed noise? In this paper, we refine existing convergence results for vanilla SGD and, more importantly, provide the first comprehensive convergence analysis of vanilla SGD with momentum for strongly convex, convex, and nonconvex objectives, without employing any gradient control mechanisms. Our results demonstrate that the obtained convergence rates are inferior to the optimal rates achieved by clipped or normalized variants of SGD, thereby revealing inherent limitations of vanilla methods under heavy-tailed noise. The theoretical findings are supported by experiments on synthetic functions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了普通SGD（含动量）在重尾噪声下的收敛性，给出了强凸、凸和非凸目标下的首次全面收敛分析，证明了其收敛速率劣于裁剪或归一化变体，揭示内在局限性，并在合成函数上验证。
Motivation: 重尾噪声下通常需要梯度裁剪或归一化，本文探究未加控制的普通SGD（含动量）是否仍能收敛，从而揭示其固有限制。
Method: 对普通SGD（含动量）进行收敛性分析，针对强凸、凸和非凸目标，不采用任何梯度控制机制。
Result: 获得的收敛速率劣于裁剪/归一化SGD的最优速率，表明普通方法在重尾噪声下的内在局限性。
Conclusion: 普通SGD（含动量）在重尾噪声下收敛性有限，需借助梯度控制机制才能达到最优性能。

papers.title: Stochastic Order Learning: An Approach to Rank Estimation Using Noisy Data
papers.abstract_en: Rank estimation under label noise poses a fundamental challenge, as ordinal annotations often exhibit structured uncertainty rather than simple label corruption. In this paper, we reformulate rank estimation with noisy ordinal labels as a stochastic ordering problem, in which each instance is inherently associated with multiple plausible ranks instead of a single deterministic label. Based on this view, we propose stochastic order learning (SOL), a learning framework that captures ordinal label uncertainty and learns an embedding space through two complementary objectives: a discriminative loss that structures instance--centroid interactions and a stochastic order loss that enforces probabilistic ordering relations between instances. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets demonstrate that SOL enables reliable rank estimation under various types and levels of label noise. The source code is available at https://github.com/cwlee00/SOL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对标签噪声下的排序估计问题，提出随机顺序学习（SOL）框架，将每个实例与多个可能等级相关联，通过判别损失和随机顺序损失学习嵌入空间。实验表明该方法在各种噪声类型和程度下均能可靠估计排序。
Motivation: 现有排序估计方法难以处理标签噪声中存在的结构化不确定性，即实例可能对应多个合理等级而非单一确定标签。
Method: 提出随机顺序学习（SOL），包括两个互补目标：判别损失用于实例-质心交互，随机顺序损失用于施加概率性顺序关系。
Result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，SOL在不同类型和程度的标签噪声下均能实现可靠的排序估计。
Conclusion: SOL通过将排序估计重新定义为随机顺序问题，有效捕捉标签不确定性，提供开源代码供复现。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: EVIS: A Physics-Grounded Event Camera Plugin for NVIDIA Isaac Sim
papers.abstract_en: Event cameras offer microsecond temporal resolution, low latency, and high dynamic range, making them attractive for robotics. However, labeled event-camera data for a specific robot and scene is scarce and expensive to collect, which slows the development of event-based perception and control. We present EVIS: a physics-grounded event camera plugin for NVIDIA Isaac Sim that generates high-rate, fully labeled event streams directly inside a physics simulator. The plugin implements a faithful log-intensity contrast event model with per-pixel asynchronous reference updates; it migrates from a normal RGB camera with few changes and integrates into any Isaac Sim / Isaac Lab scene, inheriting the simulator's physics and frame-perfect ground truth. It is fully configurable, and offers an interpolation option that renders only sparse keyframes and synthesizes the in-between frames through bidirectional motion-vector warping, making real-time generation on a single GPU possible. Optional sensor noise and motion blur further narrow the gap to real cameras. The generated streams are directly usable by pretrained event networks for downstream tasks. Code repository: https://github.com/spikelab-jhu/isaac-sim-event-camera-plugin
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EVIS，一个基于物理的事件相机插件，集成于NVIDIA Isaac Sim中，可在物理仿真环境中生成高帧率、全标注的事件流。插件实现了符合对数强度对比的事件模型，支持每像素异步参考更新，并提供插值选项以加速生成，同时可添加传感器噪声和运动模糊以逼近真实相机。生成的事件流可直接用于预训练的事件网络。
Motivation: 为特定机器人和场景标注的事件相机数据稀缺且昂贵，阻碍了基于事件的感知与控制发展。
Method: 在Isaac Sim中实现忠实于对数强度对比的事件模型，采用每像素异步参考更新；通过双向运动向量扭曲对稀疏关键帧进行插值，实现单GPU实时生成；可选传感器噪声和运动模糊。
Result: 摘要未提供定量实验结果，但声称插件可生成高帧率、全标注事件流，并直接用于预训练事件网络。
Conclusion: EVIS提供了一种在仿真中生成事件数据的方法，旨在缩小仿真与真实相机之间的差距。

papers.title: CausalDS: Benchmarking Causal Reasoning in Data-Science Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly act as integrated data-science agents, combining abstract reasoning with advanced tool use. Yet the relevant benchmark landscape largely divides into symbolic causal reasoning benchmarks without realistic data analysis or data analysis benchmarks without a principled causal data-generating structure. Furthermore, existing causal evaluation datasets are often restricted to curated examples from existing sources, with diversity coming from limited templatized variations rather than from systematic generation of novel synthetic causal structures. We introduce CausalDS, a benchmark for evaluating causal reasoning in agentic data-science workflows. Each benchmark instance is a scene consisting of a sampled structural causal model (SCM) with generated observational data and an accompanying synthetic natural-language story grounded in a realistic domain. We optionally ground the composition of the benchmark components in empirical distributions obtained from real-world datasets, thus retaining empirical structure while reducing the "causal parrot" risk through completely synthetic generation. From each scene, we then derive tasks spanning all three of Pearl's rungs, with typical data-science prediction tasks appearing as Rung 1. Most tasks include a data science coding component, where the model typically needs to use several tools to arrive at the final answer due to the frequent presence of imperfect observations, which are generated by an observation model. Additionally, recognizing when a question admits no warranted answer and abstaining is treated as a first-class scored outcome. The benchmark thus jointly evaluates symbolic causal reasoning, data science, uncertainty quantification, abstention, and tool use/coding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CausalDS 基准，用于评估大型语言模型在数据科学代理中的因果推理能力。每个实例包含一个采样的结构因果模型（SCM）生成的观测数据和合成自然语言故事，任务覆盖 Pearl 的三个阶梯，包括数据科学编码、不确定性量化、放弃回答等。基准通过完全合成生成减少“因果鹦鹉”风险，同时保留实证结构。
Motivation: 现有因果推理基准缺乏真实数据分析场景，而数据分析基准缺乏因果结构；同时现有数据集多依赖有限模板变化，缺乏系统合成生成。
Method: 基于采样的结构因果模型（SCM）生成每个场景，包括观测数据和自然语言故事；可选地根据真实数据分布校准组件。从每个场景导出覆盖 Pearl 三个阶梯的任务，多数需要数据科学编程和工具使用，并引入观测模型生成不完美观测。
Result: 提出了一个综合性基准，但摘要未报告具体实验数值结果。
Conclusion: CausalDS 联合评估符号因果推理、数据科学、不确定性量化、放弃回答和工具使用/编程，强调因果推理在数据科学代理中的重要性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Equivariant Quantum Clustering with Differential Privacy: Parameter-Efficient Privacy-Preserving Analysis Across Heterogeneous Sensitive Datasets
papers.abstract_en: Privacy-preserving clustering is critical for analyzing sensitive data in healthcare, cybersecurity, and enterprise applications, where maintaining data confidentiality must be balanced with analytical performance. This paper presents Equivariant Quantum Clustering (EQC), a parameter-efficient framework that integrates symmetry-aware quantum circuits with differential privacy to improve the privacy-utility tradeoff. EQC employs p4m equivariant parameter sharing to reduce circuit complexity while preserving informative feature representations. The framework is evaluated on three privacy-sensitive datasets: NSL-KDD, CERT Insider Threat v6.2, and a synthetic MIMIC-III clinical dataset. On the NSL-KDD benchmark, EQC achieves 79.3% clustering accuracy while reducing membership inference attack success to 38.3% under a privacy budget of ε = 1.0 and δ = 10^-5, outperforming representative classical and quantum baselines. Ablation studies indicate that the performance gains primarily arise from parameter-efficient circuit design combined with differential privacy. The results demonstrate that EQC provides a practical quantum-ready framework for secure and privacy-preserving clustering across heterogeneous sensitive datasets.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 10+ tables, multiple figures, research article. Introduces Equivariant Quantum Clustering (EQC) integrating differential privacy with parameter-efficient quantum circuits for privacy-preserving clustering. Evaluated on NSL-KDD, CERT Insider Threat v6.2, and Synthetic MIMIC-III datasets

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出等变量子聚类（EQC）框架，将对称感知量子电路与差分隐私结合，实现参数高效的隐私保护聚类分析。在NSL-KDD、CERT内部威胁v6.2和合成MIMIC-III数据集上评估，EQC在隐私预算ε=1.0、δ=10^-5下达到79.3%聚类准确率，且成员推断攻击成功率降至38.3%，优于经典和量子基线。消融研究表明性能提升主要来自参数高效电路设计与差分隐私的结合。
Motivation: 在医疗、网络安全和企业应用中，对敏感数据进行聚类分析时需要在数据保密性和分析性能之间取得平衡，现有方法往往难以同时满足隐私保护和聚类效果。
Method: 提出EQC框架，采用p4m等变参数共享降低量子电路复杂度，同时保留信息丰富的特征表示，并集成差分隐私机制以改善隐私-效用权衡。
Result: 在NSL-KDD上聚类准确率79.3%，成员推断攻击成功率38.3%（ε=1.0, δ=10^-5），优于代表性经典和量子基线。
Conclusion: EQC为异构敏感数据集上的安全隐私保护聚类提供了一种实用的量子就绪框架，其性能提升主要来自参数高效电路设计与差分隐私的结合。
