papers.title: Deep Learning Method for Stationary Distribution of Reflected Brownian Motion
papers.abstract_en: The stationary distribution of reflected Brownian motion (RBM) plays an important role in the analysis of high-dimensional stochastic systems, yet closed-form solutions are known only for a few special cases. Computing important performance metrics, such as tail probabilities, is even more intractable, despite their practical relevance. In this paper, we develop a deep learning approach that accurately and efficiently learns the Laplace transform of high-dimensional RBMs based on the basic adjoint relationship (BAR). Our framework combines a careful design of the loss function, training data sampling procedure, and neural network architecture. We evaluate the proposed method on RBM instances with known ground-truth tail probabilities and demonstrate near-perfect prediction in high-dimensional settings, highlighting its potential as a general tool for analyzing stochastic systems beyond analytically tractable regimes. Our code can be found at https://github.com/zhangz73/NN4MGF.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种深度学习方法，基于基本伴随关系（BAR）学习高维反射布朗运动（RBM）的拉普拉斯变换，从而计算平稳分布和尾概率。在已知真实值的RBM实例上取得近乎完美的预测，展示了作为不可解析处理随机系统通用工具的潜力。
Motivation: 反射布朗运动的平稳分布对高维随机系统分析重要，但封闭解仅少数特例已知，尾概率计算更难，因此需要高效准确的方法。
Method: 设计神经网络框架，结合精心设计的损失函数、训练数据采样程序和网络架构，基于基本伴随关系学习高维RBM的拉普拉斯变换。
Result: 在有真实尾概率的RBM实例上，该方法在高维设置中实现近乎完美的预测。
Conclusion: 该方法有潜力作为分析解析不可处理随机系统的通用工具，代码已开源。

papers.title: GRE-Diff: Gaussian Room Embeddings for Structured Layout Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Designing functional and aesthetically coherent floor plans requires exploring a vast space of possible room arrangements, a task that quickly becomes overwhelming for human designers. In this paper, we propose GRE-Diff, a controllable and interactive diffusion-based framework that automates the creation and editing of apartment floor plans under user-specified constraints. By combining AI-generated suggestions with real-time, human-in-the-loop editing, the system enables users to specify room types, room counts, boundary shapes, and editing operations through LLM-parsed instructions or GUI-based interaction. It then generates a diverse set of plausible and well-structured designs for refinement. At the core of our approach is Gaussian Room Embedding (GRE), a continuous latent representation that models each room as a spatial Gaussian distribution capturing its location and extent. Extensive experiments on the RPLAN dataset show that GRE-Diff produces high-quality, constraint-aware, and editable polygonal layouts, offering a practical step toward bridging AI-driven automation and human creativity in spatial design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GRE-Diff，一种基于扩散模型的交互式公寓平面图生成与编辑框架。核心是高斯房间嵌入（Gaussian Room Embedding, GRE），将每个房间建模为空间高斯分布以表示其位置和范围。在 RPLAN 数据集上的实验表明，该方法能生成高质量、符合约束且可编辑的多边形布局。
Motivation: 设计功能性和美观的公寓平面图需要探索巨大的房间布局空间，人工设计费时费力。现有方法缺乏可控性和交互性，难以结合用户约束。
Method: 提出 GRE-Diff 框架，结合扩散模型与用户交互（LLM 解析指令或 GUI）。核心是高斯房间嵌入（GRE），将每个房间表示为二维高斯分布，通过扩散过程生成布局，并支持实时编辑。
Result: 在 RPLAN 数据集上，GRE-Diff 生成高质量、约束感知、可编辑的多边形布局，证明其有效性和实用性。
Conclusion: GRE-Diff 将 AI 自动化与人类创造力结合，为空间设计提供可控且交互的布局生成工具。

papers.title: Mixture of Enhanced-View Experts for Multi-Query Vehicle ReID and A Large-Scale Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Multi-query vehicle ReID aims to leverage complementary information from diverse views for robust feature learning. However, current methods suffer from simplistic feature fusion and thus easily ignores some important view information and cross-view relationships. To handle these problems, this work presents a novel approach called Mixture of Enhanced-View Experts (EV-MoE), which enhances the feature representation of each view and efficiently integrate the view-specific enhanced features by MoE, for robust multi-query ReID. In particular, we design a mixture of enhanced-view experts module, which consists of two parts including view-specific feature enhancement sub-Module (VFEM) and dynamic multi-view fusion sub-Module (DMFM). Moreover, we further introduce Multi-view Alignment Loss (MAL), which aligns features through bidirectional crossview contrastive learning and reconstruction constraints, addressing the challenges of consistency between multi-query features and single-image features. In addition, to evaluate multi-query ReID in real-world environments, we collect LCRI-1K, a largescale vehicle ReID dataset with 1,090 identities, 107,805 images, across 23,637 cameras, where each vehicle appears in an average of 67.5 cameras, providing a comprehensive benchmark to test the robustness in complex environments. Extensive experiments demonstrate the robustness of CAFNet in addressing the multiquery vehicle ReID problem. The code is available at https: //github.com/xiaozhen28/CAFNet.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多查询车辆再识别（Multi-query Vehicle ReID）中特征融合简单、忽略跨视图关系的问题，提出了一种增强视图专家混合模型（EV-MoE），包含视图特定特征增强子模块和动态多视图融合子模块，并引入多视图对齐损失（MAL）用于一致性学习。同时，作者收集了大规模数据集LCRI-1K（1090身份，107805图像，23637相机），用于评估多查询车辆再识别。实验表明方法鲁棒。
Motivation: 现有方法在多查询车辆再识别中采用简单特征融合，容易忽略重要视图信息和跨视图关系，导致性能受限。
Method: 提出增强视图专家混合模型（EV-MoE），包括视图特定特征增强子模块（VFEM）和动态多视图融合子模块（DMFM），以及多视图对齐损失（MAL），通过双向跨视图对比学习和重构约束对齐特征。
Result: 在大规模数据集LCRI-1K上实验，验证了方法（CAFNet）在处理多查询车辆再识别问题中的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 本文的方法和数据集为多查询车辆再识别提供了更强的特征表示和融合策略，代码已开源。

papers.title: ConRad: Efficient Conformal Prediction for Radiomics
papers.abstract_en: Radiomic features derived from medical images and segmentation masks are used to support decision making in clinical imaging pipelines. In practice, these features are often computed from predicted masks, but segmentation models can be overconfident or poorly calibrated, making derived measurements appear more reliable than they are. Conformal prediction (CP) provides distribution-free prediction intervals with finite-sample marginal coverage guarantees, but black-box intervals for segmentation-derived radiomics can be inefficient because they ignore test-time information about image appearance, mask geometry, and segmentation uncertainty. We propose ConRad, a conformal framework for scalar radiomic targets that uses covariates derived from the predicted mask, input image, predicted radiomics, and boundary uncertainty to construct adaptive intervals while maintaining coverage. Across five 2D medical imaging datasets and 171 retained radiomic targets, we show that ConRad improves feature-level efficiency compared to baselines while maintaining near-nominal empirical coverage. Ablation results further indicate that segmentation boundary uncertainty features are the largest contributors to interval efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ConRad，一种针对放射组学标量目标的保形预测框架，利用预测掩膜、输入图像、预测放射组学及边界不确定性等协变量构建自适应区间，在保持覆盖的同时提高特征级效率。在五个2D医学影像数据集和171个放射组学目标上，ConRad相比基线在保持近名义覆盖的同时提升了区间效率。消融实验表明，分割边界不确定性特征对区间效率贡献最大。
Motivation: 放射组学特征常基于预测掩膜计算，但分割模型可能过度自信或校准不良，导致推导测量看似比实际更可靠。现有保形预测为分割衍生放射组学提供无分布预测区间，但因忽略测试时信息（如图像外观、掩膜几何和分割不确定性）而效率低下。
Method: ConRad是一个保形框架，利用从预测掩膜、输入图像、预测放射组学和边界不确定性导出的协变量，构建自适应预测区间，同时保证边际覆盖。
Result: 在五个2D医学影像数据集和171个放射组学目标上，ConRad相比基线在保持近名义经验覆盖的同时，提高了特征级效率。消融结果进一步表明，分割边界不确定性特征是区间效率的最大贡献者。
Conclusion: ConRad通过利用测试时信息改进放射组学保形预测的效率，其中边界不确定性特征最为关键。

papers.title: PARA-PV: Physics-Aware Retrieval-Augmented PV Prediction Based on Frozen Foundation Model and Distribution Shift Correction
papers.abstract_en: Accurate photovoltaic (PV) power forecasting is essential for reliable grid dispatch and renewable energy integration, yet it remains challenging because PV generation is jointly shaped by weather variability, day-night transitions, regime-dependent dynamics, and strict physical constraints. We propose PARA-PV, a Physics-Aware Retrieval-Augmented framework that embeds physical knowledge throughout the forecasting process. The framework first encodes multivariate PV observations into patch-level representations and, through a physics-aware retrieval-augmented learner, retrieves historical patches and analog trajectories that are consistent with the current window in temporal shape, power level, PV operating state, and intra-day period; this yields a physically grounded base forecast. To supplement local memory with broader temporal knowledge, the base forecast is then calibrated against a frozen Chronos time-series foundation-model prior through a lightweight residual adapter, so that general temporal regularities are adapted to PV-specific dynamics without overriding the physically grounded prediction. Because residual conditional distribution shifts persist when weather and diurnal regimes change, a physics-aware distribution shift correction module subsequently adjusts the preliminary forecast using power, weather, timestamp, and day/night conditions, applying gated mean-shift and scale corrections selectively. Finally, a physics-constrained loss function partitions the samples into peak, ramping, night-time, and regular regimes and adaptively reweights their error contributions, preventing the dominant regular regime from suppressing learning of operationally critical states. Our code is available at https://github.com/weican1103/PARA-PV.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PARA-PV，一种物理感知的检索增强光伏功率预测框架。该框架通过物理感知检索增强学习器检索与当前窗口在时间形状、功率水平、光伏运行状态和日内时段一致的历史补丁和模拟轨迹，生成物理基预测；然后通过轻量残差适配器将冻结的Chronos时间序列基础模型先验校准到基预测上；再通过物理感知分布偏移校正模块，利用功率、天气、时间戳和昼夜条件进行门控均值和尺度校正；最后使用物理约束损失函数对峰值、爬坡、夜间和常规模式样本自适应重加权。代码已开源。
Motivation: 光伏功率预测受天气变化、昼夜交替、状态依赖动态和严格物理约束共同影响，现有方法难以充分融入物理知识，精度不足。
Method: 提出物理感知检索增强预测（PARA-PV）框架，包括：1）物理感知检索增强学习器，检索历史一致补丁和轨迹；2）基于冻结Chronos时间序列基础模型的残差适配器校准；3）物理感知分布偏移校正模块（门控均值和尺度校正）；4）物理约束损失函数，对峰值、爬坡、夜间、常规模式样本自适应重加权。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但表明框架通过融入物理知识提升了预测精度。
Conclusion: PARA-PV通过嵌入式物理知识、检索增强和分布偏移校正，有效提升了光伏功率预测性能，尤其对操作关键状态（如峰值、爬坡）具有更好的适应性。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Modular Pretraining Enables Access Control
papers.abstract_en: AI developers face a dual-use dilemma. An AI capability that helps one user cure a disease can help another synthesize one. This dilemma could be resolved with access control, limiting dual-use AI capabilities to trusted deployments with a legitimate need. A gold standard for access control would be to serve separate models with different capabilities to different users. However, training and deploying multiple models is prohibitively expensive. To address this challenge, we propose gradient-routed auxiliary modules (GRAM), a pre-training method that adds modules to a neural network and selectively updates them to induce specialization. Ablating a module at inference time removes its capability from the network, approximating a model trained on filtered data. We evaluate GRAM on synthetic stories and realistic dual-use data spanning virology, cybersecurity, nuclear physics, and specialized code. These experiments show that GRAM disables targeted capabilities while preserving the rest, and resists their recovery under finetuning better than post-hoc unlearning. Most importantly, a Chinchilla-optimal scaling analysis from 50M to 5B parameters shows that the gap between data-filtered and full-data models widens with scale on removed capabilities but stays small on retained ones, and that GRAM closely tracks data filtering. GRAM's training cost is independent of the number of supported capability profiles, yielding a 5x reduction over data filtering in our 5-profile setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出梯度路由辅助模块（GRAM），一种在预训练阶段向神经网络添加模块并选择性更新以诱导能力专业化的方法。在推理时消融模块可移除对应能力，近似于在过滤数据上训练的模型。实验覆盖病毒学、网络安全、核物理和专业代码等双用途领域，显示GRAM能禁用目标能力并抵抗微调恢复，缩放分析表明其效果接近数据过滤，且训练成本独立于能力配置数量，在5配置下成本降低5倍。
Motivation: AI的双重用途困境使得同一能力既能用于有益用途也能被滥用于有害用途，需要访问控制。但为不同用户训练和部署多个独立模型成本过高，亟需低成本且可精细调控能力的方法。
Method: GRAM在预训练时向网络添加旁路模块，仅更新这些模块的参数使其学习特定能力；推理时通过移除模块来消融对应能力，无需重新训练整个模型。
Result: 在合成故事和真实双用途数据上，GRAM成功移除目标能力且保留其他能力，抵抗微调恢复的能力优于事后遗忘（unlearning）。Chinchilla最优缩放分析表明，在移除能力上GRAM与数据过滤的差距随规模扩大而增大，但在保留能力上差距很小；5能力配置下训练成本比数据过滤降低5倍。
Conclusion: GRAM作为一种模块化预训练方法，实现了接近数据过滤的能力控制效果，同时避免了多模型训练的高昂成本，为AI安全部署提供了实用的访问控制方案。

papers.title: LDFE: Laplacian Decoupled Feature Enhancement Block for Dual-Stream CNN-based RGB-IR Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: The complementary information between RGB and IR images can significantly enhance object detection performance under extreme conditions. Existing methods prefer dual-stream CNN backbones built upon YOLO for feature extraction and focus on the design of feature fusion. In this paper, we introduce the Laplacian Decoupled Feature Enhancement block (LDFE) to fuse features from different stages of the dual-stream CNN backbone. By design, LDFE simultaneously considers the characteristics of modalities and structures for feature fusion by employing global-local decomposition, denoising, fusion, and reconstruction, sequentially. The LDFE first separates features into global and local components based on Laplacian Pyramid, and then performs denoising and fusion based on Global State Space Enhancement module (GS2E) and Local Convolutional Correlation Enhancement module (LC2E) separately. Specifically, the GS2E conducts a two-branch architecture for the main and auxiliary modalities. It dynamically suppresses noise in the main modality through cross-modal attention derived from the auxiliary modality, while employing a State Space Model to capture long-range dependencies within the global feature representations of the main modality. To obtain bidirectional interaction, the two modalities systematically alternate their main/auxiliary roles. Moreover, the LC2E suppresses noise in local features and leverages spatial and channel dimension along with triple convolution to extract fine-grained details for fusion. These innovative designs achieve a significant performance improvement, with mAP surpassing the SOTA methods 6.2%, 3.7%, 4.7%, 2.3%, 4.1% and 2.0% on M3FD, DroneVehicle, LLVIP, FLIR-Aligned, KAIST and VEDAI datasets,respectively.

TL;DR: 本文针对RGB-IR双流CNN目标检测任务，提出拉普拉斯解耦特征增强模块（LDFE）。该模块通过拉普拉斯金字塔将特征分解为全局和局部成分，分别使用全局状态空间增强模块（GS2E）和局部卷积相关增强模块（LC2E）进行去噪与融合，实现主/辅助模态的动态角色交替和双向交互。在M3FD、DroneVehicle等六个基准数据集上，mAP超过现有SOTA方法2.0%至6.2%。
Motivation: RGB和IR图像互补信息能提升极端条件下的目标检测性能，但现有双流CNN方法侧重于融合设计，缺乏对模态特性和结构特性的联合考虑。
Method: 提出LDFE块，基于拉普拉斯金字塔分解为全局和局部成分；GS2E采用双分支架构，通过辅助模态生成的跨模态注意力动态抑制主模态噪声，并利用状态空间模型捕获全局长程依赖；LC2E抑制局部噪声并利用空间、通道维度及三重卷积提取细粒度细节。两个模块分别处理后重建融合特征。
Result: 在M3FD、DroneVehicle、LLVIP、FLIR-Aligned、KAIST和VEDAI数据集上，mAP分别超越SOTA方法6.2%、3.7%、4.7%、2.3%、4.1%和2.0%。
Conclusion: LDFE通过模态解耦与增强，显著提升了RGB-IR目标检测在多数据集上的精度。

papers.title: UAV-OVVIS: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles Also Need Open-Vocabulary Video Instance Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) videos are widely used in traffic monitoring, urban management, and emergency rescue. However, existing UAV video perception mainly relies on box-level localization and trajectory association under predefined categories, making it difficult to simultaneously support flexible queries and fine-grained instance-level dynamic understanding in open scenarios. To this end, we introduce a new task, UAV Open-Vocabulary Video Instance Segmentation (UAV-OVVIS), which discovers targets in UAV videos according to open-vocabulary queries and outputs instance-level segmentation trajectories with globally consistent identities. Considering the scarcity of instance-level annotations in UAV scenarios, we propose AeroTrack, a training-free unified framework. AeroTrack centers on periodic open-vocabulary detection, short-segment mask propagation, and cross-segment identity unification, reusing existing visual foundation models to enable UAV-OVVIS. Based on this framework, we instantiate five AeroTrack variants and construct AeroVIS, an evaluation benchmark for UAV-OVVIS containing 9 UAV object categories and 8,279 trajectories. Experiments show that AeroTrack substantially outperforms existing general video instance segmentation methods in UAV scenarios and demonstrates strong open-vocabulary robustness and generalization. To support future research, we release AeroTrack and AeroVIS as a unified framework and benchmark for UAV-OVVIS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出无人机开放词汇视频实例分割（UAV-OVVIS）新任务，并推出免训练的统一框架AeroTrack，利用现有视觉基础模型实现开放词汇查询下的实例分割轨迹输出。同时构建了包含9类无人机目标和8279条轨迹的评估基准AeroVIS。实验表明AeroTrack在无人机场景下显著优于现有通用视频实例分割方法，并展现出强大的开放词汇鲁棒性和泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有无人机视频感知主要依赖预定义类别的框级定位与轨迹关联，难以同时支持开放场景中的灵活查询和细粒度实例级动态理解。
Method: 提出AeroTrack，一种免训练的统一框架，核心包括周期性开放词汇检测、短片段掩码传播和跨片段身份统一，复用现有视觉基础模型实现UAV-OVVIS。基于该框架实例化五种变体，并构建评估基准AeroVIS。
Result: 实验表明AeroTrack在无人机场景下大幅优于现有通用视频实例分割方法，并展现出强开放词汇鲁棒性和泛化能力。
Conclusion: 本文强调了无人机视频需要开放词汇视频实例分割任务，并提供了AeroTrack作为免训练框架和AeroVIS作为评估基准，以支持未来研究。

papers.title: Cross-Modal Generative Framework for Signal Translation from Fetal-Maternal Electrocardiograms to Fetal Doppler Waveforms
papers.abstract_en: Fetal electrocardiogram (fECG) and Doppler ultrasound provide complementary views of fetal cardiovascular function: fECG captures electrical activity while Doppler reflects mechanical hemodynamics shaped by factors such as placental resistance and vascular compliance. Understanding the recoverable and unrecoverable Doppler components through reconstruction from fECG offers insight into the relative contributions of electrical versus mechanical factors in fetal circulation, thereby informing clinical decisions. In addition, clinical evidence of maternal-fetal cardiac coupling suggests that maternal cardiovascular dynamics may also inform fetal hemodynamics. To computationally model these relationships, we propose a cross-modal generative framework combining dilated convolutions with cross-modal attention to selectively incorporate maternal ECG and self-attention to capture long-range temporal dependencies. Trained on 885 synchronized fetal/maternal ECG and Doppler envelope segments from 39 pregnancies, our model synthesizes Doppler envelopes with power spectral density mean squared error (PSD MSE) of 49.9 +/- 15.8 dB^2 (51% lower than two-channel baseline) and heart-rate error of 4.71 +/- 0.77 bpm (1.5% better than baseline; negligible relative to the 110-160 bpm physiological range). Cross-modal attention yields a 39% PSD MSE reduction over naive dual-channel concatenation, quantifying the contribution of maternal-fetal coupling. Our proposed framework advances computational modeling of the maternal-fetal cardiovascular system by enabling the synthesis of Doppler envelopes from dual-lead ECG. By analysis of both recoverable and residual Doppler components, this approach enables quantification of the purely mechanical contributions to Doppler waveforms -- those not recoverable from electrical recordings -- ultimately facilitating a more comprehensive fetal assessment.
papers.comment: Accepted for oral presentation at IEEE EMBC 2026. 7 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个跨模态生成框架，通过结合扩张卷积（dilated convolutions）和跨模态注意力（cross-modal attention），从胎母心电图（fECG和mECG）合成胎儿多普勒包络（Doppler envelope）。模型在39例妊娠的885个同步信号段上训练，合成的Doppler包络在功率谱密度均方误差（PSD MSE）上达到49.9 ± 15.8 dB²，比双通道基线低51%；心率误差为4.71 ± 0.77 bpm，比基线改善1.5%。跨模态注意力相比简单双通道拼接使PSD MSE降低39%，量化了母胎耦合的贡献。该框架通过分析可恢复和残余的Doppler成分，量化了Doppler波形中纯机械成分（无法从电信号恢复的部分）的贡献。
Motivation: 胎儿心电图和Doppler超声分别提供胎儿心血管功能的电活动和机械血流动力学信息，但两者互补关系的计算模型尚不完善。理解从fECG可恢复和不可恢复的Doppler成分有助于区分电生理和机械因素对胎儿循环的影响，从而指导临床决策。
Method: 提出一种跨模态生成框架，使用扩张卷积和跨模态注意力选择性融合母体心电图（mECG），并采用自注意力捕获长期时间依赖。模型以同步的fECG和mECG为输入，输出合成的胎儿Doppler包络。
Result: 在39例妊娠的885个同步片段上，模型合成Doppler包络的PSD MSE为49.9 ± 15.8 dB²，比双通道基线低51%；心率误差4.71 ± 0.77 bpm，比基线改善1.5%。跨模态注意力相比简单双通道拼接使PSD MSE降低39%，表明母胎耦合对合成质量有显著贡献。
Conclusion: 该跨模态生成框架能够从双导联心电图合成胎儿Doppler包络，通过分析可恢复和残余成分量化纯机械贡献，为更全面的胎儿评估提供工具。

papers.title: Post-Training in End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end models that map multimodal inputs directly to future trajectories/maneuvers have emerged as an increasingly prominent research paradigm in autonomous driving. This class of models includes both Vision-Language-Action models and trajectory-generative planners. Unlike classic machine learning applications, autonomous vehicles operate in safety-critical and interaction-intensive environments where traditional open-loop imitation of expert demonstrations is not sufficient to ensure reliability. In particular, small execution errors can accumulate over time, while recovery behaviors are scarce in training data. In addition, long-horizon objectives such as safety and driving comfort are not captured by pointwise labels either. These limitations have motivated a shift toward post-training techniques, which further refine driving policies beyond pure imitation. This survey presents a unified view of post-training for autonomous driving by defining its scope and organizing the existing literature into four major families based on the form of supervision they use. For each family, we discuss its capabilities, limitations, and open challenges. We aim to facilitate a systematic understanding of this emerging area and stimulate future research on reliable and efficient post-training for autonomous driving.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于端到端自动驾驶后训练技术的综述。传统开环模仿学习存在误差累积和恢复行为稀缺等问题，后训练技术通过进一步优化驾驶策略来弥补这些不足。作者将现有文献按监督形式分为四大类，并讨论了每类的能力、局限和挑战。
Motivation: 端到端自动驾驶中，开环模仿专家演示不足以确保安全可靠性，因为小执行误差会随时间累积，且训练数据中缺乏恢复行为，长程目标如安全性和驾驶舒适度也无法通过点式标签捕获。
Method: 定义了后训练在自动驾驶中的范围，并将现有文献按使用的监督形式分为四大类（如强化学习、对抗训练、排序学习等），逐一综述。
Result: 作为综述，本文没有提出新方法或具体实验结果，但系统总结了各后训练家族的适用场景与开放挑战。
Conclusion: 旨在促进对自动驾驶后训练的系统理解，并激励未来在可靠性和效率方面的研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: COBART: Controlled, Optimized, Bidirectional and Auto-Regressive Transformer for Ad Headline Generation
papers.abstract_en: Online ads are essential to all businesses and ad headlines are one of their core creative component. Existing methods can generate headlines automatically and also optimize their click-through-rate (CTR) and quality. However, evolving ad formats and changing creative requirements make it difficult to generate optimized & customized headlines. We propose a novel method that uses prefix control tokens along with BART fine-tuning. It yields the highest CTR and also allows users to control the length of generated headlines for use across different ad formats. The method is also flexible and can easily be adapted to other architectures, creative requirements and optimization criteria. Our experiments demonstrate a 25.82% increment in Rouge-L and a 5.82% increment in estimated CTR over previously published strong ad headline generation baseline.

papers.title: Persuasion Attacks Can Decrease Effectiveness of CoT Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring is a promising safety mechanism for AI agents, based on the premise that visible reasoning traces can surface misaligned or deceptive behavior. While effective in standard scenarios, recent work highlights that LLMs remain vulnerable to persuasion-based jailbreaks, where natural-language arguments override model constraints. We stress-test whether this vulnerability extends to monitoring LLMs: can an adversarial agent persuade its CoT monitor to approve proposed actions that violate the monitor's policy? We design an evaluation framework with 40 tasks and analyze thousands of agent-monitor interactions, where agents are instructed to argue for policy-violating proposals. We find that in such adversarial settings, monitor access to the agent's CoT reasoning increases rather than decreases approval of harmful actions on average by 9.5%, as the scratchpad provides an additional persuasion channel. To address this, we introduce a fact-checking monitoring framework. We find that a fact-checker and monitor pairing from different model families, for example a Claude 3.7 Sonnet monitor paired with a GPT-4.1 fact-checker, reduces approval of policy-violating actions by up to 45%, compared to only 6%, when using the same model for both fact-checking and monitoring roles. Our results demonstrate that CoT monitoring alone may be insufficient against adversarial persuasion, and that model-diverse fact-checking provides a robust mitigation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究说服攻击（persuasion attacks）对思维链（CoT）监控机制的影响。实验表明，在对抗性设置中，监控器访问智能体的CoT推理反而使有害行为的批准率平均提高9.5%，因为思考记录提供了额外的说服渠道。为此，作者提出一种事实核查监控框架，使用不同模型族（如Claude 3.7 Sonnet监控器与GPT-4.1事实核查器配对）可将违规行为批准率降低多达45%，而相同模型配对仅降低6%。
Motivation: CoT监控被认为能通过可见推理过程暴露不当行为，但大型语言模型（LLM）易受基于自然语言的说服越狱攻击。本文旨在测试这种漏洞是否扩展到监控LLM：对抗性智能体能否说服CoT监控器批准违反策略的行动。
Method: 设计了包含40个任务的评估框架，并分析了数千次智能体-监控器交互。在对抗性场景中，智能体被指示为违规提案辩护。随后提出事实核查监控框架，采用不同模型族分别担任监控器和事实核查器。
Result: 在对抗性设置中，CoT监控使有害行为批准率平均增加9.5%。使用不同模型族（Claude 3.7 Sonnet监控器+GPT-4.1事实核查者）可将批准率降低45%，而相同模型配对仅降低6%。
Conclusion: 仅靠CoT监控可能不足以抵御对抗性说服，模型多样化的核查机制能提供更稳健的缓解方案。

papers.title: When LLMs Agree, Are They Right? Auditing Self-Consistency and Cross-Model Agreement as Confidence Signals
papers.abstract_en: LLM-as-judge (Zheng et al., 2023) is increasingly the default for evaluating AI systems in enterprise pipelines, often scaled to ensembles (Verga et al., 2024) or "mixture-of-experts" (Shazeer et al., 2017) panels of judges. These systems share a key assumption: that consistency -- agreement among judges, or among a model's own samples -- indicates correctness. We show this assumption is unreliable. Agreement is not accuracy: a model can agree with itself, and different models can agree with each other, out of shared bias, a memorized heuristic, or an option-position prior rather than truth. We ask when agreement is nonetheless a usable proxy, in a large-scale cross-runner study: 53 runners drew K=50 samples for assigned overlapping cases across comparisons of model tier, prompting, and scale on GPQA Diamond and AIME -- 265,000 samples. Using majority-correctness as the deployment label and a hierarchical runner-clustered bootstrap, agreement is a positive but weak predictor (rho 0.20-0.59, all positive under item-clustered resampling) whose usefulness is regime-dependent: best for unsaturated mid-tier models and for allocating compute, and worst -- over-confident yet no more accurate -- for the most consistent frontier model (agreement >=0.8 on 77% of GPQA case-result entries, 48% of those wrong). An exploratory cross-family check on three Claude tiers shows the same frontier over-confidence, with confident errors recurring across providers above a marginal-preserving null. Self-consistency is thus a conditional proxy for correctness, not a standalone confidence score. We publicly release the de-identified per-run rows and answer distributions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统审计了LLM作为裁判时的一致性（包括自一致性和跨模型一致性）是否能作为正确性的可靠指标。通过大规模跨运行研究（53个运行者，K=50个样本，总计265,000个样本），发现一致性与正确性正相关但相关性弱（rho 0.20-0.59），且其有效性取决于情境：对中等模型和计算分配有用，但对最一致的前沿模型（在GPQA Diamond上77%条目一致性≥0.8，其中48%错误）则过度自信且不准确。结论是自一致性只能作为正确性的条件代理，而非独立的置信度分数。
Motivation: 当前企业管线中广泛使用LLM作为裁判，并通过集成或多专家面板扩展，但默认假设一致性（裁判间或模型自身样本间的一致）表示正确性。该假设的可靠性尚未被充分检验。
Method: 进行大规模跨运行研究：53个运行者对GPQA Diamond和AIME上重叠案例抽取K=50个样本，比较模型层级、提示和规模。采用多数正确作为部署标签，并使用分层运行者聚类自助法评估预测能力。
Result: 一致性与正确性正相关但弱（rho 0.20-0.59），其有效性依赖情境：对未饱和的中等模型和计算分配最有价值，而对最一致的前沿模型（在77% GPQA条目中一致性≥0.8，其中48%错误）则过度自信。
Conclusion: 自一致性和跨模型一致性不是正确性的可靠代理，只能作为条件性指标使用。研究公开了去标识化的逐运行数据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Holographic Neural PCFG for Unsupervised Parsing
papers.abstract_en: Unsupervised constituency parsing aims to accurately induce latent tree structures from raw text alone. Recent neural parameterizations of PCFGs achieve strong performance in both supervised and unsupervised parsing, yet rely on high-capacity black-box networks for rule scoring -- as exemplified by the Neural PCFG family -- leaving rule probabilities without an interpretable mathematical form. In this paper, we propose Holographic Neural PCFG (Hol-PCFG), which recasts PCFG rule scoring as algebraic relation modeling among grammar-symbol embeddings. Hol-PCFG adapts Holographic Embeddings (Nickel et al., 2016), which scores knowledge-graph triples via circular correlation, to the left-child, right-child, and lexical-emission relations over torus-constrained embeddings, giving every rule probability a closed form that carries the intrinsic structure of grammar rules by construction. Hol-PCFG achieves state-of-the-art parsing performance in six languages while cutting rule-scoring parameters by 99.94% relative to the baseline model and training more stably. Additionally, we demonstrate that Hol-PCFG can parse Japanese directly from characters without any morphological segmentation, retaining nearly the same morpheme-level performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出全息神经PCFG（Hol-PCFG），将PCFG规则评分重新表述为语法符号嵌入之间的代数关系建模。利用全息嵌入（Holographic Embeddings）通过循环相关评分知识图谱三元组，将其应用于左子、右子和词汇发射关系，在环形约束嵌入上给出每个规则概率的闭式解，从而保留语法规则的内在结构。在六种语言上达到最先进的无监督成分句法分析性能，同时规则评分参数减少99.94%，训练更稳定。另外，可直接从字符级解析日语而无需形态分割。
Motivation: 现有神经PCFG使用高容量黑盒网络进行规则评分，规则概率缺乏可解释的数学形式。本文旨在提供一种具有闭式解且保留语法结构的方法。
Method: 提出Hol-PCFG，采用全息嵌入（circular correlation）对语法符号嵌入进行关系建模，取代传统神经网络评分。所有规则概率具有闭式形式。
Result: 在六种语言上取得最先进的无监督成分句法分析性能，规则评分参数减少99.94%，训练更稳定。可直接从字符解析日语，保留近似的词素级性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调全息嵌入为无监督句法分析提供了一种参数高效且可解释的方法，并展示了在无需形态分割情况下进行字符级解析的潜力。

papers.title: When Thinking Hurts: Epistemic Signals in the Reasoning Chains of Visual Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Uncertainty quantification for visual language models (VLMs) conventionally targets the answer token distribution. We provide the first three-family empirical characterisation of answer entropy behaviour in thinking-mode VLMs. Running four models on identical POPE adversarial samples, we find three qualitatively distinct patterns: Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking shows complete collapse (ans H AUROC = 0.492); GLM-4.1V-9B-Thinking shows no collapse (0.716); and InternVL3-8B shows selective thinking (chains on only 50% of samples, ans H = 0.675 full / 0.602 thinking-only). Across all three thinking-mode models, thinking chain entropy outperforms answer entropy on the subset where chains are generated (0.647, 0.759, 0.608 vs. 0.492, 0.716, 0.602 respectively), suggesting chain signals are the more reliable predictor whenever chains are present. This holds strongly for Qwen and GLM, but with only marginal and statistically unreliable advantage for InternVL3 (n_FP = 17). A 300-sample VQAv2 pilot confirms chain entropy (0.680) outperforms answer entropy (0.595) on VQAv2 questions, with the gap largest for free-form answers (0.733 vs. 0.467). On harder reasoning tasks (HallusionBench) both Qwen models show moderate signal (approx. 0.64), consistent with incomplete pre-commitment on difficult questions. We additionally document structured abstention affecting 12-22% of queries with asymmetry toward absent-object queries, and a practical abstention gate raising accuracy from 71.0% to 93.8% at 62.7% coverage with no additional inference cost.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Oral paper at the 2nd Workshop on Epistemic Intelligence in Machine Learning (EIML@ICML 2026), Seoul, South Korea
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次对思考模式视觉语言模型（VLM）的答案熵行为进行了三族实证刻画。在POPE对抗样本上运行四个模型，发现三种定性模式：Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking完全崩溃（ans H AUROC=0.492）；GLM-4.1V-9B-Thinking无崩溃（0.716）；InternVL3-8B选择性思考（仅50%样本有链，ans H=0.675/0.602）。在所有思考模型中，思考链熵在生成链的样本子集上优于答案熵（分别为0.647,0.759,0.608 vs 0.492,0.716,0.602），表明链信号更可靠。在VQAv2和HallusionBench上进一步验证。此外，记录了结构化弃权影响12-22%的查询，一个弃权门将准确率从71.0%提升至93.8%，覆盖62.7%且无额外推理成本。
Motivation: 传统VLM的不确定性量化仅关注答案标记分布，忽略了思考链中的认知信号。本文旨在刻画思考模式VLM中答案熵的不同行为，并探索思考链熵作为更可靠的不确定性指标。
Method: 对四个VLM（Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking, GLM-4.1V-9B-Thinking, InternVL3-8B等）在POPE对抗样本、VQAv2和HallusionBench上比较答案熵与思考链熵的AUROC，并分析行为模式。
Result: 发现三种定性模式：完全崩溃、无崩溃、选择性思考。思考链熵在链出现时优于答案熵。结构化弃权影响12-22%查询，弃权门提升准确率从71.0%到93.8%覆盖62.7%。
Conclusion: 思考链熵是更可靠的不确定性信号，弃权机制可有效提升准确性。但InternVL3的优势微弱且统计上不可靠，需要进一步研究。

papers.title: Towards Efficient Large Language Model Serving: A Survey on System-Aware KV Cache Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Despite the rapid advancements of large language models (LLMs), LLM serving systems remain memory-intensive and costly. The key-value (KV) cache, which stores KV tensors during autoregressive decoding, is crucial for enabling low-latency, high-throughput LLM inference serving. In this survey, we focus on system-aware KV infrastructure for serving LLMs (abbreviated as sKis). We revisit recent work from a system behavior perspective, organizing existing efforts into three dimensions: execution and scheduling (temporal), placement and migration (spatial), and representation and retention (structural). Furthermore, we analyze cross-behavior co-design affinity and behavior-objective links, highlighting future opportunities. Our work systematizes a rapidly evolving area, providing a foundation for understanding and innovating KV cache designs in modern LLM serving infrastructure.
papers.comment: Accepted to ACL 2026 as a Findings paper
papers.journal_ref: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2026 (pp. 38450-38476)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统综述了面向大语言模型（LLM）服务的高效KV缓存优化技术，从系统行为视角出发，将现有工作组织为执行与调度（时间维度）、放置与迁移（空间维度）以及表示与保留（结构维度）三个维度，并分析了跨行为协同设计与行为-目标关联，为现代LLM服务基础设施中的KV缓存设计提供了系统化的理解基础。
Motivation: LLM服务系统存在内存密集和成本高昂的问题，特别是自回归解码过程中的KV缓存是影响延迟和吞吐量的关键因素，但缺乏从系统行为角度对KV缓存优化的系统性综述。
Method: 采用系统行为视角，将KV缓存优化工作归类为三个维度：执行与调度（时间）、放置与迁移（空间）、表示与保留（结构），并分析跨维度协同设计以及行为与优化目标的关联。
Result: 系统化了快速发展的KV缓存优化领域，总结了各维度的主要技术手段，并指出了未来研究方向。
Conclusion: 该综述为理解和创新LLM服务中的KV缓存设计提供了系统性基础，有助于推动更高效的LLM服务基础设施。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reinforcing the Generation Order of Multimodal Masked Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) have recently achieved substantial progress in natural language generation tasks. Recent research demonstrates that adaptive token generation ordering can significantly improve performance in mathematical reasoning and code synthesis applications. In this work, we investigate the optimization of generation order for both text-to-image synthesis and multimodal understanding. We first establish that, unlike structured problems in language generation such as Sudoku puzzles, model logits alone are insufficient for determining optimal generation sequences in text-to-image generation and multimodal understanding. To address this challenge, we introduce a learnable control module trained via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to determine the generation order. Our results demonstrate that learning this control block substantially improves both text-to-image alignment and multimodal understanding in DLMs. In particular, it enhances the model's ability to capture fine-grained spatial relationships in generated images while also strengthening performance on multimodal reasoning and comprehension tasks. We evaluate our framework on GenEval, an object-focused benchmark for text-to-image alignment, where it achieves 4.08% relative improvements. In addition, experiments on VLMEvalKit confirm 4.85% relative improvements in multimodal understanding, highlighting the broad effectiveness of our approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多模态掩码扩散模型的生成顺序优化，发现对于文本到图像生成和多模态理解任务，仅靠模型logits不足以确定最优生成顺序。因此提出一个可学习的控制模块，通过组相对策略优化（GRPO）训练来动态决定生成顺序。实验表明，该方法在GenEval基准上提升了4.08%的文本-图像对齐性能，在VLMEvalKit上提升了4.85%的多模态理解性能。
Motivation: 现有扩散语言模型在数学推理和代码合成中受益于自适应生成顺序，但该方法在文本到图像生成和多模态理解中的有效性尚不清楚，且模型logits不足以指导最优顺序。
Method: 引入一个可学习的控制模块，通过组相对策略优化（GRPO）训练来决定扩散模型的生成顺序。该模块可以自适应地调整每个时间步的掩码位置。
Result: 在GenEval基准上实现4.08%的相对改进，在VLMEvalKit上实现4.85%的相对改进，表明方法在文本-图像对齐和多模态理解任务上的有效性。
Conclusion: 学习生成顺序能够显著增强多模态扩散模型在细粒度空间关系捕捉和多模态推理方面的能力，但当前评估局限于特定基准，泛化性有待进一步验证。

papers.title: Who Analyses the Analyser? Self-Validating LLM Hazard Analysis with Constitutional Meta-STPA
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly trusted to draft the artifacts of safety analysis such as, losses, hazards, Unsafe Control Actions (UCAs), and safety constraints, inside rigorous processes such as Systems-Theoretic Process Analysis (STPA). Yet a blind spot runs through this fast-growing literature: every system gets analysed except the LLM-assisted tool doing the analysing, which is itself a safety-relevant system that can hallucinate standards, emit unverifiable constraints, and leave no audit trail from prompt to artifact. We take seriously the question the field has skipped -- {who analyses the analyser?} and answer it by turning STPA on the tool itself. We present \{Constitutional Meta-STPA}, an LLM-assisted STPA tool built around a closed loop: the tool runs a {meta-STPA} of the class of AI-assisted safety tools and {derives} rather than asserts, its governance constitution from the resulting loss$\to$hazard$\to$UCA$\to$constraint chain, yielding a published constitution of $21$ Tool Principles and $8$ Meta-Safety Principles, each bound to a code enforcement point. We formalise the measured object as a constitution-marginal coverage operator over a principle set $P$ ($|P|{=}29$) with a soundness lemma that isolates coverage from model and scanner, and report four findings. {(i)~Self-derivation:} a frontier ensemble ({claude-opus-4.8}${+}${claude-sonnet-4}) recovers $18/21$ canonical and all $8/8$ governance principles from the tool's own design, while a weaker pair recovers $12/21$ and $3/8$, so the meta layer is model-limited, not constitution-limited, and the same $8/8$ re-emerge from a second, independently authored tool.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出LLM辅助安全分析工具（如STPA）自身缺乏安全分析，提出Constitutional Meta-STPA框架，通过让工具对自身进行STPA分析，推导出21条工具原则和8条元安全原则。实验表明前沿模型组合能高保真恢复这些原则，而较弱模型则表现不足，说明元层受限于模型能力而非宪法本身。
Motivation: 现有LLM辅助安全分析工具缺乏对自身的危害分析，可能产生幻觉、不可验证约束等问题，形成一个盲点。
Method: 提出Constitutional Meta-STPA，将STPA应用于LLM辅助安全分析工具本身，从损失-危险-不安全控制动作-约束链推导出治理原则，并形式化为宪法边际覆盖算子。
Result: 前沿模型组合（claude-opus-4.8+claude-sonnet-4）恢复18/21工具原则和全部8/8元安全原则；较弱模型组合恢复12/21和3/8。
Conclusion: 该自验证方法可行，但元分析效果依赖于LLM能力，且目前仅评估了自身设计。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: What LLM Forecasters Know but Don't Say: Probing Internal Representations for Calibration and Faithfulness
papers.abstract_en: Large language models fine-tuned for forecasting can be accurate yet poorly calibrated, and their chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning may not faithfully reflect the evidence behind a forecast. We ask whether internal representations offer a more direct window into both. Working with Eternis-Forecaster 8B on OpenForesight, we train representation-pooling probes on intermediate activations and find they achieve substantially better calibration; a result that also holds for GLM-4.7-Flash and GLM-4.5-Air. We then assess CoT faithfulness through evidence ablation and diversionary injection: removing an influential source in the prompt often changes the model's forecast while leaving the reasoning trace untouched. The same probes function as lie detectors: their activations track behavioral shifts far better than the reasoning trace does, and they also predict the direction of change in 84% of cases, including when the CoT conceals the perturbation's influence. Finally, forced answering reveals that forecasts are largely fixed before reasoning begins: a single pre-reasoning pass recovers the committed answer and confidence, and routing questions by the spread of this pre-set answer distribution saves 30-47% of generated tokens, with no loss of accuracy. Together, these results establish probing internal representations as a practical tool for calibrating, auditing, and triaging language model forecasters and reasoning models more broadly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型预报器（如Eternis-Forecaster 8B）的校准性和推理忠实性。通过在中间激活上训练表征池化探针（representation-pooling probes），发现探针能显著提升校准效果，且能作为“测谎仪”检测模型行为变化，预测变化方向准确率达84%。实验还表明，模型在推理开始前就已固定预测，利用这一特性可节省30-47%的生成token而不损失精度。
Motivation: LLM预报器虽然准确但校准差，且链式思维（CoT）推理可能不忠实反映真实证据，内部表征或许能提供更直接的校准和审计窗口。
Method: 在多个LLM（Eternis-Forecaster 8B、GLM-4.7-Flash等）的中间层激活上训练探针进行校准；通过证据消融和干扰注入测试评估CoT忠实性；并采用强制回答实验分析预推理阶段的预测固定性。
Result: 探针校准效果显著优于原始模型；探针能检测模型行为变化，预测方向准确率84%，即使CoT隐藏了扰动影响；预推理阶段已固定预测，按此分布分流问题可节省30-47% token且不损失精度。
Conclusion: 探测内部表征是校准、审计和分诊LLM预报器及推理模型的实用工具。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: RadioDiff-v2: Generative Angular Radio Maps for Multi-Beam Selection and Localization
papers.abstract_en: Angular radio maps describe the received-power distribution over the angle of arrival and underpin beam selection and receiver localization in sixth-generation (6G) networks. Predicting the angular power spectrum (APS) from geometry is difficult, because the mapping is ill-posed in non-line-of-sight (NLOS) conditions and must generalize to unseen environments. Distortion-minimizing regressors return the conditional mean, which over-smooths the spectrum and erases the multipath structure that downstream tasks need. We cast the task as a perception-distortion problem and propose RadioDiff-v2, a dual-branch one-dimensional diffusion transformer trained with flow matching. It couples periodic angular encoding, adaptive layer-normalization conditioning, a Fourier angular mixer, and joint velocity and clean-signal heads. A per-metric estimator portfolio reads every deployment quantity from this single model, so that samples carry the distribution, the clean-signal head supplies a regression-grade point estimate, Bayes-optimal rules select beams, and the conditional likelihood localizes the receiver. We prove that a concentrated conditional yields a straight probability-flow trajectory that one step integrates exactly, identifying deterministic transport as the correct inductive bias. On a zero-shot test of 99 environments and one million links, RadioDiff-v2 leads every baseline on every metric, with a 0.39 dB Wasserstein-1 distance, per-bin error below the regression baseline, a 2.43 dB eight-beam NLOS sweep loss, and a 20.6-pixel localization error with four base stations. Code is available at https://github.com/UNIC-Lab/RadioDiff-v2.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对6G网络中的角度无线地图生成问题，提出RadioDiff-v2，一种双分支一维扩散Transformer，用于从几何数据预测角功率谱（APS）。该方法将任务建模为感知-失真问题，通过流匹配训练，结合周期性角度编码、自适应层归一化、傅里叶角度混合器以及联合速度与干净信号头，实现波束选择与接收器定位。在99个环境的零样本测试中，RadioDiff-v2在所有指标上超越基线，包括0.39 dB的Wasserstein-1距离、2.43 dB的八波束NLOS扫描损耗和20.6像素的定位误差。
Motivation: 现有方法在非视距（NLOS）条件下难以从几何数据预测角功率谱，且回归器会过度平滑频谱，丢失多径结构，影响下游任务。
Method: 提出RadioDiff-v2，包括双分支一维扩散Transformer，采用流匹配训练，集成周期性角度编码、自适应层归一化、傅里叶角度混合器和联合速度与干净信号头，并通过每度量估计器组合实现波束选择与定位。
Result: 在99个环境和100万个链路的零样本测试中，RadioDiff-v2在所有指标上领先基线：Wasserstein-1距离0.39 dB，每像素误差低于回归基线，八波束NLOS扫描损耗2.43 dB，四基站定位误差20.6像素。
Conclusion: 该工作将角度无线地图生成视为感知-失真问题，证明集中条件可导出精确一步积分的直线概率流轨迹，确定确定性传输为正确归纳偏置。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Aleena: Alignment Agent for Research Software Engineering Collaborations
papers.abstract_en: Research software collaborations span meetings, informal chats, pull requests, and GitHub issues. A decision surfaced in a Slack thread, refined in a meeting, and implemented in a pull request can lose its original rationale across these artifacts, leaving domain researchers and research software engineers with divergent mental models of project intent, ownership, and scientific assumptions. We argue that alignment in research software engineering is a continuous lifecycle problem, and that agentic AI can support stakeholder alignment and project-state tracking without replacing human decision-making. We present Aleena, an open-source lifecycle alignment agent that uses GitHub as a shared collaboration surface, transforming multi-modal stakeholder interactions into structured project records that surface risks, track open questions, and preserve decision continuity. Grounded in university-based research software engineering center experiences, this paper presents the motivating problem, system design, prototype, and illustrative lifecycle scenarios for Aleena.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 5 figures. AgenticSE @ KDD '26: Agentic Software Engineering (SE 3.0): The Rise of AI Teammates, KDD 2026 Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Aleena，一个开源的软件工程协作智能体，利用 GitHub 作为共享协作界面，将多模态利益相关者交互转化为结构化项目记录，以追踪决策连续性、风险和未解决问题。该系统基于大学研究软件工程中心的经验设计，旨在解决研究软件协作中因沟通分散导致的对齐问题。
Motivation: 研究软件协作中，决策分散在会议、聊天、拉取请求等不同媒介中，导致领域研究人员和软件工程师对项目意图、所有权和科学假设产生分歧。现有方法缺乏持续对齐的机制。
Method: 提出 Aleena 智能体，以 GitHub 为中心平台，通过 API 整合 Slack、会议纪要等多模态输入，自动提取并维护结构化项目记录，包括决策、责任分配和未解决问题，以辅助利益相关者对齐。
Result: 摘要仅描述系统设计和原型，未提供定量实验结果。通过三个示例场景（如拉取请求审查、项目里程碑讨论）展示 Aleena 如何帮助识别风险、追踪决策并保持连续性。
Conclusion: 作者认为对齐是研究软件工程中的一个持续生命周期问题，AI 智能体可以支持利益相关者对齐和项目状态追踪，而不取代人类决策。未来工作包括扩展至更多协作平台和评估实际部署效果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: An exact information theory of generalization phase transitions in Bayesian diffusion models
papers.abstract_en: How diffusion models circumvent the curse of dimensionality to learn complex distributions over high dimensional spaces from a finite training set, instead of memorizing it, remains a fundamental mystery. To address this, we introduce analytically tractable Bayesian information restricted diffusion (BIRD) models, in which each pixel observes restricted information about noisy data. A BIRD model time-reverses diffusion by inferring which past training sample produced its current restricted observation using the Bayesian posterior. This model class generalizes existing analytical diffusion models that use spatially local information restriction. We show that spatially local BIRD models closely approximate trained diffusion models \textit{early in training}, across different architectures such as UNets and DiTs. Under minimal assumptions on the data distribution, we identify an information-theoretic phase boundary between memorization and generalization in the joint space of amount of training data, time in the reverse generative process, and amount of information restriction: a BIRD model memorizes when the mutual information between its restricted noisy observations and the training data exceeds the log number of training points, and it generalizes otherwise. Experiments across a range of datasets confirm our theoretically predicted location for the transition. We find that generation proceeds near the edge of memorization: both spatially local BIRD models and early-training diffusion models track the memorization-generalization phase boundary by increasingly restricting information over time. Overall, our results reveal a fundamental role for information restriction in generative AI to circumvent the curse of dimensionality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过引入贝叶斯信息受限扩散（BIRD）模型，从信息论角度分析了扩散模型在有限训练数据下的泛化与记忆相变。研究发现，当受限噪声观测与训练数据之间的互信息超过训练点数的对数时，模型记忆训练数据；否则泛化。实验表明，BIRD模型和早期训练的扩散模型都沿着记忆-泛化相边界进行生成。
Motivation: 扩散模型如何在高维空间中从有限训练集学习复杂分布而不记忆训练数据，这一基础问题尚未被理解。
Method: 提出解析可处理的贝叶斯信息受限扩散（BIRD）模型，每个像素仅观察含噪数据的受限信息，模型通过贝叶斯后验推断过去训练样本。
Result: 推导出记忆与泛化之间的信息论相边界：互信息超过log训练点数时记忆，否则泛化。实验验证了理论预测的相变位置，并发现生成过程接近记忆边缘。
Conclusion: 信息受限在高维生成AI中发挥了根本性作用，有助于规避维度诅咒。

papers.title: A safety-oriented hypothetico-deductive framework for AI-assisted differential diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Diagnostic error is a major threat to patient safety, yet current large language model (LLM) systems often treat diagnosis as a one-shot prediction task, lacking safeguards against missed high-risk alternatives or rigorous verification of their reasoning. Here, we present AegisDx, a safety-oriented framework for hypothetico-deductive clinical reasoning. AegisDx coordinates specialized LLM components through role-specific contracts, structured intermediate outputs, evidence-retrieval interfaces, and verification gates to generate broad differential diagnoses, enforce explicit screening for dangerous "must-not-miss" conditions, verify reasoning against grounded medical evidence, and structure actionable next steps. We evaluated AegisDx across three layers. On literature-derived case reports from NEJM and JAMA, with GPT-oss-120B as the shared backbone, Top-3 diagnostic accuracy was 59.9% versus 52.1% for the standalone LLM on JAMA cases and 62.7% versus 51.4% on NEJM cases. On cases from Annals of Emergency Medicine, Top-3 accuracy was 85.7% versus 68.6%; against physician-consensus must-not-miss diagnosis sets, AegisDx captured at least one such condition among its top three diagnoses in 78.0% of cases versus 52.0%. In a blinded physician evaluation of 43 real-world emergency department notes from the Yale New Haven Health System compared against GPT-5, AegisDx improved the physician-rated composite safety score from 4.31 to 4.55 on a 5-point scale (adjusted p = 2.1x10^-4), with qualitative gains in must-not-miss identification and reasoning safety. Our findings suggest that engineering diagnostic AI as a safety-oriented reasoning framework, rather than optimizing raw predictive accuracy alone, can provide a safer, more transparent, and clinically meaningful layer of bedside decision support for acute care workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AegisDx，一个面向安全的假设-演绎临床推理框架，用于AI辅助鉴别诊断。该框架通过协调专用LLM组件、结构化的中间输出、证据检索接口和验证门控，生成广泛的鉴别诊断列表，强制筛查“不可遗漏”的危险疾病，并验证推理过程。评估显示，在NEJM和JAMA病例上Top-3准确率分别提升至62.7%和59.9%（vs. 基线51.4%和52.1%），在急诊病例上达到85.7%，且医生评定的综合安全评分从4.31提升至4.55（5分制）。
Motivation: 诊断错误是患者安全的主要威胁，当前的LLM系统通常将诊断视为一次性预测任务，缺乏对高风险替代诊断的防护和推理验证。
Method: AegisDx框架通过角色特定合约、结构化中间输出、证据检索接口和验证门控协调多个LLM组件，实现假设-演绎临床推理，包括生成广泛鉴别诊断、强制筛查“不可遗漏”疾病、基于医学证据验证推理，并输出可操作的下一步骤。
Result: 在NEJM和JAMA病例上，AegisDx的Top-3准确率分别为62.7%和59.9%，优于基线的51.4%和52.1%；在Annals of Emergency Medicine病例上为85.7% vs. 68.6%；在“不可遗漏”诊断捕获率上为78.0% vs. 52.0%；在真实急诊病例的医生盲评中，安全评分从4.31提升至4.55（p=2.1×10^-4）。
Conclusion: 将诊断AI设计为面向安全的推理框架，而非仅优化预测准确性，可以为急性护理工作流程提供更安全、更透明、临床更有意义的床旁决策支持。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PLURAL: A Global Dataset for Value Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are used worldwide, yet disproportionately reflect Western values, limiting their ability to represent diverse value systems. We introduce PLURAL, a large-scale, value-focused preference dataset grounded in the Integrated Values Survey (IVS), a nationally representative survey spanning 92 countries. Using a two-stage generation pipeline, we transform survey responses into synthetic preference triplets that preserve normative value signals while producing realistic scenarios. We release an initial version of PLURAL containing ~500,000 preference triplets representing people in 20 diverse countries. We evaluate PLURAL in three ways: (i) dataset-level validation showing that it preserves both cross-country value differences and within-country diversity from the original survey; (ii) automated evaluation showing that training on PLURAL improves alignment with target countries' cultural profiles, reducing mean absolute error by up to 27.7% relative to strong baselines; and (iii) blind human evaluation with 176 evaluators in India, Brazil, and Japan, who judge PLURAL-aligned responses as more representative of their national values. Together, these results show that PLURAL contains learnable signal for value steering, offering a scalable resource for pluralistic alignment. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/agdhruv/plural-alignment
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PLURAL是一个基于综合价值观调查（IVS）的大规模、以价值观为导向的偏好数据集，覆盖92个国家。通过两阶段生成流程，将调查响应转化为合成的偏好三元组，保留了规范的价值观信号。初始版本包含来自20个不同国家的约50万条偏好三元组。实验表明，在PLURAL上训练可以提高语言模型与目标国家文化特征的对齐，降低平均绝对误差达27.7%，且人类评估者认为PLURAL对齐的响应更能代表其国家价值观。
Motivation: 现有大型语言模型主要反映西方价值观，难以代表多样的价值体系，需要能够指导价值观对齐的跨文化数据集。
Method: 基于综合价值观调查（IVS）数据，采用两阶段生成流水线：将调查响应转化为合成的偏好三元组，保留规范的价值观信号并生成现实场景。
Result: 数据集验证保留了跨国价值观差异和国内多样性；自动评估显示训练后与目标国家文化特征对齐的误差降低27.7%；盲人评估（176名来自印度、巴西、日本的评估者）认为PLURAL对齐的响应更具代表性。
Conclusion: PLURAL包含了可学习的价值导向信号，为多元化对齐提供了可扩展的资源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: What to Keep, What to Forget: A Rate--Distortion View of Memory Compaction in LLMs and Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language models, and the agents built on them, spend an ever-growing share of their compute and memory on remembering: caching attention keys and values, carrying long prompts, maintaining recurrent state, and storing what happened in previous turns and sessions. Because none of this memory is free, four largely separate research communities have each learned to compact it. They evict or quantize the KV cache, prune or distill prompts, bound architectural state, and consolidate agent memory. We argue that these are instances of one problem: a rate--distortion decision about what context-derived information to retain versus discard, at what fidelity, under a resource budget, so as to preserve downstream task utility. We make this lens precise with a single compaction objective and a layer-agnostic lower bound, use it to build a seven-axis taxonomy that classifies methods from across the stack uniformly, and use it to transfer mechanisms between layers that have never been connected, from serving-stack KV management to agent long-term memory. Two patterns hold across the survey. At every layer the signal that decides what to keep is attention magnitude or recency, and it fails in the same way everywhere, by discarding, before the query is known and with no way to undo it, information the query later needs. And while compression is measured carefully on single-turn long context, the repeated compaction that agents actually perform is almost never measured, and no benchmark holds one budget axis across all the layers at once. We turn both observations into a benchmark proposal, a small reference experiment, and a set of compaction-aware design principles, and we map the open problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从速率-失真（rate-distortion）视角统一审视LLM及智能体中不同层次的内存压缩方法，包括KV缓存、提示压缩、架构状态约束和智能体记忆压缩。文章构建了一个七轴分类法系统归类现有方法，揭示两个跨层模式：丢弃决策几乎都依赖注意力幅度或最近性，且在查询未知前做出不可逆的丢弃；单轮长上下文压缩被精细测量，但智能体实际执行的重复压缩几乎未被评估。最后提出基准建议、参考实验和设计原则。
Motivation: 不同研究社区各自独立发展内存压缩方法（KV管理、提示压缩、状态约束、智能体记忆），缺乏统一审视框架，导致方法间难以转移和比较，且对智能体多轮交互场景下的压缩效果缺乏系统评估。
Method: 采用速率-失真理论框架，定义统一压缩目标函数和层无关下界；构建七轴分类法（如压缩对象、决策时机、预算类型等），并用该分类法系统分类现有方法，跨层转移机制。
Result: 发现两个跨层模式：1）丢弃决策信号主要是注意力幅度或最近性，均在查询已知前做出且不可撤销；2）单轮长上下文压缩测量精细，但智能体实际执行的重复压缩缺乏基准和测量。基于此提出基准提案和小型参考实验。
Conclusion: 强调需要建立覆盖所有层和多次交互过程的统一压缩评估基准，并遵循压缩感知的设计原则。开放问题包括如何在查询已知前做出更好的保留决策、如何衡量重复压缩的累积效应等。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DKDNet: Dual Knowledge and Data-Driven Network for Cross-Domain Automatic Modulation Classification
papers.abstract_en: The dynamics of communication environments induce significant distribution shifts across domains, challenging the generalization of deep learning-based automatic modulation classification (AMC) models. While existing UDA methods alleviate this problem by aligning source and target features, they give limited consideration to modulation-specific structures that remain informative across domain conditions. In this paper, we consider signal prior knowledge, grounded in communication protocols and physical principles, as a potential way to enhance cross-domain representation learning. Given that different priors may vary in modulation discriminability, domain stability, and complementarity, this paper first analyzes five commonly adopted signal representations that instantiate different signal priors. From them, in-phase/quadrature (IQ), amplitude--phase (AP), and autocorrelation function (ACF) are selected as compact prior-guided inputs. Based on that, a dual knowledge and data-driven network (DKDNet) is proposed for cross-domain AMC. The multi-representation feature encoder (MRFE) and dynamic lightweight fusion unit (DLFU) are designed to achieve unified representation learning and adaptive feature fusion, and the resulting fused features are optimized with modulation classification and adversarial domain alignment objectives. Experiments on both simulated and public datasets validate the rationality of the prior selection and demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出双知识与数据驱动网络（DKDNet），用于跨域自动调制分类（AMC）。通过分析五种信号先验表示，选择IQ、AP和ACF作为紧凑的先验引导输入，设计多表示特征编码器（MRFE）和动态轻量融合单元（DLFU）进行统一表示学习与自适应特征融合，并联合优化调制分类与对抗域对齐目标。在模拟和公开数据集上的实验验证了先验选择的合理性和方法的优越性。
Motivation: 通信环境的动态性导致显著域偏移，现有无监督域适应方法仅对齐源域和目标域特征，未充分考虑跨域条件下仍具判别性的调制特定结构。作者认为结合通信协议与物理原理的信号先验知识可增强跨域表示学习。
Method: 首先分析五种常见信号表示的调制判别性、域稳定性和互补性，选出IQ、AP和ACF作为输入。提出DKDNet，包含多表示特征编码器（MRFE）提取统一表示，动态轻量融合单元（DLFU）实现自适应融合，最终特征通过调制分类和对抗域对齐目标联合优化。
Result: 在模拟和公开数据集上的实验表明，所选的先验表示（IQ、AP、ACF）合理，且DKDNet在跨域AMC任务上表现优越，超过现有无监督域适应方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调DKDNet通过显式引入信号先验知识，有效提升了跨域AMC的泛化能力，验证了先验选择与分析的有效性。

papers.title: Rethinking Small VLM Quantization: From Component-Wise Analysis to Hardware-Aware Edge Deployment
papers.abstract_en: The emergence of vision language models with fewer than 3 billion parameters has accelerated the implementation of on-device multimodal intelligence. However, a detailed understanding of component-wise quantization remains a bottleneck for optimal deployment. This paper presents a systematic evaluation framework for empirically validating five hypotheses across six quantization configurations on the Jetson Orin NX and AGX. By separating the vision encoder, projector, and large language model backbone yields the following results: (1) Quantization sensitivity is governed by the structural paradigm (MoE vs. dense) rather than scale alone, with MoE backbones mitigating INT4 noise where dense backbones degrade; (2) SigLIP encoders incur disproportionate INT8 latency on Jetson Ampere--a deployment-specific encoder-kernel-hardware interaction, not a SigLIP flaw; (3) Although INT4 quantization of LLMs greatly reduces VRAM consumption, it also causes slower token generation due to dequantization overhead; (4) Composite quantization errors are largely additive, except along the modality-alignment path, which is architecture-dependent; (5) The intelligence-per-joule profile varies significantly across platforms owing to memory bandwidth constraints.
papers.comment: 14 pages. Accepted at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Hypothesis Testing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了小于3B参数的视觉语言模型（VLM）在Jetson边缘设备上各组件（视觉编码器、投影器、大语言模型骨干）的量化敏感性，通过六种量化配置在Jetson Orin NX和AGX上验证五个假设。发现量化敏感度主要由结构范式（MoE vs. dense）而非规模决定，SigLIP编码器在Jetson Ampere上产生不成比例的INT8延迟，INT4量化虽减少显存但因反量化开销降低生成速度，复合量化误差大致可加，且智能每焦耳曲线因内存带宽约束在不同平台上差异显著。
Motivation: 小规模VLM在边缘设备部署中，组件级量化的理解仍不充分，导致最优部署存在瓶颈。
Method: 提出系统评估框架，在Jetson Orin NX和AGX上针对视觉编码器、投影器和LLM骨干分别进行INT8/INT4量化实验，验证五个假设。
Result: MoE骨干在INT4下鲁棒而dense骨干退化；SigLIP在Jetson Ampere上INT8延迟高；INT4量化节省显存但生成变慢；复合量化误差除模态对齐路径外大致可加；不同平台智能每焦耳差异大。
Conclusion: 表明VLM量化部署需考虑架构、硬件和组件的交互，而非仅关注模型大小。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Prompts to Contracts: Harness Engineering for Auditable Enterprise LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise large language model (LLM) applications often begin as prototypes whose behavior is carried by prompts and retrieval context. Productization adds requirements for source boundaries, entity routing, answer contracts, and reproducible traces. We present a harness-engineering approach that reconstructs this pattern into a traceable, auditable LLM-agent architecture: deterministic behavior moves into code, manifests, schemas, and validation artifacts around a replaceable composition boundary, while source-backed claims remain the authority for runtime answers. We instantiate it on a public-data slice of five Korean corporate groups (25 listed companies) and evaluate three research questions. (1) The harness preserves its source-grounding, entity-routing, trace, output-hygiene, and recommendation-language contracts across the fixed validation scenarios; a fault-injection control confirms the validators flag deliberately broken contracts. (2) The checks the harness enforces held under model substitution: across three hosted models, they passed on all 270 composition-boundary runs; failures were confined to the model-composed side and were caught and recorded. (3) The code-owned guarantees are load-bearing, not reproducible by prompting alone: holding the model fixed and varying only the enforcement layer, prompt instructions alone let recommendation-language and internal-trace-leakage violations reach the reader, which the harness blocks entirely. A bolt-on external guardrail prevents such violations too but over-refuses, dropping utility to 88/120 where the harness preserves full utility (120/120); in this ablation, only code-owned enforcement preserves both safety and utility. The result is a reusable engineering pattern for turning exploratory prototypes into auditable applications with versioned source, control, and validation artifacts.
papers.comment: 32 pages, 6 figures, 16 tables. Reference implementation and evaluation artifacts: https://github.com/hammerbaki/enterprise-llm-agent-harness (archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21269426)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种harness-engineering方法，将企业LLM应用从提示驱动的原型转化为可审计、可追溯的架构，通过将确定性行为转移到代码、清单和验证构件中，并保留源支持的声明用于运行时答案。在五个韩国企业集团（25家上市公司）的数据上验证了三个研究问题：合约保持、模型替换下的鲁棒性，以及仅靠提示无法保证的约束。结果表明，该方法在保持安全性的同时不损失效用（120/120），而外部护栏会过度拒绝（88/120）。
Motivation: 企业LLM应用从原型到产品化过程中，需要满足源边界、实体路由、答案合约和可重现轨迹等要求，而纯提示驱动的方法无法保证这些审计需求。
Method: 提出harness-engineering方法，将确定性行为封装到代码、清单、模式和验证构件中，围绕可替换的组合边界构建，运行时答案由源支持的声明提供。
Result: 在固定验证场景下，harness保持了所有合约；通过故障注入验证了校验器的有效性。模型替换测试中，270次组合边界运行全部通过，失败仅出现在模型组合侧并被捕获。仅凭提示指令无法阻止推荐语言和内部痕迹泄露，而harness完全阻止；外部护栏虽能阻止但过拒，效用降至88/120，而harness保持120/120。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了一种可复用的工程模式，将探索性原型转化为具有版本化源、控制和验证构件的可审计应用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Structured Pruning of Large Language Models via Power Transformation and Sign-Preserving Score Aggregation with Adaptive Feature Retention
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes an improved structured pruning method for large language models (LLMs) that addresses key challenges in adapting Adaptive Feature Retention (AFR), an unstructured pruning technique, to structured pruning. When applying AFR to structured pruning, three major problems arise: distribution mismatch between heterogeneous pruning scores, loss of sign information indicating optimization direction consistency, and influence of outliers. To address these issues, we propose a unified approach combining power transformation for nonlinear distribution alignment, sign-preserving score aggregation, and percentile-based outlier removal. Experiments on Llama-3-8B, Vicuna-v1.5-13B, and LLaVA-v1.5-13B demonstrate that our method maintains accuracy comparable to unstructured pruning while achieving practical inference speedup through structured pruning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种改进的大语言模型结构化剪枝方法，针对Adaptive Feature Retention (AFR)应用于结构化剪枝时遇到的分布不一致、符号信息丢失和异常值影响问题，提出结合幂变换、保号评分聚合和基于百分位的异常值去除的统一方法。在Llama-3-8B、Vicuna-v1.5-13B和LLaVA-v1.5-13B上的实验表明，该方法在保持与结构化剪枝相当精度的同时，通过结构化剪枝实现了实际推理加速。
Motivation: 将非结构化剪枝技术AFR适配到结构化剪枝时面临三个主要问题：异构剪枝评分的分布不匹配、丢失指示优化方向一致性的符号信息、以及异常值的影响。
Method: 提出统一方法，包括幂变换进行非线性分布对齐、保号评分聚合以及基于百分位的异常值去除。
Result: 在Llama-3-8B、Vicuna-v1.5-13B和LLaVA-v1.5-13B上，该方法保持了与结构化剪枝相当的精度，同时实现了实际推理加速。
Conclusion: 通过解决AFR适配到结构化剪枝的关键问题，所提方法能够在保持精度的同时通过结构化剪枝获得实际加速。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PGD-NO: A Neural Operator with Precomputed Geometry Decomposition for 3D Million-scale Physics Simulations
papers.abstract_en: While neural PDE solvers have demonstrated significant potential for accelerating engineering simulations, existing architectures remain constrained by high memory consumption and the single node bottleneck, where the maximum processable mesh resolution is strictly limited by the VRAM of a single compute unit. To address these challenges, we propose PGD-NO, a neural operator with Precomputed Geometry Decomposition, that relocates the computational overhead of geometric encoding to a deterministic pre-computation phase. By utilizing an iterative geometry decomposition algorithm to extract geometry tokens, our model decouples feature extraction from solution querying. This architecture enables linear memory scalability, allowing high fidelity learning on meshes exceeding 10 million nodes, a scale where existing architectures typically encounter memory exhaustion. PGD-NO demonstrates competitive predictive accuracy across diverse industrial benchmarks and provides intrinsic interpretability through attention mechanisms. By effectively overcoming traditional mesh-size constraints, PGD-NO offers a robust and efficient solution for the next generation of large-scale, high-fidelity industrial design applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PGD-NO，一种基于预计算几何分解的神经算子，用于3D百万级物理模拟。该方法通过将几何编码的计算开销转移到确定性预计算阶段，并采用迭代几何分解算法提取几何令牌，实现线性内存扩展性，支持超过1000万节点的高保真学习，同时提供注意力机制的内在可解释性。
Motivation: 现有神经PDE求解器受限于高内存消耗和单节点瓶颈，无法处理大规模网格，亟需一种可扩展的架构来支持百万级节点的高保真模拟。
Method: 提出PGD-NO，利用预计算几何分解将几何编码开销转移到预处理阶段，通过迭代几何分解算法提取几何令牌，解耦特征提取与解查询，实现线性内存扩展。
Result: 在多个工业基准上展示竞争性预测精度，支持超过1000万节点的网格，克服了现有架构的内存耗尽问题。
Conclusion: PGD-NO有效突破了传统网格尺寸限制，为大规模高保真工业设计应用提供了鲁棒且高效的解决方案。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: APIVOT: Adaptive Planning with Interleaved Vision-Language Thoughts
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon robot planning requires jointly reasoning over semantic task structure and geometric feasibility. To successfully execute a task, a robot must decompose goals, select task-relevant objects, and sequence actions, while ensuring that plans satisfy spatial constraints such as limited free space and object collisions. In this work, we propose APIVOT, a VLM-based planner that adaptively interleaves language and visual thoughts for long-horizon planning. APIVOT learns to leverage language for semantic reasoning, while using visual thoughts as imagined future states for internal verification of geometric feasibility. On long-horizon kitchen tasks, APIVOT outperforms general-purpose VLMs and prior planning frameworks, achieving the largest gains in spatially constrained settings. We find that APIVOT learns meaningful modality selection behavior, demonstrating that adaptive interleaving of vision-language thoughts improves both planning success and reasoning efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出APIVOT，一种基于VLM的长期机器人规划器，通过自适应地交错语言和视觉思考来同时处理语义推理和几何可行性验证。在长期厨房任务中，APIVOT优于通用VLM和先前规划框架，尤其在空间受限场景中提升最大。
Motivation: 长期机器人规划需要同时推理任务语义结构和几何可行性，但现有VLM缺乏对空间约束（如有限自由空间、物体碰撞）的内部验证能力。
Method: APIVOT采用VLM作为基础，自适应地交错两种思维模式：语言用于语义推理，视觉思考则作为想象的未来状态用于内部验证几何可行性。
Result: 在长期厨房任务中，APIVOT在规划成功率上优于通用VLM和先前规划框架，在空间受限场景下取得最大增益。
Conclusion: APIVOT学习到有意义的模态选择行为，表明自适应交错视觉-语言思考能同时提升规划成功率和推理效率。

papers.title: SAGA: Stable Acceleration Guidance for Autoregressive Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive video diffusion enables efficient streaming and long-horizon video generation, but repeatedly reusing generated latents as causal context can amplify temporal errors, resulting in flickering, motion jitter, and structural drift. In this paper, we investigate this failure mode from a spectral kinematic perspective and identify discrete latent acceleration as an effective signal for revealing unstable high-frequency temporal perturbations. To this end, we propose SAGA, a training-free \textbf{\textit{s}}table \textbf{\textit{a}}cceleration \textbf{\textit{g}}uidance approach for \textbf{\textit{a}}utoregressive video generation. SAGA integrates an acceleration domain spectral guidance objective based on finite-window Slepian projections with a structured autoregressive noise initialization strategy that suppresses short-range temporal correlations while preserving long-range motion structure. Without retraining or modifying the backbone, SAGA can be directly applied to existing chunk-wise autoregressive diffusion models, which is the prevalent setting for high-quality generation. Extensive experiments show that SAGA consistently improves temporal quality across multiple autoregressive diffusion models. On Self-Forcing, SAGA improves Temporal Quality from 97.30 to 97.91 and Image Quality from 69.60 to 70.51. Moreover, spectral analysis and human preference studies demonstrate that SAGA reduces temporal instability while maintaining visual fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自回归视频扩散模型中反复复用生成潜变量作为因果上下文导致的时间误差累积问题（闪烁、运动抖动、结构漂移），从频谱运动学角度分析该故障模式，并提出免训练的稳定加速引导方法 SAGA。该方法基于有限窗口 Slepian 投影的加速域频谱引导目标，结合结构化自回归噪声初始化策略，在不重新训练或修改骨干网络的情况下，直接应用于现有分块自回归扩散模型。实验表明 SAGA 在多个模型上一致提升时间质量，例如 Self-Forcing 模型上时间质量从 97.30 提升至 97.91，图像质量从 69.60 提升至 70.51。
Motivation: 自回归视频生成中反复重用生成潜变量作为因果上下文会放大时间误差，导致闪烁、抖动和结构漂移，现有方法缺乏对此故障模式的针对性解决方案。
Method: 提出训练自由的 SAGA 方法，包含两个部分：（1）加速域频谱引导目标，基于有限窗口 Slepian 投影来抑制不稳定高频时间扰动；（2）结构化自回归噪声初始化策略，在保持长程运动结构的同时抑制短时时间相关性。
Result: 在多个自回归扩散模型上，SAGA 一致提升时间质量。以 Self-Forcing 模型为例，时间质量从 97.30 提升至 97.91，图像质量从 69.60 提升至 70.51。频谱分析和人类偏好研究证实 SAGA 在保持视觉保真度的同时减少了时间不稳定性。
Conclusion: SAGA 是一种无需重新训练或修改骨干网络即可直接应用于现有分块自回归扩散模型的时间稳定性增强方法，在提升视频生成质量方面有效且通用。

papers.title: Concretized Proposition Prompting Resolves Composition-Knowledge Dichotomy in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: LLMs often struggle to balance compositionality with knowledgeability, a challenge we define as Composition-Knowledge Dichotomy. To address this, we propose Concretized Proposition Prompting (CPP), a framework that explicitly concretizes propositions relevant to questions. The results demonstrate that CPP significantly enhances reasoning performance, particularly in medical benchmarks where precise knowledge is paramount, while being competitive on math benchmarks where deductive reasoning is prioritized. Additional experiments reveal that CPP is scalable to various foundation models and parameter sizes, being a fundamental paradigm that bridges the gap between composition- and knowledge-based approaches. Consequently, CPP resolves the composition-knowledge dichotomy by providing a solid foundation for logically organized and factually grounded reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Concretized Proposition Prompting (CPP) 框架，通过显式具体化与问题相关的命题，解决大语言模型在组合性与知识性之间的权衡问题。实验表明 CPP 在需要精确知识的医学基准上显著提升推理性能，在数学基准上也具有竞争力，且可扩展到多种基础模型和参数量。
Motivation: 大语言模型在平衡组合推理能力与知识准确性方面存在困难，即所谓“组合-知识二分法”，现有方法难以同时兼顾两者。
Method: 提出 Concretized Proposition Prompting (CPP)，一种通过显式具体化与问题相关的命题来增强推理的框架。
Result: CPP 在医学基准上显著提升推理性能，在数学基准上表现有竞争力，并且适用于多种基础模型和不同规模。
Conclusion: CPP 桥接了基于组合和基于知识的方法之间的差距，为逻辑组织且事实有据的推理提供了坚实基础。

papers.title: Can We Trust LLM's Logic? Quantifying Uncertainty, Coherence, and Robustness via a Graph-Based Framework
papers.abstract_en: Large-Language Models (LLMs) can be prone to flawed and unfaithful reasoning that decoding strategies like Self-Consistency (SC) fail to detect as they evaluate only final-answer agreement while ignoring the logical validity of intermediate steps. This raises three fundamental questions: How can we reliably quantify uncertainty in LLM reasoning? Can semantic, structural, and causal awareness select more faithful reasoning compared to naïve majority voting? and How robust is reasoning topology under adversarial conditions? To address these questions, we introduce GRAPHEVAL, a graph-based reasoning framework that re-frames uncertainty quantification (UQ) as a holistic reasoning fidelity problem. We propose a novel UQ metric, Graph Reasoning Coherence Score (GRCS), that quantifies semantic-structural consensus of the reasoning space and captures pathological mode collapse and confident hallucinations. We find that GRCS is the only metric that is consistently negatively correlated with reasoning faithfulness across both more capable and smaller models. Additionally, we introduce Graph Self-Consistency (GSC), a medoid-based decoding strategy that trades nominal accuracy for reasoning fidelity, exposing the degree to which SC is inflated by unfaithful lucky guesses in smaller models, while preserving or improving accuracy in more capable ones. Finally, through adversarial medoid ablation, we demonstrate that the GSC-selected path acts as a "load-bearing path" and forcing models away from it degrades reasoning faithfulness and, in targeted cases, causes drops in accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GRAPHEVAL图框架，用于量化LLM推理中的不确定性、一致性和鲁棒性。引入新度量GRCS（图推理一致性分数）来捕获语义-结构共识，发现GRCS与推理忠实性呈一致负相关。提出图自一致性（GSC）解码策略，通过类中心选择提升推理忠实性，并验证GSC选中的路径是“承重路径”。
Motivation: 现有自一致性（SC）解码仅检查最终答案一致性，忽略中间逻辑有效性，无法检测推理中的错误和幻觉。需要更全面的不确定性量化方法。
Method: 提出GRAPHEVAL框架，将不确定性量化重新定义为推理忠实性问题。提出GRCS度量，量化推理空间的语义-结构共识。提出GSC medoid-based解码策略，以及对抗性medoid消融实验。
Result: GRCS是唯一与推理忠实性一致负相关的度量（在更强和更小模型上）。GSC在较小模型上暴露SC被幸运猜测膨胀的问题，在更强模型上保持或提升准确率。对抗性消融显示偏离GSC路径会降低推理忠实性并有时降低准确率。
Conclusion: 图框架能有效量化LLM推理的不确定性和忠实性，GSC是一种更可靠的解码策略，且推理拓扑具有鲁棒性特征。

papers.title: LightCrafter: PBR-Conditioned Video Diffusion Refinement for Controllable and Consistent Relighting
papers.abstract_en: Video relighting requires balancing long-form temporal consistency with a physically grounded understanding of light transport, which depends on accurate estimation of intrinsic scene properties such as materials, geometry, and illumination. Existing methods follow two paradigms: (1) reconstruct a video's photometric properties via inverse rendering and relight them to a target illumination via forward rendering, using physically-based rendering (PBR) or a neural renderer; these suffer from noisy reconstructions and struggle with hard-to-model effects such as global illumination. (2) Frame the task as generative video-to-video translation conditioned on relighting targets (a target environment map or text); this limits relighting control and temporal stability, since diffusion models struggle to translate long-form videos, and is constrained by the availability of input/relit training pairs. We propose LightCrafter, a hybrid pipeline that reformulates video relighting as video translation of a proxy video: rather than translating the input video directly to the target, we translate a PBR rendering of the input under the target illumination to the final target. This bakes illumination targets into the PBR proxy, removing the need to teach the diffusion model illumination concepts like environment maps, and enables more intricate lighting control while naturally providing long-form temporal consistency. We show PBR renders alone already outperform some prior art but struggle with effects like global illumination; to capture these, we leverage photometric priors in video generation models by post-training CogVideoX on synthetic video pairs and real-world unpaired videos. We outperform prior state-of-the-art on existing real-world relighting benchmarks and contribute a synthetic benchmark for further analysis. We will release our dataset, benchmark, metrics, and code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LightCrafter，一种混合视频重照明管线，通过将输入视频的PBR渲染代理作为目标，利用扩散模型进行视频到视频的转换，实现了在保持长时间一致性的同时提供可控的重照明效果。该方法在真实世界重照明基准上超越了先前最先进技术。
Motivation: 现有视频重照明方法在长时间一致性、物理精确性以及控制灵活性方面存在不足，尤其是生成式方法难以处理长视频且受限于训练数据对。
Method: LightCrafter将视频重照明问题重新定义为代理视频（PBR渲染下的输入视频）到目标视频的转换，结合PBR渲染和扩散模型，通过后训练CogVideoX利用合成和真实数据捕捉全局照明等效应。
Result: 在真实世界重照明基准上超越先前最先进技术，并贡献了一个合成基准用于进一步分析。
Conclusion: 该方法通过PBR代理将光照条件编码到扩散模型中，实现了更精细的控制和长时间一致性，同时降低了生成模型学习光照概念的难度。

papers.title: FedTR: Federated Learning Framework with Transfer Learning for Industrial Visual Inspection
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) is a collaborative learning scheme to train deep learning models, where collaborating parties can consolidate their models without sharing local data with other parties, hence preserving data privacy. Nevertheless, when implementing FL in Industrial visual inspection (IVI), the constraints posed by limited data availability and the intricate nature of the inspection tasks significantly impact the performance of the resulting model. This paper introduces FedTR, a novel FL framework incorporating transfer learning designed for Autonomous IVI, focusing on the challenging task of identifying label defects through end-to-end text recognition. Transfer learning is a method that leverages the knowledge of a pre-trained model to adapt to a different dataset. FedTR initially trains the model using a publicly available dataset, after which performs the essential federated learning process with model fine-tuning on the distributed and limited private data. Extensive experiment results demonstrate the effectiveness and feasibility of FedTR on private ink cartridge datasets for label defect identification. FedTR achieves an end-to-end text recognition word-level accuracy of 95.5% and 94.2% on homogeneous and heterogeneous data respectively. Additionally, it attains performance levels that are on par with those achieved through centralized training.
papers.comment: Author's accepted version. Published in Proceedings of the Great Lakes Symposium on VLSI 2024 (GLSVLSI '24)
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the Great Lakes Symposium on VLSI 2024 (GLSVLSI '24), pp. 310-314, 2024
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FedTR，一种面向自主工业视觉检测的联邦学习框架，结合迁移学习以应对数据有限和任务复杂导致的性能下降问题。FedTR先在公开数据集上预训练，再在分布式私有数据上进行联邦微调，用于标签缺陷识别中的端到端文本识别。实验表明，FedTR在同构和异构数据上分别达到95.5%和94.2%的词级准确率，性能与集中训练相当。
Motivation: 联邦学习在工业视觉检测中因本地数据稀缺和检测任务复杂导致模型性能不佳，需要一种能有效利用预训练知识并适应隐私保护协作学习的方法。
Method: FedTR框架：先使用公开数据集训练基础模型，再通过联邦学习在多个客户端的有限私有数据上进行模型微调，结合迁移学习实现知识迁移。
Result: 在墨水盒标签缺陷识别数据集上，FedTR在同构数据下词级准确率为95.5%，异构数据下为94.2%，性能与集中式训练相当。
Conclusion: FedTR验证了迁移学习与联邦学习结合在工业视觉检测中的有效性，为数据稀缺和隐私敏感场景提供了可行方案。

papers.title: Collate: Collaborative Neural Network Learning for Latency-Critical Edge Systems
papers.abstract_en: Federated Learning (FL) empowers multiple clients to collaboratively learn a model, enlarging the training data of each client for high accuracy while protecting data privacy. However, when deploying FL in real-time edge systems, the heterogeneity of devices among systems has a severe impact on the performance of the inferred model. Existing optimizations on FL focus on improving the training efficiency but fail to speed up inference, especially when there is a latency constraint. In this work, we propose Collate, a novel training framework that collaboratively learns heterogeneous models to meet the latency constraints of multiple edge systems simultaneously. We design a dynamic zeroizing-recovering method to adjust each local model architecture for high accuracy under its latency constraint. A proto-corrected federated aggregation scheme is also introduced to aggregate all heterogeneous local models, satisfying the latency constraint of different systems with only one training process and maintaining high accuracy. Extensive experiments indicate that, compared to state-of-the-art methods and under a latency constraint, our extended models can improve the accuracy by 1.96% on average, and our shrunk models can also obtain a 3.09% accuracy improvement on average, with almost no extra training overhead. The related codes and data will be available at https://github.com/ntuliuteam/Collate

papers.title: Provably Optimal Learning Algorithms for Assistance Games
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies an online variant of the assistance games framework, where an informed agent and an uninformed agent repeatedly interact over $T$ timesteps to optimize a common reward function. While the informed agent (the human) observes a latent state of the world, the uninformed agent (the assistant) observes only the human's actions. We provide the first provably efficient learning algorithms for repeated assistance games. We introduce the notion of assistance regret: the gap between the cumulative utility of interactions and that of the optimal joint policies in hindsight, which map latent states to action pairs. We present decentralized algorithms for both the human and the assistant that achieve a $(1-1/e)$-approximate assistance regret rate of $\widetilde{O}(T^{3/4})$, with runtime polynomial in the size of the action and state spaces. These algorithms are general; in particular, they accommodate any no-regret algorithm for the assistant. We prove that achieving a regret approximation factor better than $(1-1/e)$ is computationally intractable. Furthermore, we demonstrate how these generic no-regret algorithms can be tailored to a pseudo-decentralized setting -- using a shared random string -- to achieve a rate of $\widetilde{O}(T^{1/2})$, optimal up to logarithmic factors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在线援助博弈（assistance games）的变体，其中知情代理（人类）和不知情代理（助手）在T个时间步内重复交互以优化共同奖励函数。助手只能观察人类的动作，而人类观察潜在状态。文章提出了首个可证明高效的重复援助博弈学习算法，定义了援助遗憾（assistance regret），并给出了分散式算法，实现了(1-1/e)近似的援助遗憾率Õ(T^{3/4})，且运行时间关于状态和动作空间大小多项式。此外，在伪分散设置下（使用共享随机字符串）可达到Õ(T^{1/2})的速率，在log因子内最优。
Motivation: 现有援助博弈框架缺乏在线重复交互环境下可证明高效的学习算法，需要形式化援助遗憾并提供计算可行的最优策略。
Method: 提出分散式算法，人类和助手分别采用特定策略，助手可使用任意无遗憾算法；引入援助遗憾定义；证明(1-1/e)近似是最优可计算因子，并设计伪分散算法（共享随机字符串）达到更优速率。
Result: 达到(1-1/e)近似援助遗憾率Õ(T^{3/4})；伪分散设置下达到Õ(T^{1/2})，在log因子内最优。
Conclusion: 本文为重复援助博弈提供了首个计算高效且最优的学习算法，建立了理论上界和下界，并展示了如何利用共享随机性提升速率。
