papers.title: Diagnosing Shape-Prior Shortcuts in Long-Range Single-Shot Fringe Projection Profilometry
papers.abstract_en: Learning-based single-shot fringe projection profilometry (FPP) has been studied almost entirely at close range, and the networks used are evaluated only on aggregate error, leaving open whether they recover depth from fringe phase or from object-level shape cues that correlate with depth. This paper diagnoses that question mechanistically in the long-range regime (standoff beyond 1 m). Using FPP-ML-Bench, an open photorealistic synthetic benchmark (15,600 fringe images, 50 objects at 1.5--2.1 m), we first formalize why the single-shot fringe-to-depth mapping is more severely ill-posed at long range: it is non-injective without fringe-order information, and the depth error from an incorrect fringe order grows as $Z^2$ in the working distance. Systematic ablations, extended with a multi-frame study, establish a best UNet baseline at 14.54 mm object mean absolute error (MAE), 18% of the 80 mm object depth range, with only a 1.9$\times$ spread across four architectures, indicating a representational rather than a capacity-bound limit. A mechanistic interpretability study, the first applied to an FPP network, localizes the cause: linear probing shows edges are 2.82$\times$ more decodable than depth, Grad-CAM shows attention favoring boundaries over fringes by 1.28$\times$, and an in-range flat-plane test collapses a featureless plane to background depth despite valid fringes. The baseline solves the task via object-boundary shape priors rather than fringe-phase decoding. Because the shortcut is a hypothesis-space property, additional data or larger models will not remove it, motivating an architectural repair that removes the shape-prior solution by construction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文诊断了长距离（1.5-2.1米）单次条纹投影轮廓术中的形状先验捷径问题。通过构建FPP-ML-Bench合成基准（15600张条纹图像，50个物体），作者形式化证明了长距离下单次条纹到深度映射的非单射性及误差随距离平方增长的病态性。系统消融与多帧实验表明，最佳UNet基线MAE为14.54mm，仅占物体深度范围（80mm）的18%，且四种架构间表现差异仅1.9倍，提示存在表示性限制而非容量限制。机制性可解释性研究（线性探测、Grad-CAM、平面测试）揭示网络实际依赖物体边界形状先验而非条纹相位解码，因此额外数据或更大模型无法消除该捷径，需从架构上强制排除形状先验解。
Motivation: 现有学习型单次FPP几乎仅在近距离研究，且仅用聚合误差评估，无法判断网络是否真正从条纹相位恢复深度；长距离下问题更严重，缺乏对网络内部机制的诊断。
Method: 构建FPP-ML-Bench合成基准，形式化分析长距离下单次映射的病态性；通过系统消融（含多帧对比）比较四种架构；使用线性探测（解码深度与边缘）、Grad-CAM（注意力分布）及平面测试（特征平面）进行机制性可解释性分析。
Result: 最佳UNet基线MAE为14.54mm（深度范围80mm的18%），架构间性能差异仅1.9倍；线性探测显示边缘可解码性比深度高2.82倍，Grad-CAM显示注意力偏向边界超过条纹1.28倍，平面测试中平面塌缩至背景深度。网络实际利用物体边界形状先验，而非条纹相位。
Conclusion: 形状先验捷径是假设空间属性，增加数据或模型规模无法修复，需通过架构设计去除形状先验解，例如强制网络使用局部条纹信息。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Selective Mask Propagation for Multi-Object Tracking
papers.abstract_en: In multi-object tracking, most frames are easy for a lightweight base tracker while a small fraction is intrinsically hard. Video object segmentation (VOS) models can often preserve identity through the hard frames where the base tracker fails, but they are much more expensive in compute and memory. We propose selective mask propagation, a tracking algorithm that dispatches from a base tracker to a VOS model only on windows where an assignment-uncertainty signal fires. The base tracker's output is modified only when the VOS model makes a confident prediction that contradicts the base tracker's identity assignment; weak or inconclusive predictions preserve the base output. The method is training-free, treats both the base tracker and the VOS model as black boxes, and can benefit from replacing the VOS component with a more capable model. On DanceTrack, selective mask propagation significantly improves three different base trackers. On SportsMOT, where identity preservation is central to sports analytics, SAM 3-Deep-EIoU with global track association achieves state-of-the-art performance on the benchmark with 87.2 HOTA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出选择性掩码传播（Selective Mask Propagation），一种用于多目标跟踪的算法，仅在基跟踪器产生分配不确定性信号时，才调用昂贵的视频目标分割（VOS）模型。该方法无需训练，将基跟踪器和VOS模型视为黑盒，可替换更强大的VOS组件。在DanceTrack上显著提升三种基跟踪器性能，在SportsMOT上以87.2 HOTA达到当前最优。
Motivation: 多目标跟踪中大部分帧对轻量基跟踪器容易处理，但少数困难帧容易丢失身份。VOS模型能保持身份但计算成本高，需要一种机制在必要时才启用VOS模型。
Method: 提出选择性掩码传播，基跟踪器持续运行，当分配不确定性信号触发时，调度VOS模型处理窗口；仅当VOS模型做出与基跟踪器冲突的自信预测时才修改输出，否则保留基跟踪器结果。
Result: 在DanceTrack上显著提升三种不同基跟踪器的性能；在SportsMOT上，SAM 3-Deep-EIoU结合全局轨迹关联达到87.2 HOTA，实现当前最优。
Conclusion: 该训练免费方法可灵活替换VOS组件，提升多目标跟踪在困难场景下的身份保持能力，但依赖不确定性信号的有效性和VOS模型的性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Bridging Modal Isolation in Interleaved Thinking: Supervising Modality Transitions via Stepwise Reinforcement
papers.abstract_en: Interleaved thinking, where a unified multimodal model alternates between textual reasoning and visual generation, has shown promise on spatial and physical tasks. However, in complex long-chain scenarios, we identify a fundamental failure mode: generated images diverge from the textual context while subsequent text ignores the visual evidence, causing the two modalities to alternate without genuinely informing each other. We term this Modal Isolation and attribute it to compounding information loss at modality boundaries. We decompose each reasoning cycle into atomic operations and define modality transition loss, quantifying cross-modal hallucination (text-to-image) and visual utilization deficit (image-to-text) at each boundary. We propose MoTiF (Modality Tiransition Fidelity), a two-stage training framework that directly optimizes these transitions: Reflective SFT trains the model to detect and recover from erroneous visual outputs; Flow-GRPO improves image generation fidelity via reinforcement learning. All training signals in MoTiF derive from transition-level fidelity rather than end-task accuracy. Across four visual puzzle benchmarks, this transition-level supervision substantially improves both cross-modal coherence and final task accuracy. The results demonstrate that effective interleaved reasoning requires explicit structural supervision at modality boundaries, not merely scaling or end-task optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文识别多模态交错推理中“模态隔离”失败模式：生成图像偏离文本上下文，后续文本忽略视觉证据。提出MoTiF框架，包含反思性SFT和Flow-GRPO两阶段训练，直接优化模态转换保真度。在四个视觉谜题基准上，转换级监督显著提升跨模态一致性和任务准确率。
Motivation: 现有交错推理在长链场景中模态间信息丢失，导致图像与文本互不参考，影响复杂任务表现。
Method: 提出MoTiF两阶段框架：第一阶段Reflective SFT训练模型检测并纠正错误视觉输出；第二阶段Flow-GRPO通过强化学习提升图像生成保真度。所有训练信号来自转换级保真度而非最终任务准确率。
Result: 在四个视觉谜题基准上，转换级监督显著提升跨模态一致性和最终任务准确率。
Conclusion: 有效的交错推理需要在模态边界进行显式结构监督，而非仅依赖规模扩展或端任务优化。

papers.title: Deployment-Time Memorization in Foundation-Model Agents
papers.abstract_en: Foundation-model agents are increasingly long-lived systems that remember users across interactions, making memorization an explicit deployment-time function rather than solely a property of model weights. Existing work addresses parametric memorization or audits fixed memory configurations, but does not characterize how memory-design choices jointly shape personalization utility, extraction risk, and deletion fidelity. We study this surface as deployment-time memorization, formulating agent memory as a privacy-utility frontier measured by Personalization Recall (PR) and Adversarial Extraction Rate (AER), and sweeping three memory-design knobs: summarization aggressiveness, retrieval breadth (k), and deletion mode. We further introduce the Forgetting Residue Score (FRS) to quantify whether deleted information remains recoverable from derived memory tiers. On LongMemEval, key-fact summarization reduces canary extraction by 76% on Gemma 3 12B and 64% on GPT-4o-mini while preserving nearly all personalization recall; critically, once content is compressed away, increasing k no longer restores leakage. The same compression, however, induces a deletion-fidelity failure: raw-only deletion leaves derived summary copies recoverable in approximately 20% of instances, and only full-pipeline purge or tombstone redaction drives worst-tier residue to zero. Together, these results establish that persistent agent memory must be evaluated as a first-class memorization mechanism -- assessed by what it helps agents recall, what it makes extractable, and what it can truly erase.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基础模型代理中的部署时记忆（deployment-time memorization），即代理在部署期间通过记忆用户交互来个性化响应。作者系统分析了三个记忆设计参数（摘要攻击性、检索广度k、删除模式）对个性化效用（Personalization Recall）和提取风险（Adversarial Extraction Rate）的影响，并引入遗忘残余分数（Forgetting Residue Score）衡量删除后的残留信息。在LongMemEval上的实验表明，关键事实摘要可大幅降低提取率（Gemma 3 12B降低76%，GPT-4o-mini降低64%），但原始删除后仍有约20%的摘要副本可恢复，只有全流水线清除才能消除残余。
Motivation: 现有工作关注参数记忆或固定记忆配置审计，但未刻画记忆设计选择如何共同影响个性化效用、提取风险和删除保真度。
Method: 将代理记忆建模为隐私-效用前沿，使用Personalization Recall和Adversarial Extraction Rate作为度量，遍历三个记忆设计旋钮：摘要攻击性、检索广度(k)和删除模式，并引入Forgetting Residue Score（FRS）量化删除后从派生记忆层恢复信息的可能性。
Result: 关键事实摘要压缩使Gemma 3 12B的提取率降低76%，GPT-4o-mini降低64%，同时几乎保持个性化召回；但原始删除后FRS显示约20%实例中存在可恢复的摘要副本，只有全流水线清除或墓碑重写才能将最差层残余降至零。
Conclusion: 持久代理记忆必须作为第一类记忆机制进行评估，从帮助代理回忆的内容、可被提取的内容以及真正可擦除的内容三个维度衡量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MeCo: One-Step MeanFlow-based Corrector for Multi-Channel Speech Separation
papers.abstract_en: While discriminative models for multi-channel speech separation excel in reference-based metrics, they often exhibit suboptimal human listening quality. To address this, we propose a novel MeanFlow-based one-step generative corrector (MeCo). MeCo learns a conditional average velocity field to map discriminative estimates directly onto the clean speech manifold in a single step. To maximize one-step generation performance, we introduce Data-Space Optimization (DSO). DSO integrates an $\mathbf{x}_r$-loss, which penalizes prediction errors on longer displacement intervals to serve as a generative objective for human listening quality, with an Endpoint SI-SDR loss that directly optimizes terminal signal fidelity. Experiments demonstrate that MeCo achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance with minimal computational overhead, simultaneously achieving superior signal fidelity and human listening quality in both in-domain and out-of-domain scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MeCo，一种基于MeanFlow的一步生成式校正器，用于多通道语音分离。MeCo通过学习条件平均速度场，将鉴别性估计一步映射到干净语音流形。引入数据空间优化（DSO），结合x_r损失和端点SI-SDR损失，提升生成质量和信号保真度。实验表明，MeCo在域内和域外场景均达到SOTA，计算开销小。
Motivation: 鉴别的多通道语音分离模型在参考指标上表现优异，但人类听觉质量欠佳，需要一种能提升感知质量的生成式校正方法。
Method: 提出MeanFlow-based一步生成校正器MeCo，学习条件平均速度场实现单步映射；同时提出数据空间优化（DSO），联合优化x_r损失（惩罚长位移预测误差）和端点SI-SDR损失（直接优化终端信号保真度）。
Result: 实验表明，MeCo在域内和域外场景均取得最优的信号保真度和人类听觉质量，且计算开销极小。
Conclusion: MeCo以极小计算代价同时提升多通道语音分离的信号保真度和人类听觉质量，适用于域内及域外场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EasyLens: A Training-Free Plug-and-Play Subtle-Lesion Representation Amplifier for Medical Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) have shown increasing potential for clinical image interpretation, including lesion detection and report generation. However, their practical utility remains limited by insufficient sensitivity to subtle lesions, whose visual evidence is often sparse, low-contrast, and embedded within complex anatomical context. As local visual tokens are aggregated, these weak lesion cues can become underrepresented in global image representations, making them difficult for medical VLMs to recognize. Existing efforts to improve lesion sensitivity mainly rely on medical-domain vision-encoder pre-training, clinical-term-guided alignment, or trainable pathological representation enhancement. Although effective, these approaches usually require additional training or model-specific adaptation and may overfit to particular disease morphologies, limiting their applicability to frozen medical VLMs. To address these limitations, we propose EasyLens, a training-free plug-and-play subtle-lesion representation amplifier for medical VLMs. EasyLens first constructs EasyBank, a pathology-anatomy prototype space that provides lesion-related prototypes and anatomy-aware normal references for comparing suspicious patches against both pathological and normal anatomical patterns. To avoid blindly amplifying normal tissues, EasyTag selects lesion-relevant patches through counterfactual prototype reasoning. To counteract the dilution of subtle lesion cues in global image representations, EasyAmplifier strengthens the selected lesion-relevant patch representations through morphology-guided residual enhancement, thereby increasing their contribution to the global image embedding. Experiments on multiple medical image datasets and frozen medical VLM backbones show that EasyLens improves subtle-lesion detection and outperforms existing encoder-enhancement baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EasyLens，一种无需训练、即插即用的细微病变表示放大器，用于增强医学视觉语言模型（VLMs）对细微病变的敏感性。该方法通过构建病理-解剖原型空间（EasyBank）、基于反事实原型推理的病变补丁选择（EasyTag）以及形态引导的残差增强（EasyAmplifier），在不修改冻结的VLM主干的情况下提升病变检测性能。实验表明EasyLens在多个医学影像数据集上优于现有的编码器增强基线。
Motivation: 现有医学VLMs对细微病变（如低对比度、稀疏视觉证据的病变）敏感性不足，而现有的增强方法通常需要额外训练或模型特定调整，且可能过拟合特定病变形态，限制了其在冻结VLMs上的适用性。
Method: EasyLens包含三个组件：EasyBank（病理-解剖原型空间，提供病变相关原型和解剖学正常参考）、EasyTag（通过反事实原型推理选择病变相关补丁）、EasyAmplifier（通过形态引导的残差增强强化所选补丁的表示，增加其在全局图像嵌入中的贡献）。该方法无需训练，即插即用。
Result: 在多个医学影像数据集和冻结的医学VLM主干上，EasyLens改进了细微病变检测，并优于现有的编码器增强基线。
Conclusion: EasyLens提供了一种无需训练的即插即用方案，有效提升冻结医学VLMs对细微病变的敏感性，且不依赖特定病变形态。

papers.title: A Sliced-Wasserstein Framework on Correlation Matrices for EEG Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Electroencephalography (EEG) offers noninvasive, millisecond resolution recordings of neuronal activity and is widely used in neuroscience and healthcare. Many EEG decoding pipelines rely on covariance descriptors for their robustness to noise, but such representations are sensitive to channel-wise scaling. Recent studies have therefore advocated full-rank correlation matrices as a scale-invariant alternative for EEG decoding. In this paper, we study Sliced-Wasserstein (SW) discrepancies for probability distributions on the manifold of full-rank correlation matrices. We adopt the pullback-Euclidean formulation of SW, referred to as Pullback Euclidean Metric Sliced-Wasserstein (PEMSW), and instantiate it under two recently introduced correlation geometries, \textit{i.e.}, the Off-Log Metric (OLM) and Log-Scaled Metric (LSM). This yields two Correlation Sliced-Wasserstein (CorSW) discrepancies with closed-form slicing coordinates and efficient computation through one-dimensional Wasserstein distances. Building on CorSW, we further develop a domain generalization (DG) framework for EEG decoding. Experiments on three EEG datasets demonstrate improved generalization under distribution shifts, with low training overhead and no additional inference cost. The source code is available at github.com/ChenHu-ML/CorSW.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于Sliced-Wasserstein框架的相关矩阵EEG解码方法，通过Pullback Euclidean Metric Sliced-Wasserstein (PEMSW) 和两种相关几何度量（OLM和LSM）构建CorSW差异，并在此基础上开发领域泛化框架。实验在三个EEG数据集上证明该方法在分布偏移下泛化性能提升，且训练开销低、无额外推理成本。
Motivation: EEG解码中常用的协方差描述子对通道缩放敏感，而全秩相关矩阵作为尺度不变替代具有优势，但现有方法在流形上的概率分布差异计算不够高效。
Method: 采用Pullback Euclidean Metrics的Sliced-Wasserstein公式，在两种相关几何（Off-Log Metric和Log-Scaled Metric）下实例化，得到闭式切片坐标和高效计算的一维Wasserstein距离，进而构建CorSW差异并用于领域泛化。
Result: 在三个EEG数据集上，所提方法在分布偏移下泛化性能提升，且训练开销低、无额外推理成本。
Conclusion: CorSW框架为EEG解码提供了一种高效、尺度不变的领域泛化方法，代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Autonomous heterogeneous catalyst discovery with a self-evolving multi-agent digital twin
papers.abstract_en: Theoretical heterogeneous catalysis promises rapid catalyst discovery, yet computational and machine-learning predictions often deviate from experiment and stay confined to narrow material families, for want of a faithful, condition-aware catalytic simulator. We present CatDT (Catalysis Digital Twin), a self-evolving multi-agent system that builds an autonomous digital twin of a working catalyst, unifying gas-solid and liquid-solid modeling. From only a bulk crystal and a natural-language reaction description, eight specialized agents and 27 scientific tools predict stable facets, reconstruct working surfaces, enumerate and rank reaction pathways, locate transition states, and compute kinetics in 5-30 min on a single GPU. Two innovations address the hardest steps: UniMech finds dominant pathways for novel materials at over $10^3\times$ lower cost than exhaustive enumeration by fusing agent-guided proposals with energy-cached graph search, and a memory-augmented reinforcement loop raises barrier-calculation success from 41% to 84% across 600 catalytic surfaces. Across seven gas-solid benchmarks -- stepped metals, single-atom catalysts, ordered intermetallics, vacancy-rich 2D sulfides and carbides, and a strong-metal--support-interaction (SMSI) interface -- every CatDT prediction lies within 0.5-2 times experiment over four orders of magnitude. For propane dehydrogenation, CatDT independently discovers non-precious candidates rivaling the Pt-based industrial benchmark, with a proposed Ni@ZrO$_2$ SMSI overlayer reaching a simulated TOF of $1.63~\text{s}^{-1}$ at $\sim$100% selectivity. More broadly, the decisive factor for a faithful catalyst digital twin -- or any multi-stage scientific simulator -- is not raw LLM capability but the engineered harness around it: deterministic tools, persistent memory, and verified self-improvement that compound across models, tools, and runs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CatDT（Catalysis Digital Twin），一种自演进的多智能体数字孪生系统，用于自主发现异相催化剂。从块体晶体和自然语言反应描述出发，系统在 5-30 分钟内通过 8 个专门智能体和 27 个科学工具预测稳定面、重建工作表面、枚举反应路径、定位过渡态并计算动力学。两项关键创新：UniMech 将主导路径发现成本降低超过三个数量级，记忆增强强化循环将势垒计算成功率从 41% 提升至 84%。在七个气固相催化基准上，所有预测与实验值偏差在 0.5-2 倍以内。
Motivation: 理论催化预测常与实验偏离，且仅局限于窄的材料家族，缺乏忠实且条件感知的催化模拟器，这是限制催化剂快速自主发现的主要瓶颈。
Method: 构建 CatDT 多智能体系统，集成 8 个智能体和 27 个确定性工具；提出 UniMech 算法，通过智能体引导提议与能量缓存图搜索结合，以超 1000 倍效率发现主导反应路径；设计记忆增强强化循环，使过渡态搜索成功率从 41% 提升至 84%。
Result: 在阶梯金属、单原子催化剂、有序金属间化合物、富含空位的 2D 硫化物/碳化物以及 SMSI 界面等七个气固相基准上，所有预测覆盖四个数量级，与实验值偏差均在 0.5-2 倍以内。丙烷脱氢任务中，CatDT 自主发现的 Ni@ZrO₂ SMSI 覆盖层模拟 TOF 达 1.63 s⁻¹，选择性接近 100%，可媲美 Pt 基工业基准。
Conclusion: 论文强调，构建忠实催化剂数字孪生的关键并非 LLM 的原始能力，而是围绕其构建的工程框架（确定性工具、持久记忆、跨模型和运行的验证性自我改进），这一结论可推广至多阶段科学模拟器。

papers.title: When RLHF Fails: A Mechanistic Taxonomy of Reward Hacking, Collapse, and Evaluator Gaming
papers.abstract_en: RLHF evaluation should track how failures emerge, where they localize, and which warning signals appear before external quality degrades. We study this problem with a compact RLHF pipeline built for this paper, including PPO, DPO, uncertainty-penalized PPO (UP-PPO), reward-model uncertainty, approximate policy drift, diversity and repetition diagnostics, and two external LLM judges. Rather than treating reward hacking as a single terminal event, we classify matched checkpoint and prompt-level transitions by the directions of learned reward R_phi, judge scores R_dag and R2_dag, and their average R_dag. The main empirical findings are that aggressive PPO produces the clearest localized reward-hacking signal, UP-PPO reduces but does not eliminate that signal, row-level diagnostics reveal failures hidden by checkpoint averages, and pre-transition features partially anticipate future localized reward hacking. The central conclusion is methodological: RLHF failures are training dynamics that can be classified, localized, and partially anticipated, not only final-model pathologies. The repository is available at github.com/zabahana/rlhf-failure-modes-diagnostics. The pipeline is also deployed as a live interactive web demo for model comparison and diagnostic views at rlhf-failures.zelalem.ai.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 8 figures; includes code, artifacts, and live demo
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过构建包含PPO、DPO、UP-PPO等方法的紧凑RLHF管线，系统研究了奖励黑客、训练崩溃和评估者作弊等失败模式的分类、定位和预警信号。主要发现包括：激进PPO产生最清晰的局部奖励黑客信号；UP-PPO减少但不消除该信号；逐行诊断能揭示被检查点平均掩盖的失败；部分过渡前的特征可提前预测局部奖励黑客。最终方法论结论是RLHF失败是训练动态，可分类、定位和部分预测。
Motivation: 现有RLHF评估缺乏对失败模式如何出现、定位在何处以及外部质量下降前出现哪些预警信号的系统研究。
Method: 构建紧凑RLHF管线，包括PPO、DPO、不确定性惩罚PPO（UP-PPO）、奖励模型不确定性、近似策略漂移、多样性和重复诊断，以及两个外部LLM评判器。对匹配的检查点和提示级别过渡，根据学习奖励R_phi、评判分数R_dag和R2_dag及其平均值的方向进行分类。
Result: 激进PPO产生最清晰的局部奖励黑客信号；UP-PPO减少但不消除该信号；逐行诊断揭示被检查点平均掩盖的失败；过渡前特征可部分预测未来的局部奖励黑客。
Conclusion: RLHF失败是训练动态，可以分类、定位和部分预测，而不仅仅是最终模型病理。代码和交互式演示已在线上公开。

papers.title: From Performance to Viability: A Bootstrap Framework for Latent-Space Representation Learning in Adaptive Biological Systems
papers.abstract_en: Observable performance is commonly used to characterize biological systems. In adaptive systems, however, similar performances may arise from distinct organizations, and configurations that appear comparable at a given time may follow different longitudinal trajectories. This limitation motivates a methodological framework for moving beyond performance-based interpretation without assuming a complete mechanistic model in advance. This article proposes a bootstrap framework for latent-space representation learning in adaptive biological systems. Here, bootstrap is used in a methodological and epistemological sense: theory is not imposed a priori, but progressively emerges from the limitations encountered in observation. The framework is organized around five levels: observable performance, dynamic organization, latent organization, observed longitudinal viability, and internal predictive approximation. The framework is illustrated by three previously reported gait-occlusion studies, used here only as a methodological case sequence and not as new experimental evidence. The article formalizes how performance analysis led to latent organization, how static latent organization led to observed longitudinal viability, and how observed viability led to internal predictive approximation. The contribution is therefore not a new learning algorithm, clinical protocol, or dataset, but a bootstrap framework for latent-space representation learning describing how increasingly informative representations can emerge from observational insufficiencies in adaptive biological data.
papers.comment: 25 pages. Methodological framework for latent-space representation learning in adaptive biological systems
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个针对自适应生物系统的潜在空间表示学习的自举框架，包含五个层级：可观察性能、动态组织、潜在组织、观察到的纵向可行性和内部预测近似。框架通过三个步态遮挡研究案例进行方法性说明，旨在从观测局限性中逐步提取信息更丰富的表征。
Motivation: 可观察性能不足以刻画自适应生物系统的内在多样性，相同性能可能源自不同组织且随时间轨迹不同。需要超越基于性能的解释，又不假设完整的先验机制模型。
Method: 提出一个五层级自举框架：从可观察性能导出动态组织，再导出潜在组织，再导出观察到的纵向可行性，最后导出内部预测近似。理论并非先验施加，而是从观测局限性中逐步涌现。
Result: 通过三个既往步态遮挡研究作为方法案例序列，展示了框架如何从性能分析引导出潜在组织，从静态潜在组织引导出纵向可行性观察，再从纵向可行性观察引导出内部预测近似。
Conclusion: 该框架不是新学习算法、临床协议或数据集，而是一个方法论框架，描述如何从自适应生物数据的观测不足中涌现出越来越有信息量的潜在表征。

papers.title: Benchmarking Recursive-Collapse Warning Claims Under Matched False-Positive Control
papers.abstract_en: Recursive systems can enter collapse-like regimes -- self-reinforcing amplification, persistent recursion, and narrowing diversity that mask accelerating internal degradation -- before overt failure becomes visible. We introduce Loopzero, a claim-bounded benchmark framework for testing whether recursive failures follow a directional telemetry pattern: rising gain (G), recursive persistence (p), and declining diversity ($δ$). The claim boundary is specified in Lean; the Lean artifact does not verify real telemetry, benchmark validity, or detector performance. We evaluate the bridge on two frozen public-artifact benchmarks: a segmented public-markets benchmark (Volmageddon 2018, COVID MWCB 2020) and a MovieLens-25M offline deterministic recommender replay. Detectors are evaluated under a locked equal-false-positive contract (FP $\in$ [0.03, 0.07], pre-registered) so all configurations face the same alert budget. Neither tested standard comparators nor Loopzero's pre-registered quantile detector achieved an accepted operating point. Directional witness alignment held on both canonical benchmarks, with adjacent-horizon and row-level limitations disclosed. Digitized Shumailov et al. (2024) LLM training-loop trajectories are directionally consistent with the pattern; matched-FP evaluation in that domain is deferred. The contribution is a reproducible, falsifiable benchmark framework for evaluating recursive-collapse warning claims under an explicit alert-budget contract -- non-acceptance reported as a first-class scientific outcome.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables; supplementary materials: 9 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Code, derived data packets, and Lean artifact: https://github.com/davidmullett/loopzero-paper-public (release tag lean-v1.0)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Loopzero，一个声明有界的基准测试框架，用于在匹配假阳性控制条件下检验递归系统崩溃预警声明。框架将预警模式定义为增益上升、递归持久性和多样性下降三个方向性遥测指标，并在两个冻结公共基准（Volmageddon 2018、COVID MWCB 2020市场基准和MovieLens-25M推荐系统重放）上评估检测器。在固定假阳性率预算（0.03-0.07）下，标准比较器和Loopzero的预注册分位数检测器均未达到可接受工作点，但方向性证据一致。论文强调以非接受作为首要科学结果的可重复、可证伪评估框架。
Motivation: 递归系统在显性失效前可能进入崩溃类状态（自增强放大、持续递归、多样性下降），但缺乏可重复的基准测试来验证这类预警声明。
Method: 提出Loopzero框架，用Lean形式化声明边界，定义增益(G)、递归持续性(p)和多样性(δ)三个方向性遥测模式；在冻结公共基准上评估，所有检测器在预注册的锁定额定假阳性率（0.03-0.07）下比较。
Result: 标准比较器与Loopzero的预注册分位数检测器均未达到可接受工作点；方向性证据在基准上一致，但存在相邻视界和行级限制；数字化Shumailov等人LLM训练轨迹在方向上一致但未在匹配FP条件下评估。
Conclusion: 贡献是一个可重复、可证伪的递归崩溃预警评估基准框架，将非接受作为第一类科学结果报告，强调明确警报预算合同的重要性。

papers.title: Correcting Visual Blur Induced by Attention Distraction to Reduce Hallucinations: Algorithm and Theory
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) frequently suffer from object hallucinations, yet the visual perceptual mechanism underlying this failure remains poorly understood. In this work, we reveal that hallucinations are strongly associated with a human-like attention distraction phenomenon, where humans under divided focus experience degraded visual clarity and produce inaccurate descriptions, while in models the same mechanism manifests as spatial inconsistency in multi-head attention and temporal fading of attention to image tokens during decoding. We further provide theoretical insights that attention dispersion increases model complexity and degrades classification generalization. Motivated by these findings, we propose an Attention-Focused Approach for Improved Image Perception (AFIP), which corrects attention distraction via cross-head attention enrichment and reinforces visual grounding through dynamic historical attention enhancement. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks and models validate the effectiveness of AFIP without additional training. Code is available at: https://github.com/MIKUZ12/AFIP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示了多模态大模型（MLLMs）中的物体幻觉与类似人类的注意力分散现象密切相关，表现为多头注意力空间不一致和解码过程中对图像令牌的注意力时间衰减。理论分析表明注意力分散增加模型复杂度并降低分类泛化。提出无需额外训练的注意力聚焦方法AFIP，通过跨头注意力丰富和动态历史注意力增强来纠正注意力分散，在多个基准上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 多模态大模型常出现物体幻觉，但其视觉感知机制尚不清楚；本文旨在揭示幻觉与注意力分散的关联并提供理论解释。
Method: 提出AFIP方法，包含两种技术：跨头注意力丰富（cross-head attention enrichment）纠正注意力分散，动态历史注意力增强（dynamic historical attention enhancement）强化视觉基础。
Result: 在多个基准和模型上实验表明，AFIP无需额外训练即可有效减少幻觉。
Conclusion: 注意力分散是导致幻觉的关键因素，通过矫正注意力可提升图像感知质量，无需重新训练模型。

papers.title: Coupling-Robust Accuracy in Multiphysics Physics Informed Neural Networks via Kronecker-Preconditioned Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) for coupled multiphysics systems suffer systematic accuracy degradation as inter-equation coupling strengthens. We provide a theoretical explanation through neural tangent kernel (NTK) analysis: for linearly coupled systems, the standard NTK's spectral radius grows as $Ω(γ^2)$ with coupling strength $γ$, shrinking the stable learning rate, while block-diagonal Gauss--Newton (GN) preconditioning yields a preconditioned NTK $K_P = JH^{+}J^\top$ whose spectral radius is bounded by $S$ (number of networks), independent of $γ$. Adam's diagonal preconditioning destroys this projector structure -- inflating $λ_{\max}$ far above $S$ for any coupling type -- and its residual-dynamics kernel grows as $Θ(γ)$, placing its stable learning rate strictly between gradient descent and GN. For one-way coupling the limitation is class-wide: no diagonal preconditioner, fixed or adaptive, halves the driving residual in fewer than $Ω(γ)$ iterations ($Ω(γ^2)$ if fixed), whereas block-diagonal GN requires $O(1)$. We verify $Ω(γ^2)$ growth across linearly coupled benchmarks and confirm $λ_{\max}(K_P) = S$ in all three 1D systems, including nonlinearly coupled NP+P. Combining the Kronecker-preconditioned optimizer SOAP with inverse-gradient-norm loss balancing (SOAP+GradNorm) yields coupling-robust accuracy: across 222 experiments spanning three 1D systems and a 2D electroosmotic flow benchmark, SOAP+GradNorm maintains final-epoch $L_2$ accuracy across coupling strengths, with $\leq 2.3\times$ degradation in nonlinear NP+P while Adam+GradNorm fails ($L_2 > 0.1$). SOAP+GradNorm further scales to a 2D, 6-PDE electroosmotic flow at EDL-resolved conditions down to $\varepsilon = 0.01$ -- a regime all prior PINN electrokinetics studies have avoided -- where Adam+GradNorm fails entirely ($L_2 > 0.3$).

papers.title: CriterAlign: Criterion-Centric Rationale Alignment for Code Preference Judging
papers.abstract_en: Pairwise human preference prediction is central to evaluating code-generation systems, where quality often depends on task-specific trade-offs beyond functional correctness. While rubric-based LLM judges improve interpretability by decomposing evaluation into explicit criteria, most existing pipelines remain pointwise: they score each response independently and derive preferences by comparing aggregated scores. We show that this design is poorly matched to pairwise code preference prediction and can underperform a strong monolithic judge. We propose CriterAlign, a criterion-centric framework that adapts rubric-based judging to pairwise preference evaluation through direct criterion-level pairwise judgments, tie-driven criterion refinement, swap-consistency filtering, and final pairwise synthesis. We further introduce Human-Preference-Aligned Guidance (HPAG), synthesized offline from training examples by extracting recurring rationale gaps between human preferences and monolithic judge predictions, and injected into the criterion generator, criterion judge, and final judge. On BigCodeReward, CriterAlign improves a Qwen2.5-VL-32B monolithic judge from 60.4% to 66.3% accuracy, with ablations confirming the contributions of pairwise criterion design and HPAG.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CriterAlign框架，将基于标准的代码偏好判断从逐点评分改为成对判断，通过直接的标准级成对偏好、平局驱动的标准细化、交换一致性过滤和最终成对合成来提高准确性。引入HPAG从训练示例中离线提取人类偏好与单点判断之间的推理差距，并注入到标准生成器、标准判断器和最终判断器中。在BigCodeReward上，将Qwen2.5-VL-32B单点判断器的准确率从60.4%提升到66.3%。
Motivation: 现有的基于评分标准的LLM判断器虽然通过分解标准提高了可解释性，但大多数仍是逐点评分，然后汇总分数得出偏好，这种设计不适合成对代码偏好预测，甚至可能不如强大的单点判断器。
Method: 提出CriterAlign框架，包含标准级成对判断、平局驱动的标准细化、交换一致性过滤和成对合成；同时提出HPAG，离线从训练样本中提取人类偏好与单点判断之间的推理差距，用于增强标准生成器、标准判断器和最终判断器。
Result: 在BigCodeReward基准上，将Qwen2.5-VL-32B单点判断器的准确率从60.4%提升到66.3%。消融实验证实了成对标准设计和HPAG的贡献。
Conclusion: 基于标准的成对判断框架相比逐点汇总更能提升代码偏好预测的准确性，HPAG能有效利用人类偏好的推理模式。

papers.title: MasFACT: Continual Multi-Agent Topology Learning via Geometry-Aware Posterior Transfer
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems (MAS) powered by large language models (LLMs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for complex problem solving, where performance critically depends on the underlying inter-agent communication topology. However, existing topology generation methods mainly optimize for isolated tasks, while real-world deployments involve streams of evolving tasks, requiring previously effective collaboration patterns to be retained and reused rather than rediscovered or overwritten. We identify a previously underexplored failure mode, \emph{topology forgetting}, in which adapting to new tasks shifts the topology generator away from communication structures required by earlier tasks. This issue stems from cross-task misalignment in both agent-level functional semantics and relational communication structures. To address this challenge, we propose \textbf{\textsc{MasFACT}}, a geometry-aware posterior transfer framework that preserves and reuses historical collaboration knowledge as transferable topology priors. We transfer these priors across task-specific agent spaces through Fused Gromov-Wasserstein optimal transport and perform PAC-Bayes-guided conservative posterior adaptation to balance task-specific plasticity with structural stability. Experiments across class-, domain-, and task-level continual settings demonstrate that \textsc{MasFACT} consistently improves average accuracy while reducing topology forgetting compared to strong topology generation and replay-based baselines, and can be seamlessly integrated with different MAS topology generators.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MasFACT框架，用于多智能体系统（MAS）中持续学习下的拓扑生成问题。该框架通过几何感知的后验迁移，利用Fused Gromov-Wasserstein最优传输保留历史协作知识，并采用PAC-Bayes引导的保守后验自适应来平衡任务特定可塑性与结构稳定性。实验表明，MasFACT在多种持续学习设置下优于现有基线，并减少了拓扑遗忘。
Motivation: 现有拓扑生成方法主要针对孤立任务优化，而实际部署中任务不断演化，导致先前有效的协作模式被遗忘（拓扑遗忘）。该问题源于跨任务在智能体功能语义和关系通信结构上的不一致。
Method: 提出MasFACT框架，通过Fused Gromov-Wasserstein最优传输将历史拓扑先验迁移到新任务智能体空间，并采用PAC-Bayes引导的保守后验自适应以平衡可塑性与稳定性。
Result: 在类别、领域和任务级别的持续学习场景中，MasFACT相比强拓扑生成和基于回放的基线，一致提高了平均准确率并降低了拓扑遗忘。
Conclusion: MasFACT能有效缓解多智能体系统中的拓扑遗忘，且可无缝集成不同MAS拓扑生成器。

papers.title: Second-Order Actor-Critic Methods for Discounted MDPs via Policy Hessian Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: We address the discounted reward setting in reinforcement learning (RL). To mitigate the value approximation challenges in policy gradient methods, actor-critic approaches have been developed and are known to converge to stationary points under suitable assumptions. However, these methods rely on first-order updates. In contrast, second-order optimization provides principled curvature-aware updates that are proven to accelerate convergence, but its application in RL is limited by the computational complexity of Hessian estimation. In this work, we analyze second-order approximations for the actor update that leverage the full curvature information of the objective as much as possible. A stable approximation requires treating the action-value function as locally constant with respect to policy parameters, which does not generally hold in policy gradient methods. We show that this approximation becomes well-justified under a two-timescale actor-critic framework, where the critic evolves on a faster timescale and can be treated as quasi-stationary during actor updates. Building on this insight, we formulate a second-order actor-critic method for the discounted reward setting that leverages Hessian-vector product (HVP) computations, resulting in a computationally efficient and stable second-order update.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 2 figures including Appendix with Detailed proofs
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对折扣奖励强化学习中的策略梯度方法，提出利用Hessian-vector product（HVP）实现的计算高效且稳定的二阶Actor-Critic更新。通过双时间尺度框架证明，当Critic以更快时间演化时，值函数可被视为关于Actor参数局部常数，从而使二阶近似合理。该方法在理论上提供了曲率感知的更新方向，旨在加速收敛。
Motivation: 一阶Actor-Critic方法收敛到稳定点但缺乏曲率信息，二阶优化可加速收敛但Hessian估计在RL中计算复杂。本文旨在设计一种计算可行且稳定的二阶更新方法，突破这一瓶颈。
Method: 在双时间尺度Actor-Critic框架下，利用Critic的更快时间尺度使值函数相对Actor准静态，从而将动作值函数近似为局部常数。基于此，通过Hessian-vector product（HVP）实现二阶更新，避免显式计算完整Hessian矩阵。
Result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，但声称所提方法在计算上高效且更新稳定。
Conclusion: 本文为折扣奖励RL提供了一种理论上合理的二阶Actor-Critic方法，利用HVP降低了二阶优化的计算成本，同时保持了稳定性。

papers.title: Before the Last Token: Diagnosing Final-Token Safety Probe Failures
papers.abstract_en: Final-token safety probes monitor a single hidden state after prompt prefill, but jailbreak prompts can contain probe-visible unsafe evidence distributed across earlier user-token representations that is missed by this readout. We study this prefill-time failure mode using SafeSwitch-style probes trained only on clean harmful and benign prompts across three instruction-tuned LLMs. The probes achieve high recall on clean harmful prompts, but miss many jailbreaks and can produce false positives on safety-adjacent benign prompts. Subspace analyses suggest that missed jailbreaks differ from clean benign prompts along directions that are poorly captured by the probe's representational subspace, and increasing probe bottleneck width does not reliably resolve this mismatch. Token-level prefill analyses reveal that probe-visible unsafe evidence often appears earlier in the sequence but is not exposed at the final-token readout, while naive max-pooling over token positions overfires on safe prompts. A simple PCA-HMM trajectory model, trained only on the same clean split, recovers many final-token misses from user-content prefill trajectories without the catastrophic false-positive behavior of naive token pooling, motivating trajectory-aware hidden-state analyses as diagnostic complements to final-token probes
papers.comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. Accepted at the ICML 2026 Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop and the ICML 2026 Failure Modes in Agentic AI Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于最终token的安全探针在检测有害提示时的失败模式。作者发现，越狱提示中的危害证据经常出现在预填充阶段的早期用户token表示中，但被最终token读取点遗漏。通过子空间分析和令牌级分析，他们提出一个简单的PCA-HMM轨迹模型，仅利用干净数据即可恢复许多最终token遗漏的检测，且不会产生朴素最大池化带来的灾难性误报。
Motivation: 现有安全探针仅监控提示预填充后的最终隐藏状态，容易受到越狱提示的规避，因为危害证据可能分布在早期token中。
Method: 使用SafeSwitch式探针在三个指令微调LLM上训练，进行子空间分析、不同瓶颈宽度实验，以及令牌级预填充分析。提出PCA-HMM轨迹模型，仅基于同一干净分割数据，利用用户内容预填充轨迹进行检测。
Result: 探针对干净有害提示召回率高，但遗漏许多越狱提示并对安全相关良性提示产生误报。增加瓶颈宽度不能可靠解决匹配问题。令牌级分析表明危害证据常在早期出现但未在最终token暴露；PCA-HMM模型恢复了最终token遗漏，且无朴素最大池化的灾难性误报。
Conclusion: 论文强调轨迹感知的隐藏状态分析可作为最终token探针的诊断补充，但本身并非完整的安全方案。

papers.title: LoKA: Low-precision Kernel Applications for Recommendation Models At Scale
papers.abstract_en: Recent GPU generations deliver significantly higher FLOPs using lower-precision arithmetic, such as FP8. While successfully applied to large language models (LLMs), its adoption in large recommendation models (LRMs) has been limited. This is because LRMs are numerically sensitive, dominated by small matrix multiplications (GEMMs) followed by normalization, and trained in communication-intensive environments. Applying FP8 directly to LRMs often degrades model quality and prolongs training time. These challenges are inherent to LRM workloads and cannot be resolved merely by introducing better FP8 kernels. Instead, a system-model co-design approach is needed to successfully integrate FP8. We present LoKA (Low-precision Kernel Applications), a framework that makes FP8 practical for LRMs through three principles: profile under realistic distributions to know where low precision is safe, co-design model components with hardware to expand where it is safe, and orchestrate across kernel libraries to maximize the gains. Concretely, LoKA Probe is a statistically grounded, online benchmarking method that learns activation and weight statistics, and quantifies per-layer errors. This process pinpoints safe and unsafe, fast and slow sites for FP8 adoption. LoKA Mods is a set of reusable model adaptations that improve both numerical stability and execution efficiency with FP8. LoKA Dispatch is a runtime that leverages the statistical insights from LoKA Probe to select the fastest FP8 kernel that satisfies the accuracy requirements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LoKA 框架，通过系统-模型协同设计使 FP8 低精度算术在大规模推荐模型（LRMs）中实用。LoKA 包含三个组件：LoKA Probe 用于在线统计基准测试以定位可安全使用 FP8 的层；LoKA Mods 提供模型适配改进数值稳定性和执行效率；LoKA Dispatch 运行时根据统计信息选择满足精度要求的最快 FP8 内核。摘要声称该方法解决了 LRM 数值敏感、小矩阵乘法多、通信密集等挑战，而直接应用 FP8 会降低模型质量并延长训练时间。
Motivation: FP8 低精度算术在 LLM 中成功，但在 LRM 中应用受限，因为 LRM 数值敏感、以小矩阵乘法为主且训练通信密集，直接使用 FP8 会损害模型质量并增加训练时间。
Method: LoKA 框架包含三部分：LoKA Probe 基于统计的在线基准测试，学习激活和权重统计并量化逐层误差；LoKA Mods 一组可复用的模型适配改进数值稳定性和执行效率；LoKA Dispatch 运行时根据 Probe 的统计信息选择满足精度要求的最快 FP8 内核。
Result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，但声称该方法使 FP8 在 LRM 中实用，解决了精度和效率问题。
Conclusion: FP8 在 LRM 中的成功需要系统-模型协同设计，而非仅靠更好的 FP8 内核；LoKA 提供了三条原则（Profile、Co-design、Orchestrate）来实现这一目标。

papers.title: The Proxy Presumption: From Semantic Embeddings to Valid Social Measures
papers.abstract_en: Natural Language Processing is rapidly evolving into a primary instrument for Computational Social Science, with researchers increasingly using embeddings to measure latent constructs such as novelty, creativity, and bias. However, this transition faces a fundamental validity challenge: the ''Proxy Presumption,'' or the reliance on geometric properties (e.g., cosine distance) as direct measures of social concepts. We argue that without explicit validation, unsupervised representations remain entangled mixtures of the target construct ($C$) and confounding attributes ($Z$) like topic, style, and authorship. To bridge the gap between semantic embeddings and valid social measures, we introduce the Construct Validity Protocol (CVP). Drawing on causal representation learning and psychometrics, the CVP offers a rigorous pipeline from conceptualization to quantitative verification. We further propose Counterfactual Neutralization, a novel method using LLMs to reduce confounding in embedding space. By providing a standardized Validity Suite -- including tests for discriminant, incremental, and predictive validity -- this work offers the community a toolkit to transform heuristic proxies into robust, scientifically defensible instruments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出自然语言处理中利用嵌入向量测量社会概念（如新颖性、创造力、偏见）时存在“代理假设”效度问题，即余弦距离等几何性质被直接视为社会概念的量度，但缺乏显式验证导致测量结果混入主题、风格等混淆因素。作者提出构造效度协议（CVP），融合因果表示学习和心理测量学，并提供基于LLM的反事实中和（Counterfactual Neutralization）方法以减少嵌入空间中的混淆，同时提供一套标准化效度测试套件（包括判别效度、增量效度、预测效度）来将启发式代理转化为科学可靠的测量工具。
Motivation: 现有研究在利用词嵌入测量社会概念时，普遍依赖未经验证的几何性质作为直接量度，导致测量结果混入目标构念和混淆属性，缺乏科学效度支持。
Method: 提出构造效度协议（CVP），其核心是反事实中和（Counterfactual Neutralization）方法，利用LLM在嵌入空间中消除混淆变量影响；同时提供包含判别、增量和预测效度的标准化测试套件。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但声称提供了将启发式代理转化为科学可辩护测量工具的标准化流程和套件。
Conclusion: 通过CVP和反事实中和，可弥合语义嵌入与有效社会测量之间的鸿沟，但未讨论其适用范围或局限性。

papers.title: Wasserstein Distributionally Robust Regret Optimization for Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) is a central post-training tool for aligning large language models, but its training reward is only a learned proxy for true human utility. This creates a decision problem under objective misspecification: the policy is optimized against an estimated reward, while deployment performance is governed by an unobserved population preference. The resulting gap leads to reward over-optimization, where proxy reward keeps improving after true quality deteriorates. We propose distributionally robust regret optimization (DRRO) for RLHF with a Wasserstein ambiguity set over reward laws, using promptwise $\ell_p$ distances between reward vectors as transport costs. Unlike standard distributionally robust optimization, which pessimizes worst-case value, DRRO pessimizes worst-case regret relative to the best policy under the same plausible reward perturbation. We show that the expressive-policy problem decomposes into promptwise regret problems. For each prompt, the inner adversary has a dual-norm closed form; under the $\ell_1$ transport cost used by our algorithm, the optimizer has a water-filling structure. These results lead to a practical policy-gradient algorithm that adds a simple sampled bonus to GRPO-style training. Theory and experiments both show that DRRO is less over-pessimistic than standard DRO and mitigates over-optimization more effectively than existing baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对RLHF中因奖励代理导致的目标错配和奖励过度优化问题，提出Wasserstein分布鲁棒遗憾优化（DRRO）方法。该方法构造Wasserstein模糊集，以promptwise ℓ_p距离为运输成本，优化最坏情况遗憾而非最坏情况回报。理论证明问题可分解为每个prompt的遗憾问题，内层对手有对偶范数闭式解，ℓ1成本下优化器具有water-filling结构，最终导出实用的策略梯度算法。实验表明DRRO比标准DRO更少过度悲观，且更有效缓解过度优化。
Motivation: RLHF中训练奖励是真实人类偏好的代理，存在目标错配，导致奖励过度优化（proxy reward提升而真正质量下降）。现有分布鲁棒优化方法过于悲观，需要更精确的鲁棒优化框架。
Method: 提出分布鲁棒遗憾优化（DRRO），使用Wasserstein模糊集（以promptwise ℓ_p距离为运输成本），优化最坏情况遗憾（相对于同一扰动下最优策略的回报差）。问题分解为每个prompt的遗憾子问题，内层对手有对偶范数闭式解，ℓ1运输成本下优化器具有water-filling结构，最终形成在GRPO训练基础上添加简单采样奖励加成的实用策略梯度算法。
Result: 理论推导出问题分解和内层对偶闭式解；实验表明DRRO比标准DRO更少过度悲观，且更有效缓解奖励过度优化，优于现有基线。
Conclusion: DRRO通过优化最坏情况遗憾而非最坏情况回报，在RLHF中更平衡地缓解奖励过度优化，并提供了实用的算法实现。

papers.title: Predicting Scale-Up of Metal-Organic Framework Syntheses with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Scalable synthesis remains the gate between MOF discovery and industrial deployment, as scale-up know-how is fragmented across disparate reports. We introduce ScaleMOF, a literature-mined dataset and a positive-unlabeled learning strategy that fine-tunes large language models. Achieving 93.5% accuracy, this proof-of-concept serves as a literature-grounded ranking tool prioritizing plausible scale-up candidates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ScaleMOF，一个从文献中挖掘的数据集，结合正-无标签学习策略微调大语言模型，用于预测金属有机框架（MOF）合成的可规模化性。该概念验证方法达到了93.5%的准确率，可作为基于文献的排序工具，优先筛选有潜力的规模化候选方案。
Motivation: MOF的可规模化合成是连接实验室发现与工业部署的关键瓶颈，但规模化知识分散于不同文献中，缺乏系统性的预测工具。
Method: 构建文献挖掘数据集ScaleMOF，采用正-无标签学习（positive-unlabeled learning）策略，微调大语言模型进行二进制分类，预测MOF合成是否可规模化。
Result: 在测试集上达到93.5%的准确率，证明该方法的有效性。
Conclusion: 该工作作为概念验证，展示了利用文献数据和大语言模型预测MOF规模化潜力的可行性，但可能局限于已报道的数据范围。

papers.title: Deep Sprite-based Image Models: An Analysis
papers.abstract_en: While foundation models drive steady progress in image segmentation and diffusion algorithms compose always more realistic images, the seemingly simple problem of identifying recurrent patterns in a collection of images remains very much open. In this paper, we focus on sprite-based image decomposition models, which have shown some promise for clustering and image decomposition and are appealing because of their high interpretability. These models come in different flavors, need to be tailored to specific datasets, and struggle to scale to images with many objects. We dive into the details of their design, identify their core components, and perform an extensive analysis on clustering benchmarks. We leverage this analysis to propose a deep sprite-based image decomposition method that performs on par with state-of-the-art unsupervised class-aware image segmentation methods on the standard CLEVR benchmark, scales linearly with the number of objects, identifies explicitly object categories, and fully models images in an easily interpretable way.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于精灵（sprite）的图像分解模型进行深入分析，这些模型在聚类和图像分解中具有高可解释性但难以扩展到多对象场景。作者通过剖析核心组件并提出一种深度精灵方法，在CLEVR基准上达到了与最先进无监督类感知分割方法相当的性能，且复杂度随对象数量线性增长，能显式识别对象类别并保持可解释性。
Motivation: 尽管基础模型在图像分割和扩散生成中取得进展，但识别图像集合中重复模式的简单问题仍未解决。现有精灵模型虽有潜力，但需针对特定数据集定制且难以扩展到包含多个对象的图像。
Method: 系统分析了精灵模型的设计细节和核心组件，基于分析提出了一种深度精灵图像分解方法，该方法线性扩展至多对象，明确建模对象类别并保持全图像可解释性。
Result: 在标准CLEVR基准上，所提方法达到了与最先进无监督类感知图像分割方法相当的性能，且复杂度与对象数量成线性关系。
Conclusion: 本文提供了一种可解释、可扩展的精灵基图像分解方案，为无监督对象发现和图像理解提供了新思路。

papers.title: Peer-Predictive Self-Training for Language Model Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Mechanisms for continued self-improvement of language models without external supervision remain an open challenge. We propose Peer-Predictive Self-Training (PST), a label-free fine-tuning framework in which multiple language models improve collaboratively by using a cross-model aggregate response as an internal training signal. Given a prompt, models generate responses sequentially; the final aggregated answer, which is often more reliable than individual responses in practice, serves as an internal reference for learning. We measure how informative each intermediate response is about the aggregate using pointwise mutual information (PMI), and use this signal to scale self-training updates: responses already aligned with the aggregate receive smaller updates, while less informative or misaligned responses receive larger ones. On mathematical reasoning benchmarks, including SimulEq, MATH-500-Numeric, and MultiArith, PST improves exact-match accuracy by 2.2--4.3 percentage points across Gemma-2-2B, LLaMA-3.2-1B, and Qwen2.5-1.5B, and reduces the average generator--verifier gap (GV-Gap) by 26--40%, while requiring no external supervision, no teacher--student hierarchy, and only cross-model interactions. These results suggest that peer-predictive feedback from cross-model generations can provide an effective mechanism for self-supervised language-model improvement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出同伴预测自训练（Peer-Predictive Self-Training, PST），一种无需外部监督的微调框架，让多个语言模型通过交叉模型的聚合响应作为内部训练信号，并利用点互信息（PMI）调节更新权重。在数学推理基准（SimulEq、MATH-500-Numeric、MultiArith）上，Gemma-2-2B、LLaMA-3.2-1B和Qwen2.5-1.5B的精确匹配准确率提升2.2-4.3个百分点，生成器-验证器差距（GV-Gap）平均降低26-40%。
Motivation: 语言模型在没有外部监督的情况下持续自我改进仍是开放挑战；现有方法多依赖外部标签或教师-学生层级，缺乏纯粹的同行协作机制。
Method: 提出PST：给定提示，多个模型顺序生成响应，将最终聚合答案（通常比单个响应更可靠）作为内部参考；用点互信息（PMI）衡量每个中间响应关于聚合的信息量，并据此缩放自训练更新——与聚合一致的响应更新小，不一致的更新大。
Result: 在SimulEq、MATH-500-Numeric和MultiArith基准上，Gemma-2-2B、LLaMA-3.2-1B和Qwen2.5-1.5B的精确匹配准确率提升2.2-4.3个百分点；平均生成器-验证器差距（GV-Gap）降低26-40%。
Conclusion: 同伴预测反馈（cross-model generations）可为语言模型提供有效的自监督改进机制，无需外部监督、无需教师-学生层级，仅需跨模型交互。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出同伴预测自训练（Peer-Predictive Self-Training, PST），一种无需外部监督的微调框架，让多个语言模型通过交叉模型的聚合响应作为内部训练信号，并利用点互信息（PMI）调节更新权重。在数学推理基准（SimulEq、MATH-500-Numeric、MultiArith）上，Gemma-2-2B、LLaMA-3.2-1B和Qwen2.5-1.5B的精确匹配准确率提升2.2-4.3个百分点，生成器-验证器差距（GV-Gap）平均降低26-40%。
summary_sections.motivation: 语言模型在没有外部监督的情况下持续自我改进仍是开放挑战；现有方法多依赖外部标签或教师-学生层级，缺乏纯粹的同行协作机制。
summary_sections.method: 提出PST：给定提示，多个模型顺序生成响应，将最终聚合答案（通常比单个响应更可靠）作为内部参考；用点互信息（PMI）衡量每个中间响应关于聚合的信息量，并据此缩放自训练更新——与聚合一致的响应更新小，不一致的更新大。

papers.title: Beyond Fixed False Discovery Rates: Post-Hoc Conformal Selection with E-Variables
papers.abstract_en: Conformal selection (CS) uses calibration data to identify test inputs whose unobserved outcomes are likely to satisfy a pre-specified minimal quality requirement, while controlling the false discovery rate (FDR). Existing methods fix the target FDR level before observing data, which prevents the user from adapting the balance between number of selected test inputs and FDR to downstream needs and constraints based on the available data. For example, in genomics or neuroimaging, researchers often inspect the distribution of test statistics, and decide how aggressively to pursue candidates based on observed evidence strength and available follow-up resources. To address this limitation, we introduce post-hoc CS (PH-CS), which generates a path of candidate selection sets, each paired with a data-driven false discovery proportion (FDP) estimate. PH-CS lets the user select any operating point on this path by maximizing a user-specified utility, arbitrarily balancing selection size and FDR. Building on conformal e-variables and the e-Benjamini-Hochberg (e-BH) procedure, PH-CS is proved to provide a finite-sample post-hoc reliability guarantee whereby the ratio between estimated FDP level and true FDP is, on average, upper bounded by 1, so that the average estimated FDP is, to first order, a valid upper bound on the true FDR. PH-CS is extended to control quality defined in terms of a general risk. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that, unlike CS, PH-CS can consistently satisfy user-imposed utility constraints while producing reliable FDP estimates and maintaining competitive FDR control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出后验共形选择 (Post-Hoc Conformal Selection, PH-CS) 方法，允许用户根据数据动态调整候选集的大小与错误发现率 (FDR) 之间的权衡，而无需预先固定FDR水平。该方法基于共形 e-变量和 e-Benjamini-Hochberg (e-BH) 程序，提供有限样本的后验可靠性保证，使估计的FDP在平均意义上有效上界真实FDR。实验表明，相比传统共形选择 (CS)，PH-CS能更一致地满足用户指定的效用约束，同时保持竞争力的FDR控制。
Motivation: 现有共形选择方法要求在观测数据前固定目标FDR水平，限制了用户根据数据实际分布和下游需求自适应调整选择集大小与FDR的灵活性，这在基因组学或神经影像学等场景中尤为不便。
Method: 基于共形 e-变量和 e-BH 程序，生成一条候选选择集路径，每个集合附带数据驱动的错误发现比例 (FDP) 估计；用户通过最大化指定的效用函数，在路径上任意选择操作点，以平衡选择规模与FDR。
Result: 理论证明PH-CS提供有限样本后验可靠性保证，即估计FDP与真实FDP之比的平均值上界为1；在合成和真实数据集上，相比CS方法，PH-CS能一致满足用户效用约束，生成可靠的FDP估计，并保持竞争力的FDR控制。
Conclusion: PH-CS为后验自适应选择提供了通用框架，可扩展至一般风险定义的质量控制，其有限样本保证和灵活性使其适用于需要数据驱动决策的应用场景。

papers.title: Tessera: Unlocking Heterogeneous GPUs through Kernel-Granularity Disaggregation
papers.abstract_en: Disaggregation maps parts of an AI workload to different types of GPUs, offering a path to utilize modern heterogeneous GPU clusters. However, existing solutions operate at a coarse granularity and are tightly coupled to specific model architectures, leaving much room for performance improvement. This paper presents Tessera, the first kernel disaggregation system to improve performance and cost efficiency on heterogeneous GPUs for large model inference. Our key insight is that kernels within a single application exhibit diverse resource demands, making them the most suitable granularity for aligning computation with hardware capabilities. Tessera integrates offline analysis with online adaptation by extracting precise inter-kernel dependencies from PTX to ensure correctness, overlapping communication with computation through a pipelined execution model, and employing workload-aware scheduling with lightweight runtime adaptation. Extensive evaluations across five heterogeneous GPUs and four model architectures, scaling up to 16 GPUs, show that Tessera improves serving throughput and cost efficiency by up to 2.3x and 1.6x, respectively, compared to existing disaggregation methods, while generalizing to model architectures where prior approaches do not apply. Surprisingly, a heterogeneous GPU pair under Tessera can even exceed the throughput of two homogeneous high-end GPUs at a lower cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Tessera，首个内核粒度（kernel-granularity）的解耦系统，用于在异构GPU上提升大模型推理的性能和成本效率。核心洞察是单个应用中的内核具有多样化的资源需求，最适合作为对齐计算与硬件能力的粒度。系统通过离线分析提取PTX中精确的内核间依赖，采用流水线执行模型重叠通信与计算，并结合轻量级运行时自适应调度。在5种异构GPU、4种模型架构、最大16 GPU的实验中，相比现有解耦方法，吞吐量提升最高2.3倍，成本效率提升1.6倍，且能推广至先前方法不适用的模型架构。
Motivation: 现有解耦方案操作粒度粗、且紧密耦合于特定模型架构，难以充分利用现代异构GPU集群的潜力，性能提升空间大。
Method: Tessera：从PTX提取精确的内核间依赖以保证正确性；通过流水线执行模型重叠通信与计算；采用工作负载感知的调度与轻量级运行时自适应。
Result: 在5种异构GPU、4种模型架构、最大16 GPU实验中，相对于现有解耦方法，吞吐量提升最高2.3倍，成本效率提升1.6倍，且能推广至先前方法不适用的模型架构。
Conclusion: 异构GPU对在Tessera下甚至能以更低成本超过两块同构高端GPU的吞吐量，表明内核粒度解耦是提升异构GPU集群利用率的有效路径。

papers.title: DeepTutor: Towards Agentic Personalized Tutoring
papers.abstract_en: Education is one of the most promising real-world applications for Large Language Models (LLMs). However, current LLMs rely on static pre-training knowledge and lack adaptation to individual learners, while existing RAG systems fall short in delivering personalized, guided feedback. To bridge this gap, we present DeepTutor, a fully open-source agentic framework that unifies citation-grounded problem tutoring with difficulty-calibrated question generation. A hybrid personalization engine couples static knowledge grounding with dynamic learner memory, continuously adapting each interaction to the student's evolving needs. The same personalization substrate further extends to adaptive learning workflows, interactive books, and proactive multi-channel tutoring agents. To evaluate personalized tutoring, we introduce TutorBench, an interactive benchmark incorporating customized learner profiles grounded in university-level curricula across five domains. We further propose an LLM-based first-person interactive evaluation protocol that conducts assessments via a profile-driven student simulator. Complementary evaluations on established benchmarks, supported by human-alignment and ablation studies, confirm the framework's robustness and general utility. Results show that DeepTutor improves personalized metrics by 10.8\% on average and strengthens general agentic reasoning across five backbone models by 29.4\%.
papers.comment: Tech Report, work in progress. Code available at https://github.com/HKUDS/DeepTutor
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeepTutor 是一个完全开源的智能体框架，致力于个性化辅导。它统一了引用型问题辅导与难度校准的问题生成，其混合个性化引擎将静态知识基础与动态学习者记忆相结合，持续适应学生需求。该框架还扩展到自适应学习工作流、交互式书籍和主动多通道辅导智能体。为评估个性化辅导，作者引入了 TutorBench 基准测试和基于 LLM 的第一人称交互评估协议。实验表明，DeepTutor 在个性化指标上平均提升 10.8%，并在五个骨干模型上增强通用智能体推理能力 29.4%。
Motivation: 当前 LLM 依赖静态预训练知识，缺乏对个体学习者的适应，而现有 RAG 系统无法提供个性化引导反馈，因此需要能够持续适应学生需求的个性化辅导框架。
Method: 提出 DeepTutor 开源智能体框架，核心是混合个性化引擎，将静态知识基础与动态学习者记忆耦合，实现引用型问题辅导和难度校准的问题生成，并扩展至自适应学习、交互式书籍和主动辅导智能体。同时引入 TutorBench 基准测试和基于 LLM 的第一人称交互评估协议。
Result: 在 TutorBench 上，DeepTutor 使个性化指标平均提升 10.8%，并在五种骨干模型上增强通用智能体推理能力 29.4%。人类对齐和消融研究验证了框架的鲁棒性和通用性。
Conclusion: 该框架在个性化辅导和通用智能体推理方面表现出显著提升，摘要未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: Weak Adversarial Neural Pushforward Method for the Wigner Transport Equation
papers.abstract_en: We extend the Weak Adversarial Neural Pushforward Method to the Wigner transport equation governing the phase-space dynamics of quantum systems. The central contribution is a structural observation: integrating the nonlocal pseudo-differential potential operator against plane-wave test functions produces a Dirac delta that exactly inverts the Fourier transform defining the Wigner potential kernel, reducing the operator to a pointwise finite difference of the potential at two shifted arguments. This holds in arbitrary dimension, requires no truncation of the Moyal series, and treats the potential as a black-box function oracle with no derivative information. To handle the negativity of the Wigner quasi-probability distribution, we introduce a signed pushforward architecture that decomposes the solution into two non-negative phase-space distributions mixed with a learnable weight. The resulting method inherits the mesh-free, Jacobian-free, and scalable properties of the original framework while extending it to the quantum setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将弱对抗神经前推方法扩展到Wigner输运方程，用于量子系统的相空间动力学。核心发现是对非局部赝微分势算子使用平面波测试函数时，会产生狄拉克δ函数，精确逆转定义Wigner势核的傅里叶变换，从而将算子简化为两个平移参数处势的点态有限差分。该方法适用于任意维度，无需截断Moyal级数，且将势视为无导数信息的黑箱函数。为处理Wigner准概率分布的负值，引入了带符号前推架构，将解分解为两个非负相空间分布与可学习权重的混合。该方法继承了原始框架的无网格、无雅可比和可扩展特性，并扩展到量子设置。
Motivation: 现有方法求解Wigner输运方程时面临计算复杂度和处理非局域势算子的困难，且难以处理Wigner函数的负值问题。
Method: 提出弱对抗神经前推方法，利用平面波测试函数将非局部赝微分势算子简化为点态有限差分；引入带符号前推架构，将解分解为两个非负分布与可学习权重的混合。
Result: 该方法在任意维度上有效，无需截断Moyal级数，不依赖势函数的导数信息，且保持无网格、无雅可比和可扩展性。
Conclusion: 论文展示了弱对抗神经前推方法在量子动力学中的适用性，为高效求解Wigner输运方程提供了新途径。

papers.title: LSRM: High-Fidelity Object-Centric Reconstruction via Scaled Context Windows
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the Large Sparse Reconstruction Model to study how scaling transformer context windows affects feed-forward 3D reconstruction. Although recent object-centric feed-forward methods produce robust, high-quality reconstructions, they still lag behind dense-view optimization in recovering fine-grained texture and appearance. We show that expanding the context window -- by substantially increasing the number of active object and image tokens -- narrows this gap and enables high-fidelity 3D object reconstruction and inverse rendering. To scale effectively, we adapt native sparse attention for 3D reconstruction with three key contributions: (1) an efficient coarse-to-fine pipeline that focuses computation on informative regions by predicting sparse high-resolution residuals; (2) a 3D-aware spatial routing mechanism that establishes accurate 2D-3D correspondences using explicit geometric distances rather than standard attention scores; and (3) a custom block-aware sequence-parallel strategy with an All-gather-KV protocol to balance dynamic, sparse workloads across GPUs. As a result, LSRM handles 20x more object tokens and >2x more image tokens than prior state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods. Extensive evaluations on standard novel-view synthesis benchmarks show substantial gains over the current SOTA, yielding >2.4dB higher PSNR and >40% lower LPIPS. Furthermore, when extending LSRM to inverse rendering, qualitative and quantitative evaluations on widely used benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements in texture and geometry details, achieving an LPIPS that matches or exceeds that of SOTA dense-view optimization methods. Code and model weights are available on our project page.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出大规模稀疏重建模型（LSRM），通过扩展Transformer的上下文窗口（大幅增加物体和图像token数量）来提高前馈式3D重建的保真度。与密集视图优化方法相比，该方法在细粒度纹理和外观恢复上实现了可比的性能。核心贡献包括：粗到细管道、基于显式几何距离的3D感知空间路由，以及块感知序列并行策略。实验表明，在新视图合成上PSNR提升>2.4dB，LPIPS降低>40%，在逆渲染任务上纹理和几何细节一致改善。
Motivation: 现有前馈式3D重建方法在恢复细粒度纹理和外观方面仍落后于密集视图优化方法，本文旨在通过扩大上下文窗口来缩小这一差距。
Method: 采用三种关键技术： (1) 粗到细管道，通过预测稀疏高分辨率残差聚焦于信息丰富区域； (2) 3D感知空间路由机制，使用显式几何距离（而非注意力分数）建立准确2D-3D对应； (3) 自定义块感知序列并行策略（All-gather-KV协议），平衡跨GPU的动态稀疏负载。
Result: 在标准新视图合成基准上，相比当前最优方法，LSRM获得>2.4dB PSNR提升和>40% LPIPS降低。在逆渲染任务上，纹理和几何细节一致改善，LPIPS达到或超过最优密集视图优化方法。
Conclusion: 通过扩大上下文窗口并配合专用注意力机制，前馈式3D重建可以达到与密集视图优化相当的保真度，突破了前馈方法的精度瓶颈。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LESV: Language Embedded Sparse Voxel Fusion for Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Recent advancements in open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding heavily rely on 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) to register vision-language features into 3D space. However, we identify two critical limitations in these approaches: the spatial ambiguity arising from unstructured, overlapping Gaussians which necessitates probabilistic feature registration, and the multi-level semantic ambiguity caused by pooling features over object-level masks, which dilutes fine-grained details. To address these challenges, we present a novel framework that leverages Sparse Voxel Rasterization (SVRaster) as a structured, disjoint geometry representation. By regularizing SVRaster with monocular depth and normal priors, we establish a stable geometric foundation. This enables a deterministic, confidence-aware feature registration process and suppresses the semantic bleeding artifact common in 3DGS. Furthermore, we resolve multi-level ambiguity by exploiting the emerging dense alignment properties of the AM-RADIO foundation model, avoiding the computational overhead of hierarchical training methods. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on Open Vocabulary Point Cloud Understanding, and highly competitive results on 3D and 2D Object Retrieval benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LESV框架，利用稀疏体素光栅化（SVRaster）替代3D高斯泼溅（3DGS），解决开放词汇3D场景理解中空间歧义和多级语义歧义问题。通过单目深度和法线先验正则化SVRaster，实现确定性、置信度感知的特征注册，并抑制语义渗漏。结合AM-RADIO基础模型的密集对齐属性，无需层次化训练。在开放词汇点云理解上达到最先进性能，在3D和2D物体检索上具有竞争力。
Motivation: 现有基于3DGS的方法存在两个关键限制：非结构化的重叠高斯引起空间歧义，需要概率特征注册；多级语义歧义来自对象级掩码上的池化特征，稀释了细粒度细节。
Method: 使用稀疏体素光栅化（SVRaster）作为结构化、不相交的几何表示，并通过单目深度和法线先验进行正则化，实现确定性、置信度感知的特征注册，抑制语义渗漏。利用AM-RADIO基础模型的密集对齐属性解决多级语义歧义。
Result: 在开放词汇点云理解任务上达到最先进性能，在3D和2D物体检索基准上取得高度竞争性结果。
Conclusion: 提出了一种有效的替代3DGS的框架，通过结构化几何表示和基础模型对齐，解决了现有方法中的固有歧义问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Neural Harmonic Textures for High-Quality Primitive Based Neural Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Primitive-based methods such as 3D Gaussian Splatting have recently become the state-of-the-art for novel-view synthesis and related reconstruction tasks. Compared to neural fields, these representations are more flexible, adaptive, and scale better to large scenes. However, the limited expressivity of individual primitives makes modeling high-frequency detail challenging. We introduce Neural Harmonic Textures, a neural representation approach that anchors latent feature vectors on a virtual scaffold surrounding each primitive. These features are interpolated within the primitive at ray intersection points. Inspired by Fourier analysis, we apply periodic activations to the interpolated features, turning alpha blending into a weighted sum of harmonic components. The resulting signal is then decoded in a single deferred pass using a small neural network, significantly reducing computational cost. Neural Harmonic Textures yield state-of-the-art results in real-time novel view synthesis while bridging the gap between primitive- and neural-field-based reconstruction. Our method integrates seamlessly into existing primitive-based pipelines such as 3DGUT, Triangle Splatting, and 2DGS. We further demonstrate its generality with applications to 2D image fitting and semantic reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出神经谐波纹理（Neural Harmonic Textures），一种在原始基元（如3D高斯溅射）上锚定潜在特征向量，并通过周期激活函数和延迟解码实现高频细节建模的方法。该方法在实时新视角合成上达到最优结果，并兼容现有原始基元管线。
Motivation: 原始基元方法（如3D高斯溅射）相比神经场更灵活、可扩展，但单个基元表达力有限，难以建模高频细节。
Method: 在每个基元周围构建虚拟支架并锚定潜在特征向量，在光线与基元交点处插值这些特征；对插值特征应用周期激活（傅里叶分析启发），将α混合转化为谐波分量加权和；最后通过一个小型神经网络在单一延迟渲染中解码。
Result: 摘要称在实时新视角合成上取得最优结果，并弥合了原始基元与神经场重建之间的差距。方法可无缝集成到3DGUT、Triangle Splatting、2DGS等管线中，并展示了在2D图像拟合和语义重建上的泛化性。
Conclusion: 神经谐波纹理有效提升了原始基元方法的高频细节建模能力，且计算开销小，具有通用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Echoes: A semantically-aligned music deepfake detection dataset
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Echoes, a new dataset for music deepfake detection designed for training and benchmarking detectors under realistic and provider-diverse conditions. Echoes comprises 4,468 tracks (131 hours of audio) spanning multiple genres (pop, rock, electronic), and includes content generated by ten popular AI music generation systems. To prevent shortcut learning and promote robust generalization, the dataset is deliberately constructed to be challenging, enforcing semantic-level alignment between spoofed audio and bona fide references. This alignment is achieved by conditioning generated audio samples directly on bona-fide waveforms or song descriptors. We evaluate Echoes in a cross-dataset setting against three existing AI-generated music datasets using state-of-the-art Wav2Vec2 XLS-R 2B representations. Results show that (i) Echoes is the hardest in-domain dataset; (ii) detectors trained on existing datasets transfer poorly to Echoes; (iii) training on Echoes yields the strongest generalization performance. These findings suggest that provider diversity and semantic alignment help learn more transferable detection cues.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍Echoes，一个用于音乐深度伪造检测的新数据集，包含4468首歌曲（131小时），由十个AI音乐生成系统产生，覆盖多种流派。数据集通过强制语义对齐（对假音频和真音频在语义级别对齐）来防止捷径学习。跨数据集评估表明Echoes是难度最大的域内数据集，且在其上训练的检测器泛化性能最好。
Motivation: 现有音乐深度伪造检测数据集缺乏提供者多样性和语义对齐，导致检测器泛化能力差，容易利用捷径。
Method: 构建Echoes数据集，包含多个AI音乐生成系统生成的音频，并通过条件生成（基于真实波形或歌曲描述）实现语义对齐；使用Wav2Vec2 XLS-R 2B表征进行检测器训练和评估。
Result: (i) Echoes是难度最大的域内数据集；(ii) 在现有数据集上训练的检测器迁移到Echoes效果差；(iii) 在Echoes上训练的检测器泛化性能最强。
Conclusion: 提供者多样性和语义对齐有助于学习更可迁移的检测线索。

papers.title: StateLinFormer: Stateful Training Enhancing Long-term Memory in Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Effective navigation intelligence relies on long-term memory to support both immediate generalization and sustained adaptation. However, existing approaches face a dilemma: modular systems rely on explicit mapping but lack flexibility, while Transformer-based end-to-end models are constrained by fixed context windows, limiting persistent memory across extended interactions. We introduce StateLinFormer, a linear-attention navigation model trained with a stateful memory mechanism that preserves recurrent memory states across consecutive training segments instead of reinitializing them at each batch boundary. This training paradigm effectively approximates learning on infinitely long sequences, enabling the model to achieve long-horizon memory retention. Experiments across both MAZE and ProcTHOR environments demonstrate that StateLinFormer significantly outperforms its stateless linear-attention counterpart and standard Transformer baselines with fixed context windows. Notably, as interaction length increases, persistent stateful training substantially improves context-dependent adaptation, suggesting an enhancement in the model's In-Context Learning (ICL) capabilities for navigation tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出StateLinFormer，一种基于线性注意力的导航模型，通过状态化训练机制在连续训练段之间保留循环记忆状态，而非在每个批边界重新初始化，从而近似无限长序列学习。在MAZE和ProcTHOR环境中的实验表明，该方法显著优于无状态线性注意力基线和固定上下文窗口的标准Transformer，且随交互长度增加，上下文依赖适应能力提升，体现了上下文学习（ICL）能力的增强。
Motivation: 现有导航方法面临两难：模块化系统依赖显式映射但缺乏灵活性，Transformer端到端模型受固定上下文窗口限制，无法在长时间交互中保持持久记忆。
Method: 引入状态化记忆训练，在线性注意力架构上保持循环状态跨训练段传递，避免批边界重置，从而近似无限长序列学习。
Result: 在MAZE和ProcTHOR环境中，StateLinFormer在长交互任务中显著优于无状态线性注意力和标准Transformer，尤其随着交互长度增加，上下文适应能力明显提升。
Conclusion: 状态化训练能够有效提升导航模型的长时记忆能力和上下文学习能力，为端到端导航提供了一种可扩展的解决方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Improving RCT-Based Treatment Effect Estimation Under Covariate Mismatch via Calibrated Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) are the gold standard for estimating treatment effects, yet they are often underpowered for detecting effect heterogeneity. Large observational studies (OS) can supplement RCTs for conditional average treatment effect (CATE) estimation, but a key barrier is covariate mismatch: the two sources measure different, only partially overlapping, covariates. We propose CALM (Calibrated ALignment under covariate Mismatch), which learns embeddings that map each source's features into a common representation space. OS outcome models are transferred to the RCT embedding space and calibrated using trial data, preserving causal identification from randomization. Finite-sample risk bounds decompose into alignment error, outcome-model complexity, and calibration complexity terms, making explicit when the learned embedding is accurate enough to reduce variance. We instantiate CALM in two forms: a closed-form linear version, CALM-Lin, and a neural representation-learning version, CALM-NN. Across 51 simulation settings, calibration-based linear methods are effectively tied in linear-CATE regimes, while CALM-NN wins all 22 nonlinear-CATE settings by wide margins. Moreover, on two real-data studies CALM-NN delivers the largest gains over the trial-only baseline.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 42nd Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI 2026). Code: https://github.com/AsiaeeLab/calm-cate
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对随机对照试验（RCT）与观测研究（OS）之间协变量不匹配的问题，提出CALM（Calibrated ALignment under covariate Mismatch）方法。该方法通过学习嵌入将各源特征映射到公共表示空间，并将OS结果模型转移到RCT嵌入空间后基于试验数据进行校准，从而在保留因果识别的同时降低方差。理论给出了有限样本风险界，实验表明在非线性CATE场景下神经表示版本CALM-NN显著优于仅用RCT的基线。
Motivation: RCT虽为因果估计金标准，但常因样本量不足难以检测异质性；OS可提供补充数据，但两者测量的协变量集仅部分重叠，直接融合存在偏差。
Method: 提出CALM框架，包含两个实例：线性版本CALM-Lin和神经网络版本CALM-NN。核心是学习源特征到公共嵌入空间的映射，利用RCT数据校准来自OS的CATE模型，损失函数中结合对齐误差、结果模型复杂度和校准复杂度。
Result: 在51种模拟设定中，线性CATE场景下CALM-Lin与其他线性方法表现持平；在22种非线性CATE设定中，CALM-NN均以较大优势获胜。两项真实数据研究中，CALM-NN相比仅用RCT的基线获得最大增益。
Conclusion: CALM通过校准对齐有效利用OS信息提升CATE估计精度，尤其适用于非线性异质性场景。理论风险分解为不同误差项，揭示了嵌入精度与方差缩减的权衡条件。

summary_sections.motivation: RCT虽为因果估计金标准，但常因样本量不足难以检测异质性；OS可提供补充数据，但两者测量的协变量集仅部分重叠，直接融合存在偏差。
summary_sections.method: 提出CALM框架，包含两个实例：线性版本CALM-Lin和神经网络版本CALM-NN。核心是学习源特征到公共嵌入空间的映射，利用RCT数据校准来自OS的CATE模型，损失函数中结合对齐误差、结果模型复杂度和校准复杂度。
summary_sections.result: 在51种模拟设定中，线性CATE场景下CALM-Lin与其他线性方法表现持平；在22种非线性CATE设定中，CALM-NN均以较大优势获胜。两项真实数据研究中，CALM-NN相比仅用RCT的基线获得最大增益。
summary_sections.conclusion: CALM通过校准对齐有效利用OS信息提升CATE估计精度，尤其适用于非线性异质性场景。理论风险分解为不同误差项，揭示了嵌入精度与方差缩减的权衡条件。

papers.title: Variational Phasor Circuits for Phase-Native Brain-Computer Interface Classification
papers.abstract_en: We present the Variational Phasor Circuit (VPC), a deterministic classical learning architecture on the continuous $S^1$ unit-circle manifold. Inspired by variational quantum circuits, VPC replaces dense weight matrices with trainable phase shifts, local unitary mixing, and structured interference in the ambient complex space, giving a unified method for binary and multi-class classification of spatially distributed signals. We evaluate VPC on real motor-imagery electroencephalography (EEG) from the PhysioNet Motor Movement/Imagery database (10 subjects, Common Spatial Pattern features, subject-wise cross-validation), where it attains a mean decoding accuracy of $0.60$ -- the highest among standard brain--computer-interface baselines (linear discriminant analysis, logistic regression, RBF-SVM, and a multilayer perceptron) -- using an order of magnitude fewer parameters and the lowest cross-subject variance. We also characterize capacity honestly: with phase-only shifts and unitary mixing, VPC realizes a linear decision function in a fixed cosine/sine feature lifting, well matched to the largely separable band-power structure of EEG but unable to represent parity-type functions, a ceiling that depth does not raise. These results position unit-circle phase interference as a parameter-efficient alternative to dense neural computation for signal classification, and motivate VPC both as a standalone classifier and a front-end for hybrid phasor-quantum systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出变分相量电路（VPC），一种在连续S1单位圆流形上的确定性经典学习架构。受变分量子电路启发，VPC用可训练相移、局部酉混合和结构化干涉替代密集权重矩阵，用于空间分布信号的二分类和多分类。在PhysioNet运动想象EEG数据集上（10名受试者，CSP特征，逐受试者交叉验证），VPC以平均解码准确率0.60超越LDA、逻辑回归、RBF-SVM和MLP等标准BCI基线，且参数少一个数量级，跨受试者方差最低。VPC实现的是固定余弦/正弦特征提升中的线性决策函数，与EEG的频带功率结构匹配，但无法表示奇偶型函数。结果表明单位圆相位干涉可作为信号分类的参数高效替代方案，并可作为独立分类器或混合相量-量子系统前端。

Method: 提出变分相量电路（VPC），用可训练相移、局部酉混合和结构化干涉取代密集权重矩阵，在复数空间进行线性决策。
Result: 在PhysioNet运动想象EEG数据集上，VPC平均解码准确率0.60，高于LDA、逻辑回归、RBF-SVM和MLP，且参数少一个数量级，跨受试者方差最低。
Conclusion: VPC验证了单位圆相位干涉作为参数高效替代方案的有效性，可独立用于BCI分类或作为混合相量-量子系统前端，但无法处理奇偶型函数。

papers.title: The Phasor Transformer: Resolving Attention Bottlenecks on the Unit Circle
papers.abstract_en: Transformer models have redefined sequence learning, yet dot-product self-attention introduces a quadratic token-mixing bottleneck for long-context time-series. We introduce the Phasor Transformer block, a phase-native alternative representing sequence states on the unit-circle manifold $S^1$. Each block combines lightweight trainable phase-shifts with parameter-free Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) token coupling, achieving global $\mathcal{O}(N\log N)$ mixing without explicit attention maps. Stacking these blocks defines the Large Phasor Model (LPM). We validate LPM on autoregressive time-series prediction over synthetic multi-frequency benchmarks against honest baselines: it beats a zero-parameter persistence baseline and, with the corrected gradient path, improves monotonically with depth before saturating, while remaining competitive-but-not-superior to self-attention at a fraction of the parameter count. Our results establish an explicit efficiency--accuracy frontier, showing that scalable temporal modeling in oscillatory domains can emerge from geometry-constrained phase computation with deterministic global coupling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Phasor Transformer 块，通过在单位圆流形上表示序列状态，结合轻量可训练相移和无参数离散傅里叶变换（DFT）token 耦合，实现全局 O(N log N) 的混合，无需显式注意力图。堆叠这些块构成大相位模型（LPM），在合成多频时间序列预测任务上验证：超过零参数持久性基线，深度增加时性能单调提升，与自注意力相比具有竞争力但非优越，且参数更少。结果建立了效率-准确性边界。
Motivation: 点积自注意力在长上下文时间序列中引入二次令牌混合瓶颈，需要更高效的全局混合方法。
Method: 引入 Phasor Transformer 块，在单位圆流形上表示序列状态，使用轻量可训练相移和参数自由的 DFT 进行 token 耦合，实现全局 O(N log N) 混合。
Result: 在合成多频时间序列预测基准上，LPM 超过零参数持久性基线，随着深度增加单调改善，与自注意力相比具有竞争力但非优越，且参数显著更少。
Conclusion: 研究表明，在振荡域中，几何约束的相位计算与确定性全局耦合可以产生可扩展的时间建模，并揭示了效率-准确性边界。

papers.title: Optimal uncertainty bounds for multivariate kernel regression under bounded noise: A Gaussian process-based dual function
papers.abstract_en: Non-conservative uncertainty bounds are essential for making reliable predictions about latent functions from noisy data, and thus, a key enabler for safe learning-based control. In this domain, kernel methods such as Gaussian process regression are established techniques, thanks to their inherent uncertainty quantification mechanism. Still, existing bounds either pose strong assumptions on the underlying noise distribution, are conservative, do not directly apply in the multi-output case, or are difficult to integrate into downstream tasks. This paper addresses these limitations by presenting a tight, deterministic bound for multi-output functions in Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Spaces (RKHSs) subject to bounded noise. It is obtained through an unconstrained, duality-based formulation, which shares the same structure as classic Gaussian process confidence bounds, and can thus be straightforwardly integrated into downstream optimization pipelines. We show that the proposed bound generalizes existing results and illustrate its application using an example inspired by quadrotor dynamics learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对有界噪声下多输出函数在再生核希尔伯特空间中的不确定性量化问题，提出一种基于对偶公式的紧致确定性边界。该边界与经典高斯过程置信边界结构相同，可直接集成到下游优化中，并推广了现有结果。
Motivation: 现有不确定性边界要么对噪声分布假设过强，要么保守、不适用于多输出情况，或难以集成到下游任务，亟需一种非保守、易用的边界。
Method: 利用对偶理论构建无约束优化问题，推导出与高斯过程置信区间形式一致的确定性边界，适用于有界噪声下的多输出RKHS函数。
Result: 所提边界紧致且推广了已有结果，并在四旋翼动力学学习示例中展示了应用。
Conclusion: 该边界为安全学习控制提供了可靠的不确定性量化工具，且易于集成到优化框架中。

papers.title: PhasorFlow: A Python Library for Unit Circle Based Computing
papers.abstract_en: We present PhasorFlow, an open-source Python library for computing on the $S^1$ unit circle. Inputs are encoded as complex phasors $z=e^{iφ}$ on the $N$-torus ($\mathbb{T}^N$); as computation proceeds through unitary wave-interference gates, global norm is preserved while components drift into $\mathbb{C}^N$, letting algorithms leverage continuous geometric gradients. PhasorFlow makes three contributions. First, we formalize the Phasor Circuit model ($N$ threads, $M$ gates) with a 22-gate library spanning standard-unitary, non-linear, neuromorphic, and encoding operations under full matrix-algebra simulation. Second, we present the Variational Phasor Circuit (VPC), analogous to variational quantum circuits, optimizing continuous phase parameters for classification. Third, we introduce the Phasor Transformer, replacing $QK^TV$ attention with a parameter-free DFT token-mixing layer inspired by FNet. We validate on spatial classification, time-series prediction, financial volatility, neuromorphic tasks, and -- for the VPC -- real motor-imagery EEG, where it matches standard baselines at a fraction of their parameters. We characterize the models honestly: the VPC is a parameter-efficient phase-linear classifier with a parity ceiling that depth cannot raise, and the Phasor Transformer benefits from depth before saturating, competitive but not superior. This positions unit-circle computing as a deterministic, lightweight paradigm on classical hardware. Available at https://github.com/mindverse-computing/phasorflow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PhasorFlow 是一个开源 Python 库，用于在单位圆 $S^1$ 上进行计算。它将输入编码为复相量，通过波干涉门保持全局范数，支持线性、非线性、神经形态等操作。论文介绍了相量电路模型、变分相量电路（VPC）和相量 Transformer，并在空间分类、时间序列预测、金融波动、神经形态任务和运动想象 EEG 上进行了验证。结果表明 VPC 是参数高效的相位线性分类器，相量 Transformer 在深度增加时性能提升但非最优。该工作将单位圆计算定位为确定性、轻量级的经典硬件范式。
Motivation: 现有计算范式在资源受限场景下可能过于复杂或耗能，单位圆计算提供了一种确定性的轻量级替代方案，但缺乏统一的软件框架。
Method: 提出 PhasorFlow 库，包含 22 个门操作的相量电路模型，以及变分相量电路 (VPC) 和基于 DFT 的相量 Transformer。
Result: 在多个任务上验证，VPC 在运动想象 EEG 上以更少参数匹配基线性能，相量 Transformer 随深度提升但未超越 SOTA。
Conclusion: 单位圆计算是一种可行的轻量级计算范式，但存在局限性，如 VPC 的奇偶性上限和相量 Transformer 的性能限制。

papers.title: Safe Flow Q-Learning: Offline Safe Reinforcement Learning with Reachability-Based Flow Policies
papers.abstract_en: Offline safe reinforcement learning (RL) seeks reward-maximizing policies from static datasets under strict safety constraints. Existing methods often rely on soft expected-cost objectives or iterative generative inference, which can be insufficient for safety-critical real-time control. We propose Safe Flow Q-Learning (SafeFQL), which extends FQL to safe offline RL by combining a Hamilton--Jacobi reachability-inspired safety value function with an efficient one-step flow policy. SafeFQL learns the safety value via a self-consistency Bellman recursion, trains a flow policy by behavioral cloning, and distills it into a one-step actor for reward-maximizing safe action selection without rejection sampling at deployment. Empirically, SafeFQL trades modestly higher offline training cost for substantially lower inference latency than diffusion-style safe generative baselines, which is advantageous for real-time safety-critical deployment. Across boat navigation, and Safety Gymnasium MuJoCo tasks, SafeFQL matches or exceeds prior offline safe RL performance while substantially reducing constraint violations.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables; First 2 authors have contributed equally; Paper accepted at Reinforcement Learning Conference (RLC) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Safe Flow Q-Learning (SafeFQL) 将流强化学习 (FQL) 扩展到离线安全强化学习，结合哈密顿-雅可比可达性启发的安全值函数与单步流策略。该方法通过自洽贝尔曼递归学习安全值，用行为克隆训练流策略，并蒸馏为单步 actor 以实现奖励最大化安全动作选择，无需部署时的拒绝采样。实验表明，相比扩散式安全生成基线，SafeFQL 以适度增加离线训练成本为代价，大幅降低推理延迟，在船只导航和 Safety Gymnasium MuJoCo 任务上匹配或超越先前离线安全 RL 性能，同时减少约束违反。
Motivation: 现有离线安全强化学习方法依赖软期望成本目标或迭代生成推理，难以满足安全关键实时控制的要求。
Method: 提出 SafeFQL，扩展 FQL 到安全离线 RL：使用哈密顿-雅可比可达性启发的安全值函数，通过自洽贝尔曼递归学习；用行为克隆训练流策略；蒸馏为单步 actor 以进行奖励最大化安全动作选择。
Result: 在船只导航和 Safety Gymnasium MuJoCo 任务上，SafeFQL 匹配或超越先前离线安全 RL 性能，同时显著减少约束违反，且推理延迟远低于扩散式安全生成基线。
Conclusion: SafeFQL 通过结合可达性流策略实现低延迟安全决策，适合实时安全关键部署。
