papers.title: Diagnosing Corruption-Induced Reliability Failures in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Visual corruptions can change vision--language model (VLM) behavior in ways that top-1 accuracy does not capture. A model may keep the same answer while losing distributional support, or improve accuracy through unstable wrong-to-correct changes. We introduce Bench-C, a controlled multiple-choice testbed for studying these effects. It selects semantically diverse samples whose predictions respond to corruption, and evaluates them under 19 corruption types and five severity levels. To measure how corruption changes the option distribution, we introduce the Robustness Alignment Score (RAS), which combines confidence-correctness alignment with uncertainty direction. We further separate originally correct samples from originally wrong samples, and track whether changes are temporary or persistent across severity. Experiments across 13 VLMs reveal a counterintuitive pattern: mild corruptions can improve top-1 accuracy while degrading prediction structure. These failures include silent degradation, erroneous overconfidence, and severity-dependent persistence. Bench-C therefore supports robustness evaluation that goes beyond final answers and attributes where reliability changes occur. Code and data are available at https://github.com/xiangjieSui/Bench-C.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Bench-C 测试集和鲁棒性对齐分数（RAS），用于诊断视觉语言模型在图像损坏下的可靠性失效。实验发现轻度损坏可能提高 top-1 准确率但破坏预测结构，包括沉默退化、错误过度自信和依赖严重程度的持续性失效。
Motivation: 现有 top-1 准确率无法捕捉视觉损坏对视觉语言模型行为的细微影响，例如模型可能保持相同答案但分布支持丢失，或通过不稳定的错误到正确变化提高准确率。
Method: 构建 Bench-C 受控多项选择测试集，选取语义多样且对损坏响应敏感的样本，在 19 种损坏类型和 5 个严重程度下评估。引入鲁棒性对齐分数（RAS），结合置信度-正确性对齐和不确定性方向，区分原始正确和错误样本，跟踪变化是否暂时或持久。
Result: 在 13 个 VLM 上的实验揭示反直觉模式：轻度损坏可提高 top-1 准确率但降低预测结构，包括沉默退化、错误过度自信和依赖严重程度的持续性失效。
Conclusion: Bench-C 支持超越最终答案的鲁棒性评估，并归因可靠性发生变化的部位。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Geometry-Aware Deep Congruence Networks for Manifold Learning in Cross-Subject Motor Imagery
papers.abstract_en: Cross-subject motor imagery decoding remains a fundamental challenge in EEG-based brain-computer interfaces due to substantial inter-subject variability. Recent approaches have leveraged Riemannian geometry by representing EEG signals as covariance matrices on the symmetric positive definite (SPD) manifold. However, existing methods primarily focus on manifold-based representations while largely overlooking subject-specific variations in covariance dispersion and orientation. In this work, we address these challenges through geometry-aware congruence transformations and propose three complementary models: (i) Discriminative Congruence Transform (DCT), (ii) Deep Linear DCT (DLDCT), and (iii) Deep DCT-UNet (DDCT-UNet). The proposed models are evaluated both as manifold alignment modules for downstream classifiers and as end-to-end discriminative architectures optimized via cross-entropy with a custom logistic regression head. Experiments on challenging cross-subject motor imagery benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements in transductive decoding performance, achieving 2-3% higher accuracy than strong baselines. These results highlight the effectiveness of geometry-aware congruence learning for mitigating inter-subject variability in EEG decoding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对跨被试运动想象脑电解码中的被试间变异问题，提出几何感知的深度同余网络。基于对称正定流形（SPD manifold）上的协方差矩阵表示，作者提出了判别同余变换（DCT）、深度线性DCT（DLDCT）和深度DCT-UNet（DDCT-UNet）三种模型，作为流形对齐模块或端到端判别架构，在跨被试运动想象基准上取得了2-3%的准确率提升。
Motivation: 现有基于Riemannian几何的EEG解码方法主要关注流形表示，而忽略了协方差色散和方向上的被试特异性变异，导致跨被试解码性能受限。
Method: 提出三种几何感知同余变换模型：判别同余变换（DCT）、深度线性DCT（DLDCT）和深度DCT-UNet（DDCT-UNet），可作流形对齐模块或端到端架构，使用自定义逻辑回归头的交叉熵优化。
Result: 在跨被试运动想象基准上实现转导解码性能一致提升，准确率比强基线高出2-3%。
Conclusion: 几何感知同余学习能有效缓解EEG解码中的被试间变异。

summary_sections.result: 在跨被试运动想象基准上实现转导解码性能一致提升，准确率比强基线高出2-3%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 几何感知同余学习能有效缓解EEG解码中的被试间变异。

papers.title: DeltaDeno: Zero-Shot Anomaly Generation via Delta-Denoising Attribution
papers.abstract_en: Anomaly generation is often framed as few-shot fine-tuning with anomalous samples, which contradicts the scarcity that motivates generation and tends to overfit category priors. We tackle the setting where no real anomaly samples or training are available. We propose Delta-Denoising (\textbf{DeltaDeno}), a training-free zero-shot anomaly generation method that localizes and edits defects by contrasting two diffusion branches driven by a minimal prompt pair under a shared schedule. By accumulating per-step denoising deltas into an image-specific localization map, we obtain a mask to guide the latent inpainting during later diffusion steps and preserve the surrounding context while generating realistic local defects. To improve stability and control, DeltaDeno performs token-level prompt refinement that aligns shared content and strengthens anomaly tokens, and applies a spatial attention bias restricted to anomaly tokens in the predicted region. Experiments on public datasets show that DeltaDeno achieves great generation, realism and consistent gains in downstream detection performance. Code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/CROVO1026/DeltaDeno.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DeltaDeno，一种无需训练、零样本的异常生成方法，通过对比共享调度下两个扩散分支（由最小提示对驱动）的反噪增量，定位并编辑缺陷。方法累积每步反噪差异得到图像特定定位图，用于引导后续扩散步骤中的潜在内绘，在生成局部缺陷同时保留周围上下文。通过令牌级提示细化对齐共享内容、增强异常令牌，并在预测区域应用异常令牌空间注意力偏置来提升稳定性和控制力。实验表明DeltaDeno在生成质量、真实感以及下游检测性能上均有提升。
Motivation: 现有异常生成通常依赖少量异常样本进行微调，这违背了生成动机所假设的稀缺性，且容易过拟合类别先验。论文旨在解决没有任何真实异常样本或训练数据可用的零样本异常生成问题。
Method: 提出DeltaDeno，一种训练自由的零样本异常生成方法。核心是：1) 通过共享调度下最小提示对驱动两个扩散分支，对比每步反噪增量并累积为图像特定定位图；2) 利用定位图作为掩码，在后续扩散步骤中引导潜在内绘，生成局部缺陷且保持上下文；3) 令牌级提示细化以对齐共享内容并强化异常令牌；4) 在预测区域应用空间注意力偏置，仅关注异常令牌。
Result: 在公共数据集上的实验表明，DeltaDeno在生成质量、真实感方面表现优异，并在下游检测任务中取得一致提升。
Conclusion: DeltaDeno作为零样本异常生成方法，无需训练或真实异常样本，通过对比扩散分支和引导内绘有效生成缺陷，具有良好的实用性和扩展性。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: On the Gradient Complexity of Private Optimization with Private Oracles
papers.abstract_en: We study the running time, in terms of first order oracle queries, of differentially private empirical/population risk minimization of Lipschitz convex losses. We first consider the setting where the loss is non-smooth and the optimizer interacts with a private proxy oracle, which sends only private messages about a minibatch of gradients. In this setting, we show that expected running time $Ω(\min\{\frac{\sqrt{d}}{α^2}, \frac{d}{\log(1/α)}\})$ is necessary to achieve $α$ excess risk on problems of dimension $d$ when $d \geq 1/α^2$. Upper bounds via DP-SGD show these results are tight when $d>\tildeΩ(1/α^4)$. We further show our lower bound can be strengthened to $Ω(\min\{\frac{d}{\bar{m}α^2}, \frac{d}{\log(1/α)} \})$ for algorithms which use minibatches of size at most $\bar{m} < \sqrt{d}$. We next consider smooth losses, where we relax the private oracle assumption and give lower bounds under only the condition that the optimizer is private. Here, we lower bound the expected number of first order oracle calls by $\tildeΩ\big(\frac{\sqrt{d}}α + \min\{\frac{1}{α^2}, n\}\big)$, where $n$ is the size of the dataset. Modifications to existing algorithms show this bound is nearly tight. Compared to non-private lower bounds, our results show that differentially private optimizers pay a dimension dependent runtime penalty. Finally, as a natural extension of our proof technique, we show lower bounds in the non-smooth setting for optimizers interacting with information limited oracles. Specifically, if the proxy oracle transmits at most $Γ$-bits of information about the gradients in the minibatch, then $Ω\big(\min\{\frac{d}{α^2Γ}, \frac{d}{\log(1/α)}\}\big)$ oracle calls are needed. This result shows fundamental limitations of gradient quantization techniques in optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究差分隐私经验/总体风险最小化的一阶oracle查询复杂度，在非光滑和光滑Lipschitz凸损失下给出下界和几乎匹配的上界。非光滑情况下，使用私有代理oracle时必要查询次数为Ω(min{√d/α^2, d/log(1/α)})，与DP-SGD在d>Ω̃(1/α^4)时紧；光滑情况下下界为Ω̃(√d/α + min{1/α^2, n})，近乎紧。此外，针对信息有限oracle（传输Γ-bit梯度信息）给出Ω(min{d/(α^2Γ), d/log(1/α)})下界，揭示梯度量化的根本限制。
Motivation: 现有差分隐私优化算法缺少严格的运行时间（oracle查询次数）下界，尤其是维度依赖的惩罚尚未有理论表征。
Method: 通过构造对抗性问题和私有代理oracle模型，推导期望oracle查询次数的信息论下界；对光滑损失，仅假设优化器本身是差分隐私，给出更紧的下界。
Result: 非光滑损失下达到α超额风险至少需要Ω(min{√d/α^2, d/log(1/α)})次梯度查询，minibatch大小≤m̄<√d时加强为Ω(min{d/(m̄α^2), d/log(1/α)})；光滑损失下下界为Ω̃(√d/α + min{1/α^2, n})；信息有限oracle下界为Ω(min{d/(α^2Γ), d/log(1/α)})。
Conclusion: 差分隐私优化相较非隐私优化存在维度依赖的运行时惩罚，且梯度量化（通信受限）本质上会进一步增加复杂度。

papers.title: MSRNet: A Multi-Scale Recursive Network for Camouflaged Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Camouflaged object detection is an emerging and challenging computer vision task that requires identifying and segmenting objects that blend seamlessly into their environments due to high similarity in color, texture, and size. This task is further complicated by low-light conditions, partial occlusion, small object size, intricate background patterns, and multiple objects. While many sophisticated methods have been proposed for this task, current methods still struggle to precisely detect camouflaged objects in complex scenarios, especially with small and multiple objects, indicating room for improvement. We propose a Multi-Scale Recursive Network that extracts multi-scale features using a Pyramid Vision Transformer backbone and combines them with specialized Attention-Based Scale Integration Units, thereby enabling selective feature merging. For more precise object detection, our decoder recursively refines features by incorporating Multi-Granularity Fusion Units. A novel recursive-feedback decoding strategy is developed to enhance the model's understanding of global context, thereby helping it overcome the challenges of this task. By jointly leveraging multi-scale learning and recursive feature optimization, our proposed method achieves performance gains, successfully detecting small and multiple camouflaged objects. Our model achieves state-of-the-art results on two benchmark datasets for camouflaged object detection and ranks second on the remaining two. Our code, model weights, and results are available at https://github.com/linaagh98/MSRNet.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种多尺度递归网络（MSRNet）用于伪装目标检测，使用金字塔视觉Transformer骨干提取多尺度特征，并设计注意力尺度集成单元和多重粒度融合单元进行特征优化。模型采用递归反馈解码策略增强全局上下文理解，在伪装目标检测基准上达到了SOTA或第二名的性能。
Motivation: 现有方法在复杂场景下（如低光照、小物体、多物体）难以精确检测伪装目标，存在改进空间。
Method: 提出MSRNet，包含PVT骨干提取多尺度特征、注意力尺度集成单元选择性融合、多重粒度融合单元递归细化特征，并创新递归反馈解码策略。
Result: 在两个基准数据集上达到最优，在另外两个上排名第二。
Conclusion: 多尺度学习与递归特征优化联合使用可有效提升小目标和多目标伪装检测性能。

papers.title: SeFA-Policy: Fast and Accurate Visuomotor Policy Learning with Selective Flow Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Developing efficient and accurate visuomotor policies poses a central challenge in robotic imitation learning. While recent rectified flow approaches have advanced visuomotor policy learning, they suffer from a key limitation: After iterative distillation, generated actions may deviate from the ground-truth actions corresponding to the current visual observation, leading to accumulated error as the reflow process repeats and unstable task execution. We present Selective Flow Alignment (SeFA), an efficient and accurate visuomotor policy learning framework. SeFA resolves this challenge by a selective flow alignment strategy, which leverages expert demonstrations to selectively correct generated actions and restore consistency with observations, while preserving multimodality. This design introduces a consistency correction mechanism that ensures generated actions remain observation-aligned without sacrificing the efficiency of one-step flow inference. Extensive experiments across both simulated and real-world manipulation tasks show that SeFA Policy surpasses state-of-the-art diffusion-based and flow-based policies, achieving superior accuracy and robustness while reducing inference latency by over 98%. By unifying rectified flow efficiency with observation-consistent action generation, SeFA provides a scalable and dependable solution for real-time visuomotor policy learning. Code is available on https://github.com/RongXueZoe/SeFA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出选择性流对齐（SeFA）框架，用于高效准确的视动策略学习。SeFA通过选择性流对齐策略，利用专家演示纠正生成的动作并保持与观测的一致性，同时保留多模态。实验表明，SeFA策略在模拟和真实操作任务中超越扩散和流基线，准确性和鲁棒性优越，推理延迟降低超过98%。
Motivation: 现有整流流方法在迭代蒸馏后生成的动作可能偏离当前视觉观测对应的真实动作，导致误差累积和不稳定任务执行。
Method: 提出选择性流对齐（SeFA）策略，利用专家演示选择性纠正生成动作，恢复与观测的一致性，同时保留多模态。引入一致性校正机制，确保生成动作与观测对齐而不牺牲单步流推理效率。
Result: 在模拟和真实操作任务中，SeFA策略超越最先进的扩散和流策略，实现更优准确性和鲁棒性，推理延迟降低超过98%。
Conclusion: SeFA将整流流效率与观测一致的动作生成相结合，为实时视动策略学习提供了可扩展且可靠的方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Are Current Continual Learning Methods Truly Agnostic? Introducing OPRE, a Step Toward Agnostic Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: In order to achieve Continual Learning (CL), the problem of catastrophic forgetting, one that has plagued neural networks since their inception, must be overcome. The evaluation of continual learning methods relies on splitting a known homogeneous dataset and learning the associated tasks one after the other. We argue that most CL methods introduce a priori information about the data to come and cannot be considered agnostic. We exemplify this point with the case of methods relying on pretrained feature extractors, which are still used in CL. After showing that pretrained feature extractors imply a loss of generality with respect to the data that can be learned by the model, we then discuss other kinds of a priori information introduced in other CL methods. We then present the Online Patch Redundancy Eliminator (OPRE), an online dataset-compression algorithm that discards information through two explicit, input-space criteria. With a classifier that was randomly initialized at test time, OPRE's performance matches reported state-of-the-art online continual-learning methods on CIFAR 10 and CIFAR-100 without any pretrained feature extractor, and outperforms GDumb at an identical memory budget-while making only minimal and interpretable assumptions about the data to come. We frame these results as an empirical, information-theoretic perspective on continual learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出大多数持续学习（CL）方法并非真正任务无关（agnostic），因为它们引入了关于未来数据的先验信息，例如预训练特征提取器。作者提出在线补丁冗余消除器（OPRE），一种基于输入空间显式判据的在线数据集压缩算法。在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上，使用随机初始化的分类器，OPRE无需预训练特征提取器即可匹配报告的最先进在线CL方法性能，且在相同内存预算下优于GDumb。
Motivation: 现有持续学习方法通常依赖预训练特征提取器或其他先验信息，这些信息隐含了对未来数据分布的假设，因此不能被视为真正任务无关（agnostic）的。这限制了方法的通用性。
Method: 提出在线补丁冗余消除器（OPRE），一种在线数据集压缩算法，通过两个显式的输入空间判据丢弃冗余信息。该方法在测试时使用随机初始化的分类器，不依赖预训练特征提取器。
Result: 在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上，OPRE在没有预训练特征提取器的情况下，性能匹配了报告的最新在线持续学习方法；在相同内存预算下优于GDumb。这些结果从信息论角度为持续学习提供了实证支持。
Conclusion: 作者认为大多数CL方法并非真正任务无关，而OPRE通过最小化且可解释的数据假设实现了更好的通用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Robustness to Sparse Adversarial Corruption in Arbitrary Linear Measurements: Beyond Exact Recovery
papers.abstract_en: Recovery from linear measurements under sparse adversarial corruption is typically formulated as an exact-recovery problem: one seeks structural conditions on $\mathbf{A}$ (e.g., restricted isometry property) guaranteeing unique recovery of $\mathbf{x}^\star$ from $\mathbf{y} = \mathbf{A}\mathbf{x}^\star + \mathbf{e}$ with $\|\mathbf{e}\|_0 \leq q$. However, these guarantees provide no guidance once exact recovery fails. This limitation obscures simple robustness phenomena -- for instance, repeated rows in $\mathbf{A}$ can preserve nontrivial information about $\mathbf{x}^\star$ under sparse corruption. In this paper, we study what information about $\mathbf{x}^\star$ can be \emph{uniformly} recovered from $\mathbf{y} = \mathbf{A}\mathbf{x}^\star + \mathbf{e}$ for arbitrary $\mathbf{A}\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times n}$ and \emph{any} $q$-sparse $\mathbf{e}$. We show that the robust information is precisely $\mathbf{x}^\star + \ker(\mathbf{U})$, where $\mathbf{U}$ is the orthogonal projection onto the intersection of rowspaces of all submatrices of $\mathbf{A}$ obtained by deleting $2q$ rows. This clarifies how the row structure of $\mathbf{A}$ governs whether a $q$-sparse corruption allows exact, partial, or only trivial recovery. We further prove every $\mathbf{x}$ minimizing $\|\mathbf{y} - \mathbf{A} \mathbf{x}\|_0$ belongs to $\mathbf{x}^\star + \ker(\mathbf{U})$, yielding a constructive approach to recover this set. For i.i.d. Gaussian matrices, we establish a sharp phase transition between exact and trivial recovery. We sketch two applications: robust network tomography and signal reconstruction from oversampled DCT.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 3 figures; preprint submitted a journal
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究任意线性测量下稀疏对抗性腐败的鲁棒恢复问题。作者证明，对于任意矩阵A和任意q-稀疏腐败向量e，能够从y=Ax+e中统一恢复的稳健信息恰好是x^* + ker(U)，其中U是正交投影到删除2q行后所有子矩阵的行空间交集。该结果揭示了A的行结构如何决定稀疏腐败下是精确恢复、部分恢复还是只能平凡恢复。对于i.i.d.高斯矩阵，论文建立了精确恢复与平凡恢复之间的尖锐相变。
Motivation: 经典的精确恢复条件（如限制等距性质）在精确恢复失败时无法提供任何指导，掩盖了简单的鲁棒现象（例如重复行可在稀疏腐败下保留非平凡信息）。本文旨在刻画任意线性测量下稀疏对抗性腐败中可统一恢复的信息。
Method: 通过定义U为删除2q行后所有子矩阵行空间交集的正交投影，证明稳健恢复的信息集为x^*+ker(U)。进一步证明任何最小化||y-Ax||_0的x都属于该集合，从而提供构造性恢复方法。
Result: 对于i.i.d.高斯矩阵，建立了精确恢复与平凡恢复之间的尖锐相变。应用示例包括鲁棒网络断层扫描和过采样DCT信号重建。
Conclusion: 论文揭示了矩阵A的行结构在稀疏腐败下决定恢复能力的机制，并给出了统一的理论框架。局限性在于仅考虑了均匀恢复，未涉及统计优化方法的性能。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: A Vision Toward Energy-Efficient Domain-Specific Artificial Intelligence Models and Agents
papers.abstract_en: The field of artificial intelligence (AI) has taken a tight hold on broad aspects of society, industry, business, and governance in ways that dictate the prosperity and might of the world's economies. The AI market size is projected to grow from {\$}189 billion in 2023 to {\$}4.8 trillion by 2033. Currently, AI is dominated by large language models (LLMs) that exhibit linguistic and visual intelligence. However, training these models requires a massive amount of data scraped from the web as well as large amounts of energy (50-60 GWh to train GPT-4). Despite these costs, these models often hallucinate, a characteristic that prevents them from being deployed in critical application domains. In contrast, the human brain consumes only 20W of power. What is needed is the next level of AI evolution in which lightweight domain-specific multimodal models, especially compact models with 10--20B parameters for bounded domains, with higher levels of intelligence can reason, plan, and make decisions in dynamic environments with real-time data and prior knowledge, while learning continuously and evolving in ways that enhance future decision-making capability. This will define the next wave of AI, progressing from today's large models, trained with vast amounts of data, to nimble energy-efficient domain-specific agents that can reason and think in a world full of uncertainty. To support such agents, hardware will need to be reimagined to allow system-level energy efficiencies $\geq {1000X}$ over the state of the art for targeted domain tasks, subject to accuracy, latency, and coverage constraints. Such a vision of future AI systems is developed in this work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文前瞻性地探讨了下一代人工智能的发展方向，即从当前能耗巨大且易产生幻觉的大语言模型（LLM）转向轻量级、领域特定、能效高的多模态智能体。文章主张通过约10-20B参数的紧凑模型在受限领域内实现推理、规划和决策，并要求硬件系统级能效提升1000倍以上，同时满足准确性、延迟和覆盖率约束。
Motivation: 当前AI以LLM为主，但训练耗能巨大（GPT-4需50-60 GWh）且存在幻觉问题，难以部署于关键领域。相比之下人脑仅消耗20W。因此需要下一代AI进化，实现低能耗、高智能的领域特定智能体。
Method: 提出愿景：开发轻量级多模态域特定模型（10-20B参数），使其能在动态环境中利用实时数据和先验知识进行推理、规划与决策，并实现持续学习。同时要求硬件重新设计，达到针对特定任务比现有技术高1000倍以上的系统级能效。
Result: 论文未提供具体实验结果，而是给出目标：域特定AI模型应比LLM显著降低能耗，且硬件能效提升≥1000倍，同时满足准确性、延迟和覆盖约束。
Conclusion: 本文展望了未来AI系统的发展路径，强调从大型通用模型转向能量高效的领域特定智能体，并指出硬件创新是实现这一目标的关键。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Rotated Mean-Field Variational Inference and Iterative Gaussianization
papers.abstract_en: We propose an iterative Gaussianization method for sampling from unnormalized densities by repeatedly applying mean-field variational inference (MFVI) in rotated coordinate systems. At each iteration, the method selects a rotation, solves an MFVI subproblem in the rotated coordinates, and applies the inverse coordinatewise map to transform the current target closer to the standard Gaussian. The resulting algorithm provides a computationally efficient way to construct flow-like transport maps: it requires only MFVI subproblems, avoids large-scale optimization, and produces transformations that are easy to invert and evaluate. The effectiveness of the procedure depends on selecting informative rotations. We develop an efficient PCA-type method that chooses rotations from the leading eigenvectors of a cross-covariance matrix involving the target's score function. Experiments on Bayesian posterior sampling tasks show that performing MFVI in the proposed PCA-rotated coordinate systems substantially improves over standard MFVI, and that the resulting iterative Gaussianization procedure provides accurate flow-like approximations at lower computational cost than conventional normalizing-flow variational approximations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种迭代高斯化方法，通过在旋转坐标系中反复应用平均场变分推断（MFVI）来从非归一化密度中采样。每次迭代选择旋转，求解旋转坐标下的MFVI子问题，并应用逆坐标映射使当前目标更接近标准高斯。该方法仅需MFVI子问题，避免大规模优化，且变换易于求逆和评估。实验表明在贝叶斯后验采样任务中，PCA旋转的MFVI显著优于标准MFVI，且迭代高斯化以较低计算成本提供类似流的精确近似。
Motivation: 从非归一化密度中采样存在计算挑战，标准MFVI可能效率低下，需要更高效的变换方法以构建易于求逆和评估的传输映射。
Method: 提出迭代高斯化算法：每次迭代中，选择旋转（通过PCA从目标得分函数的交叉协方差矩阵提取主要特征向量），在旋转坐标系中求解MFVI子问题，然后应用逆坐标映射更新当前分布。该方法只需重复调用MFVI，无需端到端的大规模优化。
Result: 在贝叶斯后验采样任务上，PCA旋转的MFVI显著提高逼近质量；迭代高斯化过程以低于常规标准化流变分近似的计算成本，实现了精确的流式近似。
Conclusion: 方法的有效性取决于选择信息性旋转，所提出的PCA型旋转策略有效；迭代高斯化框架提供了一种计算高效且易于可逆的采样替代方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TOPO-Bench: An Open-Source Topological Mapping Evaluation Framework with Quantifiable Perceptual Aliasing
papers.abstract_en: Topological mapping offers a compact and robust representation for navigation, but progress in the field is hindered by the lack of standardized evaluation metrics, datasets, and protocols. Existing systems are assessed using different environments and criteria, preventing fair and reproducible comparisons. Moreover, a key challenge - perceptual aliasing - remains under-quantified, despite its strong influence on system performance. We address these gaps by (1) formalizing topological consistency as the fundamental property of topological maps and showing that localization accuracy provides an efficient and interpretable surrogate metric, and (2) proposing the first quantitative measure of dataset ambiguity to enable fair comparisons across environments. To support this protocol, we curate a diverse benchmark dataset with calibrated ambiguity levels, implement and release deep-learned baseline systems, and evaluate them alongside classical methods. Our experiments and analysis yield new insights into the limitations of current approaches under perceptual aliasing. All datasets, baselines, and evaluation tools are fully open-sourced to foster consistent and reproducible research in topological mapping.
papers.comment: Jiaming Wang, Diwen Liu, and Jizhuo Chen contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TOPO-Bench，一个开源拓扑地图评估框架，量化了感知混淆对系统性能的影响，并形式化了拓扑一致性作为拓扑地图的基本属性。通过构建具有可校准混淆水平的多样基准数据集，评估了深度学习和经典方法，实验揭示了现有方法在感知混淆下的局限性。所有数据集和工具均已开源。
Motivation: 拓扑地图领域缺乏标准化评估指标、数据集和协议，导致方法比较不公且不可重复。感知混淆这一关键挑战未被量化，但其对系统性能影响显著。
Method: 形式化拓扑一致性为基本属性，证明定位精度可作为有效且可解释的替代指标；提出首个量化数据集混淆度的指标以支持跨环境公平比较；构建具有可校准混淆水平的基准数据集，实现并开源深度学习基线系统，并与经典方法共同评估。
Result: 实验揭示了当前方法在感知混淆下的局限性，具体结果摘要未给出数值。
Conclusion: 该框架通过标准化评估协议和开源工具，促进拓扑地图领域的一致和可重复研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Neural non-canonical Hamiltonian dynamics for long-time simulations
papers.abstract_en: This work focuses on learning non-canonical Hamiltonian dynamics from data, where long-term predictions require the preservation of structure both in the learned model and in numerical schemes. Previous research focused on either facet, respectively with a potential-based architecture and with degenerate variational integrators, but new issues arise when combining both. In experiments, the learnt model is sometimes numerically unstable due to the gauge dependency of the scheme, rendering long-time simulations impossible. In this paper, we identify this problem and propose two different training strategies to address it, either by directly learning the vector field or by learning a time-discrete dynamics through the scheme. Several numerical test cases assess the ability of the methods to learn complex physical dynamics, like the guiding center from gyrokinetic plasma physics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对非正则哈密顿动力学（non-canonical Hamiltonian dynamics）的长时程数据驱动模拟问题，指出现有方法在结合势能基架构和退化变分积分器时存在数值不稳定性，导致长时程模拟失败。作者提出两种训练策略：直接学习向量场或通过时间离散格式学习动力学，并在回旋等离子体物理的引导中心等测试案例上验证了方法的有效性。
Motivation: 非正则哈密顿动力学的长时程预测要求学习模型和数值方案同时保持结构，但现有方法分别关注势能基架构或退化变分积分器，两者结合时出现数值不稳定性，制约了模拟时长。
Method: 提出两种训练策略：1) 直接学习连续向量场；2) 通过离散时间格式学习整个动力学，以解决规范依赖性导致的数值不稳定问题。
Result: 多个数值测试案例表明，所提方法能够学习复杂物理动力学（如回旋等离子体物理中的引导中心轨迹），并实现稳定的长时程模拟。
Conclusion: 通过识别数值不稳定的根源并引入两种训练策略，实现了结构保持的非正则哈密顿动力学的稳定长时程数据驱动模拟。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: MultiFair: Multimodal Balanced Fairness-Aware Medical Classification with Dual-Level Gradient Modulation
papers.abstract_en: Medical decision systems increasingly rely on data from multiple sources to ensure reliable and unbiased diagnosis. However, existing multimodal learning models fail to achieve this goal because they often overlook two critical challenges. First, various data modalities may learn unevenly, thereby converging to a model biased towards certain modalities. Second, the model may emphasize learning on certain demographic groups causing unfair performances. The two aspects can influence each other, as different data modalities may favor respective groups during optimization, leading to both imbalanced and unfair multimodal learning. This paper proposes a novel approach called MultiFair for multimodal medical classification, which addresses these challenges with a dual-level gradient modulation process. MultiFair dynamically modulates training gradients regarding the optimization direction and magnitude at both data modality and group levels. We evaluate MultiFair on three real-world medical classification datasets with diverse demographic attributes,including multiclass classification and missing-modality settings. Experimental results demonstrate its effectiveness.
papers.comment: This work has been accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Medical Imaging
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MultiFair方法，用于多模态医学分类中的公平性感知学习，通过双层级梯度调制同时处理模态不平衡和群体不公平问题。在三个真实医学数据集上验证了有效性，包括多分类和缺失模态场景。
Motivation: 现有多模态学习模型常忽视两个挑战：不同模态学习不均匀导致模态偏差，以及模型可能偏重某些人口群体导致不公平表现，且二者相互影响。
Method: 提出双层级梯度调制机制，在数据模态和群体两个层面动态调整优化方向和幅度，以平衡多模态学习并提升公平性。
Result: 在三个真实医学分类数据集（含多分类和缺失模态设置）上实验，证明了MultiFair的有效性。
Conclusion: 多模态医学分类中，双层级梯度调制可同时缓解模态不平衡和群体不公平问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Effective Gaussian Management for High-fidelity Scene Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes an effective Gaussian management framework for high-fidelity scene reconstruction of both appearance and geometry. Unlike recent Gaussian Splatting (GS) pipelines that treat all primitives uniformly during optimization, our framework explicitly manages the attribute activation, representation and pruning of Gaussian. Specifically, our framework first introduces GauSep, a novel densification strategy that selectively activates Gaussian color or normal attributes to alleviate destructive gradient conflicts arising from dual supervision. We further propose GauRep, an adaptive Gaussian representation that dynamically adjusts spherical harmonics (SHs) orders and performs task-decoupled pruning to reduce redundancy at both the individual and global levels. To provide reliable geometric supervision for above mangement process, we additionally introduce CoRe, an regularized surface reconstruction module that distills robust normal fields from an SDF branch to the Gaussian representation through a confidence mechanism. Notably, the proposed Gaussian management is compatible with various reconstruction architectures and can be seamlessly integrated to improve performance while reducing size of the model. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves superior or comparable performance in appearance and geometry reconstruction compared with state-of-the-art methods, while using significantly fewer parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种高效的高斯管理框架，用于高保真场景重建（外观和几何）。该框架包括GauSep（选择性激活高斯颜色或法线属性以缓解梯度冲突）、GauRep（自适应调整球谐阶数并进行任务解耦剪枝）和CoRe（通过置信度机制从SDF分支蒸馏鲁棒法线场）。实验表明，在参数显著减少的情况下，该方法在重建质量上与现有最优方法相当或更优。
Motivation: 现有高斯泼溅（GS）管线在优化过程中统一处理所有基元，未考虑由双重监督引起的梯度冲突，且存在参数冗余，影响重建质量和效率。
Method: 提出包含三个组件的框架：GauSep选择性激活颜色或法线属性进行稠密化；GauRep动态调整球谐阶数并执行任务解耦剪枝；CoRe通过置信度机制从SDF分支蒸馏法线场以提供可靠几何监督。
Result: 在多个场景重建基准上，该方法在参数显著减少的情况下，实现了与SOTA相当或更优的外观和几何重建性能。
Conclusion: 该高斯管理框架兼容多种重建架构，可有效提升性能并压缩模型大小，但摘要未明确讨论局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FedDAF: Federated Domain Adaptation Using Model Functional Distance
papers.abstract_en: Federated Domain Adaptation (FDA) improves model performance at a target client by collaborating with source clients while preserving data privacy. FDA faces two key challenges: domain shift between source and target data, and limited labeled data at the target, a common constraint when a new site joins a federation before it has accumulated its own labeled data, as in clinical deployments. Most existing methods address domain shift alone, assuming ample target data; those that also tackle data scarcity still fail to prioritize source information according to the target's specific objective. We propose FedDAF, which addresses both challenges through similarity-based aggregation of the global source and target models, using their model functional distance, computed from the angle between their mean gradient fields on target data and normalized via a Gompertz function. The global source model itself is formed using a distance-based weighted average, giving greater weight to source models closer to the target model. Experiments on real-world datasets show FedDAF outperforms existing federated learning (FL), personalized FL, and FDA methods in test accuracy.
papers.comment: Under review at Machine Learning (Springer). Code available at https://github.com/sid0nair/FedDAF
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FedDAF，一种联邦域适应方法，通过模型函数距离（基于目标数据上平均梯度场的角度并用Gompertz函数归一化）进行相似性聚合，同时解决源-目标域迁移和标签稀缺问题。实验表明在多个真实数据集上优于现有联邦学习、个性化联邦学习和联邦域适应方法。
Motivation: 现有联邦域适应方法大多仅处理域迁移，假设目标客户端有充足标记数据；当目标客户端标记数据极少（如临床新站点）时，无法根据目标特定目标优先选择源信息。
Method: FedDAF 使用模型函数距离（源模型与目标模型在目标数据上的平均梯度场夹角，经Gompertz函数归一化）作为相似度进行聚合；全局源模型通过距离加权平均形成，更靠近目标模型的源模型权重更大。
Result: 在真实世界数据集上，FedDAF 在测试准确率上超过现有联邦学习、个性化联邦学习和联邦域适应方法。
Conclusion: FedDAF 通过基于梯度场角度的模型函数距离，有效结合源和目标模型，应对域迁移和标签稀缺双重挑战。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Dropping Just a Handful of Preferences Can Change Top Large Language Model Rankings
papers.abstract_en: We propose a method for evaluating the robustness of widely used LLM ranking systems -- variants of a Bradley--Terry model -- to dropping a worst-case very small fraction of preference data. Our approach is computationally fast and easy to adopt. When we apply our method to matchups from popular LLM ranking platforms, including Chatbot Arena and derivatives, we find that the rankings of top-performing models can be remarkably sensitive to the removal of a small fraction of preferences; for instance, dropping just 0.003% of human preferences can change the top-ranked model on Chatbot Arena. Our robustness check identifies the specific preferences most responsible for such ranking flips, allowing for inspection of these influential preferences. We observe that the rankings derived from MT-bench preferences are notably more robust than those from Chatbot Arena, likely due to MT-bench's use of expert annotators and carefully constructed prompts. Finally, we find that neither rankings based on crowdsourced human evaluations nor those based on LLM-as-a-judge preferences are systematically more sensitive than the other.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种快速评估大型语言模型（LLM）排名系统对少量偏好数据删除的鲁棒性方法。通过分析 Chatbot Arena 等平台的对战数据，发现仅移除 0.003% 的人类偏好即可改变顶级模型的排名；而基于专家标注的 MT-bench 排名则更为鲁棒。
Motivation: 当前 LLM 排名依赖 Bradley-Terry 模型等从偏好数据中推断排序，但人们对这些排名在少量数据扰动下的稳定性缺乏认识。
Method: 提出一种计算高效的方法，用于评估在最坏情况下移除极小部分偏好数据对排名的影响，并识别导致排名翻转的关键偏好。
Result: 在 Chatbot Arena 数据上，移除 0.003% 的偏好即可改变榜首模型；MT-bench 的排名更鲁棒，且未发现人类评估与 LLM 评委评估之间存在系统性差异。
Conclusion: LLM 排名对少量偏好数据可能非常敏感，鲁棒性检查应成为排名报告的常规部分。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: How Causal Abstraction Underpins Computational Explanation
papers.abstract_en: Explanations of cognitive behavior often appeal to computations over representations. What does it take for a system to implement a given computation over suitable representational vehicles within that system? We argue that the language of causality -- and specifically the theory of causal abstraction -- provides a fruitful lens on this topic. Drawing on current discussions in deep learning with artificial neural networks, we illustrate how classical themes in the philosophy of computation and cognition resurface in contemporary machine learning. We offer an account of computational implementation grounded in causal abstraction, and examine the role for representation in the resulting picture. We argue that these issues are most profitably explored in connection with generalization and prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从因果关系抽象（causal abstraction）的理论出发，探讨认知行为的计算解释。作者认为，因果抽象理论为理解系统如何实现特定计算提供了富有成果的视角，并结合深度学习中的当前讨论，展示了哲学主题在当代机器学习中的重现。文章提出了基于因果抽象的计算实现说明，并考察了表征在该图景中的作用，强调这些问题的探讨应联系泛化和预测。
Motivation: 认知行为的解释常常诉诸于表征上的计算，但系统如何实现特定计算这一问题尚缺乏清晰的框架。
Method: 利用因果抽象理论来刻画计算实现，并结合人工神经网络的深度学习案例进行哲学分析。
Result: 摘要未提供具体实验或数值结果，主要贡献是理论框架和概念澄清。
Conclusion: 作者主张因果抽象为计算实现提供了有效语言，并指出这些问题应结合泛化和预测来深入探讨。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Douglas-Rachford Splitting for Group-Sparse Feedback Linear-Quadratic Control
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we study the distributed linear quadratic problem with fixed communication topology (DFT-LQ) and the sparse feedback linear quadratic (SF-LQ) problem through a unified optimization framework. Specifically, both problems are formulated as a nonconvex, nonsmooth optimization problem equipped with an $\ell_0$-penalty under affine constraints. To solve this problem, we first investigate the application of the Douglas-Rachford (DR) splitting algorithm. Under the local condition that the generated iterates remain on a fixed smooth manifold, we establish the convergence of the DR splitting to a stationary point. Furthermore, we characterize this stationary point as the global minimizer of a corresponding DFT-LQ problem. To bypass the restriction of the smooth manifold assumption, we introduce a projected subgradient descent algorithm that achieves global convergence without relying on smooth-manifold structures. This algorithm may serve as a warm-start mechanism that effectively drives the iterates toward the desired smooth manifolds, thereby establishing a favorable initialization where the convergence theory of the DR splitting algorithm becomes fully applicable. Numerical experiments shed light on the effectiveness of the proposed methods in distributed group-sparse controller design.
papers.comment: arXiv admin note: substantial text overlap with arXiv:2507.18114
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究具有固定通信拓扑的分布式线性二次问题（DFT-LQ）和稀疏反馈线性二次问题（SF-LQ），将它们统一建模为带 ℓ₀ 惩罚的非凸非光滑优化问题。采用 Douglas-Rachford (DR) 分裂算法并证明其在光滑流形条件下的收敛性，还提出一种无需流形假设的投影次梯度下降算法作为热启动。数值实验验证了分布式群稀疏控制器设计的效果。
Motivation: 分布式控制和稀疏反馈控制问题通常涉及非凸非光滑优化，现有算法缺乏收敛性保证，尤其是针对群稀疏结构。
Method: 将 DFT-LQ 和 SF-LQ 统一为带 ℓ₀ 惩罚的非凸非光滑优化问题，应用 Douglas-Rachford (DR) 分裂算法，并在迭代序列始终位于某个光滑流形上的局部条件下证明收敛到驻点。为了绕过光滑流形假设，引入投影次梯度下降算法实现全局收敛，可为 DR 分裂提供热启动。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，仅称数值实验表明所提方法在分布式群稀疏控制器设计中的有效性。
Conclusion: 所提方法为分布式群稀疏控制提供了一种理论上有收敛保证的求解方案，但 DR 分裂的收敛依赖于光滑流形条件，投影次梯度下降可作为补充。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: StreamVLN: Streaming Vision-and-Language Navigation via SlowFast Context Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) in real-world settings requires agents to process continuous visual streams and generate actions with low latency grounded in language instructions. While Video-based Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) have driven recent progress, current VLN methods based on Video-LLM often face trade-offs among fine-grained visual understanding, long-term context modeling and computational efficiency. We introduce StreamVLN, a streaming VLN framework that employs a hybrid slow-fast context modeling strategy to support multi-modal reasoning over interleaved vision, language and action inputs. The fast-streaming dialogue context facilitates responsive action generation through a sliding-window of multi-turn dialogues, while the slow-updating memory context compresses historical visual states using a 3D-aware token pruning strategy. With this slow-fast design, StreamVLN achieves real-time dialogues through KV cache reuse, supporting long video streams with bounded context size and inference cost. Experiments on VLN-CE benchmarks show state-of-the-art performance with low latency, ensuring robustness and efficiency in real-world deployment. The project page is: https://streamvln.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 StreamVLN，一种流式视觉语言导航框架，采用慢-快上下文建模策略。快速流式对话上下文通过滑动窗口实现低延迟动作生成，慢速记忆上下文利用3D感知令牌剪枝压缩历史视觉状态。该方法通过KV缓存重用实现实时对话，在VLN-CE基准上取得最先进性能并保持低延迟。
Motivation: 现有基于视频大模型（Video-LLM）的VLN方法在细粒度视觉理解、长期上下文建模和计算效率之间面临权衡。
Method: 提出慢-快混合上下文建模：快速流式对话上下文使用滑动窗口处理多轮对话，慢速记忆上下文使用3D感知令牌剪枝压缩历史视觉状态，并利用KV缓存重用支持长视频流，控制上下文大小和推理成本。
Result: 在VLN-CE基准上达到最先进性能，同时保持低延迟。
Conclusion: 该慢-快设计实现了实时对话，支持长视频流，确保实际部署中的鲁棒性和效率。

papers.title: Instance Generation for Patient-to-room Assignment and Admission Scheduling Based on Real Hospital Data
papers.abstract_en: Developing algorithms for real-life problems that perform well in practice depends on the availability of realistic data for testing. Obtaining real-life data for optimization problems in health care, however, is often difficult, and such data typically cannot be published, which limits reproducibility by other researchers. This is especially true for patient-related problems because of data privacy policies such as the patient-to-room assignment problem. Therefore, artificially generated instances are commonly used. To improve the generation of realistic instances, we develop a configurable instance generator for the patient-to-room assignment problem and other patient-related problems, featuring an easy-to-use graphical user interface. The design of the generator is based on an extensive empirical analysis of real hospital data, which identifies relevant ward-specific patterns such as patients' age and length-of-stay distributions. Moreover, as randomly generated instances are often infeasible, we address this issue in two ways. We implement a dynamic programming approach in the generator to optionally enforce feasibility and extend existing results from the literature to derive new combinatorial insights into patient-to-room feasibility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于真实医院数据的实证分析，开发了一个可配置的实例生成器，用于患者到房间分配问题和相关患者调度问题。该生成器提供图形用户界面，通过分析实际病房模式（如年龄和住院时长分布）生成更现实的实例，并利用动态规划可选地保证实例可行性，同时扩展了理论可行性结果。
Motivation: 患者相关问题的真实数据因隐私政策难以获取且无法公开发布，导致算法测试依赖人工生成实例，但随机生成的实例常不真实或不可行，限制了研究的可重复性和实用性。
Method: 基于真实医院数据的广泛实证分析，识别病房相关模式（如年龄和住院时长分布），设计可配置的实例生成器；通过动态规划方法可选地强制生成可行实例，并推导患者到房间分配可行性的新组合理论结果。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值实验结果，但声称生成器能生成更现实的实例并解决不可行性问题。
Conclusion: 该生成器旨在为患者分配和入院调度算法提供更真实、可重复的测试实例，改善实际应用中的算法评估。

papers.title: Less Is More: Reducing Token Counts Without Compromising Performance
papers.abstract_en: Tokenization directly affects the inference efficiency of large language models, since fragmented tokenization increases sequence length and generation cost. Although longer, multi-word tokens can reduce fertility, naively adding them often degrades language model performance. We propose Thunder-Tok, a subword tokenizer that reduces fertility while preserving downstream performance. Thunder-Tok first constructs a large seed vocabulary from corpus substrings and filters structurally incomplete candidates, including invalid Unicode byte fragments and word-boundary violations. It then prunes the seed vocabulary using a likelihood-based token score derived from a uniform Jensen lower bound of the training-data probability. Experiments show that Thunder-Tok reduces fertility by approximately 25% in English and 9% in Korean compared with the standard BPE tokenizer while maintaining competitive performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Thunder-Tok，一种新的子词分词器，旨在降低大语言模型的分词生育率（fertility），同时保持下游性能。该方法通过从语料子串构建候选词汇表，过滤结构不完整的候选词，并利用基于似然的词汇评分进行剪枝。实验显示，与标准 BPE 分词器相比，Thunder-Tok 在英语中降低约 25% 的生育率，在韩语中降低约 9%，且性能相当。
Motivation: 当前大语言模型的推理效率受限于分词方式：碎片化分词增加序列长度和生成成本。虽然长多词 token 可降低生育率，但简单添加会损害模型性能。因此需要一种能降低生育率又不降低性能的分词方法。
Method: Thunder-Tok 首先从语料子串构建大种子词汇表，过滤无效 Unicode 字节片段和违反词边界的候选词；然后使用基于似然的 token 评分（源自训练数据概率的均匀 Jensen 下界）剪枝种子词汇表。
Result: 与标准 BPE 分词器相比，Thunder-Tok 在英语中降低约 25% 的生育率，在韩语中降低约 9%，同时保持有竞争力的下游性能。
Conclusion: 实验表明，Thunder-Tok 能在不牺牲性能的前提下有效降低分词生育率，提高大语言模型的推理效率。

papers.title: LlamaSeg: Image Segmentation via Autoregressive Mask Generation
papers.abstract_en: We present \textbf{LlamaSeg}, a visual autoregressive framework that unifies multiple image segmentation tasks via natural language instructions. By reformulating segmentation as visual generation, LlamaSeg encodes masks as visual tokens and uses a LLaMA-style Transformer for direct next-token prediction, naturally fitting segmentation into autoregressive architectures. To support large-scale training, we introduce a data annotation pipeline and construct the \textbf{SA-OVRS} dataset, which contains \textbf{2M} segmentation masks annotated with over \textbf{5,800} open vocabulary labels or diverse textual descriptions, spanning diverse real-world scenarios. This enables our model to localize objects in images based on text prompts and to generate fine-grained masks. We further introduce the composite metric average Hausdorff Distance ($d_{\mathrm{AHD}}$) to evaluate mask contour fidelity for generative models better. Experiments show that LlamaSeg consistently outperforms existing generative approaches on multiple segmentation benchmarks and delivers finer, more accurate segmentation masks. Code and dataset are available at \href{https://github.com/GML-FMGroup/llamaseg}{https://github.com/GML-FMGroup/llamaseg}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LlamaSeg 是一个视觉自回归框架，通过自然语言指令统一多种图像分割任务。它将分割重定义为视觉生成，用 LLaMA 风格的 Transformer 直接预测下一个 token，并引入 SA-OVRS 数据集（200 万掩码，5800 个开放词汇标签），在多个分割基准上优于现有生成方法。
Motivation: 现有分割方法依赖特定架构或任务特定设计，缺乏统一框架；生成式分割方法在掩码质量和训练数据规模上存在不足。
Method: 提出 LlamaSeg 框架，将分割视为自回归视觉生成，掩码编码为视觉 token，使用 LLaMA 风格 Transformer 进行下一 token 预测；构建大规模 SA-OVRS 数据集，覆盖开放词汇和多样化文本描述；引入平均豪斯多夫距离（d_AHD）评估生成掩码的轮廓保真度。
Result: 在多个分割基准上，LlamaSeg 优于现有生成式方法，生成更精细、更准确的掩码。
Conclusion: LlamaSeg 展示了自回归框架在分割任务中的潜力，代码和数据集已开源。

papers.title: PhyMAGIC: Physical Motion-Aware Generative Inference with Confidence-guided LLM
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in 3D content generation have amplified demand for dynamic models that are both visually realistic and physically consistent. However, state-of-the-art video diffusion models frequently produce implausible results such as momentum violations and object interpenetrations. Existing physics-aware approaches often rely on task-specific fine-tuning or supervised data, which limits their scalability and applicability. To address the challenge, we present PhyMAGIC, a training-free framework that generates physically consistent motion from a single image. PhyMAGIC integrates a pre-trained image-to-video diffusion model, confidence-guided reasoning via LLMs, and a differentiable physics simulator to produce 3D assets ready for downstream physical simulation without fine-tuning or manual supervision. By iteratively refining motion prompts using LLM-derived confidence scores and leveraging simulation feedback, PhyMAGIC steers generation toward physically consistent dynamics. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that PhyMAGIC outperforms state-of-the-art video generators and physics-aware baselines, enhancing physical property inference and motion-text alignment while maintaining visual fidelity.
papers.comment: This work is accepted by ECCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PhyMAGIC，一个无需微调或人工标注的框架，能从单张图像生成物理一致的运动视频。它结合预训练图像到视频扩散模型、LLM置信度引导推理和可微物理模拟器，通过迭代优化运动提示实现物理合理性。在多项实验上，PhyMAGIC在物理属性推断和运动文本对齐上优于现有视频生成和物理感知基线，同时维持视觉质量。
Motivation: 现有视频扩散模型常生成违反物理规律（如动量异常、物体穿插）的结果，而现有物理感知方法依赖任务微调或有监督数据，限制了可扩展性和通用性。
Method: 采用无训练框架，集成（1）预训练图像到视频扩散模型作为基础生成器，（2）LLM根据置信度分数推理运动提示，（3）可微物理模拟器提供反馈，迭代优化生成的运动，确保物理一致性。
Result: 实验表明，PhyMAGIC在物理属性推断和运动文本对齐上超越现有视频生成器和物理感知基线，同时保持视觉保真度。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了无需额外训练或标注即可从单张图像生成物理一致动态3D资产的可行性，但具体物理约束的复杂场景性能有待进一步验证。

papers.title: ToDMA: Large Model-Driven Massive Token Communications for Semantic Multiple Access
papers.abstract_en: Token communications (TokenCom) is an emerging generative semantic communication paradigm, where tokens serve as compact representation units across modalities. Their contextual dependencies can be exploited by pretrained large models for semantic recovery. In this paper, we propose token-domain multiple access (ToDMA), a large-model-driven semantic multiple access scheme for massive token communications. ToDMA integrates unsourced random access with context-aware token processing. It enables massive uncoordinated devices to transmit tokenized source representations over common uplink resources. Specifically, each token index is associated with a shared modulation codeword, exposing token-level structure to the receiver for context-aware recovery. At the receiver, compressed sensing is first employed to jointly detect active tokens and estimate their corresponding channel state information (CSI) from the superposed signals. The source token sequences are then reconstructed by exploiting the consistency of token-associated CSI across multiple token positions. In the presence of token collisions, some active tokens may remain unassigned, leading to missing entries in the reconstructed token sequences. To recover these tokens, candidate-restricted masked-token prediction is performed using pretrained contextual models, thereby leveraging token-level context to mitigate collision effects. Simulation results on both image and text transmission tasks demonstrate that ToDMA reduces access latency while maintaining favorable token recovery and semantic reconstruction quality, showing its scalability for semantic multiple access.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ToDMA（Token-Domain Multiple Access），一种大规模模型驱动的语义多址接入方案。该方案将令牌通信（TokenCom）与无源随机接入结合，利用预训练大模型的上下文感知能力恢复令牌序列。接收端先通过压缩感知检测活跃令牌并估算信道状态信息，再基于令牌关联CSI一致性重建序列，对碰撞令牌采用候选限制的掩码令牌预测。仿真表明，ToDMA在图像和文本传输中降低了接入延迟，同时保持了令牌恢复与语义重建质量。
Motivation: 现有语义通信中，大规模设备同时接入时碰撞严重，令牌通信的语义恢复需要有效利用令牌间的上下文依赖，现有方法缺乏针对令牌域的多址接入设计。
Method: 提出ToDMA方案：每个令牌索引关联共享调制码字，接收端先使用压缩感知联合检测活跃令牌并估计CSI，然后利用令牌CSI一致性重建源令牌序列；对于因碰撞未分配的令牌，采用候选限制的掩码令牌预测（基于预训练上下文模型）进行恢复。
Result: 在图像和文本传输任务上，ToDMA相比基线方案降低了接入延迟，同时保持较好的令牌恢复和语义重建质量。
Conclusion: 摘要认为ToDMA通过令牌级上下文处理有效缓解了碰撞效应，展示了在语义多址接入场景中的可扩展性。

papers.title: BiasBench: A reproducible benchmark for tuning the biases of event cameras
papers.abstract_en: Event-based cameras are bio-inspired sensors that detect light changes asynchronously for each pixel. They are increasingly used in fields like computer vision and robotics because of several advantages over traditional frame-based cameras, such as high temporal resolution, low latency, and high dynamic range. As with any camera, the output's quality depends on how well the camera's settings, called biases for event-based cameras, are configured. While frame-based cameras have advanced automatic configuration algorithms, there are very few such tools for tuning these biases. A systematic testing framework would require observing the same scene with different biases, which is tricky since event cameras only generate events when there is movement. Event simulators exist, but since biases heavily depend on the electrical circuit and the pixel design, available simulators are not well suited for bias tuning. To allow reproducibility, we present BiasBench, a novel event dataset containing multiple scenes with settings sampled in a grid-like pattern. We present three different scenes, each with a quality metric of the downstream application. Additionally, we present a novel, RL-based method to facilitate online bias adjustments.
papers.comment: Accepted to CVPR 2025 Workshop on Event-based Vision

papers.title: Dual-Difficulty Curriculum Learning for Direct Preference Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Curriculum learning enhances Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) for aligning Large Language Models (LLMs), yet existing methods rely on a one-dimensional view of difficulty. In this work, we reframe alignment difficulty as a two-dimensional space spanned by Prompt Complexity (PC) and Pairwise Distinguishability (PD), providing a more principled foundation for alignment. We first demonstrate the efficacy of this space by developing DM-Curri-DPO, a framework of static curricula that already achieves significant gains over baseline methods. Moving beyond these handcrafted paths, we introduce our primary contribution: GSP-Curri-DPO, a novel Group-wise Self-Paced Learning framework. This advanced method empowers the model to navigate the difficulty grid, discovering an optimal learning trajectory based on its own evolving capabilities. Extensive experiments show our self-paced approach not only sets a new state-of-the-art on key benchmarks but, more importantly, demonstrates superior data efficiency and robustness to preference noise. Our work establishes a new paradigm for LLM alignment, offering both a structured difficulty space and an intelligent, model-driven methodology for navigating it.
papers.comment: We found a critical flaw in the prompt complexity metric, which affects the 2D curriculum grid construction and leads to potentially invalid comparisons. Since this undermines our main conclusions, we are withdrawing the paper and will revise the methodology before resubmission
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对直接偏好优化（DPO）提出一种基于双难度课程学习的方法，将对齐难度分解为提示复杂度（PC）和成对可区分性（PD）两个维度，并引入组式自定进度学习框架。然而，作者在评论中指出提示复杂度指标存在严重缺陷，导致主要结论可能无效，因此主动撤回论文。
Motivation: 现有课程学习增强DPO的方法仅从一维难度出发，缺乏对对齐难度的细致刻画。本文旨在建立更原则性的二维难度空间。
Method: 提出静态课程框架DM-Curri-DPO，以及主要贡献GSP-Curri-DPO——一种组式自定进度学习框架，使模型能根据自身能力在难度网格上探索最优学习轨迹。
Result: 实验表明所提方法在关键基准上达到新最优，并展示了更好的数据效率和鲁棒性。但作者随后发现提示复杂度指标存在致命缺陷。
Conclusion: 本文虽然提出了新的范式，但因提示复杂度指标的严重缺陷，作者已撤回论文并计划修订方法后重新提交。

papers.title: Asynchronous Federated Continual Segmentation with Evolving Clients and Label Spaces
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning seeks to foster collaboration among distributed clients while preserving the privacy of their local data. Traditional federated learning methods typically assume a fixed setting, where participating clients, client data, and learning objectives remain unchanged. However, in real-world scenarios, a federation may evolve over time, with changes in both its client composition and target label space. In this evolving federated setting, conventional round-wise model aggregation becomes inflexible, as each federation update requires repeated communication, repeated local computation, and synchronized participation from all accumulated clients. To address this limitation, we propose CA-MMDS, a continual multiple-model distillation framework for federated continual segmentation with asynchronous clients and evolving label spaces. Instead of repeatedly aggregating model parameters from all clients, CA-MMDS maintains a server-side archive of client models and updates the global model through proxy-based distillation from multiple archived local models. When new clients join or existing clients evolve, only the newly added or updated local models need to be uploaded, while unchanged clients can remain offline and continue to contribute through their archived models. This design substantially reduces communication and computation costs while enabling flexible asynchronous cooperation among evolving clients. Using multi-class 3D abdominal CT segmentation as an application task, we demonstrate that CA-MMDS efficiently incorporates evolving client knowledge while achieving competitive segmentation performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CA-MMDS，一种针对异步客户端和演化标签空间的联邦持续分割框架。通过服务器端维护客户端模型档案，利用代理蒸馏更新全局模型，减少通信计算成本。在3D腹部CT分割上验证效果。
Motivation: 传统联邦学习假设固定设置，但实际场景中客户端和标签空间会演化，导致轮次聚合不灵活、成本高。
Method: 提出CA-MMDS框架，维护服务器端客户端模型档案，通过基于代理的蒸馏从多个存档的本地模型更新全局模型。新客户端加入或现有客户端演化时，只需上传新增或更新的本地模型，未变客户端可离线并通过存档模型继续贡献。
Result: 在多类3D腹部CT分割任务上，CA-MMDS高效整合演化客户端知识，取得有竞争力的分割性能。
Conclusion: CA-MMDS显著降低通信和计算成本，实现演化客户端间的灵活异步合作。

papers.title: Concept-as-Tree: A Controllable Synthetic Data Framework Makes Stronger Personalized VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated exceptional performance in various multi-modal tasks. Recently, there has been an increasing interest in improving the personalization capabilities of VLMs. To better integrate user-provided concepts into VLMs, many methods use positive and negative samples to fine-tune these models. However, the scarcity of user-provided positive samples and the low quality of retrieved negative samples pose challenges for existing techniques. To reveal the relationship between sample and model performance, we systematically investigate the amount and diversity impact of positive and negative samples (easy and hard) on VLM personalization tasks. Based on the detailed analysis, we introduce Concept-as-Tree (CaT), which represents a concept as a tree structure, thereby enabling the data generation of positive and negative samples with varying difficulty and diversity, and can be easily extended to multi-concept scenarios. With a well-designed data filtering strategy, our CaT framework can ensure the quality of generated data, constituting a powerful pipeline. We perform thorough experiments with various VLM personalization baselines to assess the effectiveness of the pipeline, alleviating the lack of positive samples and the low quality of negative samples. Our results demonstrate that CaT equipped with the proposed data filter significantly enhances the capabilities of VLMs across personalization benchmarks. To the best of our knowledge, this work is the first controllable synthetic data pipeline for VLM personalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Concept-as-Tree (CaT) 框架，通过将概念表示为树结构来生成可控的合成正负样本，以解决 VLM 个性化任务中正样本稀缺和负样本质量低的问题。实验表明，结合数据过滤策略的 CaT 能显著提升 VLM 在个性化基准上的性能。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 个性化方法依赖用户提供的正样本和检索的负样本，但正样本稀缺且负样本质量低，限制了模型性能。需要一种可控的数据生成方法来缓解这些问题。
Method: 提出 Concept-as-Tree (CaT) 框架，将概念表示为树结构，基于该结构生成不同难度和多样性的正负样本，并设计数据过滤策略确保数据质量，支持多概念场景。
Result: 在多个 VLM 个性化基线上，CaT 结合数据过滤显著提升了模型在个性化基准上的性能，缓解了正样本缺乏和负样本低质的问题。
Conclusion: 该工作是第一个可控的 VLM 个性化合成数据 pipeline，通过树结构表示概念实现可控数据生成，有望推动个性化 VLM 的发展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Simulator Ensembles for Trustworthy Autonomous Driving Systems Testing
papers.abstract_en: Scenario-based testing with driving simulators is extensively used to identify failing conditions of automated driving assistance systems (ADAS). However, existing studies have shown that repeated test execution in the same as well as in distinct simulators can yield different outcomes, which can be attributed to sources of flakiness or different implementations of the physics. In this paper, we present MultiSim, a novel approach to multi-simulation ADAS testing based on a search-based testing approach that leverages an ensemble of simulators to identify failure-inducing, simulator-agnostic test scenarios. During the search, each scenario is evaluated jointly on multiple simulators. Scenarios that produce consistent results across simulators are prioritized for further exploration, while those that fail on only a subset of simulators are given less priority, as they may reflect simulator-specific issues rather than generalizable failures. Our empirical study, which involves testing three lane-keeping ADAS on different pairs of three widely used simulators, demonstrates that MultiSim outperforms single-simulator testing by achieving, on average, a higher rate of simulator-agnostic failures by 66%. Compared to a state-of-the-art multi-simulator approach that combines the outcome of independent test generation campaigns obtained in different simulators, MultiSim identifies, on average, up to 3.4X more simulator-agnostic failing tests and higher failure rates. To avoid the costly execution of test inputs on which simulators disagree, we propose to predict simulator disagreements and bypass test executions. Our results show that utilizing a surrogate model during the search retains the average number of valid failures and also improves efficiency. Our findings indicate that combining an ensemble of simulators is a promising approach for the automated cross-replication in ADAS testing.
papers.journal_ref: Published in Empirical Software Engineering (EMSE), Vol. 31, No. 4, Article 80 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MultiSim，一种基于搜索的多模拟器集成测试方法，用于自动驾驶辅助系统（ADAS）的场景测试。MultiSim 在搜索过程中联合评估多个模拟器上的场景，优先探索跨模拟器一致的结果，从而识别模拟器无关的失败场景。实验表明，与单模拟器测试相比，MultiSim 将模拟器无关失败率平均提高66%，与独立多模拟器方法相比，有效失败测试数量平均提高3.4倍。此外，引入代理模型预测模拟器分歧可提升测试效率。
Motivation: 现有基于模拟器的 ADAS 测试中，同一场景在不同模拟器或同一模拟器的重复运行中可能产生不同结果（易碎性或物理实现差异），导致单模拟器测试难以泛化。需要一种方法识别跨模拟器一致且可复现的失败场景。
Method: 提出 MultiSim 方法，基于搜索测试（search-based testing）框架，在进化搜索的每一代中，将每个候选场景在多个模拟器上联合评估。根据场景在各模拟器上的结果一致性分配优先级：跨模拟器一致的场景获得更高探索优先级，仅在一部分模拟器上失败的场景被降权。同时，训练代理模型预测模拟器分歧，跳过可能产生分歧的昂贵模拟执行。
Result: 在三个不同的车道保持 ADAS 系统和三对常用模拟器上的实验表明：MultiSim 相比单模拟器测试，模拟器无关失败率平均提高66%；相比独立多模拟器测试合并结果的方法，MultiSim 平均多识别3.4倍的模拟器无关失败测试，且失败率更高。使用代理模型预测分歧可在保持有效失败数量相近的同时提升效率。
Conclusion: 多模拟器集成（ensemble of simulators）是自动化 ADAS 测试中实现跨模拟器交叉复现（cross-replication）的有前景方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ($θ_l, θ_u$)-Parametric Multi-Task Optimization: Joint Search in Solution and Infinite Task Spaces
papers.abstract_en: Multi-task optimization is typically characterized by a fixed and finite set of tasks. The present paper relaxes this condition by considering a non-fixed and potentially infinite set of optimization tasks defined in a parameterized, continuous and bounded task space. We refer to this unique problem setting as parametric multi-task optimization (PMTO). Assuming the bounds of the task parameters to be ($\boldsymbolθ_l$, $\boldsymbolθ_u$), a novel ($\boldsymbolθ_l$, $\boldsymbolθ_u$)-PMTO algorithm is crafted to operate in two complementary modes. In an offline optimization mode, a joint search over solution and task spaces is carried out with the creation of two approximation models: (1) for mapping points in a unified solution space to the objective spaces of all tasks, which provably accelerates convergence by acting as a conduit for inter-task knowledge transfers, and (2) for probabilistically mapping tasks to their corresponding solutions, which facilitates evolutionary exploration of under-explored regions of the task space. In the online mode, the derived models enable direct optimization of any task within the bounds without the need to search from scratch. This outcome is validated on both synthetic test problems and practical case studies, with the significant real-world applicability of PMTO shown towards fast reconfiguration of robot controllers under changing task conditions. The potential of PMTO to vastly speedup the search for solutions to minimax optimization problems is also demonstrated through an example in robust engineering design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出参数化多任务优化（PMTO）问题，将传统固定有限任务集扩展为参数化连续有界任务空间。设计($\boldsymbol\theta_l, \boldsymbol\theta_u$)-PMTO算法，包含离线联合搜索构建两种近似模型（统一解空间到目标空间的映射、任务到解的概率映射）和在线直接优化模式，无需重新搜索。在合成测试问题和实际案例（如机器人控制器快速重配置）中验证了有效性，并展示其在极小极大优化问题中的应用潜力。
Motivation: 现有多任务优化通常假设固定有限的任务集，无法处理参数化连续变化的无限任务空间。
Method: 提出($\boldsymbol\theta_l, \boldsymbol\theta_u$)-PMTO算法：离线阶段联合搜索解空间和任务空间，构建两种映射模型（统一解空间到所有任务目标空间的映射以加速收敛，和任务到解的概率映射以探索任务空间未探索区域）；在线阶段利用模型直接优化任意任务。
Result: 摘要称该算法在合成测试问题和实际案例（如机器人控制器重配置）中有效，并可用于提升极小极大优化问题的求解速度。
Conclusion: PMTO框架显著扩展了多任务优化的范型，尤其适用于任务条件变化的实际场景（如机器人控制）和鲁棒工程设计。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: From Theory to Application: A Practical Introduction to Neural Operators in Scientific Computing
papers.abstract_en: This review examines neural operator architectures for learning solution operators of parametric partial differential equations (PDEs), with an emphasis on conceptual clarity and practical implementation. The work analyzes key models, including DeepONet, PCANet, and the Fourier Neural Operator, highlighting their underlying representations, computational structures, and comparative performance. These architectures are demonstrated on three canonical PDE problems: the Poisson equation, a linear elasticity problem, and a hyperelasticity problem. To make the presentation self-contained, key foundational topics are introduced, including finite-dimensional representations of function spaces, singular-value decomposition, and sampling from infinite-dimensional function spaces. Beyond forward modeling, the review discusses the use of neural operators as surrogate models within a Bayesian inverse-problem framework, including prior specification, forward-map approximation, and posterior computation. The performance of the three neural-operator architectures is evaluated on in-distribution samples, out-of-distribution samples, and Bayesian inference tasks. The review also discusses challenges related to prediction accuracy and generalization, outlining emerging strategies such as residual-based error correction and multi-level training. The review concludes by positioning neural operators within broader scientific-computing workflows and by identifying directions for reliable, scalable operator learning.

papers.title: FunHOI: Annotation-Free 3D Hand-Object Interaction Generation via Functional Text Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Hand-object interaction(HOI) is the fundamental link between human and environment, yet its dexterous and complex pose significantly challenges for gesture control. Despite significant advances in AI and robotics, enabling machines to understand and simulate hand-object interactions, capturing the semantics of functional grasping tasks remains a considerable challenge. While previous work can generate stable and correct 3D grasps, they are still far from achieving functional grasps due to unconsidered grasp semantics. To address this challenge, we propose an innovative two-stage framework, Functional Grasp Synthesis Net (FGS-Net), for generating 3D HOI driven by functional text. This framework consists of a text-guided 3D model generator, Functional Grasp Generator (FGG), and a pose optimization strategy, Functional Grasp Refiner (FGR). FGG generates 3D models of hands and objects based on text input, while FGR fine-tunes the poses using Object Pose Approximator and energy functions to ensure the relative position between the hand and object aligns with human intent and remains physically plausible. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves precise and high-quality HOI generation without requiring additional 3D annotation data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FGS-Net，一个无需标注数据的两阶段框架，利用功能文本驱动生成3D手-物交互（HOI）。FGG生成手和物体的3D模型，FGR通过物体位姿近似器和能量函数优化姿态，实现符合人类意图且物理合理的交互。实验表明该方法能生成精确且高质量的HOI。
Motivation: 现有手-物交互生成方法主要关注稳定性和正确性，但忽略了功能性抓取的语义，难以实现功能性的抓取。
Method: 提出两阶段框架FGS-Net，包含文本引导的3D模型生成器FGG和姿态优化策略FGR。FGG根据文本生成手和物体模型，FGR使用物体位姿近似器和能量函数微调姿态，确保手与物体相对位置符合意图且物理合理。
Result: 无需额外3D标注数据，实现了精确且高质量的手-物交互生成。
Conclusion: 该方法通过功能文本引导实现了语义驱动的功能性抓取，但摘要未提及局限或未来工作。

papers.title: ParamMute: Suppressing Knowledge-Critical FFNs for Faithful Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) integrated with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) have improved factuality by grounding outputs in external evidence. However, they remain susceptible to unfaithful generation, where outputs contradict retrieved context despite its relevance and accuracy. Existing approaches aiming to improve faithfulness primarily focus on enhancing the utilization of external context, but often overlook the persistent influence of internal parametric knowledge during generation. In this work, we investigate the internal mechanisms behind unfaithful generation and identify a subset of mid-to-deep feed-forward networks (FFNs) that are disproportionately activated in such cases. Building on this insight, we propose Parametric Knowledge Muting through FFN Suppression (ParamMute), a framework that improves contextual faithfulness by suppressing the activation of unfaithfulness-associated FFNs and calibrating the model toward retrieved knowledge. To evaluate our approach, we introduce CoFaithfulQA, a benchmark specifically designed to evaluate faithfulness in scenarios where internal knowledge conflicts with accurate external evidence. Experimental results show that ParamMute significantly enhances faithfulness across both CoFaithfulQA and the established ConFiQA benchmark, achieving substantial reductions in reliance on parametric memory. These findings underscore the importance of mitigating internal knowledge dominance and provide a new direction for improving LLM trustworthiness in RAG. All codes are available at https://github.com/OpenBMB/ParamMute.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究检索增强生成（RAG）中模型不忠实于检索上下文的问题，发现中深层前馈网络（FFN）在不忠实生成中过度激活，提出ParamMute方法通过抑制这些FFN来校准模型依赖检索知识。构建CoFaithfulQA基准评估，实验显示ParamMute提升了忠实性，减少了参数记忆依赖。
Motivation: 现有方法注重增强对外部上下文的利用，但忽视了内部参数知识对生成的持续影响，导致即使在检索上下文相关且准确时仍可能产生不忠实输出。
Method: 识别出中深层FFN子集在不忠实生成中过度激活，提出ParamMute框架，通过抑制这些FFN的激活来减弱参数记忆的影响，迫使模型更依赖检索知识。
Result: 在CoFaithfulQA和ConFiQA基准上，ParamMute显著提升了忠实性，大幅减少了对参数记忆的依赖。
Conclusion: 减轻内部知识主导对提升LLM在RAG中的可信度至关重要，为改进忠实性提供了新方向。代码开源。

papers.title: Transport Quasi-Monte Carlo
papers.abstract_en: Quasi-Monte Carlo (QMC) is a powerful method for evaluating high-dimensional integrals. However, its use is typically limited to distributions where direct sampling is straightforward, such as the uniform distribution on the unit hypercube or the Gaussian distribution. For general target distributions with potentially unnormalized densities, leveraging the low-discrepancy property of QMC to improve accuracy remains challenging. We propose training a transport map to push forward the uniform distribution on the unit hypercube to approximate the target distribution. Inspired by normalizing flows, the transport map is constructed as a composition of simple, invertible transformations. To ensure that QMC achieves its superior error rate, the transport map must satisfy specific regularity conditions. We introduce a flexible parametrization for the transport map that not only meets these conditions but is also expressive enough to model complex distributions. Our theoretical analysis establishes that the proposed transport QMC estimator achieves faster convergence rates than standard Monte Carlo, under mild and easily verifiable growth conditions on the integrand. Numerical experiments confirm the theoretical results, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed method in Bayesian inference tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出传输拟蒙特卡洛方法 (Transport QMC)，通过训练一个可逆传输映射将均匀分布推送到目标分布，从而将QMC的低差异优势推广到一般分布（包括未归一化密度）。理论证明在积分函数满足温和增长条件时收敛速度优于标准蒙特卡洛，贝叶斯推断实验验证了有效性。
Motivation: 传统QMC仅适用于可直接抽样的简单分布（如均匀、高斯），对于一般高维目标分布难以直接利用低差异序列提升精度。本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 受normalizing flows启发，构造由一系列简单可逆变换复合而成的传输映射，并确保映射满足正则性条件以维持QMC的误差率。映射参数化既灵活又能保证所需条件。
Result: 理论分析表明，在积分函数满足易验证的增长条件下，所提估计量达到比标准蒙特卡洛更快的收敛速度。数值实验在贝叶斯推断中验证了该方法的有效性。
Conclusion: 传输QMC将低差异序列的优点扩展至更一般的目标分布，并在理论上给出了收敛率保证。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Goal-Driven Reasoning in DatalogMTL with Magic Sets
papers.abstract_en: DatalogMTL is a powerful rule-based language for temporal reasoning. Due to its high expressive power and flexible modeling capabilities, it is suitable for a wide range of applications, including tasks from industrial and financial sectors. However, due to its high computational complexity, practical reasoning in DatalogMTL is highly challenging. To address this difficulty, we introduce a new reasoning method for DatalogMTL which exploits the magic sets technique -- a rewriting approach developed for (non-temporal) Datalog to simulate top-down evaluation with bottom-up reasoning. We have implemented this approach and evaluated it on publicly available benchmarks, showing that the proposed approach significantly and consistently outperformed state-of-the-art reasoning techniques.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对DatalogMTL（一种基于规则的高表达力时序推理语言）的高计算复杂度问题，引入magic sets重写技术以模拟自顶向下求值，从而实现高效的自底向上推理。在公开基准上的实验表明，该方法显著且一致地优于现有最先进的推理技术。
Motivation: DatalogMTL因其高表达力和灵活性适用于工业与金融领域的时序推理任务，但高计算复杂度使得实际推理极具挑战，亟需更高效的推理方法。
Method: 提出基于magic sets的推理方法：通过重写规则模拟自顶向下求值，利用自底向上推理引擎实现目标导向的查询评估。
Result: 在公开基准上，该方法的性能显著且一致地超越了现有最先进的DatalogMTL推理技术（具体提升幅度未在摘要中量化）。
Conclusion: magic sets技术能有效缓解DatalogMTL的高计算复杂度，为目标导向的时序推理提供实用方案，但摘要未讨论泛化性或局限性。

papers.title: GERD: Geometric event response data generation
papers.abstract_en: Event-based vision sensors offer high temporal resolution, high dynamic range, and low power consumption, yet event-based vision models lag behind conventional frame-based vision methods. We argue that this gap is partly due to the lack of principled study of the transformation groups that govern event-based visual streams. Motivated by the role that geometric and group-theoretic methods have played in advancing computer vision, we present GERD: a simulator for generating event-based recordings of objects under precisely controlled affine, Galilean, and temporal scaling transformations. By providing ground-truth transformations at each timestep, GERD enables hypothesis-driven and controlled studies of geometric properties that are otherwise hard to isolate in real-world datasets or with current event simulators. GERD supports three noise models and sub-pixel motion as a complement to real sensor datasets. We demonstrate its use in training by evaluating models from the literature with geometric guarantees and release GERD as an open tool available at
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GERD，一个用于生成事件相机数据（事件流）的模拟器，支持在仿射变换、伽利略变换和时间缩放变换下精确控制目标的几何变换。该模拟器提供每步真实变换，有助于研究事件视觉中的几何性质，并支持三种噪声模型和亚像素运动。
Motivation: 事件视觉模型在性能上落后于传统帧式视觉方法，部分原因在于缺乏对事件视觉流中变换组的系统研究。GERD旨在提供可控的几何变换模拟环境，以弥补现有数据集和模拟器在隔离几何性质方面的不足。
Method: GERD是一个基于事件的模拟器，能够生成受控仿射、伽利略和时间缩放变换下的事件记录，提供每步的真实变换。支持三种噪声模型和亚像素运动。
Result: 摘要中未提供具体实验结果，但展示了GERD在训练中的应用，通过评估具有几何保证的模型来验证其用途。
Conclusion: GERD作为开源工具，可用于事件视觉中几何性质的研究，补充真实传感器数据集。

papers.title: GSurf: Learning Signed Distance Fields from Splatting Opaque Gaussians for High-quality 3D Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: High-fidelity surface reconstruction from multi-view images is a core problem in 3D computer vision. While neural implicit surfaces like SDFs offer smooth geometry, they are often bottlenecked by the computational intensity of volume rendering. Conversely, 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) provides rapid training but lacks geometry continuity, often leading to fragmented surfaces. This paper presents a novel framework that integrates Signed Distance Fields directly into the splatting pipeline. By leveraging the continuous nature of SDFs to regularize Gaussian primitives, our method effectively fills geometric holes and suppresses noise inherent in sparse point clouds. Unlike hybrid approaches that rely on heavy volumetric sampling, our approach utilizes the efficiency of splatting to achieve faster convergence. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our method produces high-quality surfaces with significantly fewer primitives, offering a more compact and efficient representation for both indoor and outdoor environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出GSurf框架，将符号距离场（SDF）直接集成到3D高斯溅射（3DGS）管道中，利用SDF连续性正则化高斯原语，在保持溅射高效性的同时实现高质量表面重建，显著减少原语数量并提升几何完整性。
Motivation: 神经隐式表面（如SDF）虽能提供平滑几何，但体渲染计算量大；3D高斯溅射训练快但缺乏几何连续性，易导致表面碎片化。
Method: 将SDF作为隐式几何表示嵌入3DGS溅射流程，通过SDF的连续约束填充几何空洞、抑制稀疏点云噪声，避免混合方法中的体积采样开销。
Result: 在室内外场景中，该方法用更少的高斯原语生成高质量表面，收敛更快，表示更紧凑高效。
Conclusion: GSurf证明了将连续SDF约束融入溅射管线的有效性，为兼顾效率与精度的表面重建提供了新方案。

papers.title: Koopman-informed recurrent neural networks
papers.abstract_en: Recurrent neural networks are a successful neural architecture for many time-dependent problems, including time series analysis, forecasting, and modeling of dynamical systems. In the context of dynamical systems, training with backpropagation through time can lead to challenges arising from exploding or vanishing gradients. In this contribution, we introduce Koopman-informed recurrent neural networks, a computational approach to construct all weights and biases of a recurrent neural network without using gradient-based methods. The approach is based on a combination of random feature networks and Koopman operator theory for dynamical systems. The hidden parameters of a single recurrent block are sampled at random, while the outer weights are constructed using extended dynamic mode decomposition. This approach alleviates some problems with backpropagation commonly related to recurrent networks. The connection to Koopman operator theory also allows us to start using results in this area to analyze recurrent neural networks. In computational experiments on time series, forecasting for chaotic dynamical systems, control problems, and on real-world data, we observe that with comparable forecasting accuracy, the training time of the Koopman-informed recurrent neural networks is significantly improved when compared to models trained with commonly used gradient-based methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Koopman-informed循环神经网络，通过随机特征网络与Koopman算子理论结合，无需梯度方法即可构造RNN所有权重和偏置，在多个时间序列任务中实现与梯度方法相当的预测精度，并显著缩短训练时间。
Motivation: 循环神经网络在训练中常面临梯度爆炸或消失问题，基于时间反向传播的优化方式存在挑战。本文旨在避免梯度方法，同时保持RNN对动力学系统的建模能力。
Method: 采用随机特征网络随机采样单个循环块的隐藏参数，利用扩展动态模态分解构造外部权重，整体基于Koopman算子理论，使RNN的构建与梯度无关。
Result: 在时间序列预测、混沌动力学系统、控制问题及真实世界数据上的实验表明，与常用梯度方法训练的模型相比，Koopman-informed RNN在保持相近预测精度的同时，训练时间显著降低。
Conclusion: 该方法不仅解决了梯度相关问题，还通过Koopman算子理论为RNN分析提供了新视角，但未明确讨论在降水或气象领域的具体应用。

papers.title: Joint Bayesian Parameter and Model Order Estimation for Low-Rank Probability Mass Tensors
papers.abstract_en: Obtaining a reliable estimate of the joint probability mass function (PMF) of a set of random variables from observed data is a significant objective in statistical signal processing and machine learning. Modelling the joint PMF as a tensor that admits a low-rank canonical polyadic decomposition (CPD) has enabled the development of efficient PMF estimation algorithms. However, these algorithms require the rank (model order) of the tensor to be specified beforehand. In real-world applications, the true rank is unknown. Therefore, an appropriate rank is usually selected from a candidate set either by observing validation errors or by computing various likelihood-based information criteria, a procedure that could be costly in terms of computational time or hardware resources, or could result in mismatched models which affect the model accuracy. This paper presents a novel Bayesian framework for estimating the low-rank components of a joint PMF tensor and simultaneously inferring its rank from the observed data. We specify a Bayesian PMF estimation model and employ appropriate prior distributions for the model parameters, allowing the rank to be inferred without cross-validation.We then derive a deterministic solution based on variational inference (VI) to approximate the posterior distributions of various model parameters. Numerical experiments involving both synthetic data and real classification and item recommendation data illustrate the advantages of our VI-based method in terms of estimation accuracy, automatic rank detection, and computational efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种贝叶斯框架，用于从观测数据中联合估计低秩联合概率质量函数（PMF）张量的参数和秩。通过变分推断（VI）近似后验分布，无需交叉验证即可自动推断秩。在合成数据和真实分类、推荐数据上的实验表明，该方法在估计精度、自动秩检测和计算效率方面具有优势。
Motivation: 现有低秩CPD的PMF估计算法需要预先指定张量秩，而真实秩未知，传统方法通过交叉验证或信息准则选择秩，计算成本高或导致模型失配。
Method: 建立贝叶斯PMF估计模型，对模型参数使用适当先验分布，允许从数据中推断秩，并基于变分推断导出确定性解以近似后验分布。
Result: 数值实验（合成数据及真实分类、推荐数据）表明，该方法在估计精度、自动秩检测和计算效率上优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 所提贝叶斯框架能有效联合估计低秩PMF张量的参数和秩，避免了交叉验证，适用于统计信号处理和机器学习中的PMF估计问题。

papers.title: IFAR: Multi-Perspective and Multi-Level Causal Discovery with LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have developed rapidly, and their reasoning capabilities have become a hot research topic. However, there is still limited exploration of abductive reasoning. The multi-perspective and multi-level of causes is one of the core challenges of abductive reasoning, which cannot be solved well by existing methods. We construct a specialized dataset named DeepAbduction, which is designed for tracing the causes of pollution and disease, addressing the lack of datasets in this field. We propose \textsc{Inverse-Forward Abductive Reasoning} (IFAR) framework for LLMs multi-perspective and multi-level abductive reasoning. IFAR is zero-shot and combines generalized backward reasoning with relation-by-relation forward verification. Experimental results show that IFAR achieves an improvement of approximately 40\% in the F1 score compared to other methods under mainstream LLMs, while maintaining a balance between recall and precision. Furthermore, IFAR enhances the performance of non-reasoning LLMs to surpass LLMs which have been trained for reasoning, and remains effective when applied to the latter. Code will be released after the acceptance of our work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型在溯因推理（abductive reasoning）中难以处理多视角、多层级原因的问题，提出了基于逆向-正向推理的IFAR框架。该方法为零样本，结合广义反向推理与逐关系前向验证。在自主构建的污染与疾病原因追踪数据集DeepAbduction上，IFAR在主流LLM下将F1分数提升约40%，并能使非推理LLM的性能超越专门训练的推理LLM。
Motivation: 现有LLM推理研究多聚焦于演绎与归纳，对溯因推理的探索不足，而溯因推理的核心挑战之一——原因的多视角与多层级——尚未被现有方法有效解决。
Method: 提出IFAR（Inverse-Forward Abductive Reasoning）框架，采用零样本方式，先进行广义反向推理生成候选因果假设，再通过逐关系前向验证进行筛选。
Result: 在DeepAbduction数据集上，IFAR在主流LLM下将F1分数提升约40%，同时保持精确率与召回率的平衡；非推理LLM使用IFAR后性能超越推理LLM，且对推理LLM也有增益。
Conclusion: IFAR框架有效提升了LLM在多视角、多层级溯因推理任务上的表现，且具有零样本、通用性强的特点。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Contribution of XAI for the Safe Development and Certification of AI: An Expert-Based Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Developing and certifying safe - or so-called trustworthy - AI has become an increasingly salient issue, especially in light of upcoming regulation such as the EU AI Act. In this context, the black-box nature of machine learning models limits the use of conventional avenues of approach towards certifying complex technical systems. As a potential solution, methods to give insights into this black-box - devised in the field of eXplainable AI (XAI) - could be used. In this study, the potential and shortcomings of such methods for the purpose of safe AI development and certification are discussed in 15 qualitative interviews with experts out of the areas of (X)AI and certification. We find that XAI methods can be a helpful asset for safe AI development, as they can show biases and failures of ML-models, but since certification relies on comprehensive and correct information about technical systems, their impact is expected to be limited.

The Version of Record of this contribution is published in Artificial Intelligence in HCI (HCII 2026), Lecture Notes in Computer Science, vol. 16745, and is available online at https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-032-30849-8_13

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过15位（X）AI与认证领域专家的定性访谈，探讨可解释AI（XAI）方法在安全AI开发与认证中的潜力与局限。结果表明XAI能帮助揭示ML模型的偏见和失败，但由于认证需要技术系统的全面且正确信息，其实际影响预计有限。研究为即将到来的欧盟AI法案等监管背景下的AI可靠性提供了专家视角。
Motivation: AI安全认证日益重要（如欧盟AI法案），但ML模型的黑箱特性阻碍了传统认证方法。XAI方法可能为黑箱提供洞察，但其在认证中的实际作用尚不明确。
Method: 采用定性研究方法，对15位来自（X）AI和认证领域的专家进行半结构化访谈，分析XAI在安全AI开发和认证中的贡献与局限。
Result: 专家认为XAI有助于检测模型偏见和失败，但因其无法提供技术系统的全面正确信息，对认证的贡献有限。
Conclusion: XAI可作为安全AI开发的辅助工具，但在认证中作用受限，建议在监管框架下谨慎评估其适用性。
