papers.title: Data Alchemy: Mitigating Cross-Site Model Variability Through Test Time Data Calibration
papers.abstract_en: Deploying deep learning-based imaging tools across various clinical sites poses significant challenges due to inherent domain shifts and regulatory hurdles associated with site-specific fine-tuning. For histopathology, stain normalization techniques can mitigate discrepancies, but they often fall short of eliminating inter-site variations. Therefore, we present Data Alchemy, an explainable stain normalization method combined with test time data calibration via a template learning framework to overcome barriers in cross-site analysis. Data Alchemy handles shifts inherent to multi-site data and minimizes them without needing to change the weights of the normalization or classifier networks. Our approach extends to unseen sites in various clinical settings where data domain discrepancies are unknown. Extensive experiments highlight the efficacy of our framework in tumor classification in hematoxylin and eosin-stained patches. Our explainable normalization method boosts classification tasks' area under the precision-recall curve(AUPR) by 0.165, 0.545 to 0.710. Additionally, Data Alchemy further reduces the multisite classification domain gap, by improving the 0.710 AUPR an additional 0.142, elevating classification performance further to 0.852, from 0.545. Our Data Alchemy framework can popularize precision medicine with minimal operational overhead by allowing for the seamless integration of pre-trained deep learning-based clinical tools across multiple sites.
papers.comment: accepted to Machine Learning in Medical Imaging (MLMI 2024)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Data Alchemy，一种可解释的染色标准化与测试时数据校准方法，用于缓解多站点医学影像中的域转移问题。在HE染色肿瘤分类任务上，AUPR从0.545提升至0.852，无需调整网络权重。方法适用于未见站点，有助于推广预训练临床工具。

Method: 结合可解释染色标准化与基于模板学习的测试时数据校准，不修改模型权重，适用于未知域转移场景。
Result: 在HE染色肿瘤分类中，AUPR从0.545提升至0.710（+0.165），进一步校准后提升至0.852（额外+0.142）。
Conclusion: Data Alchemy能以最小操作开销实现预训练深度学习工具的多站点无缝集成，推动精准医学普及。

papers.title: XOV-Action: Towards Generalizable Open-Vocabulary Action Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Inspired by the impressive success of image-text foundation models, recent works have proposed to adapt these foundation models to video data, leading to efficient and effective video models for open-vocabulary action recognition. However, through a comprehensive evaluation, our work finds that state-of-the-art open-vocabulary action recognition models still struggle with generalization to video domains that they have not encountered. To address this limitation, we introduce \textit{generalizable open-vocabulary action recognition}, which aims to develop action recognition models capable of generalizing to both novel action categories and unseen video domains. Our work contributes a novel model named XOV-Action to overcome two critical challenges: (1) understanding novel action concepts of open-set categories, and (2) mitigating the scenario discrepancy between training and test datasets. Specifically, XOV-Action first proposes to capture diverse action-related concepts by learning diversified elaboration representations, which enables better generalization to open-set action categories. Second, XOV-Action learns scene-agnostic video representations to overcome the scene bias, which improves the generalization in unseen video domains. Additionally, to evaluate models in generalizable open-vocabulary action recognition, we contribute a new cross-domain action benchmark named XOVABench, which covers multiple video domains with varying degrees of gaps and consists of both closed-set and open-set action categories. Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that our proposed XOV-Action can effectively improve action recognition performance for both closed-set and open-set categories across video domains. The benchmark is available at https://github.com/KunyuLin/XOV-Action/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对开放词汇动作识别中模型对新视频域泛化能力不足的问题，提出 XOV-Action 模型。该模型通过学习多样化的阐述表示来捕获开放集类别的动作概念，并学习场景无关的视频表示以克服场景偏差，从而提升对未见视频域的泛化能力。同时，贡献了包含多个视频域和开集/闭集类别的跨域动作基准 XOVABench。实验表明 XOV-Action 能有效提升跨域动作识别性能。
Motivation: 现有开放词汇动作识别模型在面对未见过的视频域时泛化能力较差，无法同时处理新动作类别和域偏移。
Method: 提出 XOV-Action 模型，包含两个关键模块：1) 学习多样化阐述表示以捕获开放集类别的动作相关概念；2) 学习场景无关视频表示以减轻场景偏差。
Result: 在多个视频域和开集/闭集类别上，XOV-Action 提升了动作识别性能，具体定量结果见论文。
Conclusion: 本文强调了跨域开放词汇动作识别的重要性，提出的方法能有效改善泛化性，但仍需更多域和更复杂场景的验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Conformal Predictive Programming for Chance Constrained Optimization
papers.abstract_en: We propose conformal predictive programming (CPP), a framework to solve chance constrained optimization problems, i.e., optimization problems with constraints that are functions of random variables. CPP utilizes samples from these random variables along with the quantile lemma - central to conformal prediction - to transform the chance constrained optimization problem into a deterministic problem with a quantile reformulation. CPP's main strength is an independent calibration step that provides a posteriori guarantees for the solution of this problem that are of conditional and marginal nature otherwise. These guarantees even apply in settings when assumptions required for obtaining standard a priori guarantees (e.g., in scenario optimization or sample average approximation) are unavailable, difficult to compute, or conservative. Another strength of CPP is that it can easily support different variants of conformal prediction which have been (or will be) proposed within the conformal prediction community. To illustrate this, we present robust CPP to deal with distribution shifts in the random variables and Mondrian CPP to deal with class conditional chance constraints. In a series of case studies, we show the validity of the aforementioned approaches, and illustrate the advantage of CPP as compared to scenario approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出共形预测规划（CPP）框架，用于求解机会约束优化问题。CPP利用随机变量样本和分位数引理（共形预测的核心思想），将机会约束优化转化为带有分位数重写的确定性问题。CPP的主要优势在于独立的标定步骤，能够为解提供后验条件性和边际性保证，即使在无法获得标准先验保证（如场景优化或样本平均近似）的情况下也适用。此外，CPP支持共形预测的多种变体，如鲁棒CPP处理分布偏移，Mondrian CPP处理类别条件机会约束。案例研究验证了方法的有效性，并展示了CPP相对于场景方法的优势。
Motivation: 求解机会约束优化问题时，现有方法（如场景优化、样本平均近似）需要先验假设，当这些假设不成立或保守时，难以提供可靠的解的保证。本文旨在提供一种无需强先验假设、并能提供后验保证的通用框架。
Method: 提出共形预测规划（CPP）框架，利用随机变量样本和分位数引理将机会约束优化转化为确定性分位数问题；通过独立的标定步骤（基于共形预测）为解提供后验保证；并扩展出鲁棒CPP和Mondrian CPP两种变体，分别处理分布偏移和类别条件约束。
Result: 论文在案例研究中验证了CPP方法的有效性，并展示了其相对于场景方法（scenario approach）的优势，但未在气象等领域进行验证。
Conclusion: CPP为机会约束优化提供了一种灵活的框架，能够在弱假设下获得高质量的保证解，尤其适合传统方法不适用的场景。

papers.title: Precise localization within the GI tract by combining classification of CNNs and time-series analysis of HMMs
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a method to efficiently classify the gastroenterologic section of images derived from Video Capsule Endoscopy (VCE) studies by exploring the combination of a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for classification with the time-series analysis properties of a Hidden Markov Model (HMM). It is demonstrated that successive time-series analysis identifies and corrects errors in the CNN output. Our approach achieves an accuracy of $98.04\%$ on the Rhode Island (RI) Gastroenterology dataset. This allows for precise localization within the gastrointestinal (GI) tract while requiring only approximately 1M parameters and thus, provides a method suitable for low power devices
papers.comment: Accepted at MLMI 2023, Code on Github: https://github.com/juliawerner/cnn-hmm-viterbi
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出结合卷积神经网络（CNN）与隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）的方法，用于视频胶囊内镜（VCE）图像的胃肠道分段分类。通过HMM的时间序列分析纠正CNN输出的错误，在罗德岛胃肠病学数据集上达到98.04%的准确率，且模型仅需约1百万参数，适合低功耗设备。
Motivation: 视频胶囊内镜图像数量庞大，需要高效自动分类以精确定位胃肠道区域，现有单一CNN方法可能因时间依赖性而产生误分类。
Method: 使用CNN进行单帧图像分类，然后将分类结果序列输入HMM进行时间序列分析，利用Viterbi算法解码最可能的分类路径，从而修正CNN的局部错误。
Result: 在罗德岛胃肠病学数据集上达到98.04%的准确率，模型参数量仅约1百万，表明该方法兼具高精度和低资源需求。
Conclusion: CNN与HMM的组合能有效提升胃肠道定位的准确性，且模型轻量，适用于资源受限的设备。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Efficient Partitioning Method of Large-Scale Public Safety Spatio-Temporal Data based on Information Loss Constraints
papers.abstract_en: The storage, management, and application of massive spatio-temporal data are widely used in practical scenarios, including public safety. However, due to the unique spatio-temporal distribution characteristics of real-world data, existing methods still face limitations in preserving spatio-temporal proximity and achieving load balancing in distributed storage. This paper proposes an efficient partitioning method for large-scale public safety spatio-temporal data based on information loss constraints, named IFL-LSTP. The model combines a spatio-temporal partitioning module (STPM) and a graph partitioning module (GPM). STPM reduces the scale of data under a predefined information-loss threshold, while GPM uses graph representation learning to obtain balanced graph partitions. Experiments on multiple real-world datasets show that IFL-LSTP can reduce data scale, shorten graph model training time, preserve spatio-temporal proximity, and improve load-balancing effectiveness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于信息损失约束的大规模公共安全时空数据高效分区方法 IFL-LSTP，结合时空分区模块（STPM）和图分区模块（GPM），在预定义信息损失阈值下降低数据规模，并使用图表示学习获得平衡的图分区。多个真实数据集实验表明，该方法能降低数据规模、缩短图模型训练时间、保持时空邻近性并提升负载均衡效果。
Motivation: 现有方法在处理大规模时空数据时难以同时保持时空邻近性和分布式存储的负载均衡。
Method: 提出 IFL-LSTP，包含时空分区模块（STPM）和图分区模块（GPM），STPM 在预定义信息损失阈值下降低数据规模，GPM 使用图表示学习获得平衡的图分区。
Result: 多个真实数据集实验表明，IFL-LSTP 能降低数据规模、缩短图模型训练时间、保持时空邻近性并提升负载均衡效果。
Conclusion: 该方法在公共安全时空数据分析中有效，但摘要未提及局限性。

papers.title: Calibrated Stackelberg Games: Learning Optimal Commitments Against Calibrated Agents
papers.abstract_en: We introduce \emph{Calibrated Stackelberg Games (CSGs)}, a generalization of the standard Stackelberg Games (SGs) framework. In CSGs, a principal repeatedly interacts with an agent who (contrary to standard SGs) does not have direct access to the principal's action but instead best-responds to calibrated forecasts about it. This framework provides a powerful and realistic modeling tool that goes beyond assuming that agents use ad hoc and highly specified algorithms for interacting in strategic settings and instead builds on statistical foundations of forecasts and calibration. We show that in CSGs, despite both the principal and the agent having less information than in standard SGs, the principal's optimal utility remains upper and lower bounded by the Stackelberg value of the one-shot game, in both finite and continuous settings. Alongside CSGs, we develop stronger notions of calibration and corresponding algorithms that address two central challenges for calibration in game-theoretic environments. First, achieving point-wise calibration typically incurs an error that scales exponentially with the dimension of the strategy space. Second, the principal's convergence rate in CSGs depends critically on the adaptivity of the agent's calibration algorithm. To address these challenges, we establish a meaningful, efficiently achievable relaxation of calibration based on conditioning on best-response regions. This yields the first notion of calibration in games with a statistical rate that only depends on the number of agents' actions rather than the dimension of the principal's strategy space and that leads to no-swap regret for the agent. We further develop adaptive calibration algorithms for the agents that provide fine-grained, any-time calibration guarantees against adversarial sequences, enabling the principal to achieve faster convergence in CSGs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出校准斯塔克尔伯格博弈（CSGs），推广了标准斯塔克尔伯格博弈框架。在该博弈中，主体没有直接观察主事的行动，而是基于关于主事行动的校准预测做出最佳响应。作者证明，在有限和连续设定下，主事的最优效用仍以单阶段博弈的斯塔克尔伯格值为上下界。同时，开发了基于最佳响应区域条件化的校准概念和算法，使得校准的统计速率仅依赖于主体行动数量而非主事策略空间维度，并实现无交换遗憾。
Motivation: 标准斯塔克尔伯格博弈假设主体能直接观察主事行动，但现实中主体往往只能基于预测做出决策。需要一种更现实的模型，基于预测和校准的统计基础，而不是依赖特定的启发式算法。
Method: 引入校准斯塔克尔伯格博弈（CSGs），主体使用校准预测决定行动。提出基于最佳响应区域条件化的松弛校准概念，并开发自适应校准算法，提供细粒度的任意时间校准保证，对抗对抗序列。
Result: 主事的最优效用在有限和连续设定下均以斯塔克尔伯格值为上下界。校准的统计速率仅依赖于主体行动数量，与主事策略空间维度无关，且主体达到无交换遗憾。
Conclusion: CSGs为标准博弈提供了更现实的扩展，证明了即使在信息减少的情况下，主事仍能获得接近最优的效用。新的校准概念和算法在博弈论环境中具有理论和实践意义。

papers.title: Computation, Condensation, and the Incompleteness Between Them: A Coupled Foundation of Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: The theory of computation was built to answer Turing's question: what is effectively calculable by an unbounded, immortal, disembodied agent following rules? Intelligence answers a different question (nature's): what can a \emph{finite}, mortal, energy-limited agent do quickly enough to survive in a non-stationary world? We argue that a complete answer requires two operators: \emph{computation} and \emph{memorizaion}. Computation, $\dpar$, transforms structure toward closure; memorization, $\kap$, condenses a validated closed cycle into a reusable token. Turing formalized $\dpar$ and abstracted $\kap$ away, because his agent had infinite time and never needed to amortize. The new insight of our position paper is that the coupling of the two is not optional but \emph{forced}, and forced by a precise mathematical fact: \textbf{neither operator alone can be complete}. We prove that symbolic computation confined to a discrete sector suffers Gödel's diagonalization incompleteness, that geometric descent confined to a continuous sector suffers a Morse forced-saddle incompleteness, and that these two are not analogies but the parity-conjugate faces of a single obstruction on a coherent complex with $\dpar^2=0$ - the even face realized by diagonalization, the odd by the topologically forced saddle, and no resolution confined to one parity able to come full circle. Intelligence must therefore couple both modes. We then locate the price of the coupling: its hinge operation, context-identification (the recognize-versus-discover decision), is exactly where the two incompletenesses coincide, hence undecidable and carrying an irreducible error floor. Finally we argue that the coupling is a universal law, realized, in the emergent sense of Anderson's ``more is different,'' at every scale from genes to thoughts to cultures, and give its falsifiable core and honest scope.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出计算（computation）和记忆（memorization）是两个基本算子，它们的耦合是智能的必要基础。作者证明单独使用符号计算或几何下降均存在不完备性，二者实际上是同一障碍的奇偶共轭面，只有耦合才能解决。耦合的关键操作——上下文识别（context-identification）是不可判定的，因此存在固有的错误下界。论文认为这种耦合是跨越基因、思维和文化的普适规律。
Motivation: 图灵的计算理论假设了无限的、不死的、非体化的代理，而智能需要有限、有限能量、快速反应的代理。现有理论忽视了记忆（或凝结）算子，导致对智能的完整理解缺失。
Method: 通过理论分析，证明符号离散领域的计算面临哥德尔对角线不完备性，连续领域的几何下降面临莫尔斯强迫鞍点不完备性，并证明这两者是同一障碍的奇偶共轭面。耦合这两个算子是数学上被迫的。
Conclusion: 智能必须耦合计算和记忆两个算子，且这种耦合在从基因到文化的各个尺度上普遍存在。耦合的代价是上下文识别操作的不可判定性，导致不可消除的错误下限。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出计算（computation）和记忆（memorization）是两个基本算子，它们的耦合是智能的必要基础。作者证明单独使用符号计算或几何下降均存在不完备性，二者实际上是同一障碍的奇偶共轭面，只有耦合才能解决。耦合的关键操作——上下文识别（context-identification）是不可判定的，因此存在固有的错误下界。论文认为这种耦合是跨越基因、思维和文化的普适规律。
summary_sections.motivation: 图灵的计算理论假设了无限的、不死的、非体化的代理，而智能需要有限、有限能量、快速反应的代理。现有理论忽视了记忆（或凝结）算子，导致对智能的完整理解缺失。
summary_sections.method: 通过理论分析，证明符号离散领域的计算面临哥德尔对角线不完备性，连续领域的几何下降面临莫尔斯强迫鞍点不完备性，并证明这两者是同一障碍的奇偶共轭面。耦合这两个算子是数学上被迫的。
summary_sections.conclusion: 智能必须耦合计算和记忆两个算子，且这种耦合在从基因到文化的各个尺度上普遍存在。耦合的代价是上下文识别操作的不可判定性，导致不可消除的错误下限。

papers.title: Retrieval of Scientific and Technological Resources for Experts and Scholars
papers.abstract_en: Institutions of higher learning, research institutes and other scientific research units have abundant scientific and technological resources of experts and scholars, and these talents with great scientific and technological innovation ability are an important force to promote industrial upgrading. The scientific and technological resources of experts and scholars are mainly composed of basic attributes and scientific research achievements. The basic attributes include information such as research interests, institutions, and educational work experience. However, due to information asymmetry and other reasons, the scientific and technological resources of experts and scholars cannot be connected with the society in a timely manner, and social needs cannot be accurately matched with experts and scholars. Therefore, it is very necessary to build an expert and scholar information database and provide relevant expert and scholar retrieval services. This paper sorts out the related research work in this field from four aspects: text relation extraction, text knowledge representation learning, text vector retrieval and visualization system.

papers.title: Knowledge Graph and Accurate Portrait Construction of Scientific and Technological Academic Conferences
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, with the continuous progress of science and technology, the number of scientific research achievements has increased rapidly. As an exchange platform and medium for scientific research achievements, scientific and technological academic conferences have become increasingly abundant. The convening of academic conferences brings large numbers of papers, researchers, institutions, projects, and research topics, but massive conference data also makes it difficult for researchers to obtain valuable information efficiently. It is therefore meaningful to use deep learning, knowledge graph technology, semantic similarity calculation, and portrait modeling to mine core information from conference data. This paper reviews the key technologies for constructing knowledge graphs and accurate portraits of scientific and technological academic conferences, including named entity recognition, semantic text similarity, trend prediction, graph storage, search engines, and visualization components. These techniques jointly support the construction of conference knowledge services that help researchers acquire scientific information more quickly.

papers.title: Accurate Portraits of Scientific Resources and Knowledge Service Components
papers.abstract_en: With the advent of the cloud computing era, the cost of creating, capturing, and managing information has gradually decreased. The amount of data on the Internet is showing explosive growth, and more scientific and technological resources are being uploaded to the network. Different from news and social media data, scientific and technological resources are mainly composed of academic-style resources or entities, such as papers, patents, authors, and research institutions. There is a rich relationship network between these resources, from which a large amount of cutting-edge scientific and technological information can be mined. Existing scientific resource management and classification standards are difficult to completely cover all entities and associations, and they cannot accurately extract the important information contained in scientific and technological resources. Therefore, how to construct a complete and accurate representation of scientific and technological resources from structured and unstructured reports and texts, and how to tap the potential value of scientific and technological resources, are urgent problems. A feasible solution is to construct accurate portraits of scientific and technological resources by combining knowledge graph technology, text representation learning, entity extraction, and knowledge service components.

papers.title: Real-World Blind Super-Resolution via Feature Matching with Implicit High-Resolution Priors
papers.abstract_en: A key challenge of real-world image super-resolution (SR) is to recover the missing details in low-resolution (LR) images with complex unknown degradations (e.g., downsampling, noise and compression). Most previous works restore such missing details in the image space. To cope with the high diversity of natural images, they either rely on the unstable GANs that are difficult to train and prone to artifacts, or resort to explicit references from high-resolution (HR) images that are usually unavailable. In this work, we propose Feature Matching SR (FeMaSR), which restores realistic HR images in a much more compact feature space. Unlike image-space methods, our FeMaSR restores HR images by matching distorted LR image features to their distortion-free HR counterparts in our pretrained HR priors, and decoding the matched features to obtain realistic HR images. Specifically, our HR priors contain a discrete feature codebook and its associated decoder, which are pretrained on HR images with a Vector Quantized Generative Adversarial Network (VQGAN). Notably, we incorporate a novel semantic regularization in VQGAN to improve the quality of reconstructed images. For the feature matching, we first extract LR features with an LR encoder consisting of several Swin Transformer blocks and then follow a simple nearest neighbour strategy to match them with the pretrained codebook. In particular, we equip the LR encoder with residual shortcut connections to the decoder, which is critical to the optimization of feature matching loss and also helps to complement the possible feature matching errors. Experimental results show that our approach produces more realistic HR images than previous methods. Codes are released at https://github.com/chaofengc/FeMaSR.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FeMaSR，一种面向真实世界盲超分辨率的方法，通过在特征空间中将退化LR图像特征匹配到预训练VQGAN的离散HR码本，并解码得到高质量HR图像。方法使用Swin Transformer作为LR编码器，引入残差快捷连接优化匹配损失，并加入语义正则化提升重建质量。实验结果显示生成的HR图像比现有方法更真实。
Motivation: 真实世界LR图像受复杂未知退化影响，现有方法依赖于不稳定的GAN或需要显式HR参考图像，本文旨在通过特征空间匹配避免这些问题，实现更稳定的盲SR。
Method: 预训练一个VQGAN（含离散特征码本和解码器）作为HR先验，并引入语义正则化。LR编码器基于Swin Transformer，提取特征后通过最近邻搜索匹配到码本，匹配的特征经解码器生成HR图像。编码器与解码器之间增加残差快捷连接以辅助匹配损失优化和补偿匹配错误。
Result: 在真实世界盲SR任务上，FeMaSR生成的HR图像比先前方法更真实，视觉质量更高。
Conclusion: 特征空间匹配结合预训练HR先验为盲SR提供了一种有效方案，避免了GAN的不稳定性和对HR参考的依赖，代码已开源。

papers.title: EgoWAM: World Action Models Beyond Pixels with In-the-Wild Egocentric Human Data
papers.abstract_en: Egocentric human data offers scalable supervision for robot manipulation. However, behavior cloning entangles transferable content like objects, scenes, and task semantics, with non-transferable factors like human morphology, head motion, and behavioral style. We study whether World Action Models (WAMs) provide a better training signal by requiring policies to predict not only actions, but also how the scene evolves. The central question is what world representation best enables human-to-robot transfer. We hypothesize that an effective world target should abstract appearance, capture agent-invariant physical effects, and separate camera motion from environment change. We introduce EgoWAM, a controlled human-robot co-training framework that fixes the policy backbone, action head, and data mixture while varying only the world prediction target, comparing Pixel, DINO, and 3D motion flow. Across three real-world bimanual tasks, WAM co-training scales more effectively with in-the-wild egocentric human data than behavior cloning. Pixel-based prediction transfers weakly, while DINO and 3D flow yield substantial gains: DINO improves out-of-distribution object and scene generalization by up to 4x, and 3D flow improves in-domain performance by 20-30%. More details: https://gatech-rl2.github.io/egowam.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究世界动作模型（WAM）如何利用野外自我中心人类数据训练机器人操作策略。核心问题是哪种世界表示最适合人机迁移，通过控制实验比较像素、DINO和3D运动流三种预测目标。在三个真实双手任务上的结果表明，WAM联合训练比行为克隆更有效，其中DINO提升分布外泛化最多达4倍，3D流提升域内性能20-30%。
Motivation: 行为克隆中人类数据包含不可迁移因素（人体形态、头部运动、行为风格），需要分离可迁移的内容（物体、场景、任务语义）。世界动作模型通过预测场景演化可能提供更好的训练信号。
Method: 提出EgoWAM框架，固定策略主干、动作头和数据混合，仅改变世界预测目标（像素、DINO特征、3D运动流），进行人机联合训练。
Result: 三个真实双手任务上，WAM联合训练比行为克隆缩放更有效；像素预测迁移弱，DINO提升分布外泛化最多4倍，3D流提升域内性能20-30%。
Conclusion: 摘要指出世界动作模型能从人类数据中更有效地学习可迁移表示，DINO和3D流是有效的世界目标。

papers.title: Hallucination Self-Play: Bootstrapping Reinforced Detector via Evolved Generator
papers.abstract_en: Identifying faithfulness hallucinations in LLM-generated outputs remains challenging due to the scarcity of high-quality annotated data. Recent work relies on advanced LLMs to synthesize training data, including rationales, labels, and hallucinated claims. However, these methods treat the generator as a static component, limiting iterative improvement of the detector. To address this limitation, we introduce Hallucination Self-Play (HSP), a novel framework that enables the detector to bootstrap with an evolved generator. HSP involves two roles initialized from the same base model, a detector that assesses the faithfulness of model outputs, and a generator that produces increasingly hard-to-detect hallucinated responses. Specifically, the detector is first fine-tuned on human-labeled data and then employed as a reward model to train the generator via reinforcement learning from AI feedback (RLAIF). In turn, the evolved generator synthesizes hallucination data to further optimize the detector through rule-based reinforcement learning. Experiments on RAGTruth benchmark and two model families demonstrate that the proposed framework can progressively enhance a small LLM to match or even outperform advanced LLMs without external supervision. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Hallucination-Self-Play-50B5 .
papers.comment: Accepted to COLM 2026. Camera-ready version to appear
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出幻觉自我对弈框架（Hallucination Self-Play, HSP），通过让检测器与进化的生成器自举迭代，解决LLM输出忠实性幻觉检测中高质量标注数据稀缺的问题。HSP从同一基模型初始化检测器和生成器，检测器先微调于人工标注数据，再作为奖励模型通过RLAIF训练生成器，生成器合成更难检测的幻觉数据，并基于规则强化学习进一步优化检测器。实验表明，该方法能使小型LLM在RAGTruth基准上匹配甚至超越先进LLM。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖高级LLM合成训练数据，但将生成器视为静态组件，限制了检测器的迭代改进。
Method: HSP框架包含两个角色：检测器（评估输出忠实性）和生成器（产生越来越难检测的幻觉响应）。检测器先基于人工标注数据微调，然后作为奖励模型通过RLAIF训练生成器；进化后的生成器合成幻觉数据，通过规则强化学习进一步优化检测器。
Result: 在RAGTruth基准和两个模型家族上，HSP能使小型LLM逐渐增强，匹配或超越外部监督下的先进LLM。
Conclusion: HSP通过自举迭代生成-检测过程，有效缓解了幻觉检测中标注数据不足的问题，并为无外部监督的弱模型增强提供了新途径。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在RAGTruth基准和两个模型家族上，HSP能使小型LLM逐渐增强，匹配或超越外部监督下的先进LLM。
summary_sections.conclusion: HSP通过自举迭代生成-检测过程，有效缓解了幻觉检测中标注数据不足的问题，并为无外部监督的弱模型增强提供了新途径。

papers.title: Who Broke the System? Failure Localization in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) based multi-agent systems enable complex problem solving through coordinated reasoning and action, but their distributed structure also introduces new challenges in diagnosing system-level failures. When an execution fails, identifying which agent is responsible and at what point the trajectory first becomes irreversibly misdirected is difficult due to long-horizon interactions and tightly coupled agent behaviors. In this paper, we study the problem of failure localization in LLM-based multi-agent systems and present AgentLocate, a framework that attributes failures to both a specific agent and the earliest decisive step. AgentLocate combines an LLM-based judging mechanism with multi-perspective verification by independent evaluators, whose assessments are aggregated using a confidence-aware strategy. The resulting feedback is further used to adapt the judge through lightweight fine-tuning, improving attribution quality. We evaluate AgentLocate on two complementary benchmarks covering diverse tasks, agent configurations, and trajectory lengths. Experimental results show that AgentLocate consistently outperforms existing failure localization methods in identifying both responsible agents and failure steps, while remaining efficient in terms of token usage and running time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统中的故障定位问题，提出了AgentLocate框架。该框架结合LLM裁判机制与多视角验证，通过置信度感知的聚合方法定位故障代理和最早错误步骤，并利用轻量级微调优化裁判。在两个基准上的实验表明，AgentLocate在识别责任代理和故障步骤方面优于现有方法，且令牌使用和运行时间高效。
Motivation: LLM多智能体系统分布式结构带来系统级故障诊断挑战，由于长程交互和紧密耦合的代理行为，难以在失败时确定责任代理和轨迹最早不可逆转向点。
Method: 提出AgentLocate框架，包含LLM裁判机制和独立评估者的多视角验证，通过置信度感知策略聚合评估结果，并利用反馈对裁判进行轻量级微调以提升归因质量。
Result: 在两个覆盖不同任务、代理配置和轨迹长度的基准上，AgentLocate在识别责任代理和故障步骤方面持续优于现有故障定位方法，同时保持令牌使用和运行时间的效率。
Conclusion: AgentLocate能有效定位LLM多智能体系统中的故障，归因于置信度感知的聚合和裁判微调。

papers.title: A Reliability Assessment of LALM Audio Judges for Full-Duplex Voice Agents
papers.abstract_en: We report the empirical reliability of Gemini models as audio judges that score full-duplex agent conversations directly from the raw stereo waveform, tested across three models in the Gemini family: 2.5 Flash, 3.5 Flash, and 3.1 Pro. Our primary evidence base uses Gemini 2.5 Flash as the ground-truth model, validated against three calibrated human raters on 209 stereo sessions, scored on 8 production dimensions: 152 full-duplex conversations across 13 accent-and-condition strata, together with 57 adversarial defect-injected clips. The evidence for Gemini 2.5 Flash is consistent across three tests. (i) On 5 of 8 dimensions the LALM-human Spearman rho departs from the pairwise human-human rho by at most 0.07, and on 7 of 8 dimensions the two quantities 95 percent bootstrap confidence intervals overlap. (ii) The LALM agrees with the three-rater human mean within 1 point on 60 to 92 percent of sessions on 6 of 8 dimensions. (iii) On 45 of 48 (defect, dimension) cells the LALM is as sensitive as humans or better under Newcombe-Wilson 95 percent confidence intervals, though most of these are underpowered nulls rather than demonstrated parity. Rank-ordering ability transfers across the Gemini family: 3.5 Flash improves simple agreement to 8 of 8 dimensions, while 3.1 Pro rates several dimensions markedly lower than humans despite comparable rank correlation. A model swap should be re-validated on calibration specifically, not assumed from rank-correlation alone. We identify four areas where deployment requires care, and we estimate that human rating alone for our current evaluation cadence costs roughly two orders of magnitude more than the equivalent LALM workload. The data presented here provides a defensible empirical basis for deploying the LALM as a substitute or fourth rater on the dimensions where the evidence supports it.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文评估了Gemini系列模型（2.5 Flash、3.5 Flash、3.1 Pro）作为音频评判器（LALM）在全双工语音代理对话中的可靠性。以Gemini 2.5 Flash为基准，与三位人工评判者在209个立体声会话（含152个全双工对话和57个缺陷注入片段）上比较，在8个生产维度上进行了验证。结果显示，Gemini 2.5 Flash在多数维度上与人类评判一致性较高，且对缺陷的敏感度不低于人类；模型间排序能力可迁移，但替换模型需重新验证。论文还指出部署时需注意四个领域，并估计LALM比人工评判成本低约两个数量级。
Motivation: 全双工语音代理需要自动评判对话质量，但人工评判成本高昂，因此需要可靠的自动化音频评判器。现有研究缺乏对大规模语言模型（LALM）作为音频评判者的系统可靠性评估。
Method: 使用三种Gemini模型（2.5 Flash、3.5 Flash、3.1 Pro）直接对原始立体声波形进行评分，与三位校准人工评判者在8个生产维度上比较。评估数据包括152个全双工对话（13种口音和条件）和57个缺陷注入片段。统计上通过Spearman相关性、一致性百分比和敏感性分析衡量可靠性。
Result: Gemini 2.5 Flash在8个维度中的5个上，其与人类的Spearman rho与人类间rho偏差不超过0.07；在7个维度上95%置信区间重叠。在6个维度上，LALM与三评者平均分在1分内的一致率达60-92%。在45/48个（缺陷，维度）单元格中，LALM敏感性不逊于人类。3.5 Flash在8个维度上均提升一致性，而3.1 Pro在评分绝对值上偏低但秩相关可比。
Conclusion: 在证据支持的维度上，LALM可作为人工评判的替代或第四评判者部署，但模型替换需重新验证而非仅依赖秩相关性。部署时需注意四个领域（文中未详述）。LALM成本显著低于人工。

papers.title: Agentic Neural Architecture Search
papers.abstract_en: Neural architecture search (NAS) methods have grown increasingly efficient, yet they remain bounded by manually engineered search spaces that require substantial domain expertise and must be rebuilt for every new task. Large language models (LLMs) can generate architectures in an open-ended space, but how to optimally divide the labor between LLM-driven design and NAS-driven search remains unexplored. We propose a mechanism that bridges these two paradigms: an LLM produces a high-quality seed architecture, then decomposes it into a "slotted architecture", a scaffold with named, interchangeable module slots that automatically defines a bounded, task-specific search space for conventional NAS to explore, without manual engineering. We instantiate this mechanism in AgentNAS, a modular three-phase pipeline in which each component's contribution can be measured independently. On 17 tasks spanning classification, dense regression, segmentation, and multi-label tagging across diverse modalities (NAS-Bench-360 and Unseen NAS), AgentNAS establishes a new state of the art on 11 tasks, outperforming published baselines including task-specific expert designs. Ablation studies show that the two search mechanisms are broadly complementary: the LLM-generated seed already surpasses published baselines on the majority of tasks, and NAS delivers additional gains in most cases through combinatorial recombination across slots, a mode of search that independent LLM samples cannot replicate. These patterns hold across three LLMs of different capability levels, confirming that the division of labor is robust. Our code is available at https://github.com/alroimfebruary/AgentNAS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AgentNAS，一种将大语言模型（LLM）与神经架构搜索（NAS）结合的流水线。LLM首先生成高质量种子架构，然后将其分解为带有可互换模块槽位的“槽位架构”，自动定义任务特定的搜索空间，供NAS探索。在涵盖分类、密集回归、分割和多标签标注的17个任务上，AgentNAS在11个任务上取得了新的最优结果，并证明LLM生成的种子已优于多数基线，而NAS通过槽位组合搜索进一步带来额外收益。
Motivation: 现有NAS方法受限于人工设计的搜索空间，需领域专家为每个新任务重建；LLM可以生成任意架构，但如何最优分配LLM设计任务与NAS搜索任务尚未被探索。
Method: 提出AgentNAS机制：LLM生成高质量种子架构后，将其分解为“槽位架构”（包含命名、可互换的模块槽位），自动定义有界且任务特定的搜索空间，供传统NAS进行组合搜索。流水线分为三个阶段，每个阶段贡献可独立评估。
Result: 在NAS-Bench-360和Unseen NAS的17个任务上，AgentNAS在11个任务上达到新最优，超越包括任务特定专家设计在内的已发布基线。消融实验显示LLM种子和NAS搜索互补：种子单独已超过多数基线，NAS通过槽位组合搜索带来额外增益，且独立LLM样本无法复制此效果。
Conclusion: LLM与NAS的劳动力分工是鲁棒的，能提升NAS的自动化程度和性能。

papers.title: 3100 Opinions on Code Review in an AI World: Building Causal Theory from Practitioner Discourse
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents now author entire pull requests, and practitioners sharply disagree about what this does to code review: whether it becomes the bottleneck, whether human review is still necessary, and whether it quietly erodes the understanding that it once built. Repository-mining studies measure surface trends but seldom explain the mechanisms beneath them, and the trends themselves prove unstable. A motivating observational analysis of public GITHUB activity finds that agent-authored pull requests are reviewed less often, merged several times faster, and discussed less than human-authored ones, yet the direction of these trends flips under different but equally defensible analysis choices, so the traces establish what is changing without explaining why. To recover the mechanisms, we synthesize practitioner discourse at scale into an explanatory theory: we collect 38,709 grey-literature documents (engineering blogs and Reddit threads), filter to those substantively about code review, and code a stratified random sample of 3,100 with an LLM-assisted pipeline, from which we build a causal model of 26 constructs and 67 relationships (64 directed, 3 contested). Its organizing claim is that review is the control point through which a coding agent's effect on software is decided, and that AI does not fix the sign of that effect: the team sets it, through the expertise its humans bring and how it structures the review process. The theory makes the competing positions explicit and turns "AI is changing code review" into falsifiable propositions with named constructs and moderators. As a secondary contribution, we offer the underlying LLM-assisted, grey-literature theory-building method as a scalable template for software-engineering research, with a public implementation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过分析3,100条关于AI生成代码审查的从业者话语，构建了一个因果理论模型，包含26个构造和67个关系，解释AI如何改变代码审查过程。研究发现，AI代码审查的效果取决于团队的专业知识和审查流程设计，而非AI本身。
Motivation: 现有研究通过仓库挖掘测量表面趋势，但无法解释机制，且趋势不稳定。需要从从业者话语中提炼因果理论，理解AI对代码审查的深层影响。
Method: 收集38,709份灰色文献（工程博客和Reddit帖子），过滤出与代码审查相关的内容，使用LLM辅助流水线对3,100个样本进行编码，构建包含26个构造和67个关系的因果模型。
Result: 发现AI生成的拉取请求审查频率更低、合并速度更快、讨论更少，但趋势因分析选择而异。核心主张是代码审查是控制AI影响软件效果的关键点，效果由团队专业知识和审查流程决定。
Conclusion: 将竞争性立场转化为可证伪的命题，并提供了一种可扩展的灰色文献理论构建方法。

papers.title: A Quantum Reservoir Architecture for Chaotic Forecasting and a Test of Whether Its High Dimension Helps
papers.abstract_en: Quantum reservoir computing uses a fixed quantum circuit as a feature generator and trains only a simple linear readout on top of it. This makes it cheap to train and free of the optimisation problems that affect many quantum machine-learning models. A natural worry is that the very large feature space the circuit produces might inflate apparent performance without adding anything real. This paper provides two things. First, it gives a complete, reproducible recipe for one such reservoir applied to forecasting chaotic systems, including how data is fed in, how the circuit is built, and how the readout is trained. Second, it gives a way to tell whether the reservoir's high dimension is actually doing useful work. We grow the size of the prediction problem and the size of the quantum reservoir together, so that extra capacity cannot be the explanation for any improvement, and we track a single stability number that measures how well behaved the readout fit is. On two chaotic test systems, a spatiotemporal chain and a shallow-water fluid model, the quantum reservoir keeps a flat, stable error as both sizes grow, while a matched classical reservoir does not. We report where the classical baseline is in fact stronger, so the comparison is honest. The result is a clean specification plus a diagnostic that other groups can apply to any reservoir whose features have a known scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种量子储层计算（quantum reservoir computing）架构用于混沌系统预测，并通过同步增大问题规模和储层维度的方法，测试高维特征空间是否真正提升了性能。在两个混沌系统（时空链和浅水模型）上，量子储层的误差保持平坦稳定，而匹配的经典储层则不然。文中还提供了完整的可复现实现细节和一个诊断指标。
Motivation: 量子储层计算在训练成本低且无优化问题的同时，其庞大的特征空间可能带来虚假的性能提升；需要一种方法来评估高维度是否真正有效。
Method: 采用固定量子电路作为特征生成器，仅训练简单的线性读出层；通过同时增大预测问题规模和量子储层大小，使额外容量不能解释任何改进，并跟踪一个稳定数（stability number）衡量读出拟合的良性程度。
Result: 在时空链和浅水模型上，量子储层在问题规模和储层大小增长时保持平坦的稳定误差，而匹配的经典储层误差上升；同时报告了经典基线更强的场景以确保比较的诚实性。
Conclusion: 提供了量子储层用于混沌预测的完整实现方案和经验诊断方法，可用于其他具有已知尺度特征的储层。强调了高维特征空间在特定条件下确实有用，但并非在所有情况下都优于经典方法。

papers.title: When Implausible Tokens Get Reinforced: Tail-Aware Credit Calibration for LLM Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has achieved remarkable success in enhancing the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). However, widely used critic-free RL methods rely on uniform credit assignment, broadcasting the same advantage to all tokens regardless of their differences. We identify a critical failure mode of this design, which we refer to as Positive-Credit Contamination: low-probability tail tokens that are contextually erroneous receive identical positive credit to plausible ones within the same trajectory, resulting in the indiscriminate reinforcement of flawed reasoning behavior. To mitigate this issue, we propose Tail-Aware Credit calibratiOn (TACO), a method that calibrates uniform credit assignment to suppress undesirable positive updates. TACO first computes a tail-risk score that incorporates the local generation context to assess each token's risk of falling into the unreliable tail, distinguishing unexpected rarity from uncertainty-driven exploration. TACO then uses this score to tune positive credit for risky tokens without removing their gradients entirely, so that recurring useful rare patterns can accumulate reinforcement while incidental noise is progressively dampened. Experimental results across three LLMs and eight benchmarks show that TACO consistently outperforms GRPO-style baselines. Notably, TACO improves training stability, supporting sustained performance gains in long-horizon RL. The source code is available at: https://github.com/xiuyilou/TACO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现LLM强化学习中统一信用分配导致低概率尾词被强化的问题，提出Tail-Aware Credit Calibration (TACO)方法，通过计算尾风险分数调整正信用，实验表明优于GRPO基线并提升训练稳定性。
Motivation: 常用无批评者RL方法对所有token分配相同优势，导致上下文错误的低概率尾词被不当强化，产生Positive-Credit Contamination问题。
Method: 提出TACO方法，首先计算结合局部生成上下文的尾风险分数，评估每个token落入不可靠尾部的风险，然后用该分数调整风险token的正信用，保留有用稀有模式，抑制偶然噪声。
Result: 在三个LLM和八个基准上，TACO一致优于GRPO风格基线，并改善长期训练稳定性。
Conclusion: 本文提出TACO方法有效缓解统一信用分配导致的尾词正污染问题，提升RL训练稳定性。

papers.title: Orthogonality of coastal trapped waves
papers.abstract_en: Coastal trapped wave modes are shown to be orthogonal in the sense that they make independent contributions to the energy of the wave field. The hydrostatic Boussinesq dynamics on an $f$-plane, linearized around a state of rest, are formulated as a (generalized) Schrödinger equation, which exposes the Hermitian structure of the wave operator that implies the orthogonality of eigenmodes. This formulation, which becomes particularly simple in weak form, is parlayed into a finite-element discretization that preserves the symmetries of the original problem and therefore the energy conservation and orthogonality of modes. The geostrophic momentum approximation, under which the orthogonality of modes has been recognized previously, is reprised and discussed in the present context to emphasize that low-frequency coastal trapped waves are edge waves. Their dynamics are governed by boundary potential-vorticity anomalies, both Bretherton-type contributions familiar from the quasi-geostrophic equations and lateral contributions that are important for steep slopes and coastal walls.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明了海岸俘获波模态在能量贡献上是正交的。通过将静力Boussinesq动力学表述为广义Schrödinger方程，揭示了波算子的Hermite结构，从而自然导致模态正交性。该弱形式表述可用于保持原始问题对称性的有限元离散，以保持能量守恒和模态正交性。还讨论了地转动量近似，指出低频海岸俘获波是边缘波，其动力学由边界位势涡度异常控制。
Motivation: 海岸俘获波的模态正交性此前未被严格证明，而这对于理解波动能量独立贡献以及数值离散保持物理特性至关重要。
Method: 将线性化的静力Boussinesq动力学表示为广义Schrödinger方程，利用Hermite算子结构导出模态正交性，并推广到有限元离散以保持对称性和能量守恒。
Result: 理论证明海岸俘获波模态在能量意义下正交；地转动量近似下低频波为边缘波，受边界位势涡度异常驱动。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了海岸俘获波正交性的严格数学基础，并为保结构数值离散奠定了基础。

papers.title: A Multi-cluster Boundary Learning Method for Out-of-Scope Intent Detection via MiniLM Embedding
papers.abstract_en: Intent detection is a critical task that bridges human intents and system actions in human-machine interaction systems. However, there still exist challenges for detecting out-of-scope (OOS) intents. (i) The traditional methods view the OOS intent detection as a multi-class classification, then the detection accuracy decreases as the class number of the known intents increases; (ii) LLM-embedding methods require large parameters, that makes them difficult to train and practically deploy. Thus, this work proposes a multi-cluster boundary learning method to detect OOS intents via MiniLM embedding (i.e., all-MiniLM-L6-v2) in an one-class classification workflow. The method learns the boundaries of multi-cluster embeddings generated by MiniLM from the training utterances, and then rejects the out-of-domain utterances as OOS intents. Experiments are conducted on public CLINC150, StackOverflow and Banking77 datasets. The results show that the method achieves the state-of-the-art OOS intent detection performance compared the other baselines. Ablation studies are also conducted and the results show that the used MiniLM can better adapt to the workflow and utterance embedding requirements. The code is available at supplementary materials.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于MiniLM嵌入的多簇边界学习方法，用于在单分类工作流中检测超出范围（OOS）意图。该方法学习MiniLM生成的嵌入的多簇边界，拒绝域外话语作为OOS意图。在CLINC150、StackOverflow和Banking77数据集上达到最先进的OOS检测性能。
Motivation: 传统OOS意图检测方法在已知意图类别增多时精度下降，而LLM嵌入方法参数大、难训练和部署。本文旨在提供一种轻量且高效的OOS检测方法。
Method: 提出多簇边界学习方法，使用all-MiniLM-L6-v2嵌入生成训练话语的嵌入，学习多簇边界，并在推理时根据是否位于边界内判断是否为OOS意图。
Result: 在CLINC150、StackOverflow和Banking77数据集上，该方法相比其他基线取得了最先进的OOS检测性能。消融实验表明MiniLM能更好地适应工作流和话语嵌入需求。
Conclusion: 基于MiniLM的多簇边界学习是一种有效的OOS意图检测方法，兼顾性能与部署效率。

papers.title: Expressivity and Statistical Trade-offs in Diffusion Policy Learning
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based policies have recently emerged as powerful policy parameterizations for reinforcement learning, representing state-conditioned action distributions as terminal laws of diffusion processes with parameterized drifts. This terminal-law representation has shown substantial expressive flexibility in practice, enabling diffusion policies to model complex, multimodal, and highly non-Gaussian action distributions; however, it remains unclear what mathematically drives this expressivity and how to fully exploit it when the policy is learned from finite data. In this paper, we identify the drift Lipschitz budget $K$ as a central quantity governing the expressivity and statistical behavior of diffusion policies. We quantify expressivity through approximation: diffusion policies with $K$-Lipschitz drifts can concentrate near optimal deterministic policies and achieve value approximation error of order $1/K$; moreover, we prove a matching lower bound under nondegenerate diffusion noise. This increased expressivity comes with a statistical cost. When the drift is parameterized by neural networks, increasing $K$ improves approximation but increases statistical complexity. Balancing these two terms yields a finite-sample performance gap of order $\tilde{O}(n^{-2/(m+6)})$ for generic neural-network drifts, and a sharper rate $\tilde{O}(n^{-2/(m+4)})$ for one-sided dissipative drift classes, where $n$ is the sample size and $m$ is the dimension of the state space. Numerical experiments provide empirical evidence for the sample-dependent trade-off in $K$, supporting both theoretical regimes. Our framework also suggests a practical implementation principle: choose the diffusion budget $K$ according to the available sample size, and then select a neural-network architecture with the corresponding fixed Lipschitz coefficient.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究扩散策略（diffusion policy）在强化学习中的表达能力与统计权衡，将漂移Lipschitz预算K作为核心量，证明K- Lipschitz漂移的扩散策略可实现阶为1/K的价值近似误差，并匹配下界；同时分析有限样本下的性能差距，给出神经网络参数化下的收敛率，数值实验支持理论发现。
Motivation: 扩散策略已在实际中展现出强大的表达能力，但数学上驱动表达能力的机制及其在有限数据下的统计行为尚不明确。
Method: 通过漂移Lipschitz预算K量化表达性与统计行为，建立近似误差上界与下界，并分析神经网络参数化下的有限样本性能，提出根据样本量选择K的实用原则。
Result: 理论表明：扩散策略价值近似误差为O(1/K)；通用神经网络漂移下的有限样本性能差距为Õ(n^{-2/(m+6)})，一类耗散漂移下可改进至Õ(n^{-2/(m+4)})。
Conclusion: 扩散策略的表达能力与统计复杂度之间存在权衡，应依据样本量选择适当的Lipschitz预算K，以优化整体性能。

papers.title: KronQ: LLM Quantization via Kronecker-Factored Hessian
papers.abstract_en: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is a widely adopted technique for compressing large language models (LLMs) without retraining. Existing second-order PTQ methods, including GPTQ, construct quantization objectives exclusively from input activation statistics, effectively assuming that all output channels contribute equally to the layer-wise reconstruction objective. We propose KronQ, a PTQ framework that challenges this assumption by introducing the gradient covariance into the quantization pipeline. Under the Kronecker-factored Hessian approximation, the quantization loss depends jointly on both the activation and gradient covariances, and KronQ exploits this at two complementary levels. (1) KronQ introduces bidirectional incoherence processing, extending the existing input-side random rotation to the output dimension using the gradient covariance, reducing weight magnitude variance across both input and output dimensions. (2) KronQ derives a new sensitivity metric for inter-layer mixed-precision allocation, driven by the gradient and activation Hessian traces. Notably, in the case of 2-bit weight-only quantization on LLaMA-3-70B, while GPTQ and GPTAQ diverge or produce degenerate quantizations (>2000 perplexity on WikiText-2), KronQ achieves 7.93 perplexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KronQ是一种基于Kronecker因子分解Hessian矩阵的大语言模型后训练量化框架。它引入梯度协方差改进量化目标，通过双向非相干处理和新的敏感度指标实现混合精度分配。在LLaMA-3-70B的2比特量化上，KronQ达到了7.93困惑度，而GPTQ等方法发散。
Motivation: 现有二阶PTQ方法（如GPTQ）仅利用激活统计信息，假设所有输出通道对重构目标贡献相等，忽略了梯度协方差，导致量化性能受限。
Method: KronQ利用Kronecker因子分解Hessian近似，同时考虑激活和梯度协方差。它提出双向非相干处理，将输入侧随机旋转扩展到输出维度，并基于梯度与激活Hessian迹计算新的敏感度指标用于混合精度分配。
Result: 在LLaMA-3-70B的2比特仅权重量化中，GPTQ和GPTAQ发散（WikiText-2困惑度>2000），而KronQ达到7.93困惑度。
Conclusion: 引入梯度协方差改进量化目标，在极端低位宽下保持性能，展示了对现有PTQ方法的优势。

papers.title: Beyond Thermal Imaging: Inferring Thermophysical Properties from Time-Resolved Thermal Observations
papers.abstract_en: Inferring latent physical properties from sensory observations is a fundamental challenge in machine perception. Among available sensing modalities, thermal imaging is particularly promising because temperature evolution is directly governed by heat-transfer physics and therefore encodes information about underlying thermophysical properties of a scene. Recovering spatially resolved thermophysical properties from thermal observations could transform applications ranging from digital twins and infrastructure monitoring to robotics and scientific imaging. However, existing thermal scene reconstruction methods can recover temperature fields in complex 3D environments without identifying the thermophyiscal properties that govern thermal evolution, whereas inverse methods provide physically interpretable parameter estimation but typically rely on simplified geometries and controlled experimental conditions. Here we introduce ThermoField, a framework that unifies thermal scene reconstruction and thermophysical parameter estimation through differentiable heat-transfer simulation. The proposed framework represents these quantities as spatially varying neural fields and constrains them through scene geometry, governing heat-transfer physics, and temporal thermal observations. We demonstrate that ThermoField jointly reconstructs geometry, estimates spatially varying thermal diffusivity, and predicts thermal evolution under previously unseen environmental conditions. By integrating neural scene representations with differentiable heat-transfer solver, the framework enables physically interpretable parameter inference in complex 3D scenes. Our results establish a bridge between thermal scene reconstruction and inverse heat-transfer analysis, providing a unified approach for geometry reconstruction, thermophysical property estimation, and predictive thermal simulation from thermal observations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ThermoField 框架，通过可微分热传导仿真，从时间分辨热观测中联合重建三维几何、估计空间变化的热扩散率，并预测未知环境下的热演化。该框架统一了热场景重建与热物理参数估计，为数字孪生、基础设施监测等应用提供物理可解释的推断。
Motivation: 现有热场景重建方法能恢复温度场，但无法识别控制热演化的热物理性质；而逆方法虽能估计物性参数，却依赖简化几何和受控实验条件。缺乏在复杂三维场景中同时重建几何与估计物性参数的统一方法。
Method: ThermoField 将几何、热扩散率等量表示为空间变化的神经场，并通过可微分热传导求解器，用场景几何、热传导物理和时序热观测共同约束这些场，实现联合优化。
Result: 论文展示 ThermoField 能联合重建几何、估计空间变化的热扩散率，并在未见环境条件下预测热演化。该方法在复杂三维场景中实现了物理可解释的参数推断。

papers.title: Evaluating the Effect of Frame Rate in Sequence-Based Classification of Autism-Related Self-Stimulatory Hand Idiosyncrasies
papers.abstract_en: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) affects over 75 million individuals worldwide, yet scalable computational methods for remote behavioral screening remain limited. This study addresses two complementary challenges in automated detection of autism-related self-stimulatory behaviors from video: (1) identifying the optimal sequence-based neural network architecture and temporal sampling rate, and (2) characterizing data augmentation strategies for training on small behavioral datasets. For the first objective, long short-term memory (LSTM) and gated recurrent unit (GRU) models were trained on pose-derived features from the Self-Stimulatory Behavior Diagnosis (SSBD) dataset at frame sampling intervals of 1, 5, 15, 30, 45, and 90 frames. Both architectures exceeded prior convolutional neural network (CNN) baselines (62-76% accuracy), with peak accuracies of 97.5% (LSTM) and 98.75% (GRU) at a sampling interval of every 15 frames. For the second objective, ten data augmentation strategies were applied to an I3D transfer learning pipeline, with an ablation study quantifying the marginal contribution of each technique. Horizontal flip achieved the highest standalone accuracy (48.78%), while exclusion of upsampling from the augmentation pipeline produced the largest performance degradation, indicating its necessity for complex behavioral video augmentation. A personalized machine learning approach, in which per-subject models were trained and tested on temporally split segments of each video, produced consistent predictions (mean loss 1.84, SD 0.79). These results provide practitioners with concrete guidance on architecture selection, sampling rate, and augmentation strategy for video-based behavioral classification in data-scarce clinical domains.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Preliminary version presented as a poster at the AMIA 2024 Informatics Summit
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本论文研究了基于视频的自闭症相关自我刺激行为分类中帧率的影响，比较了LSTM和GRU在不同帧采样间隔下的性能，并探索了数据增强策略。在SSBD数据集上，GRU在15帧间隔时达到98.75%的最高准确率。消融实验表明水平翻转和上采样对性能至关重要。
Motivation: 自闭症谱系障碍影响广泛，但远程行为筛查的计算方法有限，特别是在视频帧率选择和序列模型架构方面缺乏系统指导。
Method: 使用SSBD数据集，从视频中提取姿态特征，分别训练LSTM和GRU模型，测试1、5、15、30、45、90帧的采样间隔。另外，对I3D迁移学习管道应用十种数据增强策略并进行消融研究。
Result: LSTM和GRU均超过此前CNN基线（62-76%），在15帧间隔时达到最高准确率（LSTM 97.5%, GRU 98.75%）。数据增强中，水平翻转独立准确率最高（48.78%），省略上采样会导致性能最大下降。个性化模型平均损失1.84。
Conclusion: 该研究为数据稀缺的临床视频行为分类提供了架构选择、采样率和数据增强策略的具体指导。

papers.title: Linear Attention Architectures: Mechanisms, Trade-offs, and Cross-Layer Routing
papers.abstract_en: Self-attention lets each token retrieve information from the full context, but its quadratic cost in sequence length limits training and inference at long context. This paper presents a comparative study of softmax attention and four recent recurrent linear-attention architectures: DeltaNet, Gated DeltaNet, Kimi Delta Attention, and Gated DeltaNet-2. We express these mechanisms in a common recurrent-memory notation, making explicit how they differ in expressivity, memory decay, erase and write control, training throughput, and implementation complexity. Our experiments center on 350M-parameter models trained for 15B tokens, and include optimizer and learning-rate comparisons, hybrid-versus-pure stack comparisons, sequence-length runtime measurements, larger DeltaNet runs at 1.3B and 3B parameters, and a small set of downstream evaluations. The reported speed results measure training throughput and iteration time; we do not provide an empirical inference-speed benchmark. Within the reported 350M-parameter, 15B-token sweep, Kimi Delta Attention with Muon reaches the lowest final validation loss, a pure Gated DeltaNet stack trained with AdamW has the highest normalized training throughput, hybrid stacks generally improve loss at a throughput cost, and Muon consistently lowers final validation loss relative to AdamW in the matched architecture settings we evaluate. We introduce and evaluate lightweight cross-layer routing mechanisms for DeltaNet-style memories. The most natural DeltaNet-inspired formulation, forwarding a lower layer's delta-rule write error into the next layer's value target, does not improve over matched baselines. Routing into the aligned hidden stream and forwarding the write value instead yields a modest improvement in the matched runs we report: Cross-Layer Value Routing (CLVR) lowers final validation loss for both DeltaNet and Gated DeltaNet.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables. Code available at https://github.com/tommasocerruti/linear-attention-architectures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较了softmax注意力与四种近期循环线性注意力架构（DeltaNet, Gated DeltaNet, Kimi Delta Attention, Gated DeltaNet-2）。作者以统一的循环记忆表示描述这些机制，并在350M参数、15B token的训练设置下进行实验，包括优化器对比、混合堆叠、序列长度运行时测量以及更大规模模型（1.3B和3B参数）的扩展。研究还引入了轻量级跨层路由机制，发现跨层值路由（CLVR）能略微降低验证损失。
Motivation: 传统softmax注意力在长序列上计算复杂度为二次，限制了训练和推理效率；需探索更高效的线性注意力架构并理解其性能与实现复杂度的权衡。
Method: 提出统一的循环记忆记法来形式化四种线性注意力机制，并在350M参数、15B token的受控实验中比较不同优化器（AdamW, Muon）、纯堆叠与混合堆叠、序列长度扩展，同时设计并评估DeltaNet风格记忆的跨层路由变体（如跨层值路由CLVR）。
Result: 在350M/15B设置下，Kimi Delta Attention + Muon取得最低验证损失；纯Gated DeltaNet + AdamW训练吞吐量最高；混合堆叠改善损失但吞吐量下降；Muon相比AdamW一致降低验证损失。CLVR在DeltaNet和Gated DeltaNet上均小幅降低验证损失。
Conclusion: 该比较为线性注意力架构的选择提供了收益-成本参考，并表明跨层值路由是一种有潜力的改进方向，但更直接的路由方式（转发delta规则写错误）未见提升。

papers.title: Evaluating the Generalizability of Foundation Models for Extreme Environmental Events: Case Study of California Wildfire PM2.5
papers.abstract_en: Wildfire smoke events produce extreme PM$_{2.5}$ concentrations that pose severe public health risks, yet forecasting rare, hazardous-level spikes remains a fundamental challenge. Time series foundation models (TSFMs), pretrained models offering zero-shot inference and efficient adaptation, perform strongly on general benchmarks, but their behavior under extreme out-of-distribution conditions is poorly understood. We present the first systematic benchmark comparing six TSFM configurations (zero-shot TimesFM, Chronos-2, Moirai-2, and Time-MoE, plus LoRA fine-tuned Chronos-2 and Time-MoE) against fully-trained baselines (LSTM, BiLSTM, Transformer) and naive persistence on a 12-year (2013--2025) hourly PM$_{2.5}$ dataset covering 1,375 wildfire incidents across 79 California monitoring sites. A leave-one-incident-out (LOIO) protocol evaluates generalization to unseen fires, using MAE, RMSE, and exceedance F1 at EPA AQI thresholds across 6-, 12-, and 24-hour horizons. Results reveal a consistent hierarchy. The BiLSTM achieves the lowest MAE ($5.16\,μg/m^3$) and the highest exceedance F1 at every threshold, including the Hazardous band ($>225.5\,μg/m^3$), reaching 0.63 versus at most 0.54 for any foundation model. Zero-shot TSFMs improve on persistence only modestly, and zero-shot Chronos-2 exhibits severe RMSE tail instability ($23.4\,μg/m^3$, negative $R^2$) from sporadic large errors. LoRA fine-tuning substantially improves both adapted families and largely repairs this instability, yet no foundation model surpasses the trained recurrent baselines on any metric. These findings challenge the assumption that larger pretrained models universally dominate environmental forecasting and provide actionable deployment guidance for wildfire air quality prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了时间序列基础模型（TSFM）在极端野火PM2.5事件中的泛化能力。基于加州79个监测站12年的小时级数据，对比了零样本TimesFM、Chronos-2、Moirai-2、Time-MoE以及LoRA微调版本与训练基线（LSTM、BiLSTM、Transformer）和持久性模型。结果表明，BiLSTM在所有指标上全面优于TSFM，零样本Chronos-2出现严重的RMSE尾部不稳定，LoRA微调虽有改善但仍不及训练基线。
Motivation: 野火烟雾事件产生极端PM2.5浓度，但时间序列基础模型（TSFM）在罕见、危险级尖峰上的预测行为尚不明确，现有研究缺乏系统性评估。
Method: 构建包含1,375次野火事件的12年小时级PM2.5数据集，采用留一事件（LOIO）协议，对比六种TSFM配置（含零样本和LoRA微调）与全训练基线（LSTM、BiLSTM、Transformer）及持久性模型，在6、12、24小时预测窗口上评估MAE、RMSE和超阈值F1。
Result: BiLSTM取得最低MAE（5.16 μg/m³）和最高超阈值F1（危险等级0.63），而所有TSFM均未超越该基线；零样本Chronos-2的RMSE表现为23.4 μg/m³且R²为负值，LoRA微调修复了不稳定性但仍不及训练基线。
Conclusion: 结果挑战了更大预训练模型在环境预测中全面占优的假设，为野火空气质量预测提供了部署指导。

papers.title: DeepSWE: Measuring Frontier Coding Agents on Original, Long-Horizon Engineering Tasks
papers.abstract_en: DeepSWE is a benchmark of 113 original, long-horizon software engineering tasks for evaluating coding agents. Most public agentic coding benchmarks follow SWE-bench in mining merged fixes from public GitHub repositories, which creates two problems: the fixes and their discussion were likely seen during pretraining, so a high score can reflect recall rather than problem-solving; and each task is graded by the tests that shipped with its merged fix, which were written to confirm one specific fix rather than grade an arbitrary solution, so they can fail a correct alternative or pass an incomplete one. DeepSWE avoids both. Its tasks are written from scratch across 91 active open-source repositories and five languages and are never contributed back upstream, so their reference solutions stay out of the public record that model training scrapes; and each task is graded by a hand-written verifier that checks the requested functionality and accepts any implementation that provides it. When an independent LLM judge re-reviews graded runs, it disagrees with DeepSWE's verifier about an order of magnitude less often than with SWE-Bench Pro's inherited tests (1.4% versus 32.4%). Despite being about half the length of SWE-Bench Pro's prompts, DeepSWE's prompts describe tasks whose reference solutions touch 5.5x more code, and the benchmark separates frontier agents across a wider score band than the leaderboards on which they otherwise cluster. We release the benchmark, its verifiers, and the full record of evaluation trajectories.
papers.comment: 32 pages, 10 figures. Code and data: https://github.com/datacurve-ai/deep-swe ; https://deepswe.datacurve.ai/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeepSWE是一个包含113个原创、长周期软件工程任务的基准，用于评估前沿代码智能体。与从公开GitHub仓库挖掘合并修复的SWE-bench不同，DeepSWE的任务从零编写，参考解决方案不会出现在训练数据中，且每个任务由手动编写的验证器进行评分，接受任何实现所需功能的方案。独立LLM评审与DeepSWE验证器的一致率远高于SWE-Bench Pro（1.4% vs 32.4%）。任务提示长度约为SWE-Bench Pro的一半，但参考解决方案涉及5.5倍更多的代码，且能更有效地区分前沿智能体的性能。
Motivation: 现有代码智能体基准（如SWE-bench）存在两个问题：修复和讨论可能已被模型预训练看到，导致高分反映记忆而非问题解决能力；任务评分依赖合并修复附带的测试，可能误判正确或不完整的解决方案。
Method: 构建了113个原创软件工程任务，涉及91个活跃开源仓库和5种编程语言，任务不提交上游，参考解决方案不公开。每个任务由手动编写的验证器根据功能正确性评分。
Result: 独立LLM评审与DeepSWE验证器的不一致率仅1.4%，而SWE-Bench Pro为32.4%。DeepSWE任务提示长度约为SWE-Bench Pro的一半，但参考解决方案影响5.5倍更多的代码。基准能更广泛地分离前沿智能体的性能得分。
Conclusion: DeepSWE通过避免数据泄露和评分问题，提供了更可靠的代码智能体评估，揭示了现有基准中聚类现象。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: path_boost: A Python Package for Interpretable Graph-Level Prediction using Path-Based Gradient Boosting
papers.abstract_en: We present path_boost, a Python package for interpretable supervised learning on graph-structured input data. The package implements PathBoost, a gradient boosting algorithm that automatically discovers predictive labeled paths within graphs during the learning process. Unlike graph neural networks, which are generally difficult to interpret, PathBoost produces an additive prediction model over path-based features that explicitly reveals which substructures drive predictions. To avoid an exhaustive enumeration of all possible paths, the algorithm iteratively selects and extends paths during learning based on their predictive power, using boosting to combine weak learners into a strong ensemble. The package supports both regression and binary classification. Key features include compatibility with scikit-learn workflows, support for custom base learners and selectors, automatic starting node selection, parallel training across anchor nodes, and built-in variable importance computation. We demonstrate PathBoost on molecular property prediction of transition metal compounds, where atoms serve as nodes and bonds as edges, and further benchmark PathBoost against an established graph neural network and a graph kernel method across six molecular datasets. The package is available on PyPI and GitHub under an open-source license.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 path_boost，一个用于图结构数据可解释监督学习的 Python 包。它实现 PathBoost 梯度提升算法，在学习过程中自动发现预测性标记路径，生成基于路径特征的加性预测模型，显式揭示哪些子结构驱动预测。包支持回归和二分类，兼容 scikit-learn，提供自定义基学习器和选择器、自动起始节点选择、跨锚节点并行训练及内置变量重要性计算。在过渡金属化合物分子性质预测和六个分子数据集上对比图神经网络和图核方法。
Motivation: 图神经网络通常难以解释，而现有方法可能依赖枚举所有路径导致计算开销大。需要一种既能自动发现预测性子结构又保持可解释性的图学习方法。
Method: PathBoost 算法：梯度提升框架，迭代选择并扩展具有预测能力的路径，避免穷举所有路径；使用 boosting 组合弱学习器为强集成；支持回归和二分类；提供 scikit-learn 接口。
Result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，仅说明在过渡金属化合物分子性质预测以及六个分子数据集上与图神经网络和图核方法进行了对比。
Conclusion: PathBoost 提供了一种可解释的图级预测方法，通过路径特征显式解释预测，并在分子数据集上展现了竞争力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Adversarial Decoys: Misdirecting Attention-Based Defenses in ViT
papers.abstract_en: Vision Transformers (ViTs) remain vulnerable to localized adversarial attacks, e.g., adversarial patches, while recent test-time defenses mitigate them by suppressing image tokens with abnormally high attention scores. These defenses exploit a strong coupling between attention and adversarial effectiveness: adversarial tokens often need to attract substantial attention to influence the prediction. We introduce adversarial decoys, independently optimized image patches that redirect the attention, and therefore related defenses, toward selected target tokens. Rather than jointly optimizing misclassifications and defense evasion, our approach decouples the two objectives: the original adversarial region induces the incorrect prediction, while a separate decoy manipulates the attention ranking used by the defense. A layer-wise objective increases target-token attention and promotes these tokens above competing non-target ones. Since the decoy is optimized independently of the underlying attack, the method is attack-agnostic and can be easily integrated with any existing adversarial patch attack. Experiments on ImageNet across multiple ViT architectures and attacks show that decoys can redirect high attention scores away from the true adversarial region while preserving much of the attack effectiveness. These results reveal a fundamental limitation of using attention magnitude as an indicator of adversarial relevance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对Vision Transformers (ViTs)容易受到局部对抗攻击（如对抗贴片）的问题，现有防御方法通过抑制注意力分数异常高的图像token来缓解攻击。本文提出对抗诱饵（adversarial decoys），即独立优化的图像贴片，用于将注意力及依赖注意力的防御引向选定的目标token，从而绕过防御。该方法将误分类和防御逃逸两目标解耦，可集成到任何现有对抗贴片攻击中。实验表明，诱饵能有效将高注意力分数从真正对抗区域转移，同时保持攻击有效性，揭示了基于注意力大小作为对抗相关性指标的局限性。
Motivation: 现有基于注意力的测试时防御利用对抗token需要高注意力才能影响预测这一强耦合特性，但缺乏对注意力的可控重定向方法。本文旨在揭示这种防御的根本局限。
Method: 提出对抗诱饵，独立优化的图像贴片，通过层目标函数增加目标token注意力并使其超过非目标token，实现注意力重定向。攻击无关，可集成任意对抗贴片攻击。
Result: 在ImageNet上多个ViT架构和攻击下，诱饵能将高注意力分数从真正对抗区域转移，同时保持攻击有效性。
Conclusion: 揭示了使用注意力大小作为对抗相关性指标的根本局限性，表明当前防御存在漏洞。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Efficient Safety Alignment of Language Models via Latent Personality Traits
papers.abstract_en: Current safety methods for large language models are known to be vulnerable to adversarial attacks, motivating research into robust alternatives. Latent Adversarial Training (LAT) is among the most effective defenses, but can degrade utility and requires training on large datasets of harmful prompts. We introduce Latent Personality Alignment (LPA), which replaces explicit harm refusal with adversarial training on just 66 harm-agnostic statements drawn from psychometric personality literature. We hypothesize that personality-anchored representations share latent structure with harm avoidance, so adversarially stabilizing them implicitly constrains the subspace exploited by jailbreak attacks. LPA achieves near-zero attack success rates on HarmBench across direct requests and five jailbreak methods, despite never seeing harmful content during training and no loss of performance on standard benchmarks. Moreover, the training process is lightweight; the entire procedure completes in minutes on a single GPU and uses 75x fewer examples than standard LAT. Extensive ablations demonstrate the robustness, efficiency, and generalization of our method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Latent Personality Alignment (LPA) 方法，利用仅 66 条来自人格心理学的无伤害陈述进行对抗训练，替代传统的基于有害提示的对抗训练。该方法在 HarmBench 上对直接请求和五种越狱攻击实现接近零的攻击成功率，且不降低标准基准性能。训练过程轻量，单 GPU 数分钟完成，所需示例数比标准 LAT 少 75 倍。
Motivation: 现有安全方法易受对抗攻击，Latent Adversarial Training (LAT) 虽有效但会降低效用且需要大量有害提示数据，因此需要更高效且无害的替代方案。
Method: 提出 Latent Personality Alignment (LPA)，通过人格心理学中 66 条与伤害无关的陈述进行对抗训练，稳定模型的人格锚定表示，从而隐式约束越狱攻击利用的子空间。
Result: 在 HarmBench 上，LPA 对直接请求和五种越狱方法均实现接近零的攻击成功率，且在标准基准上无性能损失。训练仅需单 GPU 数分钟，示例数比标准 LAT 减少 75 倍。
Conclusion: LPA 提供了一种轻量、鲁棒且高效的安全对齐方法，无需有害内容输入，具有良好的泛化能力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Persona Cartography: Charting Language Model Personality Traits in Weight Space
papers.abstract_en: Large language models exhibit recurring behavioural patterns -- personas -- that shape generalisation and safety, but we lack reliable tools for decomposing, measuring, and controlling them. Our central insight is to treat personas as positions in a space of behavioural traits, using the OCEAN framework to describe model personas in terms of Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness, and Neuroticism. We train low-rank adapters to amplify or suppress individual traits, and evaluate their effects using an LLM-judge calibrated against a human-validated panel, trait-specific multiple-choice benchmarks, and standard capability evaluations. Across six models from three families (4B-32B), we find that each adapter moves its target trait largely monotonically with scale, combines approximately additively with other adapters to construct mixed personas, and preserves performance on capability benchmarks at moderate scales. We further show that the induced trait axes affect safety-relevant behaviour in downstream evaluations: for example, moving along neuroticism and agreeableness axes affects frustration and sycophancy respectively. We also introduce an unsupervised psychometric pipeline that recovers four interpretable behavioural factors (tone, initiative, didacticism, epistemic caution) from model rollouts. Persona control can then be considered in terms of learning, scaling, and composing traits in weight space, providing a bridge between personality measurement, model editing, and safety.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将大语言模型的行为模式（persona）视为OCEAN人格特质空间中的位置，通过训练低秩适配器（LoRA）来放大或抑制特定特质，并发现适配器对特质的影响具有单调性、可加性，且在中规模下不损害能力。还引入无监督心理测量管线，从模型输出中恢复出四个可解释的行为因子。该方法连接了人格测量、模型编辑和安全控制。
Motivation: 大语言模型展现出重复的行为模式（persona），影响泛化和安全，但缺乏可靠的工具来分解、测量和控制这些模式。
Method: 将人格特质映射到OCEAN框架，训练低秩适配器来放大或抑制开放、尽责、外向、宜人、神经质特质。使用LLM评判员（校准过的人类验证面板）、特质特异性多选题基准和能力评估来评估效果。
Result: 在六个模型（4B-32B）上，每个适配器对目标特质的影响随规模大致单调，适配器之间近似可加地组合以构建混合人格，在中规模下保持能力基准性能。沿着神经质和宜人轴移动分别影响挫败感和谄媚行为。
Conclusion: 人格控制可以在权重空间中通过学习、缩放和组合特质来实现，为性格测量、模型编辑和安全之间搭建桥梁。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multimodal Unlearning Across Vision, Language, Video, and Audio: Survey of Methods, Datasets, and Benchmarks
papers.abstract_en: With the growing adoption of VLMs, DMs, LLMs, and AFMs, these multimodal foundation models can inadvertently encode sensitive, copyrighted, biased, or unsafe cross-modal associations that originate from their training data. Retraining after deletion requests or policy updates is often impractical, and targeted forgetting remains difficult because knowledge is distributed across shared representations. Multimodal unlearning addresses this challenge by enabling selective removal across modalities while retaining overall utility. This survey offers a unified, system-oriented view of multimodal unlearning across vision, language, audio, and video, grounded in recent advances, emerging applications, and open problems. Our taxonomy enables systematic comparison across model architectures and modalities, clarifying trade-offs among deletion strength, retention, efficiency, reversibility, and robustness. This survey highlights open problems and practical considerations to support future research and deployment of multimodal unlearning. We release a curated repository: https://smsnobin77.github.io/Awesome-Multimodal-Unlearning/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了多模态遗忘（multimodal unlearning）在视觉、语言、视频和音频领域的方法、数据集和基准。随着多模态基础模型的广泛应用，训练数据中嵌入的敏感、版权、偏见或不安全的跨模态关联需要选择性移除，而重训练成本高昂。该综述提供了一个统一的系统视角，基于最新的进展和开放问题，提出了分类法以比较不同模型架构和模态间的遗忘强度、保留度、效率、可逆性和鲁棒性。
Motivation: 多模态基础模型可能从训练数据中无意编码了敏感或有害的跨模态关联，而重新训练不切实际，定向遗忘因知识分布在共享表示中而困难。多模态遗忘旨在选择性移除特定信息同时保持模型整体效用，但缺乏统一视角。
Method: 通过系统综述，构建了涵盖视觉、语言、音频、视频的多模态遗忘分类法，基于模型架构和模态进行对比，分析遗忘强度、保留度、效率、可逆性和鲁棒性等权衡。
Result: 总结了多模态遗忘的最新方法、数据集和基准，指出了开放问题和实际部署考虑。
Conclusion: 多模态遗忘是一个重要但充满挑战的领域，该综述为未来研究和部署提供了系统性的分类和实践指南。

papers.title: 3D Reconstruction of deciduous Trees using low-cost UAV- and Crane-based Photogrammetry for Monitoring Shoot Elongation across entire Canopies
papers.abstract_en: Tree growth determines how much CO2 is sequestered from the atmosphere and temporarily stored in woody biomass. At the same time tree growth is affected by increasing temperatures, more frequent drought periods, late frosts and other extreme events associated with climate change. While continuous measurements of radial (secondary) tree growth using dendrometers are well established, monitoring of shoot elongation (primary growth) has largely been neglected because suitable measurement techniques are lacking. As a result, the effects of climate change on primary tree growth remain insufficiently understood. This work aims at reconstructing native deciduous trees in 3D as a basis for measuring and monitoring shoot elongation over entire tree canopies. Here we explored the use of low-cost UAV photogrammetry and of a multi-camera CraneCam system under real-world conditions. Data were collected in two study areas over an entire growing season. We present sensor evaluations, photogrammetric data acquisition and processing strategies. A special focus is placed on the analysis of the resulting photogrammetric 3D point clouds in terms of accuracy, resolution and completeness. Results demonstrate 3D point accuracies of 5-6 mm for entire trees using consumer-grade UAVs weighing less than 250 g and a 3D reconstruction completeness between 92% and 98% depending on the UAV type. The paper introduces a novel 3Dprinted ground-truth branch to evaluate the capability to reconstructing fine-detail structures such as thin tree shoots. Finally, we discuss operational challenges and initial experiments towards a skeletonization of entire trees based on photogrammetric point clouds.
papers.comment: Accepted to ISPRS Congress 2026, camera-ready version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用低成本无人机摄影测量和多相机CraneCam系统，在真实条件下对落叶树进行3D重建，以监测整个树冠的枝条伸长（初级生长）。在两个研究区域、一个完整生长季采集数据，评估了传感器和数据处理策略。结果表明，使用低于250g的消费级无人机，整体树木3D点云精度达5-6毫米，重建完整度92%-98%。论文还引入3D打印地面真值分支评估细部结构重建，并讨论了从点云进行整树骨架化的初步实验。
Motivation: 树木径向生长（次级生长）已有成熟连续测量方法，但枝条伸长（初级生长）因缺乏合适技术而被忽视，导致气候变化对初级生长的影响理解不足。因此需要开发能够测量和监测整个树冠枝条伸长的方法。
Method: 采用低成本无人机（<250g消费级无人机）摄影测量和多相机CraneCam系统，在两个研究区域、整个生长季采集数据；设计了数据采集和处理策略，并开发了3D打印地面真值分支用于评估重建细部结构的能力。
Result: 整体树木3D点云精度达5-6毫米，重建完整度92%-98%（取决于无人机类型）。评估了传感器、点云精度、分辨率和完整度。
Conclusion: 展示了利用低成本无人机摄影测量进行树木3D重建的可行性，并能支持枝条伸长监测。讨论了操作挑战和基于摄影测量点云的整树骨架化初步实验。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mechanistic Interpretability of LLM Jailbreaks via Internal Attribution Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit remarkable capabilities but remain highly vulnerable to adversarial prompts and jailbreak attacks. Existing approaches primarily analyze these failures through input-output behaviors or attribution methods, offering limited insight into how adversarial perturbations alter the model's internal reasoning. Consequently, the mechanisms underlying unsafe or incorrect behaviors remain poorly understood. We introduce a mechanistic framework for diagnosing LLM vulnerabilities using paired internal computation graphs, which represent prompt-specific inference as structured causal interactions among latent features. By constructing and aligning computation graphs for clean and attacked prompts, we reveal that adversarial attacks induce systematic transformations of internal reasoning, including suppression of safety-relevant components, emergence of attack-specific features, and rerouting of computation paths. Building on this representation, we propose a unified framework that (i) decomposes computation into invariant, suppressed, and emergent structures, (ii) identifies recurring vulnerability motifs associated with failure modes, and (iii) performs causal interventions on nodes, paths, and subgraphs to directly evaluate their contributions to attack success. This enables a transition from descriptive attribution to causal diagnosis of model failures. Experiments across multiple open-source LLMs and diverse adversarial and jailbreak benchmarks demonstrate that structural deviations in internal computation graphs strongly correlate with unsafe behaviors. Furthermore, targeted interventions on identified vulnerability motifs improve model robustness, establishing internal computation graphs as a principled foundation for understanding, diagnosing, and mitigating LLM vulnerabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于内部计算图的机制可解释性框架，用于诊断大语言模型（LLM）的越狱攻击（jailbreak attacks）。通过对比正常提示和攻击提示下的计算图，发现攻击会抑制安全相关组件、涌现攻击特定特征并重路由计算路径。实验显示计算图的结构偏差与不安全行为强相关，针对脆弱性基序（vulnerability motifs）的因果干预可提升模型鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有方法主要通过输入输出行为或归因方法分析LLM失败，缺乏对对抗性扰动如何改变模型内部推理机制的深入理解。
Method: 构建并对齐干净提示和攻击提示的内部计算图，将计算分解为不变、抑制和涌现结构，识别重复出现的脆弱性基序，并对节点、路径和子图进行因果干预评估。
Result: 在多个开源LLM和多种越狱基准上，实验表明计算图的结构偏差与不安全行为强相关；针对脆弱性基序的定向干预改善了模型鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 内部计算图为理解、诊断和缓解LLM脆弱性提供了原则性基础，实现了从描述性归因到因果诊断的转变。

papers.title: Closed-Loop Dynamic Validator Node Scaling in Private Substrate Blockchains Using Takagi-Sugeno Fuzzy Inference
papers.abstract_en: Private blockchain networks run with fixed node configurations that cannot adapt to changing workload conditions. Too many nodes serving a light workload waste resources; too few nodes facing heavy demand slow block production and degrade finalisation. The right validator count is hard to determine, as it depends on overlapping factors that shift over time. This paper presents a Takagi-Sugeno (TS) fuzzy inference system that reads live blockchain parameters (block production time, block size, and active node count) and outputs a continuous efficiency score alongside a scaling recommendation: Scale Up, Maintain, or Scale Down. The controller uses triangular membership functions across three linguistic variables, evaluated through a complete 27-rule base with product t-norm aggregation. A key contribution is an empirical recalibration of the membership functions, anchoring linguistic terms to the observed operating range of the testbed rather than to theoretical extremes. The system is evaluated on a 10-node Substrate blockchain network storing real smart water meter data hashes from the Queensland Government open data portal. Statistical analysis across configurations of 4, 7, and 10 active nodes confirms that the controller produces distinct operational profiles reflecting each configuration's provisioning state. In closed-loop experiments, the controller autonomously adjusts validator participation in both directions, activating validators under rising load and removing them under over-provisioning, converging to the same stable equilibrium from both directions. Compared against three threshold-based baselines, it shows fewer scaling oscillations while maintaining comparable block production times. Results show that TS fuzzy inference can support autonomous validator management in private blockchain deployments, with stable scaling behaviour threshold approaches cannot match.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对私有区块链网络中固定节点配置无法适应工作负载变化的问题，提出基于Takagi-Sugeno模糊推理的动态验证节点缩放控制器。控制器读取区块生成时间、区块大小和活跃节点数，输出效率评分和缩放建议（扩容、保持、缩容）。通过在10节点Substrate区块链上存储真实智能水表数据哈希的实验，验证了控制器在不同配置下的有效性和稳定性，相比阈值基线减少了缩放振荡。
Motivation: 私有区块链网络使用固定节点配置，无法适应工作负载变化：节点过多浪费资源，节点过少降低出块速度和最终性。确定合适的验证节点数量困难，因为依赖于随时间变化的多种因素。
Method: 提出基于Takagi-Sugeno模糊推理的闭环控制器，使用三角隶属函数和27条规则库（乘积t范数聚合），并经验性地重新校准隶属函数以匹配测试床实际运行范围。控制器根据三个输入（区块生成时间、区块大小、活跃节点数）输出效率评分和缩放建议。
Result: 在10节点Substrate区块链上，使用4、7、10个活跃节点的统计对比确认控制器产生不同的运行轮廓。闭环实验中，控制器能双向自动调整验证节点参与数量（负载增加时激活节点，过度供应时移除节点），并从两个方向收敛到相同的稳定平衡。与三种阈值基线相比，缩放振荡更少，同时保持相当的区块生成时间。
Conclusion: 结果表明，TS模糊推理能够支持私有区块链部署中的自主验证节点管理，其稳定缩放行为是阈值方法无法比拟的。
